title: Aalto
content:
Aalto is a Finnish word meaning "wave".
Aalto’s Chinese name 秋水 (qiūshuǐ) means "autumn water". It can also be used as an adjective for something clear or translucent.

title: Aalto/Backstory
content:
2023-09-26

Aalto is a Congenital Resonator. He was born in the New Federation amidst a rare fog that had not been seen for years.

title: Aalto/Backstory
section: A Street Magician that Brings Joy
content:
Aalto often entertains those with a long face with his magic tricks. In those performances, he shapes little animals with the mist created by his Forte, bringing joy to his audience. Sometimes they take the form of cute bunnies, other times majestic falcons, and even Encore's woolies.
He is flexible like mist and sensitive like air. Aalto can read others' feelings, enveloping them in a lighthearted atmosphere, much like mist. Wherever he goes, cheers and joy always follow him.
===A Shrouded Man===
Aalto's Forte allows him to conjure mist, shaping it into various forms, or briefly dissolving into it.
Much like the ever-shifting mist, his personality is erratic and unpredictable as well. One can hardly tell his true intentions. After all, for an intelligence broker, concealing weaknesses and veiling true emotions is always the wisest choice.
Yet, when Rover clears up the mist, Aalto's flippant and unreliable facade will be unveiled as mere camouflage. He is thoughtful and meticulous, always allowing him to resolve crises at critical moments. It is safe to conclude that Aalto is, in fact, a dependable man, contrary to what he appears to be.

metadata.section: A Street Magician that Brings Joy

title: Aalto/Backstory
content:
On the surface, Aalto appears to be a greedy, venal broker, willing to strike deals with anyone for the right price. However, deep down, he knows well that intelligence can do either good or evil. This realization has led him to establish his own unique pricing criteria — his scale to determine the value of everything. No one can hustle a deal if it involves intelligence Aalto does not want to sell.
Despite Aalto's catchphrase, "Availability depends on remuneration", speculating the ideal offer for his intelligence — that is, ideal to Aalto — is never an easy task. Those with unrealistic dreams of amassing wealth by acquiring a piece of vital intelligence will find Aalto's quote astronomically high, whereas a lost girl can easily secure her mother's whereabouts from Aalto by offering him a piece of candy. No one knows what tips the balance on Aalto's scale to obtain the intelligence they desire. However, one thing is certain: you can never attempt to take advantage of Aalto or obtain anything from him that you don't rightfully deserve.

title: Aalto/Backstory
content:
Encore, a whimsical girl, is Aalto's best partner. Together, they embark on journeys filled with bustles while working on quests in the Black Shores. The odd pairing of an unreliable adult and a sensible child may seem peculiar to others, but surprisingly, it works.
Whenever Aalto comes up with his wild plans, Encore is always the first to support him. Having been partners for a long time, she understands that there are always deeper meanings behind his ideas.
To make things easier and gain the trust of people, the two would occasionally pose as a family, with Encore in charge of acting cute and Aalto being her miserable guardian. Although the two often squabble with each other, Aalto would always put Encore's safety first.

title: Aalto/Backstory
content: On the battlefield, Aalto's role is not that of a frontline warrior engaging enemies in close combat. Instead, he adopts a more strategic approach, maneuvering around the battle to support his allies. He can create Mist Avatars to taunt the enemies, and allow his teammates to deal damage safely. His Resonance Liberation creates a Gate of Quandary, which enhances ranged attacks launched from behind the Gate.

title: Abby
Abby
content: Abby is a small cat-like Echo with white fur, light brown hands and feet and long ears that serve as wings adorned with golden earrings that match the bracelets Abby wears and the charm on its black collar. Abby additionally has heterochromatic eyes, with the left eye being a light blue and the right eye a vibrant orange with pupils that resemble Tacet Marks. Around its eyes, Abby has pink-orange markings on the outer side of its eyelids and on each cheek as well as another Tacet Mark of the same color on its forehead.

title: Abby
content:
The exact identity of Abby is yet to be revealed, only that they have resided within Rover for a long time. Abby is also capable of tracking down strange frequencies and absorbing a large amount of harmful frequencies.. They also help maintain Rover's frequency and sometimes scold Rover for absorbing "weird stuff". While Abby can manifest when called and stay apart from Rover for a certain amount of time, they cannot maintain their form very long and often have to rest.

Baizhi analysis and Jiyan interview determines Abby is a very rare and highly intellectual Echo, capable of speech and acting out on their own will, which is an uncommon sight in Huanglong. They theorized Abby to being a foreign Echo as there are others places, Rinascita being one, that have such intellectual Echoes.

title: Abby
content:
When encountering Sentinel Jué on Mt. Firmament, the Sentinel suggested that Abby might be an entity similar to themselves, even though Jué was not familiar with it. Abby was also able to remember who Iuno was, further proving their bond to Rover.

Abby may also have close connection, and possible past allegiance, with the Threnodians of Solaris-3 with Leviathan questioning why "Abraxas" has betrayed "us" just before its defeat, but whether or not Abby is also a Threnodian like Leviathan is unknown. It's also unknown if Cristoforo is aware of Abby's identity.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: The Academy's Dark Side is a Point of Interest and a Sonoro Sphere that mirrors the thoughts and emotions of students and teachers alike at Startorch Academy.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: As described by Lucilla, the Dark Side is the Startorch Academy's "reflection", which had ben undirectedly created through the collective emotions of the student body and faculty staff. Due to it's nature, it is considered inseparable from the school itself and through the collective thoughts, the Sonoro Sphere mirrors the thoughts of every students, reflecting their "youth". Due to this, the Dark Side has many oddities such as floating desks, massive equipment, giant cats, among other strange concepts formed by their delusions. However, despite many students being filled by ideals and passions, the Sonoro Sphere takes in the academy's anxiety and sorrow, absorbing it all before reflecting their truest selves back at them, acting as a vortex of sorts. If allowed, the gathered emotions will swell and collide, where the link between the Dark Side and the minds of everyone that helped form the location will seep into their minds, affecting them negatively.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: This causes students mental health to decline and affect their judgement, with some losing control over their own actions. As a precaution, the academy created a system that allows those who enter the Dark Side so they'd be prepared to face the "truth" it tries reflecting towards them. In this case, the Dark Side was confined within "riddles", turning it into a harmless game where the students can properly confront their Reflections and face their problems, allowing them to process the negative emotions embodied in the Dark Side and come out without being harmed.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: Though, it is possible for the Dark Side to be controlled and turned more harmful, as the Fractsidus themselves did by sending forth two agents known as the Vortex's Eye and the Strange Rabbit. Together, the two proceeded to influence and control the realm to cause more harm and restricted the academy's control over it. Due to the Grand Architect, he also linked the realm to reflect Sigrika's concerns, which impacted how the Dark Side worked. However, it should be noted that despite the danger the two represented, they could not control the emotions in the Dark Side, merely influence them to affect the Reflections - which in turn affected their real-live selves.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: At the same time, the Vortex's Eye and Strange Rabbit also used student's negative emotions into manifesting aggressive Tacet Discord's, which threatened any students who were forcibly entrapped in the Dark Side. Though, once the two were defeated, the school regained proper control of the Dark Side itself.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content: Reflections are shadows of students’ emotions in the Dark Side, which mirror the hidden feelings within the students’ hearts. They take their form and reveal the "truth" that the students would likely never say aloud in the real world. Be it their fears, anger, disappointment, or anything else they hide. While not impossible to hear positive truths, it's unlikely due to the nature of the Dark Side. Due to their nature, the Reflections are linked to their real-selves and depending on the circumstances, anything that affects the Reflections could potentially affect the students themselves, leading to decline in their mental health.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content:
Reflections will also always exist, even if their real-life counterparts vanish. One student who had been permanently lost to the school, despite being gone, her Reflections persists as the Dark Side absorbed her pain where her Reflection exists at her lowest moment.

The Vortex's Eye and Strange Rabbit could influence or disguise themselves as Reflections, which was used in an attempt to mentally harm Sigrika among others to cause them distress.

title: Academy's Dark Side
content:
Alongside confining the Dark Side into a harmless game, the faculty had also created a method to communicate with those in the inside if they needed help. Furthermore, certain measures were made for a forcible exit; the alarm clock. Lucilla explaining that just as a pillow is an invitation to sleep (entering the realm), the alarm clock will wake one up and is the key to leaving the Dark Side.

There are of course a few backup measures if one cannot solve the riddles to exit the location or find the alarm clock to leave. The only seeming consequence is that those who enter the Dark Side through methods aside from the pillow can exit out in odd locations. Sigrika, upon exiting the Dark Side at one point, fell from the sky as the Sonoro Sphere portals can be random at times.

title: Adalbert

title: Adalbert
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Alberto: O dear Sentinel, please calm the furious sea and guide us safely home...
[Dialogue Option] : Dear Sentinel...
Alberto: It seems this is your first time performing the Tide Prayer Rite. I can tell from your slightly awkward movements and the look of uncertainty on your face.
[Dialogue Option] : What can be sought from the Sentinel?
Alberto: This is Ragunna's famous Tide Prayer Rite. Sailors pray here for calm seas before long voyage.
Alberto: Legend has it, that the Sentinel has calmed countless storms, saved lives at sea, and guided people out of the worldly ocean...
Alberto: Hey! Come on! Let me teach you a trick! When a storm looms, hold a sword or dagger to your chest, then make a motion as if cleaving the storm in two...
[Dialogue Option] : Can I summon the Sentinel like this?
Alberto: Of course not. This gesture is to invoke the Sentinel's power, helping us through the storm, and conquering the sea!
[Dialogue Option] : Is this how I can ensure a more dignified sea burial?
Alberto: Ah, don't be so pessimistic. The sea isn't untamable! This gesture is to invoke the Sentinel's power, helping us through the storm, and conquering the sea!
Alberto: You're from a foreign land, so you might not fully understand...
Alberto: This simple gesture, however, can fill us with resolve and strength when facing the raging tides.
Alberto: In my view, this is the essence of faith.

title: Adrian
content:
Adrian is an NPC in The Black Shores. He can be found repairing a KU-Roro, KU-Boku, at the Tethys Hub during the daytime (06:00 AM - 05:59 PM).

At night (06.00 PM - 05.59 AM), he can be found talking with Leclerc in Haven of Sprouts

title: Adrian
content:
[Objective: (In Thetys Hub at afternoon)]
Adrian: Update failed? Why is this the only robot that's incompatible?
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong with this robot?
Adrian: The components of its control system got an error. I'm repairing it and updating the system.
KU-Boku: Ku... Ku... Feels bad... Ku...
[Dialogue Option]  It looks uncomfortable.
Adrian: It can't be. These robots don't feel pain. What you're hearing is just the language module reacting to the repairs.
Adrian: Their personalities are also functions added by the Tethys System, something that needs regular maintenance.
Adrian: Upgrading their systems and chips is the best way to improve them.
Adrian: Trust me, I'm the best engineer here. This robot will be better than ever when I'm done.

title: Adrian
content:
[Objective: (In Haven of Sprouts at night)]
Leclerc: Adrian, are you planning to upgrade KU-Miki?
Adrian: Yeah, its system's been acting up since the last update. I think the new component isn't compatible, so I need to make some adjustments.
Leclerc: But you can't just change things like that. The last time you upgraded KU-Miki, it lost a whole year of memories!
Adrian:That was a temporary side effect--things like discomfort, memory loss, or cognitive issues can happen sometimes. Once I'm done, everything will be fine.
Leclerc: But you're interfering with its natural growth. It has its own way of adapting.
Leclerc: We should guide these little ones based on their development, not just force changes on them.
Adrian:It's more efficient if we handle the adjustments ourselves to improve their programming.
Leclerc: Don't you think your approach is a bit too harsh? They hide from you every time they see you.
Adrian: It's okay. I've got a remote controller to track them down.
Leclerc: I... I just can't reason with you!

title: Aemeath/Backstory
Aemeath/Backstory
content:
.  Suddenly, Alara turned to her.  "Aemeath! How come you don't seem bothered at all?"  Aemeath blinked. "Worried about what? ...Oh, the grades, you mean?" She paused, then waved a hand airily. "But everyone's scores were basically the same this time. Professor Sakya is just way too strict. It's not like we're actually that bad. Just relax." She pulled out a tissue and handed it to their group's biggest crybaby. "Here, Lynn! Dry your eyes!"  Celeste handed the tissue over, exchanged a glance with the others, and said softly, "You really don't seem to care much about your future as a Synchronist."  What would Aemeath usually do in moments like this? Probably crack a joke, change the topic, laugh it off. But today was that person's birthday, and thoughts of him filled her mind. For once, she forgot to hide her feelings from her friends.  "Being a Synchronist... It's just one path," she said evenly. "Someone once told me he hoped I'd live a happy, carefree life. I think that matters more. My dreams aren't as grand as yours. Isn't it normal for a slacker like me to take it easy?"  "Really?" her friends asked, watching her closely. Aemeath just smiled back. "Really."  But that wasn't the truth.  Her real dream was far too heavy, too arrogant, too absurd to be spoken aloud in calm, measured words. It grew larger every day, sinking its roots deep into her heart. Yet she refused to acknowledge it, because she had already accepted that promise. If day after day of simple happiness was enough, then she would remain happy like this forever. She would keep her word. Unless...  Her thoughts were abruptly interrupted as Alara pinched her cheek hard. "Ow! What was that for?" Aemeath protested, her words muffled. "You little liar," her friend grumbled. "Fine, fine. We'll stop asking... Library this afternoon? Group study session?" Aemeath nodded. "Of course!"  Laughing and jostling with her friends, Aemeath drifted toward the elevator. They were all still young, in no rush to find answers just yet. In this Academy brimming with prodigies, the future stretched out before them, full of endless possibilities.
|mention2 = Nova, Alara, Sakya, Celeste, Lynn, Rover

title: Aemeath/Backstory
content:
|mention2 = Nova, Alara, Sakya, Celeste, Lynn, Rover



|title3   = Only the Unseen Shall See
|text3    = Aemeath walked up to the mirror, but no reflection appeared.  After her death, the world had fallen out of step. Her Synchronist friends had once debated what made the essence of humanity. Alara said it was love, Nova believed it was memory, Celeste argued that it was the self, and Lynn declared it was faith... "No," Aemeath thought. "Humanity's essence is frequency." Given what she had become, it was the only framework that made sense.  Was it her Resonance with the Exostrider that had altered her state of being? Her physical body had been torn apart in the simulation cockpit. She should be dead. Yet here she was. She no longer bothered thinking about the essence of existence, though for a digital ghost, she had all the time in the world to contemplate such things.  What she understood now was far more important.  When she entered the Exostrider's Reactor Drive hanging in the sky, she saw the message hidden within.  "So that's how it was," she realized. The message had never been read because, from the very beginning, it had been placed where it could not be accessed. Only now, as a Synchronist resonating with the Exostrider, could she see it. The entire underground cavern relied on this "sun" for survival, so of course, the people of Lahai-Roi had never stood a chance to know.  Should she feel happy? The content of the message gave her the chance to realize her grandest vision, but in a way she had never imagined. A bitter, cosmic joke. Yet this was a task only she could accomplish.  "If I can help, I will. I have to." …Yes. That's how it should be.  Aemeath thought of that person and quietly cheered herself on. She could be braver. More steadfast. She wasn't ready yet, but that was fine. There was still time to prepare. In that sense, fate had already done her a favor. Lost in thought, she found herself softly humming a tune. It was a pity that Fleet Snowfluff wouldn't be able to release her new song. If she had known what tomorrow would bring, she would have finished it.  The mirror did not reflect her face, so Aemeath did not see her own smile. It resembled a streak of crayon dragged sideways, its color ending in a sudden, blunt end.
|mention3 = Alara, Nova, Celeste, Lynn, Exostrider

title: Aemeath/Backstory
content:
|mention3 = Alara, Nova, Celeste, Lynn, Exostrider



|title4   = What She Fears, What She Dreads
|text4    = There was nothing but stillness.  Aemeath turned and saw it.  It resembled an eye, yet she knew it was not. A black hole? Maybe that was the closest human concept. But to the one who resonated with the , it was a different order of existence: a "phenomenon" of ceaseless, overflowing occurrence. Whatever it engulfed simply ceased to be. The  named it Voidmatter. Let it be called that. Beings of a lower dimension needed a term for it, just as humans needed to call that "eye" Aleph-1.  This was not her first time meeting its so-called "gaze." Such encounters were unavoidable in her repeated journeys between Voidspace and the outside world. Over time, she had learned not to react.  Until not too long ago, its gaze had always affected her. A hollowness. A quiet wish for dissolution. A sense that nothing mattered set against a silent, unanswering universe. These were the aftereffects of staring into Aleph-1 that not even death had freed her from. But now, after exploring the ruins of one of the civilizations it had devoured, she looked into that impossibly vast eye that transcended space and time and heard only her own laughter, thin and verging on hysteria.  "So this is what he was searching for?" The laugh that escaped her was brittle. "This is… the truth?"  How absurd.  Every ideal and vision nurtured since childhood collapsed at once, emptied of all meaning. Aemeath was exhausted. Beneath the fatigue stirred a dull ache, followed closely by something colder.  "What about him?" "Did he know?"  If he did, Aemeath could not imagine how he had kept moving forward while carrying this knowledge. And if he didn't... then this truth could never reach him. It had to be buried. Shattered. Erased completely. Cold concern settled in her heart, even as it burned with a pure, clarifying rage. For the first time, she understood hatred.  The illusion of the paper plane she had conjured crumpled in her fist. She let the scraps slip from her fingers and watched them drift away, dissolving into the endless void.
|mention4 = Exostrider, Aleph-1, Rover

content: Aeschylus  is a NPC that first appears in . After completing Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens his Reverberation can be found in the Lost Beyond.

title: Aeschylus
content:
[Objective: (After 18 : 00)]
;Aeschylus So what do you think?
;Leah Yawn...

title: Aeschylus
content:
Aeschylus: Don't be indifferent. Now listen, a normal welcome-back party is boring. We should throw a surprise party. The youths do like surprises.
Leah: There's a fine line between surprise and jump scare.
Aeschylus: Hehe, she's brave than you. Maybe she's into that kind of thing.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you talking about?
Aeschylus: Oh, it's you. Phrolova is out performing, and we're discussing how to organize a party for her return.
Leah: You act younger than the youths of today. Try not to overexert yourself. Oh, you seem tired, child. Care for a glass of water?
Aeschylus: Hey child, do you like my idea? If we throw a surprise party, maybe they'll let me be the main organizer.
[Dialogue Option]  It's a good idea.
Aeschylus: Hahaha, I most certainly know what the youths want. What have you got to say to that, Leah?
Leah: Sigh...
[Dialogue Option]  Why do you care so much?
Aeschylus: Uh... haha, we saw them grow up. Those young'uns are like family to us.
Aeschylus: Besides, I need to be important to them. If they enjoy my company, they won't forget to visit us from time to time.
Aeschylus: Unlike our own ungrateful brat... He never...
Leah: Okay, that's enough.

title: Agio
content: Agio is a male NPC who appears near the entrance of the Order of the Deep's Cathedral of Mercury. From 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM, He can be seen arguing with Fili.

title: Agio
content:
[Objective: (First Interaction)]
Fili: This was a case of civil dispute. You've absolutely no basis to demand that man to be handed over to the Order Penitentiary.
Agio: You're right. But his speech in the court showed a great disrespect towards the Sentinel.
Agio: Once matters related to the doctrines are involved, the nature of the case changes entirely.
Fili: You cannot forcibly take him away during the tribunal proceedings.
Agio: He spoke disrespectfully of the Sentinel.
Fili: What evidence do you have to prove that this person truly harbors resentment towards the Sentinel and discontent with the Order's doctrines?
Agio: He spoke disrespectfully of the Sentinel. We must remain vigilant for any potential heresies within this city.
Fili: ...You!
[Dialogue Option]  Order Tribunal and Order Penitentiary?
[Dialogue Option]  What are you arguing about? I can't quite understand.
Fili: Hello, esteemed guest from afar. Please excuse our faux pas.
Fili: At the inception of Ragunna, several prominent families rigged the city's governance with their control over the city's wealth.
Fili: This divided Ragunnesi into two distinct, constantly conflicting classes: the commoners and the aristocrats.
Fili: After the establishment of the Order by the first Primus, a Council of Ten was formed through consensus as the city's legislature to balance the interests of the aristocracy and the common people.
Fili: The Council of Ten is the predecessor of the Order Tribunal, its members elected from both aristocrats and commoners. It serves as a judicial body for mediating civil disputes, handling political crimes, and adjudicating significant public affairs.
Fili: All resolutions of the Order Tribunal are passed through votes, which are binding even over the Primus.
Fili: But after the Dark Tide twenty years ago, Fenrico became the Primus, and established the Order Penitentiary for investigating heresy. The Order Tribunal's influence has been gradually diluted...
Fili: Primus Fenrico established the Order Penitentiary as a response to the societal instabilities at the time.
Fili: I don't disagree, but... listen, Agio, I respect us as brothers and sisters under the Sentinel's wings.
Fili: Even if the ten seats within the Cathedral of Mercury remain empty and covered in dust, as long as the Order Tribunal exists, we will uphold the principles of fairness and justice to the very end.
Fili: Without conclusive evidence, we shall never convict someone based on assumption! Thus is the value the Order Tribunal upholds, and so must the Order Penitentiary! This is the Sentinel's teaching!
Agio: That much we know! I don't need this lecture from you.

title: Agliano
content:
Agliano: Have logistics bring over another half-bag of cement powder.
Agliano: Can't believe they managed to blast a hole in it. 3D printing alone won't cut it for a patch job.
Siric: I've seen worse. Last week at the proving grounds was a real mess.
Siric: A student had a Forte freak-out and caused a gravity shift in a lecture hall.
Siric: By the time I got there, everything was just... floating.
Agliano: Ah, the new generation outdoes the old. These kids keep getting more powerful. Back in my day—

Agliano: Oh, no. It's nothing.
Siric: Let's wrap this up. They've got lectures tomorrow.

title: Agune
content: ' is an NPC male professor or researcher, and graduate of Rabelle College, found outside the office during the day.

title: Agune
content:
Startorch Academy only has four departments. Where  did this "Agronomy Wing" come from?
Agune: Oh, that's a nickname for the Division of Ecology Conservation, out of the Department of Light Energy Sciences.
Agune: We're like the fantastic four and a half. Kinda funny, don't you think?

title: Agune
content:
Agune: Ah, a new student of Rabelle College. What do you want to know? I'm familiar with the ins and outs of this place. Got questions? Ask away!
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me about how the "Agronomy Wing" nickname came to be.
Agune: The nickname "Agronomy Wing" refers to the Division of Ecology Conservation within the Department of Light Energy Sciences. They spend their days planting things in lunar soil and are the most "grounded" bunch in the entire Academy.
Agune: The novel foodstuffs served in the Food, Utilities & Energy Lounge are mostly the result of their research. Always nutritious, but the taste... well, best not to think about that.
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me about Rabelle College.
Agune: As a recent graduate, here's the advice I give to current students: If a classmate tries to recruit you into the "superfood" research group, start running!
Agune: The stuff they come up with tastes ten times worse than the food in F.U.E.L. (the cafeteria). I wouldn't steer you wrong, fresher!
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me about the other departments.
Agune: Well, the Department of Exostrider Engineering is obsessed with all things Exostrider. The students there are either geniuses or lunatics. It's the most "dangerous" department in the Academy.
Agune: The Department of Voidmatters specializes in the studying Waveworn Phenomena and Void Storms to predict and control these disasters. But once they get deep into their research, they often forget to eat and... can start to lose touch with humanity.
Agune: Then there's the Department of Light Energy Sciences, home to the Division of Light Array Engineering, focused on energy conversion. They spend their days buried in blueprints and equations—a stark contrast to the guys over at the Agro Wing.
Agune: In short, each department is unique. Choosing one isn't just about picking an area of study, it's about choosing a lifestyle for the next four years.
Agune: I hope you'll find your passion during your time here at Startorch Academy.

title: Agune
content: Despite asking about Rabelle College, he only talks about "superfood" research group, implying Rabelle College students are most likely participates or members.

title: Ahab
content: Ahab is a deceased quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in .

title: Ahab
content:
Ahab is the captain of the ship Pequod. According to his diary, he is not originally from Rinascita, but arrived on the shores of Riccioli Islands after he and his crew pursued Cetus the Tidebreaker into a whirlpool.

He vanishes along with his crew after Cetus the Tidebreaker is healed. Ishmael reveals that they had died decades ago, though their spirts lingered until peace was restored to the waters of Riccioli Islands.

title: Ahab
content:
Ahab is a reference to the protagonist of , the novel that the story of Old Man and the Whale is based on. The Ahab of the novel is also the tyrannical captain of a ship named Pequod who is seeking vengeance against a whale.
In the original novel, Ahab is named after the biblical .

title: Aleksander
content:
Aleksander is a male NPC who works as a tour guide in Rinascita.

From 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM he can be seen talking with Lian in front of the hotel near Trattoria Margherita.

Meanwhile, around 6:00 PM to 10:59 PM, he can be seen with his cat, haggling with Bellano at the Montelli Quarter marketplace.

title: Aleksander
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 5:59 PM)]
Aleksander: Is your luggage all set up in your room? As your guide, let me share some important travel tips for Ragunna.
Lian: Alright... Is this going to be about the Order and the Sentinel again?
Aleksander: I won't cover that topic since you should already know it. This time, I'll focus on dining customs.
Aleksander: Don't add ice to your espresso, don't use scissors to cut your pasta at the table, and definitely don't order cappuccino at dinner...
Lian: Uh, okay...
Aleksander: And for Sentinel's sake, don't just eat the center of the pizza and leave the precious crust! The last person who did that ended up on the Pilgrim's Sail.
[Dialogue Option]  ...?
Lian: I would never do that! Besides, is the consequence really that severe?
Aleksander: There's a dish at the trattoria on the first floor of this hotel called Pizza Tropicale. Just remember,  it's called pizza, but it's definitely not one.
Aleksander: Once you leave that trattoria, don't mention it to any local. Even if someone asks, don't answer.
Lian: Now you're making me scared...

title: Aleksander
content:
[Objective: (6:00 PM to 10:59 PM)]
Aleksander: Mister Bellano, you leave me no choice—
Bellano: You again! How many times must I tell you, no discounts!
Bellano: Keep it up, and I'll call in the Order Tribunal's Acolytes!
Aleksander: This is my cat, Aleksander II—come on! Say hello to the shopkeeper!
Aleksander II: Me-ow!
Bellano: ...
Aleksander II: Purrrrrr...
Bellano: ...Alright, fine, 20% off. No more.
Aleksander: Hooray!

title: Alexandro
content: Alexandro is a male NPC who appears in Bank Street, Ragunna, near Trattoria Margherita. He can be seen arguing with Riccardo de Fisalia.

title: Alexandro
content:
Riccardo de Fisalia: I heard that Montelli's golds flow on every river in today's Ragunna.
Alexandro Montelli: Simple rule of supply and demand. The market calls and we're only answering their needs.
Riccardo de Fisalia: And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
Alexandro Montelli: Some folks are eager to work with us in their pursuit of wealth and self-actualization. We're simply providing them with the platform.
Alexandro Montelli: Since we're on that matter, do you have financial needs we can assist you with? I couldn't help but notice the lofts in Fisalia Residencies seem... out of repair.
Alexandro Montelli: If you're planning on a renovation, rest assured—I have some connections in construction and design.
Riccardo de Fisalia: Hmph—I would not waste my breath lecturing you on defending the longstanding traditions and principles of Ragunna, and of Rinascita.
Riccardo de Fisalia: We Fisalias would never disrespect our values and beliefs. But you Montellis wouldn't wait to walk away from these for your grand "course", would you?
[Dialogue Option]  (It got pretty intense...)
[Dialogue Option]  (Best not to interrupt...)
Alexandro Montelli: We're simply adapting to the times. Even the Order is willing to guide us toward ascension. Only fools would drown in old dreams.
Alexandro Montelli: Oh, forgive me—I nearly forgot.
Alexandro Montelli: In the past, it was you who controlled the Order and the path of ascension. But now...
Riccardo de Fisalia: Mind you, though we may have past our prime, our family still stands stronger than yours.
Alexandro Montelli: There, you said it yourself, Fisalia is history now.

title: Alice
content: Alice is a female Acolyte NPC found at the Order of the Deep found with a young girl named Juno during the day.

title: Alice
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Juno: Alice, when will Phoebe bring the Echoes back here?
Juno: Since she and the Echoes left, even the little  sea anemones here have been looking a bit droopy.
Alice: Phoebe?
Juno: Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
Juno: Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
Juno: Whenever she tells us a story, a bunch of Echoes would join in and perform with her, like a little play—it's incredible!
Juno: I haven't seen her in ages... Do you know when she'll come back?
Alice: I'll pass your message on to her. Knowing her, I'm sure she'll come as soon as she has a moment.
Juno: Really? That's wonderful!

title: Alviss
content: ' is a NPC male Royan found speaking to a researcher, Vitruvio, near by the Resonance Beacon of Atuja Camp.

title: Alviss
content:
Vitruvio: May I ask why your people don't settle within Bjartr Woods?
Alviss: For the Soliskin, Bjartr Woods is home. It is there they rest, grow, and return to the Solistrees at the very end.
Alviss: We Shepherds watch and tend to them, but disturb their rest we do not. Neither do we infringe on their freedom.
Vitruvio: I see... so only Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods most of the time?
Alviss: Yes, child. When we enter, we pitch only a small tent, so the forest remains theirs. That is also why Haldarheim was built :outside the woods.
Alviss: All things human—our rituals, out trade, our crafting—we do away from the woods. Only the Solisylum's calculations remain.
Alviss: Only when we lay aside human noise and enter in reverence can we come close to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition.

title: Amamiya
content:
KU-Clinic: How many moons are there in the sky?
Amamiya: One... Can you stop asking me these weird questions? My head hurts...
KU-Clinic: Is water toxic or non-toxic?
Amamiya: Are you serious? Non-toxic.
KU-Clinic: Is the Shorekeeper male or female?
Amamiya: How am I supposed to know? I've never met them before!

title: Amamiya
content:
Amamiya: W-wait a second... Is this person here real or simulated?
[Dialogue Option]  Of course I'm real.
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, I'm totally fake.
Amamiya: Ahhhhh!
KU-Clinic: Don't worry, (he's/she's) real.
KU-Clinic: Your treatment isn't finished yet. Please stay still.
[Dialogue Option]  What happened to him?
KU-Clinic: Amamiya, field agent. The preliminary diagnosis is mild reality perception disorder. In other words, the patient may feel like their surroundings aren't real.
KU-Clinic: Most of our members are experiencing this because the Tethys' reality Anchors are unstable.
Amamiya: No wonder I've had a stomachache and headache ever since I got out of the underground area.
KU-Clinic: Wait... Is this pain even real, or...?
KU-Clinic: It's real, trust me.
Amamiya: Darn it! I've only been to the Black Shores for a few days... Useless me!

title: Amedeo
content:
;Amedeo "Eyes of illusion reflected underwater, coveting Avinoleum above..."
;Amedeo "...yet deceit draws breath, and truth drowns."
;Amedeo It... it's his work! It has to be!

title: Amedeo
content:
[Objective: (First time talking to him)]
Amedeo: Hello... a plesant day to you here in Ragunna!
[Dialogue Option]  What were you just reciting?
Amedeo: Oh... nothing, just some giberrish.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean by "trouble will come knocking?"
Amedeo: Please, forget what you heard.
Amedeo: I don't want to board the Pilgrim's Sale. I have a family to support!
Amedeo: Forget these forbidden words. They're curses from a mysterious playwright.
Amedeo: He cursed the people of Ragunna with his truncated sonnet verses, condemning everything here... and now, I'm the next target.
Amedeo: I... I have a family to feed.
Amedeo: Amedeo, forget it, forget you saw those words.
[Dialogue Option]  Is there anything I can do to help?
Amedeo: O merciful Imperator, I have fallen into the depths of unforgivable sin...
Amedeo: Forgive my family, forgive this innocent stranger!

title: Amedeo
content:
[Objective: (At Night)]
Amedeo: Ah, well... Right. Yeah... oh no...
[Dialogue Option]  What?
Amedeo: Lower you voice! Did you forget? This has to stay under wraps! Those who spread it around have already been exiled!
[Dialogue Option]  I haven't said anything...
Amedeo: From the sea, they shall walk upon the land. And now the land has become one with the sea.
Amedeo: That line is definitely correct. Even though it's just one line, I've researched it for a long time! It's definitely from that playwrite.
Amedeo: They say the original manuscript was destroyed by the Order, which is such a shame- a real waste of a beautiful poem...
Amedeo: Hehehe... the heavenly feast awaits me! Blessed, sweet lamb... the sacrificed maiden...
Amedeo: Lower your voice! Amedeo! Do not grant her authority, balance will... the chosen garden...
Amedeo: Curses... unblessed... praise them by name...

title: Amedeo
content:
[Objective: (After )]
Amedeo: Oh... This... Huh? Why am I here?
[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
Amedeo: I don't know!
Amedeo: Why am I here? I was supposed to be at home reading...
[Dialogue Option]  You don't remember anything?
Amedeo: No, not at all! Have we met before?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes!
Amedeo: Please tell me what I've been doing!
[Dialogue Option]  No.
Amedeo: I guess my mind must have wandered off... Maybe I had a bout of hysteria or something.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you really want to know?
Amedeo: ...No. No, forget it.
Amedeo: Never mind. I'm not that eager to know what I've been up to lately.
Amedeo: To hell with the Threnodian! I'm going home to get some rest.

title: Anastasia
content: Anastasia is a female NPC who appears in . She rescued Federico and Chantelle from the Pilgrim's Sail.

title: Anastasia
content:
;Federico: Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
;Federico: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
;Chantelle: Fede... we can't go back.
;Anastasia: I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
;Anastasia: In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
Federico: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
Anastasia: I... I don't know...
Chantelle: Wake up, Fid. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
Chantelle: Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
Federico: Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
Chantelle: Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
Federico: What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
Anastasia: Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
Chantelle: Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
Federico: Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...

title: Anastasia
content:
;Federico: So, can we go back to Ragunna now? My property, my family... They might still be there.
;Chantelle: Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is... unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
;Federico: I don't care! I'm going back now!
;Anastasia: Mr. Fede, the Order's silence in times like these is anything but normal. For your own safety, please don't act on impulse.
Federico: I heard something big has happened in Ragunna... If we return now, maybe we can find our place again.
Chantelle: ...Though our status as citizens has been erased, if our acquaintances are willing to vouch for us, we might actually have a chance.
Federico: I've already sent letters to the friends who still live there. Perhaps hope is finally within reach...
Chantelle: Me too! I want to reach out to my friends! I'd do anything just to return to my homeland.
Chantelle: This time, I'll follow the Order's rules strictly and live a simple life.
Federico: O Sentinel above... Wait, can we still say that?
Anastasia: Are you...
Federico: No, no, no, we're not complaining that this place isn't good enough. Please, don't misunderstand.
Anastasia: It's alright. I understand. Missing home is only natural. I miss mine too.
Chantelle: But... should I really go home? Miss Anastasia and everyone here mean so much to me...
Anastasia: If you want, you can always stay here.
Chantelle: That would be wonderful...

title: Anastyn
content: ' is a female NPC student located by Fangspire Chasm Station, , seen speaking to Lyralyn.

title: Anastyn
content:
Anastyn: The landscape and architecture where I'm from are stunning. Dazzling even, like the sun.
Lyralyn:  Why are you boasting about Septimont all of a sudden? I mean, it is incredible, but still.
Anastyn: But look at that greatsword plunged straight into the earth! It's just so raw, so visceral… it gives me chills!
Anastyn: It reminds me of Ephor Augusta's sword cleaving through the mountains at the hunting grounds. It literally carved out a new future for Rinascita.
Anastyn: I'll bet it was the same with the Exostrider's sword here. It must've laid the foundation for Lahai-Roi's future.
Lyralyn: Okay, now you're giving me chills. Still, I'm more curious to know how much energy was required to create this wonder.
Anastyn: Well, uncovering mysteries ike that is the whole reason we enrolled, right? I can't wait!

title: Anastyn
content:
[Objective: After]
;Anastyn I heard the Exostrider actually swung that humongous thing and fought the Threnodian! Is that true?!
;Lyralyn Of course it is! The Void Storms and all those Threnodian creations are gone now, aren't they?
;Anastyn Ah! To be born in Septimont and miss a duel of such grandeur...
Anastyn: Look! The greatsword is actually gone! I heard the Exostrider actually swung that humongous thing and fought the Threnodian! Is that true?!
Lyralyn: Of course it is! The Void Storms and all those Threnodian creations are gone now, aren't they?
Anastyn: Ah! How can this be!
Anastyn: This is bound to be the single greatest regret of my life. I hate being from Septimont!
Lyralyn: Eh? Why?
Anastyn: Because I missed it! Oh, what I'd give to fight in a battle of that scale myself! Even if I died... it would've been worth the journey.
Lyralyn: ...You Septimontians. I'll never understand how your brains work.

title: Andrius
content:
Andrius is a male NPC in Rinascita.

During the daytime, he can be seen talking to Troy in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna City.

title: Andrius
content:
[Objective: (During the daytime)]
Andrius: You should know that people from Rinascita place a high value on family honor and kinship.
Andrius: Without an influential family behind you, it's nearly impossible to rise in Ragunna.
Andrius: But the Montellis are different. We believe opportunities multiply when they're shared. Money means nothing unless it's in circulation.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you a Montelli?
Andrius: Of course! That's why we get to sit here.
Troy: I want to be rich too! I want people to be in awe whenever they speak my name! I'll make the most of this opportunity!
Andrius: Then go for it! Do whatever it takes to earn your status and honor.
Andrius: These things won't just fall into your lap—they're up to you to pursue.
Andrius: If you share my belief, I promise that serving the Montelli family will not leave you wanting.
Andrius: Shall we toast?
Troy: C-can I?
Andrius: Of course! I might be your employer, I prefer to see us as partners.
Troy: W-well, cheers, then!

title: Annika
content: ' is a female NPC who can be found during the day at Septimont bathhouse in the VIP section with a noblewoman name Emilia. She is a reputable merchant and designer for Gladiators armor.

title: Annika
content:
;Annika Gladiator Plate Armor. Gold-tier quality! 5,000 each. Get it while it's in stock!
;Emilia Can't you sell these a little cheaper?
;Annika I'm sorry, but this is the best deal I can offer...
;Annika Honesty's our trade, fair to everyone, young and old. We've been in this business for years, and our reputation speaks for itself.

title: Annika
content:
[Objective: (Day at the Bathhouse)]
Annika:  I'll be honest with you, miss. This is as low as we can go.
Emilia:  I know, but right now our family's funds are... on the tighter side.
[Dialogue Option]  Listen in.
Annika:  I can understand your situation, but please think it through. Spending some money now on proper equipment is a way better investment than being forced to pay a "sponsorship fee" just because you didn't qualify for the main tournament.
Emilia:  I get what you're saying. Last time we bought gear from that merchant, Banagher, he sold us nothing but repackaged junk.
Emilia:  How are we supposed to fight with this junk? That's what our Gladiators kept complaining to me. You take my meaning, Miss Annika?
Annika:  Banagher? Ha. Those scrap metals he calls armor don't even come close to my work. Honestly, you'd be better off strapping yourself with cardboard than using his junk.
Annika:  My shop has always done honest business. Don't take my word for it, ask anyone on this street.
Emilia:  Since a friend recommended your shop to me, I place my trust in you. And I truly hope that we can establish a long-term partnership.
Emilia:  As a gesture of goodwill, our family's Gladiators will help promote your shop after winning this Agon season. As long as we can secure a place in the tournament, we'll be in for a long-term partnership. But on the other hand, I hope you can understand the situation we're currently facing.
[Dialogue Option]

title: Annika
content:
[Objective: (Night at the arena)]
;Annika  Hmm. I just can't shake the feeling that the way Gladiator is handling their weapon is a bit strange...
;Annika  Maybe the hilt was made too stiff?
;Annika  There's still room for adjustments for this batch... Give me a moment.
Annika: There, modeling the pauldron after the buckler and adding concussion edges is perfect for Gladiators who excel in strength.
Annika: Offers an extra option for parrying, and it also lets you catch your opponent's weapon with your pauldron. And if it really came down to it, you can use that momentum to crash straight into them and close the distance...
Annika: Hey, you there. What do you think of that Gladiator's gear design?
[Dialogue Option]  That's quite unique.
[Dialogue Option]  Not interested.
Annika: Hehe. Sparking new ideas through actual combat is what makes the stuff we make at our workshop unique.
Annika: If we could test our equipment in more combat scenarios, our skills would do an even better job of protecting the Gladiators and the warriors out on hunts, wouldn't you think?

title: Annis
content:
Annis is an NPC that appears in .

Annis was a hallucination conjured by Cantarella to cope with the horrors of the Divine Trials. The backstory that Cantarella created for Annis was that despite not being of the Fisalia bloodline, Annis took part in the Divine Trials during which she, alongside Cantarella, made it past the second trial. At some point during the trials, she lost her voice permanently due to exposure to various poisons.

title: Anthony
content: Anthony is an NPC researcher found inside the Cassette Burning room.

title: Anthony
content:
Zhuming: Did you see the incident report? That disciplinary action is harsh. You don't see that very often these days…
Anthony: If you ask me, it's not harsh enough. You don't know what they did!
Anthony: Those two selfish fools snuck off on their own to collect samples just to gain a smidge of progress in their project. The researcher who went to rescue them got completely consumed by the Voidmatter...
Anthony: How is it fair that a good man is gone, and the ones responsible are still alive and kicking?
Zhuming: Don't worry. The Institute has zero tolerance for breaking safety protocols. They will pay for their stupidity.
Zhuming: They aren't worth your time. Not even your anger. Come on, focus on your research and look forward to the future.
Zhuming: Maybe one day… we can use Cassettes to bring back those lost to the Voidmatter. It sounds like a pipe dream now, but turning dreams into reality is what science is all about, isn't it?

title: Anthony
content:
[Objective: After]
; Zhuming So get this. I heard those two are petitioning to restart their project and get their disciplinary action softened.
; Anthony: Over my dead body! Void Storm or not, selfish pricks like that are a walking liability!
A researcher seems to be seething over what happened with two troublesome students.
[Dialogue Option]  (Listen)
Anthony: I don't think I'll ever forgive those two selfish bastards. After all...
Anthony: ...If the Void Storms are truly gone for good, doesn't that mean the people we lost in them are gone forever too?
Zhuming: I don't think their sacrifice was meaningless.
Anthony: I know! They were the pride of the Spacetrek Collective. I'm not GRIEVING their deaths... I'm FURIOUS. That's what I am.
Anthony: Every time I think about the colleagues we lost trying to save those two rule-breaking idiots, it makes my blood boil.
Zhuming: But... Anthony, did you know?
Zhuming: The two kids they saved back then? They joined the rescue team when Aleph-1 hit.
Zhuming: When the Void Storm was expanding, they saved another search unit. And that unit brought back data on one of the Royan rune sites.
Zhuming: And those Royan runes... they're proof that the colleagues we lost in the Void Storm once existed.
Zhuming: Beyond the Stridergate, they became torches, lighting the coordinates in Voidspace for the Exostrider.
Anthony: Are you saying those two idiots helped fight Aleph-1 too?
Zhuming: No... I'm saying that driving back Aleph-1 was a miracle. Only that miracle was made possible by every single person within that closed loop of cause and effect.
[Dialogue Option]  (Leave)

title: Anthony
content:
[Objective: Nearby]
;...How many times do I have to say this? In the frostlands, it's every man and woman for themselves. No one is going to hold your hand.
;Running off like that cost us an exceptional colleague their life trying to rescue you… He even made sure to leave a final report before he disappeared.
;Disciplinary actions will be reported along with details of the incident. After that, you'll be sent home to face trial under your local laws. That's the punishment you deserve.
;And if you have any conscience left, remember this :  a colleague gave their life to save you two fools.

title: Anyad

Anyad: I worked so hard... I was this close... and now I have to start all over again from scratch here...

title: Ariosto
content: Ariosto is an NPC in Rinascita. He is an undercover member of the Black Shores, searching for further information about Rinascita's Sentinel.

title: Ariosto
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
???: Ah, finally. I can tell at a glance that you are not an ordinary person.
???: You... You must be a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you? How did you know?
[Dialogue Option]  You are a Bloom Bearer, more Bloom Bearer than I.
???: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
Ariosto: Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself first. My name's Ariosto, and I am the undercover Bloom Bearer sent here to investigate Rinascita's recent issues.
[Dialogue Option] : Are you the only one they sent here?
[Dialogue Option] : Are there any other Bloom Bearers here?
Ariosto: The Black Shores has also sent other Bloom Bearers to Rinascita, but to keep things under the radar of the Order, we decided to split up.
Ariosto: If you head  southeast towards Septimont, you'll likely run into some of our colleagues. Compared to Ragunna, Bloom Bearers enjoy a bit more freedom there—less surveillance and fewer rules to follow.
Ariosto: But... how should I put it? Things aren't quite as smooth in Septimont. Our operations face their own set of challenges, and the Bloom Bearers' work there hasn't been progressing as well as we'd hoped.
Ariosto: As you know, the Black Shores is a neutral organization, so we don't have the right to meddle in their affairs without the consent of the local officials.
Ariosto: Our relationship with Rinascita's city-state is... well, "delicate" is one way to put it. We've been providing warnings about the Lament crisis- Ragunna being the prime example, of course.
Ariosto: By the way... Come closer, gotta keep our voice low for this... Have you run into any... obstructions from the Order during your mission?
[Dialogue Option] : Indeed I have.
[Dialogue Option] : Obstruction is an understatement...
Ariosto: I see. It happened to me as well. ON the surface, Ragunna appears peaceful, but behind the scenes, the Order has been plotting something.
Ariosto: People from the Order was hot on my tail when I was investigating this matter, and even had my Terminal taken from me. Luckily the Montellis extended a helping hand...
Ariosto: It was the same Ms. Carlotta who told me that a member of the Black Shores would be arriving in Ragunna soon. I decided to find (him/her) quickly and share the information I have.
Ariosto: I borrowed this costume and a mask from the Montelli to blend in with the crowd, so I could get back to the city during the Carnevale. Well, at least my hard work finally paid off.
[Dialogue Option] : That sounds really rought.
[Dialogue Option] : How could they treat us like this!
Ariosto: Us Bloom Bearers, we endure hardship, but the Lament must be stopped at all costs! That's our Bloom Bearer Creed!
Ariosto: You must already have some sense of Ragunna's situation. Now, let me share a wild thought with you...
Ariosto: You saw that Sentinel statue in Ragunna, right? That status is strikingly different from the appearance of Sentinel Imperator we recorded in the Tethys System.
Ariosto: Now, take a deep breath—because I'm about to say something big. What if, just what if... the people of Ragunna have been believing in a false Sentinel all along?
Ariosto: Wait... Enough talk for today. I can't shake the feeling that we're being watched.
Ariosto: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.

title: Ariosto
content:
[Objective: (Talk again)]
Ariosto: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.

Arsenio: Your Terminal has captured a warm afterglow—this is no coincidence. After all, similar frequencies are known to be drawn to each other.

title: Art Manager
content: The Art Manager is an NPC featured in the Somnium Labyrinth Event as part of the quest Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits. He serves as the antagonist in Zhezhi's Somnoire storyline. During the quest, the Art Manager is portrayed as someone who exploits Zhezhi's artistic skills, using her talent to create fine art that he sells at auctions for the highest prices. He pressures Zhezhi to recreate another Winter's Serenade in Bloom, which he believes would fetch a significant sum at auction. However, Zhezhi refuses his demand after meeting and gaining insight from Rover in the Somnoire.

title: Artemisia
content:
Artemisia: I've made up my mind, Ms. Eleanor.
Eleanor: I see. Artemisia, I want you to know that I respect whatever decision you make.
Eleanor: Indeed. Resonators assigned to collect Reverberations tend to have acute senses that allow them to detect even minuscule amounts of residual frequencies.
Eleanor: It's our gift... also our burden.
Artemisia: Are you saying that before you assumed the role of Gardener...
Eleanor: ...I'd felt the weight of those lingering emotions myself, yes. So if you feel like you need someone to talk to, I'm here for you.
Artemisia: Thank you, Ms. Eleanor. It's just that... the moment I touch those Reverberations, the emotions and last wishes contained within them flood my mind...
Artemisia: I know my work helps many, but I simply can't take in all the pain, despair, and regret I feel...
Artemisia: The heaviness of it all has been wearing me down, leaving me torn between my urge to end the suffering and my sense of responsibility.
Artemisia: I joined the Black Shores to free the world from suffering, didn't I?
Artemisia: Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
Eleanor: Artemisia...

title: Artemisia
content:
Artemisia: Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
Eleanor: Artemisia...



;(Found by the docks afterwards)
Eleanor: Don't leave the Black Shores with such a weight in your heart.
Eleanor: What I meant to tell you is that you've done an outstanding job.
Eleanor: You've protected many from harm and contributed significantly to the Black Shores' understanding of the Lament's origin.
Eleanor: Please have faith that the things you did have left a positive impact, no matter how intractable at first. The momentum of change you've started will tilt the track of history for the better and leave a mark on your life.
Eleanor: These changes will endure, even if you leave the Black Shores.
Artemisia: Ms. Eleanor...?
Eleanor: Did you notice? The seed you brought from your hometown has fully bloomed now.
Eleanor: Thank you, Artemisia, for everything.

;Ovid Maja, what brings you here today?
;Maja Waaaahhh...
Ovid: Maja, what brings you here today? I thought you were planning to wait right until the term's end to review key points?
Maja: Argh, don't me started...
Maja: My mother just went to see all of my professors. After finding out how poor my grades were, she almost pulled me out of school. She said that if I'm doing this badly, I might as well go home and spend the rest of my life counting Exoswarm.
Maja: I was just trying to help Professor Mornye. How did that end with her tattling to my mother?! Ugh, talk about a disaster...

title: Atrium of Reflections
content: Atrium of Reflections is an area of Nimbus Sanctum, Rinascita.

title: Aubrey
content: Aubrey is a male student of the Department of Light Energy Sciences, seen lecturing his classmate, Hedlus.

title: Aubrey
content:
Aubrey: So this is your new master plan for the semester?
Hedlus: Why? Isn't it comprehensive?
Aubrey: You want to juggle coursework, health, research, club activities...
Aubrey: ...What are you, a thousand-armed Chop Chop?
Hedlus: A Huanglong proverb said it best, "Aim high and you will shoot the middle. Aim for the middle and will shoot the ground. A determined heart can achieve anything, so let your resolve take root today."
Aubrey: Funny how you skipped the part before that, "Study now, lest you regret it later." How about you retake the courses you failed last semester first?
Hedlus: Come on, give me a break...

title: Aucustus
content:
' is a male NPC in Septimont and Chairman of the Association of Architects. He can be seen giving a speech to his apprentice, Galatea and Flamaxis.
Listening in to his speech will reward the Achievement: Triple Walls? Triple Achievements!.
__NOTOC__

title: Aucustus
content: File:Trophy Map Triple Walls? Triple Achievements!.png|Map location of the three target NPCs.

title: Aucustus
content:
Aucustus: Remember, you're not just plastering cement! You're building the very walls of this city!
Aucustus: We are the Association of Architects! We are the builders of Septimont!
Aucustus: Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
Flamaxis: Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
Galatea: Sheesh, I thought I was here for construction work. No one told me I'm supposed to be donating organs...
Galatea: The Association of Architects is so awful...

title: Aucustus
content:
Aucustus: This Wall of Morta standing before you is Septimont's first line of defense.
[Dialogue Option]  Listen in on the architect's speech.
Aucustus: Over a century, four chairman of the Association of Architects devoted their lives to the Wall of Morta. Four generations, transforming it from a simple fence used to ward off animals, into a behemoth holding back the tide.
Aucustus: The project began with the founders of the Association, later passing on to their descendants through the generations. To this day, the Association continues to perform its regular maintenance.
Aucustus: It was here that my great-grandfather reinforced the Wall of Morta during the Second Dark Tide. He excavated the earth with the help of a Diggy Duggy from Ragunna and erected steel rods, laying the foundation for the reinforcement work.
Aucustus: Later, the same Diggy Duggy accompanied my grandfather to drive away the Tacet Discords that were disrupting their construction work.
Aucustus: When I first set eyes on the Wall of Morta, my father told me stories of how countless Septimont families contributed to the cause, just like we did.
Aucustus: Whether nobleman, commoner, or Echo. In the construction of the city's future, they all had the same identity: Citizens of Septimont.
Aucustus: As individuals, your names may become forgotten, yet through your tireless efforts, your contributions will live on forever as an integral part of Septimont!
Aucustus: Architects! Pledge your hearts for the future of Septimont!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Auditorium
content: ' is is a Point of Interest located in Startorch Academy. You can invite companions to watch movies here after the completion of .

title: Auditorium
content:
"Doomsday Divas" is the latest sensation of the genre. It follows a heroine who, after a twist of fate, is forced to hit the road on a desperate journey to the "edge of the world"...

"The Quadricentennial Man" is a sci-fi movie adapted from a novel by the same name. It follows the journey of Rupert, a machine that embarks on a journey to become "human" in the name of love.

"The Shadowed Identity" is an action movie about a man driven by revenge against evil forces, who plunges headfirst into the world of espionage...

"Reborn Poets Society" is a poignant drama that follows an unconventional teacher whose radical methods rekindle a passion for life in his students...

"Winged Marathon" is a documentary co-produced by world-famous cinematographers. It chronicles the spectacular seasonal journey of migratory birds...

title: Auditorium
content:
Different movies appear at different times.
Specific characters can't be invited for certain movies as it does not suit them.

title: Auditorium
content:
As you step into the cinema, the entire world seems to fall silent. In the dimly lit space, the hazy, flickering images on the projection screen hint at the upcoming movie...
You scan the announcements on the Academy Forum and notice that a newly released movie is about to start...

content:
"Winged Marathon" is a documentary co-produced by world-famous cinematographers. It chronicles the spectacular seasonal journey of migratory birds...



...Invite a friend to watch it with you?

title: Auditorium
content:
...Invite a friend to watch it with you?



[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lynae.)
Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Lynae would like... You invite her.
You send an invitation to Lynae...
Lynae: I'm here! I'm here!
Lynae: Doomsday Divas! I've been waiting for it to come out for ages! Can't believe you remembered the kinda stuff I'm into!
Lynae: C'mon, let's get inside!
You and Lynae settle in for a movie night to remember..
Lynae: Whoa, didn't see that ending coming...
Lynae: Her whole trip was full of crazy stuff and she had her moment to shine... but she never made it to where she thought she was going. Kind of tragic, huh?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, a bit tragic.
Lynae: ...Right. But hey, she managed to do her big one. Can't say it was all in vain.
[Dialogue Option]  No, her journey was still worth it.
Lynae: ...You're right. She managed to do her big one. Can't say it was all in vain!
Lynae: Anyway, let's watch another movie together soon! I'm free whenever... Why are you looking at me like that? I'll pick a time when you don't have class, duh!

title: Auditorium
content:
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Mornye.)
Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Mornye would like... You invite Mornye.
You send an invitation to Mornye...
Mornye: Sorry to keep you waiting, Mentor. It took me a while to shut down the experiment, but it looks like I arrived in time.
Mornye: I don't really watch movies. You know I spend most of my time in the lab working on experiments...
Mornye: But a sci-fi movie? I'll give it a try. Perhaps I'll even get some inspiration from it.
You and Mornye settle in for a movie night to remember...
Mornye: We still lack a rigorous definition for the emotion known as \"love.\" Not to mention an explanation of its origins or its operating principles.
Mornye: As a mechanical entity... how could Rupert ever determine that he possessed such an emotion?
Mornye: It's hard for me to understand, but after seeing Rupert and Susanna embrace, I do want to believe... that "love" is real.
[Dialogue Option]  Love transcends all things.
[Dialogue Option]  Love is hard to explain.
Mornye: Yes... Science has yet to explain much of the phenomena in the world.
Mornye: I've heard students talk about such things before—that all scientific explanations of mechanical things are actually reflections of the human condition... This movie truly was worthwhile.
Mornye: I should analyze this movie frame by frame. Thank you... I hope we can watch another movie together sometime.

title: Auditorium
content:
Mornye: I should analyze this movie frame by frame. Thank you... I hope we can watch another movie together sometime.



[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Luuk Herssen.)
Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Luuk Herssen would like... You invite Luuk.
You send an invitation to Luuk Herssen...
Luuk Herssen: Your invitation to join you for a movie came as a surprise. A pleasant surprise, of course.
Luuk Herssen: I'm not much of a movie buff, to be honest. Thanks to the Ichor, I see everything in shades of gray, no matter how vibrant it's supposed to look.
Luuk Herssen: But I've heard about this movie from my students. They say the fight choreography is incredible. That, I can appreciate.
Luuk Herssen: Shall we? It's about to start... Oh, and how about some popcorn?
You and Luuk settle in for a movie night to remember...
Luuk Herssen: t's true what they say. A little controlled dopamine release does wonders for one's state of mind.
Luuk Herssen: You could feel every punch and kick right through the screen. I've needed that kind of adrenaline rush for a while.
Luuk Herssen: And the espionage, the intrigue... The depiction felt authentic.
[Dialogue Option]  Did it resonate with you? After all, you were undercover for a while...
[Dialogue Option]  Did it feel familiar? After all, you know how to navigate a fight...
Luuk Herssen: Haha! No, that's not it.
Luuk Herssen: The period of my life "mingling" with their members wasn't that stressful.
Luuk Herssen: Anyway, that was a great watch. Really. Let me know when you're in the mood for another. I've got plenty of leave saved up.

title: Auditorium
content:
Luuk Herssen: Anyway, that was a great watch. Really. Let me know when you're in the mood for another. I've got plenty of leave saved up.



[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lucilla.)
Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Lucilla would like... You invite Lucilla.
You send an invitation to Lucilla...
Lucilla: Reborn Poets Society... A true classic! One of my favorites, actually. Seems like you know my tastes.
Lucilla: The Academy lends out videotapes, but I've always wanted to rewatch it on the big screen.
Lucilla: Thank you for the invite. You just saved me from missing the release under a mountain of paperwork.
Lucilla: It's about to start. Ready to go in?
You and Lucilla settle in for a movie night to remember...
Lucilla: I pick up something new every time I watch it. Every time...
Lucilla: Keaton cultivated something lasting in his students. And that final tribute they gave him at the end...
Lucilla: ...I don't think there's an educator who wouldn't be moved by that.
Lucilla: Rover, what kind of teacher do you prefer?
[Dialogue Option]  The ones who are highly qualified.
[Dialogue Option]  The ones who adapt to the student.
[Dialogue Option]  The... less strict kind.
Lucilla: Hm... Interesting. I'll remember that.
Lucilla: The gravity of reality is so heavy. It can crush spirits meant to be light...
Lucilla: I've always believed part of our duty is to guard the idealism in our students' wings, to be the wind that helps them soar.
Lucilla: I have a long list of classics I'd love to revisit. Let's make this a habit. An invitation to unwind is one I'll always accept.

title: Auditorium
content:
Lucilla: I have a long list of classics I'd love to revisit. Let's make this a habit. An invitation to unwind is one I'll always accept.



[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Sigrika.)
Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Sigrika would like... You invite Sigrika.
You send an invitation to Sigrika...
Sigrika: Phew... I made it! I'm here!
Sigrika: So you're interested in documentaries? That's surprising...
Sigrika: Most of my friends think they're boring. They prefer "popcorn flicks" instead.
Sigrika: This is the first time anyone's invited me to watch a documentary, so... Thanks! Should we, um, head in?
You and Sigrika settle in for a movie night to remember...
Sigrika: Birds go through so much. The danger, the predators, the storms... just to make it to their "Promised Land" and survive.
Sigrika: People always say that documentaries don't have a storyline, but I think this one was about...
[Dialogue Option]  It was a story about promises.
[Dialogue Option]  It was a story about determination.
Sigrika: Yes! Migration is just an instinct for them, but still. Life just refuses to give up, you know?
Sigrika: And the photographers... imagine waiting days, weeks, just for one perfect moment. That's not just patience and respect. That's love.
Sigrika: This was so wonderful... Thanks for thinking of me, Senior! I'd love to do this again sometime!

title: Auditorium
content:
Sigrika: This was so wonderful... Thanks for thinking of me, Senior! I'd love to do this again sometime!



[Dialogue Option]  I've got more important things to do...

title: Augusta
Augusta
content:
==Trivia==
===Etymology===
Augusta may be a reference to Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus, the founder of the Roman Empire and the first Roman Emperor.

title: Augusta/Backstory
content: An undefeated warrior in battle, Augusta is fearless; this trait makes her a worthy leader of her people. Although an ordinary human, Augusta shows that she can rise to great power through dedication and strength.

title: Augusta/Backstory
content:
Augusta is a tall, striking woman with a lean, slender, but fit build and pale, clear skin. She has sharp, narrow eyes of an intense red hue with a white-gold ring surrounding her red pupils. She has long, vibrant and wavy orange-red hair that cascades past her shoulders down to her waist.

Her Tacet Mark is located on the back of her left hand.

title: Augusta/Backstory
content: Augusta wears a flowing white high-necked, sleeveless tunic-like top with golden accents in the style of wreaths. Over her top is a golden metallic chestplate with intricate detailing in a darker gold. A pair of metal pauldrons rest on both of her shoulders and connect to a black and golden high-necked choker. The lower part of Augusta's outfit is a white flowing skirt of the same design as her top along with silver armor plating but has three long pterugues strips of brown leather decorated with three gold disks. Underneath her skirt, Augusta has on a pair of thick black high cut shorts. For footwear, Augusta wears white high-heeled sandals accented with brown leather straps, and two metal platings over each of her shins. To accent her outfit, Augusta sports a golden piece of headwear shaped like a sunburst that rests on her brow and a pair of golden dangle earrings shaped as eight-pointed stars. Two leather brownvambraces with metallic platings cover both her foreams and she wears a black ring on each thumb.

title: Augusta/Backstory
content:
Septimont
|power=Magnetism Before Light
|evaluation= [Extracted from █████ Agon Participant Physical Report]  Name: Augusta This contender's Resonance history dates back to early childhood, nearly concurrent with her age. It is speculated that she is a Congenital Resonator.  Contender Augusta's Tacet Mark is located on the back of her left hand. Upon activation, she can generate and manipulate a magnetic field with a radius of approximately ten meters, centered around herself. With increasing mastery of her Forte, she can freely control and reshape materials such as iron, cobalt, and nickel. However, based on both personal testimony and test data, her Forte appears to have reached its developmental ceiling, with the ten-meter radius marking its practical upper limit.  "A rare Congenital Resonator, but her Forte offers little more than minor support in combat, and might, at best, be described as 'unremarkable.' For someone like her to stand out in the Agon? That's about as likely as the sun rising at midnight. Pure fantasy." —From a medical examiner's notes  The Tacet Mark branded on the back of her hand since childhood was both a gift from above and a cruel joke. Her feeble Forte once bound her like shackles, but now, she has long since melted those chains away. Step by step, she climbs the stairs to the throne, proving to all that even one born of dust can shine with the brilliance of a blazing sun.
