title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Augusta
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Strong—that was my first impression of you. Few have ever made me think that, but you were an intriguing exception. It was then I decided: when the time came, we would fight by each other's side. And as you know, I seized that opportunity when it came.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Deceit and vanity are the fragile facades I despise most. One must face their feelings in the light, be it joy, pain, ambition, or evil. That's why I admire you. You've never tried to hide the fire in your eyes. It's that honesty that made us comrades.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = You hold special access to the Ephor's Palace. Therefore, its gates shall always stand open for you. Hm? You wish to know why? There is no need. I recognize you as a dear friend, and that is reason enough. Should you ever need me, I will stand by you on any journey. This I swear.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = As I said before, the title of ruler is almost too narrow to capture the depths of your humanity. And yet... I can't think of a title more fitting for you. Of course, it should and will never bind you, because only you can define who you are. Ragunna's Laureate, Septimont's Champion, Hero of Heroes... they're but fragments of your story, never the sum of your soul.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I know well that your path stretches far beyond —that is what sets us apart. I, Augusta, Ephor of Septimont, was born of this land, and to its soil I shall one day return. My gaze reaches every hill and peak of Septimont, but it ends at the sea. You, however, are meant to embrace the world. So go. Seek the lands far and wide. That is where your true arena lies.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Augusta's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = From the heights of the Ephor's Palace, one can overlook the entire City of Septimont. Whenever I finish my duties, I enjoy climbing up to the rooftop to feel the wind. At times, Griffrexes returning from the Sanguis Plateaus soar above the palace. I listen to their cries, eyes tracing their wings as they sweep across every inch of Septimont's land, a land that we, and our forebearers, reclaimed from the jaws of calamity. We Septimontians rarely dwell on the pain of struggle, for we understand that the road to victory is never smooth. And I will carry this glorious legacy forward. It is the promise I make to our people, and to this land that burns with pride.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Augusta's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = My favorite food? Haha, that's a difficult question. The food in Septimont suits my taste just fine, though I do enjoy some foreign dishes as well. But if you ask me to recommend something, well, I'll spare you. Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired. Still, if you're in the mood for something, don't hesitate to speak up. I'll treat you. Good food is best shared with friends.
|vo_02_03_mention            = Iuno

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_mention            = Iuno



|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Uhm, I'm not a picky eater. As long as it satisfies, I'm content with anything. As for sweets, I don't indulge much. When I was young, Angel had a great fondness for desserts, so I would often leave her the treats that the adults gave us. Over time, I grew indifferent to sweets. But I wouldn't say I dislike them, either.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = When I was appointed as Ephor, I swore to defend the glory of Septimont until my last breath. Since that moment, my conviction has never wavered for even an instant. The passage of time has not dulled my vow. On the contrary, with each clash of blades, each call of the hunt, my resolve has only grown steadier and stronger. This is the mission I have chosen, and the path I must conquer.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = This greatsword is forged from the blades of countless Gladiators. You may have heard its tale. At first, I took those swords to spare the defeated a crueler fate. I took their blades, so they could live. I've always believed that a Gladiator's blood should be shed only for the greater good of Septimont. Of course, back then, I needed those blades to serve as my own fangs. Now, Gladiators no longer fight to the death in the Colosseum, and I no longer need a sword to prove myself. Yet somewhere along the way, this weapon became part of me, fused with my very flesh and blood. It bears witness to who I was... and shapes who I must become.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Not many know about my past, or rather, my whole past. It's not that there are dark secrets to hide, just... the things I did in my younger, more reckless days still make me cringe a little. But with you, I don't feel the need to hide anything. Honesty is the least I can offer in return for your trust.

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Avidius
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Avidius.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Avidius

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_mention            = Avidius



|vo_04_02_title              = About Lupa
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Lupa.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Lupa

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_02_mention            = Lupa



|vo_04_03_title              = About Buling
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Buling.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Buling

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_03_mention            = Buling



|vo_04_04_title              = About Angel
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Angel.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Galbrena

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_04_mention            = Galbrena



|vo_04_05_title              = About Iuno
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_hidden             = By Sun's Burning Hand
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Iuno.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Iuno

title: Augusta/Voicelines
content:

Aunt Qiu
content: Aunt Qiu is an NPC in , . A dried fruit maker whose left alone after her son left Mt. Firmament.

title: Aunt Qiu
content:
[Objective: (During Day)]
Aunt Qiu: Come, try my freshly dried fruit.
[Dialogue Option]  (Wave and decline.)
Aunt Qiu: Come on, don't be shy. Take it!
Mrs. Qiu stuffs a handful of dried fruit in your hand.
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the dried fruit.)
Aunt Qiu: Give it a try. How is it? Do you like it?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes.
Aunt Qiu: Grab more if you like it. I was worried it wouldn't suit your foreign taste buds!
[Dialogue Option]  How do you make these?
Aunt Qiu: That's easy. Let me show you.
Aunt Qiu: You get some berries in advance and wash them in cold mountain spring water.
Aunt Qiu: Then you cut them up, marinate them in a jar of sugar overnight, sun-dry them on a warm day, and they're guranteed to be a treat.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds simple.
Aunt Qiu: It does sound simple, but my child still can't manage it for the sake of his life. Sometimes he tries to help me, but usually, he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.
Aunt Qiu: Sigh. He's no longer in town now. I have no clue how he's doing outside Mt. Firmament...
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds complicated.
Aunt Qiu: Hehe, you are just like my child. He thought it was hard, too. Though he still tries to help me sometimes, usually he just ends up causing more trouble than it's worth.
Aunt Qiu: Sigh. He's no longer in town now. I have no clue how he's doing outside Mt. Firmament...
[Dialogue Option]  No.
Aunt Qiu: Not your taste, huh? Well, I have no clue whwat you foreign kids like or dislike. Guess I'll try something else when I return home.

title: Aurelius
content: Aurelius is a male NPC at the Echo Depository in Averardo Vault. Unlike his co-worker, Valerius, he is terrified of Echoes. Specifically, the ones from the vaults.

title: Aurelius
content:
[Objective: (During the Day)]
Aurelius: I'm quitting... I have to quit...
[Dialogue Option] : What's the matter?
Aurelius: Ugh! Just look at this place. There's nothing but creepy Echoes and oddballs. I don't know anyone can put up with this.
[Dialogue Option] : Creepy Echoes?
Aurelius: Yes, the Echoes here in this section of the depository! They've all got that spooky look on their faces. What are they even for anyway? They're nothing like the ones in Ragunna City.
Aurelius: I just don't get it. What do these rich folks even want with this stuff?
[Dialogue Option] : Oddballs?
Aurelius: Look at that guy over there by the bookshelf. The so-called  caretaker.
Aurelius: He's either buried in books or pacing around the Echoes... I even saw him reach out and touch one of their wings! He was muttering to himself the whole time, too.
Aurelius: Come on, these Echoes are alive! What if he's performing some kind of ritual to release them?!
Aurelius: I'm quitting... I have to quit...

title: Aurelius
content:
[Objective: (At Night)]
Aurelius: Don't come any closer, don't come any closer...
[Dialogue Option] : What are you talking about?
[Dialogue Option] : I'm coming closer.
Aurelius: Eeeehhh!!
Aurelius: Wait, you're not an Echo...
Aurelius: Wait. I think I just saw something flash and for a second there I thought one of those Echoes came to life.
Aurelius: Working here is just terrifying. I'm quitting... I have to quit...

title: Averardo Vault (Area)
content:
Front Desk Attendant: Welcome back, honored guest of the Montelli family. It is my pleasure to see you again at Averardo Vault.
Front Desk Attendant: Thank you for everything you've done for the Montellis and the Vault.
Front Desk Attendant: How may I help you today?
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of services do you offer here?
Front Desk Attendant: Well, as you can see, the Vault houses a special collection of rare items collected by the Montelli family.
Front Desk Attendant: From tangible relics like fine art, precious metals, and advanced technologies, to more elusive assets—Reserved Echoes, Remnants, and even abstract concepts. If it holds value, we store it.
Front Desk Attendant: You are welcome to store your valuables in our safe—for a small fee, of course.
Front Desk Attendant: Rest assured, the security we provide is well worth every coin.
Front Desk Attendant: Alternatively, if you wish to part with any of your items or Echoes, we can access their value. Should they be deemed worthy, we will make you an offer based on their worth.
Front Desk Attendant: By the way, we're currently refining our auction process to align with best practices from other regions.
Front Desk Attendant: As such, the auctions will be on hold for the time being.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds... good.
[Dialogue Option]  Many thanks.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll take a look around.
Front Desk Attendant: It's my pleasure. Should you require anything else, do not hesitate to ask.

He is a gladiator of Septimont, who is greatly favored by the Senate into becoming the Heroes of Hero and next Ephor.

title: Awei
content: Awei is an NPC located in . He can be found chatting with Hongzhen local, Xiangping (after completing Main Quest 'Thaw of Eons').

title: Awei
content:
Awei: There's nothing about this plant anywhere...
Xiangping: What's wrong?
Xiangping: Oh, what you got there is a Silver Lotus. We use it for food. It's nothing special.
Xiangping: If you're interested , I can give you some from my house.
Awei: Thank you, ma'am, but it's all right. I can pick some when I do my research in the mountains.
Xiangping: Okay, whatever you like.
Xiangping: Come over for dinner, I'll make my signature Silver Lotus dish.
Awei: Won't that be too much trouble?
Xiangping: No trouble at all! You don't get that outside Mt.Firmament. It is said Silver Lotuses only grow in snow patches where the Sentinel has been.
Awei: What? Silver Lotuses have something to do with the Sentinel? It sounds like a myth, but still, it could be a nice subject for a paper...

title: Ayla
content:
__NOTOC__
' is a NPC female Gladiator by the lake with the leaning blue tree. She's not originally from Septimont.

title: Ayla
content:
[Objective: (Only before]
Ayla: This is truly a remarkable place...
Ayla: That Priestess... She's still not here yet.

title: Ayla
content:
Ayla: Excuse me, I was wondering if you've seen a young beautiful Priestess with dark blue hair around here?
[Dialogue Option]  You mean… Iuno?
Ayla: That's right. Do you know her? Could it be we were destined to cross paths here...?
[Dialogue Option]  You can try your luck at Tetragon Temple.
Ayla: You are correct, in normal cases. But the Priestess I am looking for is rather unique.
Ayla: Her name is Iuno, the most gifted Priestess throughout the history of Septimont.
Ayla: I've heard that Priestess Iuno would come here for a walk during her leisure time. So I've decided to try my luck and hope that I can bump into her.
Ayla: I am not a Gladiator born from Septimont, so my knowledge of Septimont's Priestesses is rather superficial.
Ayla: I was quite skeptical about how the Priestesses are able to perceive the future. But that was before I saw Iuno's prophecy of Septimont's calamity with my own eyes.
Ayla: I came here to ask Lady Iuno to look into my fate. See if there's any possibility of realizing my dreams in the future.
Ayla: It's rather embarrassing to visit her at Tetragon Temple for a selfish matter like this. I wouldn't want to disturb the other Priestesses at work.
Ayla: Since there are rumours of people meeting her here, I will continue to wait patiently for my opportunity... Or perhaps this wait is also part of her prophecy?

title: Ayla
section: Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]
content:
[Objective: After]
;Ayla: Why do I come here every day?
;Ayla: Am I attracted to these views to this extent?
;Ayla: Or are there reasons beyond that?
Ayla: Graced by moonlight, this tree stands tall, bridging the heavens and the earth. For generations, it has silently watched over the hunting grounds, a steadfast witness to the stories of Septimontians.
Ayla: Such magnificence... You share the same sentiment as I do, don't you?
[Dialogue Option]  Did you get to see Iuno?
Ayla: Iuno? Who may that be?
[Dialogue Option]  Did you get your wish fulfilled?
Ayla: Strange... Have we met before? And did I mention anything about a wish?
Ayla: For some reason, I've been visiting this tree every night ever since I arrived at the hunting grounds.
Ayla: Whenever I take in this breathtaking view, a strange sense of loss will always weigh heavily on my heart.
Ayla: Am I... am I really here every night just for the view?
Ayla: Do you have the same feeling as I do?
Ayla: There's always this tingling feeling that I've forgotten something important. And yet I can't for the life of me recall what it was.

metadata.section: Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]

title: Ayla
section: Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]
content:
[Objective: After]
Ayla: Several days ago, when I returned to Septimont, I met a strange girl.
Ayla: For some reason, I felt like I'd seen her before… but when I thought about it, nothing came to mind...
Ayla: She caught me staring and came over to talk. We ended up having a pleasant conversation.
Ayla: That's how I made a new friend. Her name is Iuno.
[Dialogue Option]  Congrats on fulfilling your wish.
Ayla: Haha, that wasn't my wish! But I was genuinely happy to meet her.
Ayla: If I get the chance, I'd love to bring her here, to share this beautiful view.
Ayla: I'm sure she'd love it.
Ayla: Maybe that's the real reason I keep coming back to this tree, to one day bring a friend here.
Ayla: …And yet, I can't shake the feeling I've forgotten something important. No matter how hard I try, I just can't recall what it is.

title: Baglionia
content: ' is a NPC female Noble Gladiator participating in the Hunt, seen talking with two male Gladiators, Este and Sforza. They can be found in the Hunter's Den speaking about Avidius.

title: Baglionia
content:
;Este Always rambling on about glory, and then he aligns himself with that scorpion Falco?!
;Este No Gladiator worth their honor would crawl that low.
;Sforza Say what you want, but Avidius has what it takes to lead!
;Baglionia Enough. Let's not tear each other apart until we know the whole picture.
Baglionia: Ephor Augusta is certainly capable. But cries for Avidius to be the next Hero of Heroes grow louder by the day.
Baglionia: Makes you wonder whose banner we should rally behind. A difficult choice indeed...
Sforza: I respect the Ephor and hold no prejudice toward her background, but let's be honest. A Hero of Heroes is defined by innate talent, not by a crown of victory from the Great Agon!
Sforza: Avidius has braved four successful expeditions into Manes Deep. If that doesn't prove he's fit to be ruler, what does?
Este: Still, he's backed by Falco. That venomous scorpion alone should be enough to make you question his judgment!

title: Baglionia
content:
[Objective: ;After]
;Sforza Avidius is a hero, no doubt. Always has been, and he still is.
;Baglionia I've always known Ephor Augusta would turn the tide sooner or later...
;Este Ha, listen to you. Since when did you start playing Priestess?
Baglionia: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. My loyalty to the Ephor has never wavered. Her deeds shine as gloriously as the eternal blazing sun. A mere figure like Avidius can never be compared to her.
Sforza: The Ephor's deeds are indeed admirable. But I must insist that Avidius, too, is a true Gladiator and a hero deserving of the same glory!
Este: I agree with you, Sforza. I have respect for Avidius as well.
Este: As for you, Baglionia, spare us your theatrics.
Este: A profit-chasing opportunist has no loyalty to offer. You'd call yourself faithful no matter who comes out on top.

title: Baglionia
content:
[Objective: After]
Sforza: After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
Baglionia: Still no word on Avidius… and that Priestess…
Este: She seems cunning… but who exactly is she? Doesn't ring any bells.

title: Baglionia
content:
[Objective: After]
;Sforza Still no word on Avidius?
;Baglionia Ephor Augusta hasn't given a straight answer. Who knows where he's gone?
;EsteHa, maybe she's the one pulling the strings!
Baglionia: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. Ephor Augusta's radiance is beyond question. On what grounds could she ever deal with Avidius?
Sforza: The Ephor's virtues are beyond reproach. Still, it troubles me that we've heard nothing of Avidius so far.
Este: I heard a report that he was last seen in Ragunna, but since then, there has been no word.
Baglionia: You see? The Ephor has no part in this. Our concern should be finding Avidius's whereabouts.
Este: May the winds of Septimont not shift because of this.

title: Baiju
content: Baiju is a researcher for the Huaxu Academy. He can be found talking to Qinru during 07:00 to 18:00 and alone between 18:00 to 06:00.

title: Baiju
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Baiju:  A quantitative change leading to a qualitative change is not just about the quantity. Have you factored in the weight?
Baiju:  The weight distribution of the weapon will affect the accuracy, speed, and even the effective range of the attack.
Baiju:  The current designs have an even weight distribution compatible with most wielder's habits, which was approximated by the Ordance Division through rounds of trials and modeling.
Baiju:  Instead of strategizing on paper out of pure imagination.
Baiju:  It's normal for ordinary people to be curious about the unknown Tacetite weapon, but if you're  serious about studying it—
Baiju:  –you should master the basics of Tacetite before you get ahead of yourself.
Baiju:  Like this, asking me every day, the work in my hands is almost too busy.

title: Baiju
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Baiju: Ah, peace at last. Finally, I can have some time for me to think about the iteration of the Tacetite weapons.
Baiju: The most important in research is to block out frequent external disruptions. As a rookie researcher, I had the opportunity to collaborate with Mortefi before.
Baiju: He said that the research process is like playing a musical piece, the melody should be coherent and uninterrupted by any distractions from the audience.
Baiju: Though the grand tower of Tacetite studies is almost established, there are still two clouds obscuring the sky above it.
Baiju: Not far away, you can vaguely see a few small dark clouds drifting. What we have to do is to clear the clouds and let the sun shines through.
Baiju: After hearing this, it's like I was awakened from a daze and suddenly I found a path forward.
Baiju: Isn't it the reason why I set foot on this path to see the views behind those dark clouds? At the very least, I need to try to keep up.
Baiju: So that I can reach the highest point of the Tacetite building with everyone.

title: Baisong
content: Baisong is a Teacher NPC found in , Jinzhou Institute, found upstairs above the Jinzhou Theater stage.

title: Baisong
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Baisong: Children. One by one. Take your time. No need to rush.
Baisong: Let's start with Xinxin. What does Xinxin want to show the teacher?
Xinxin: Mr. Bosong! I finished my essay! I'm the first again!
Baisong: Good work, Xinxin. You always finish fast. I'll read them carefully.
Baisong: What about Ling'er? How's her essay coming along? Xinxin said before that Ling'er liked being alone and didn't seem to talk to everyone.
Baisong: So, if you encounter any difficulties, or if you have something that you don't understand or don't know who to share with, you can pen a letter to Ms. Yuyi. Sounds good?

title: Baisong
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Baisong again)]
Baisong: Well. When it comes to Ling'er...
Baisong: She doesn't like to talk and likes to keep things to herself. Her parents passed away while she was young and there's no one to take care of her.
Baisong: Yuyi's used to worry for Ling'er the most. During the holidays, she always asked me about how's Ling'er doing in school and in life.
Baisong: She said that she loved these children the most, and always worried about if they were healthy and getting the stuff they needed.
Baisong: When she left, she entrusted these children to me, but I could never be as thoughtful as she is. I really don't know if I can take care of them well... sigh...

title: Baisong
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Baisong once again)]
Baisong: Alright, children, it's time for class. Please be quiet.
Baisong: You may play all you want after class. But during class, please listen carefully.

She has seafoam green eyes under red eyelids and knee-length black hair with white streaks that has a low ponytail tied with a circular ornament though the sides of her hair from the back are loose, instead of going down with the tied bit of hair. Her hair is also tied with a gray tie, close to her head. Her Tacet mark is on her right thigh.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content: Baizhi wears a black, strapless short wrap dress that has a slit on the right thigh, revealing a white clothing that has flower-shaped tips, and the left side of the dress is white, starting from her chest to her thigh, and a white clothing under her dress, exposing her chest, with a sheer layer beneath it all. She also wears detached long sleeves, black gloves that partially cover her hand, a thigh garter at her right thigh, and black heeled boots.

content:
, Fridays are dedicated to analyzing  frequency bands, and the rest of her time is spent on field research, observing Remnant biology, and integrating cases. She adjusts her plan as needed, moving forward with precision and purpose.

Baizhi remains composed and self-sufficient, unfazed by unfinished work or challenging problems. She diligently studies until she grasps them with ease. This sense of calm makes it hard for others to approach her. With a cold expression and a distant tone, she unintentionally creates a feeling of distance. People can't help but imagine themselves being pushed away.

"Your report for the previous week was not submitted before its designated deadline."

"Ah... Yes... I, uh... The original  samples were contaminated. I had to..."

"Uhh, I'm sorry! No, I'm deeply sorry for my negligence! I... I'll make up for..."

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
"Uhh, I'm sorry! No, I'm deeply sorry for my negligence! I... I'll make up for..."



Seeing Baizhi approaching closer and closer, the reporting researcher nervously clutched his clothes and subconsciously bowed his head even lower. But the next moment, a processed sample slice was handed to him.

"I presume samples from a Fission Junrock would suffice?"

"But, that's your work..."

"You may complete your report before the stasis-evolution. Having anticipated this potential scenario, I have allocated adequate time to mitigate any deviation."

"Please inform me ahead of time should any analogous scenarios occur in the future. You were... trembling intensively just now. May I suggest increasing the ambient temperature?"

Her pair of emerald eyes finally revealed a pure and unconcealed sense of confusion.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
|text2         = A small sphere began to roll, then fell down a curve, and the end of the lever tilted upwards, showcasing the transmission of force.



11-year-old Baizhi observed the sphere as it once again stopped at its predetermined spot. She concluded that no matter how complex it may appear, the sphere would always roll uncontrollably to its destined end according to the device's design. This brought to mind a theoretical hypothesis from a recent book: Throughout history, human civilizations have failed to break through the bottleneck of this apparatus and inevitably meet their downfall. No exception.

If the results are always consistent, then isn't everything that has ever happened only a predictable repetition? Is there truly a meaning to it all?

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
If the results are always consistent, then isn't everything that has ever happened only a predictable repetition? Is there truly a meaning to it all?



Baizhi was consumed by this question, and her parents shared her concern for a different reason. While her passion for knowledge was admirable, Baizhi's obsession with theoretical concepts had distanced her from reality. She spent hours poring over esoteric texts and conducting simulations instead of enjoying life or making friends.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
Some days later, Baizhi received an invitation to the Huaxu Academy's scientific expedition base. That afternoon, she saw a device larger and more intricate than any before—components symbolizing different variables, intricately connected like a complex organic system. Yet, despite its grandeur, the device was still incomplete and too uncertain to become her "sphere" in what she was planning to achieve. With pensive eyes, Baizhi examined each part and formed hypotheses on how it functioned.

"How do you like it? Our team plans to finish building this someday."

The group's leader, who triumphantly returned from one of many grueling scientific expeditions he led, smiled warmly at Baizhi.

"Right there... If designed in such a way, the remaining energy will not be adequate to support the further distances, thus the information cannot be transmitted."

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
"Aah. So you've spotted its problem already... The Director was right about you. You really are talented! What say you? Do you want to join us?"

"Any rolling sphere will only end up in one way: to ultimately stop at a certain location. But I fail to see where your design will end up in."

"I would say, it will be in a place... unknown now, but can be made known one day? I agree there must be an endpoint. As to where it should end up... Well, maybe you can join us to find the answer. Together."

As he finished speaking, the half-opened door suddenly burst. open, revealing the rest of the team who had been hiding behind it. They stumbled into the room, their faces a mix of embarrassment and eagerness for Baizhi's response to join their mission.

At that moment, Baizhi thought she heard a faint crackling sound of a sphere being placed into its starting point.

|title3        = A Close Encounter
|text3         = In her fourth year on the scientific expedition, Baizhi encountered that piece of  band for the first time.

During that time, Baizhi's passion for research was at its peak. No longer isolated in her studies, she delved into every aspect of civilization with the rest of the scientific expedition team.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
As she ventured out into the frigid environment, she came to realize that true cold cannot be defined by a simple temperature reading of "-25°C." It was more accurately painted by endless blankets of white snow, the shivers that still crept through insulated gear, and the desperate knocking of frozen instruments. This theory was merely a skeleton, in need of real feelings and experiences for true understanding. Baizhi dutifully accompanied her team to other sites, not just ordinary ruins but surreal places filled with Remnant Energy—pure and complete information that remained elusive and intangible. Despite their advanced technology, they could not capture or analyze this powerful force.

Baizhi's ninth  expedition revealed a breakthrough.

The buildings within were neither distorted nor a reflection of reality; their material remained unknown.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
The buildings within were neither distorted nor a reflection of reality; their material remained unknown.



From above, light flowed through a hole in the dome, casting a soft pearl shimmer upon them. Baizhi and her team's arrival seemed to have triggered a mechanism. The geometrical buildings, originally suspended, began to change in their arrangement rapidly, forming unique images of symbols and numbers.

Baizhi was unable to decipher the purpose of the Sonoro Sphere or determine if she was witnessing a glimpse of the past, present, or an unknown future. But there was no time for wonder as her research instincts kicked in, pushing her to record every detail. This could be a breakthrough for a new theory—

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
The survey instruments displayed live fluctuation of frequencies. Baizhi cut off all distractions and focused on the displays. Her cumulated theories and feelings all came in handy for this exact moment.

The shorter the distance, the lower the energy consumption. Two points form a straight line, which leads to the source.

Just like constructing a device channel, Baizhi selected the two ends of the extension, connected them into a line, and picked up the sampling device towards the center of the gathering—

The surging light responded to Baizhi's actions, condensing into a ball of pure white light.

The Remnant band was thus captured and manifested, full but like an empty shell, pure and free of impurities.

Little did Baizhi know back then, it would forever stay with her and shape her lifelong research.

|title4        = Infinitely Close to Zero
|text4         = To Baizhi, making a wish was a perplexing action.

"Knowing that wishes are unlikely to come true, what is the point of making them? This action does not even have a clear object. Once you make a wish, will it be answered? Who will answer it?" Faced with Baizhi's sincere questions, her teammates were once again left speechless. Fortunately, after knowing her for a thousand days, they understood her seriousness and indirect tone as a means of seeking the truth and avoiding inconsistencies when judging or stating things.

Though Baizhi never made a wish herself, she always stood beside her teammates, as they made wishes on candlelights, shooting stars, or anything else.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
Though confused, she still tried to understand them and be there for them, like what they did for her.

"Please, I hope we can completely unravel the mysteries of  Creatures!"

"It can be done, but unlikely within our generation."

"Ahh, it's true... yet disheartening nonetheless! No need to overthink it, making wishes and reality are two different things... Anyway, you'll understand when you have one!"

In the dead silence of the icy field, that fateful day arrived.

The world collapsed without warning, as it often does. Vivid figures were dismantled by , and eyes that once spoke of the future grew cold. Baizhi felt her pulse weaken and her thoughts spiral out of control. Why was this happening? So much had been lost in the search for the . This couldn't be how it ends... She couldn't imagine a future without them.

"Please... I hope they can wake up again."

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
"Please... I hope they can wake up again."



She finally made a wish of her own, but she didn't know who could grant it.

As the Sonoro Sphere collapsed, Tacet Discords swarmed towards her. A tumultuous mix of emotions churned inside her, unable to stop her burning desire for everyone to wake up and return to her. She longed for them to open their eyes like they used to...

At that moment, a  appeared on her body, and a Remnant Creature resembling an Epiphyllum appeared before her, as if responding to her wish.

Nowadays, Baizhi still doesn't make wishes.

Wishes are not facts. She focuses on the tangible and what she can control instead.

As for the sole wish she has ever made, it was like a number infinitely close to zero, a longing buried deep inside her. It seems unattainable, yet it never fades away.

|title5        = The Endpoint
|text5         = Everything that happened under the glacier is already in the past.

As the only survivor, Baizhi never mentions it on her own accord.

Despite attempts by nosy individuals to uncover her secrets, nothing was revealed. There was no shady secret that could not be revealed. Everyone did their best. The public could not assign blame, and even the most diligent researchers understood the inherent risks in scientific expeditions. They push themselves to the limit, sacrificing their bodies to discover the truth, while also recognizing death as a possible outcome.

Baizhi's silence is rather more of her not knowing how to convey her thoughts.

Reflecting on the past is futile. Baizhi prioritized her time on crucial tasks, unique to her as the only survivor.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
Reflecting on the past is futile. Baizhi prioritized her time on crucial tasks, unique to her as the only survivor.



Soon after joining the Academy, Baizhi was seen rushing between various labs in the Branch of  Ecoacoustics, making countless innovations in the fields of Waveband Analysis, Applied  Studies, and simulated .

She proposed that Remnant creatures are energy bodies derived from "empty shells." They may be able to resonate with humans and be formed in a form beyond the band. By mastering the principle, humans may be able to develop artificial Sonoro Spheres and more Remnant creatures. These hypotheses shocked the academic community, but the Remnant creature that returned from a Sonoro Sphere with her perfectly proved her point.

title: Baizhi/Backstory
content:
She dubbed the Remnant creature  after the udumbara, a mystical flower sometimes associated with the Epiphyllum. This night-blooming flower, like the elusive Dharma and ultimate truth, vanishes quickly after a brief blossom. Despite years of searching, researchers have only found glimpses of what they seek—a concept no more tangible than the ephemeral Epiphyllum blossom.

Perhaps the name was a tribute to her lost comrades, or a constant reminder to keep pushing forward in her quest. So many answers await, and Baizhi knows she must find them all.

But she doesn't rush, for the destination lies ahead. She takes each step with patience as she journeys on before time runs out.

And this is not a lonely journey, for Baizhi has found a partner along the way—someone who shares her path and purpose.

title: Balanophora
content: Balanophora  is a quest-exclusive NPC who is first mentioned during Song of the Heart Sword, and makes her first appearance during . She is an Overseer of the Fractsidus, and is the overarching antagonist of Chapter IV: Rebirth From the Depths.

title: Balanophora
content: Balanophora is the "woman in red" referenced by Muyu that pulled the strings of the Autopuppet Crisis from afar. According to Muyu, Balanophora wanted to take Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule. She spent years undercover as a Ministry Intendant, backstabbed Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox and assassinated her. The Sentinel split off a Fractal Form known simply as "Hsin" in the crisis.

title: Balanophora
section: Infiltrating the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs
content: At some point in the distant past, over 200 years ago, she infiltrated and posed as an Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, as a means of getting close to Sentinel Hsin and her Civilization Capsule's technology for the Fractsidus. Hsin later summoned a meeting at Mengzhou's City Hall to deliberate between Zhuojun Atelier and the Court of Savantae over which of the two would construct Xuanfang Hold. Balanophora was present at the summoning in disguise, where she helped magistrate the meeting at Hsin's side, before Hsin ultimately selected the Court of Savantae to be the future Xuanfang Hold's builders.

metadata.section: Infiltrating the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs

title: Balanophora
section: Infiltrating the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs
content: After the conclusion of the meeting, Balanophora pulled Hsin aside to relay her doubts, questioning Zhoujun Atelier's self-serving, untrustworthy nature, and telling Hsin that she believed their lack of loyalties made them a liability. Hsin disagreed, arguing that the Court were the more dangerous of the two due to their relentless obsession with the pursuit of knowledge, and that reigning this ideology in at arm's length was her primary motive for selecting them to be Xuanfang Hold's architects, as she believed they would preserve it at all costs, granting them their "final wish" to sacrifice themselves to build the hold.

metadata.section: Infiltrating the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs

title: Balanophora
content: Later that evening, she accompanied the Sentinel back to her quarters. She praised the Sentinel's decision as one that would lift the spirits of the Mengzhou border troops, advising her to "pay no mind to the occasional objections," and encouraging her to be resolute in her decision. Caught unawares after settling, Balanophora unsheathed a hidden blade concealed within her hairpin, seizing the moment to quickly assassinate Hsin from behind.

title: Balanophora
content:
This later lead to the damaging and sabotage of her Civilization Capsule by the Fractsidus, while the original Hsin survived but was left in a critically injured state, forcing her to split her essence into the fractal form that became her eventual successor, who quickly fled with the Civilization Capsule in fox form to save it from the Fractsidus. According to Suoming, Hsin's assassination also coincided with the later emergence of the mysterious Waveworn Phenomenon known as the Evil Miasma.

Long afterwards, Balanophora's actions eventually led to the original Hsin being too weak to survive the inadvertent draining of her energy by her fractal form's remolding of the Civilization Capsule beyond the Hold's intended collapse, leading to her death.

title: Balanophora
content:
Over two centuries later, she temporarily allied herself with Muyu in the modern era, using him as a means to find another opportunity to steal Hsin's civilization capsule by infiltrating the Xuanyuan Domain. Muyu brought Xuanfang Hold close to the brink, but ultimately met his defeat at the hands of Rover and Qingxiao within the Xuanyuan Domain's Tian Realm.

Muyu was cornered at the end of the fight, where he unapologetically admitted his ties to Balanophora after failing to kill the duo with his newly-created Calamity Effigy shell that was possessed by him, before being struck down. Some time afterwards, he later attempted to escape in secrecy with one of Hsin's data cores by transferring his Reverberation into a frail Autopuppet shell.

title: Balanophora
content:
However, he was found and killed by Jingran, who sought revenge for Muyu's murder of his parents; Having earlier pretended to ally with Muyu to get in close proximity before betraying him. Ultimately, Muyu failed to procure the Civilization Capsule for Balanophora, causing her to suffer yet another setback in her conspiracy to seize the Capsule.

Following Muyu's death, her current whereabouts remain unknown.

Balanophora was disavowed in the aftermath by the Flowerveil Puppet upon Suisui's investigation into Muyu's ties to her, who denied Zhuojun Atelier having ties to the Fractsidus, claiming that Muyu's alliance with Balanophora was merely a technology trading partnership that ended years ago, despite evidence from logs left behind by Muyu that showed otherwise, along with his own final testimony to Rover and Qingxiao.

title: Balanophora
content:
Balanophora is a fair-skinned, slim woman with an angular face, dark black straight hair, and azure blue eyes. In her guise as a Sentinel Affairs Intendant, she kept her hair styled in a chin-length bob-cut, which she kept tied back, with her face being sharply framed by her bangs. Her most visually striking feature are the snake-like scales along the left side of her face. She physically appears to at least be middle-aged, judging by the wrinkles under her eyes, which give her a weary appearance. Though as Hsin noted, she had gone without sleep for 3 days at this point, so these may also simply be eye bags.

Balanophora's true appearance remains unknown.

title: Balanophora
content: As the Intendant of Sentinel Affairs, she wore a standard-issue Intendant uniform to maintain her guise. She wore a black, wide-sleeved jacket with black wrist-length gloves, layered over a crisp white high-collared blouse with dark gold regalia styling her overcoat and undershirt. The jacket itself is embroidered with traditional Chinese-inspired fox emblems that are braided along the jacket, including an ornamental fox pin on the left side of the coat. The jacket extends into a frock coat hanging over the sides of each leg. The uniform has a red pouch sashed at its hip.

title: Balanophora
content:
Little is known about Balanophora's true personality, beyond glimpses from her actions and comments made while in her disguise at the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.

Judging from her campaign against Hsin, Balanophora has had a centuries-long obsession with capturing the Mengzhou civilization capsule, to the point of political subterfuge. Similar to how her peers in the Fractsidus have acted, namely her superior and Cristoforo, she will not hesitate to resort to infiltration in order to get close to her targets or those she seeks to influence with a disturbing level of patience and commitment, as the Intendant role in the Ministry is notably one of its highest-ranking roles, both in the organization, and by extension the greater Huanglong political sphere. This is also shown in her successor Suoming's chain of command over the Ministry's representatives and agents.

title: Balanophora
content: She is also fiercely opportunistic and manipulative, even going as far as to engage in civil conspiracy and sabotage by manipulating Muyu, exploiting his drive to steal Hsin's knowledge for her own benefit in capturing the Civilization Capsule. In the past, she also quickly seized the chance to remove the original Hsin from the board just before she could use the Civilization Capsule to construct Xuanfang Hold, once they were isolated and alone together, having flawlessly played her role just to work towards this moment for an unknown amount of years beforehand, showcasing a strong degree of cunning.

title: Balanophora
content: As the Intendant, she retained an air of paranoia, suspicion, and hypervigilance around Hsin, particularly shown by her distrust of Zhuojun Atelier's selfish ambitions. In some of her final words to Hsin before murdering her, she briefly encouraged her to act decisively, while ignoring the disagreements of the people regarding her choice for the Court of Savantae to build Xuanfang Hold, implying she may be an Overseer that values faith and dedication to one's goals, and steadfast commitment over paying mind to the perspectives of her subordinates.

title: Balanophora
content: Like other Fractsidus Overseers, she is a Resonator, though her Tacet Mark and Forte remain unseen. Her namesake being a parasitic plant that deprives other plants' roots of sustenance suggests that her powers may involve a form of parasitism, and the ability to seed her influence in others. Whether her Forte empowered the hairpin she used to assassinate Hsin, or was some form of anti-Sentinel weapon, currently remains unknown. Her snake-like facial scales suggest that her Forte may also potentially involve poison.

title: Balanophora
content:
During the part where Balanophora is about to assassinate Sentinel Hsin, there are a bunch of scenes flashing on the screen within 2 seconds. These scenes include the Fractsidus Overseers Cristoforo and Phrolova, which implies that the Sentinel's assassination is connected to Fractsidus, and that the "Intendant of Sentinel Affairs" was associated with them.
This is confirmed by the skip summary mentioning her to be Balanophora.
The snake scales on Balanophora's face may reference the Chinese translation of her name, which literally translates to "蛇菰 (shé gū)", or "snake-fungus." In-universe, this may be a physical trait of her Resonator mutation.
Her actions may have additional parallels, due to her namesake's nature as a parasitic plant that burrows underground and attaches itself to roots to derive water and nutrients, which mirrors her deep infiltration of the Ministry's ranks and corruption of Hsin's Civilization Capsule.
As of her debut, Balanophora is technically the first human character to physically kill a Sentinel onscreen, having been the cause of the original Hsin's inability to survive her later frequency loss to her successor's remolding of the Civilization Capsule, despite the assassination attempt initially failing.

title: Balanophora
content: Balanophora is named after the genus of parasitic flowering plants.

title: Bank of Life
content: Bank of Life is an area of Tethys' Deep, The Black Shores, and a plant archive. Here, seeds collected by Bloom Bearers and Consultants from around the world are carefully nurtured by robot attendants. This vibrant underground section is where Solaris' flora gets systematically categorized.

title: Baptiste
content: ' is a Blacksmith supporting the Hunt. He is seen next to a fledgling Gladiator, Fredrico outside of the Tetragon Temple.

title: Baptiste
content:
Baptiste: This is the best blade I've forged in a long while.
Baptiste: To face the Dark Tide creations, steel and soul must fight as one. Sadly, I've seen far more blades make it home than men...
Baptiste: Hope this blade bring you luck, lad!
Fredrico: Does this sword have a name, sir?
Baptiste: No, not yet. Tell me, lad, what's your name?
Fredrico: Fredrico, sir.
Baptiste: Fredrico... A fine name. Return with this blade, and you can name it after you.
Fredrico: ...I will earn that honor, sir.
Fredrico: For the glory of my House, I'll prove myself worthy of this sword.

title: Baptiste
content:
[Objective: (After )]
Baptiste: You made it back, lad!
Fredrico: Barely... This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others...
Baptiste: Survival is an honor in itself. Don't be too hard on yourself.
Fredrico: Also... the sword you gave me, I lost it in the battle...
Fredrico: A Gladiator should never let go of their blade. I guess I'm not ready yet...
Baptiste: Haha! A sword's a sword. I can always forge another.
Baptiste: But you, you are the real blade of Septimont. This hunt only whets your edge.
Baptiste: Shame, though. The sword with your name will have to wait for another day.
Fredrico Until then, I'll keep sharpening myself.

title: Barrie
content: ' is a researcher located at a Roya camp in the Roya Frostlands.

title: Barrie
content:
;Barrie Sir, what were the frostlands like before the Lament? Could you tell the story again?
;Orson Back then, the water was clear, and the air was full of peace.

title: Barrie
content:
Barrie Sir, what were the frostlands like before the Lament? Could you tell the story again?
Orson Before the Lament... Ah. Back then, the Roya Frostlands were all fjords and vast forests. Peaceful. Serene. Endless...
Orson We roamed the forests and fjords, living off the land, guided by our deer. We drove our sleds through glacial valleys...
Orson Back then, the water was clear, and the air was full of peace... The white moon shone on the earth, holding the memories of our people...
Orson Then… they fell. Those "giants." Like stars, crashing down upon the frostlands.
Barrie The Lament shifted Solaris's axis and magnetic poles. Roya forests became the new south pole. Then came the first wave of extinctions.
Barrie The geomagnetic chaos that followed caused satellites and space stations orbiting Solaris to fall.
Orson These giant wrecks became shelters from the cold for the Roya, allowing one tribe to survive.
Orson But as for the others... They were not so lucky... Sigh.
Barrie I'm sorry. I shouldn't have asked... It must be hard to talk about.
Orson Oh, it's all right, young man. It's just a story passed down from my great-great-grandfather...
Orson I've spent most of my life trudging through ice and snow. What do you think? Will I ever have a chance to see the Roya forests again?
Barrie Of course!

title: Barton
content: Barton is an NPC in  and a member of the Troupe of Fools. he can be seen talking with Mosi during the day about the Order's new play.

title: Barton
content:
Barton This... this... is yet another baseless slander!
Barton If this religious play actually gets performed, how will my wife and daughter see me? How will the rest of the town see them?
Barton How are they supposed to live in Ragunna after this? Damn it!

title: Barton
content:
Mosi: Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?
Barton Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.
Mosi: Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.
Barton If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.
Barton But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.
Barton There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
Barton We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.
Mosi: ...That's not the life I want.
Mosi: I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.
Barton Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.
Barton This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.

content: Base Camp is an area of Solisia Landing, Roya Frostlands. The camp levels up through Into the Land of Paradox.

title: Batti
content: Batti is a girl NPC who appears in Ragunna, Rinascita. She can only be seen from 5:00 PM to 6:59 PM, talking to Leto next to a Tubpup.

title: Batti
content:
Leto: I feel like I've seen that "Drama Maniac" from Egla Town somewhere before...
Batti: He's a bit odd... but his stories about the Fool's Troupe are rather captivating!
Batti: Eccentric Roccia the First Mate, free-spirited Captain Brant...
Leto: Batti, don't you think the "Drama Maniac" looks a lot like Uncle Lorenzo?
Leto: But his hair color is different, his clothes have a different style, and he wears a mask, so you can't see his face...
Leto: But when he performs, his gaze always drifts toward us.
Leto: Almost as if he's telling the story for our sake...
Batti: Uncle Lorenzo went on a pilgrimage, didn't he... The adults looked so strange when he left.
Leto: So I haven't dared mention this to Gisle—just hearing Uncle Lorenzo's name makes him sad.
Batti: How about... we investigate it ourselves!
Admiral Tubpup: Bark bark!
Batti: I bet a Monnaie he's not Uncle Lorenzo!
Leto: It's a bet!

title: Battier
content: Battier is a quest-exclusive NPC and a member of the Troupe of Fools. He first appears in .

title: Beatrice
content:
Beatrice: It's said that the Chief Steward of the Black Shores once dedicated all of Tethys' computing power to simulating the development of civilizations.
Beatrice: However, this practice pushed the System to the brink of collapse.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Beatrice: The Stellar Navigators were amazed by Tethys' nearly otherworldly programming.
Beatrice: Still, even such power is fragile in a world where the future is always uncertain.
Beatrice: Preventing disasters, preserving the sparks of civilization, and monitoring the Lament—these are the duties we bear at the Black Shores, a promise we've made to humanity.
Beatrice: If sacrifice is what's needed for a better future, then... I'll keep walking this path, carrying on the struggle until my last breath.

title: Beatrix
content:
Beatrix is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita.

From 8.00 AM - 11:59 AM and 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM, she can be found talking with Nevana in the middle of Bank Street.

title: Beatrix
content:
[Objective: (at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)]
Beatrix: I'm so tired. My eyes can barely stay open...
Beatrix: 6681, 6682...

title: Beatrix
content:
[Objective: (at 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM)]
Beatrix: Phew... I've been busy all morning, and I still have to keep counting this afternoon. I need to pull myself together...
Nevana: Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. Zani.
Beatrix: Tell Ms. Zani I said thank you.

title: Beatrix
content:
[Objective: (at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)]
Nevana: What are you counting?
Beatrix: That bastard Barbosa made me count every old Monnaie sent to the vault.
Nevana: The more incompetent the boss, the more fragile their ego. I warned you not to go against him. He'll just make an example out of you.
Nevana: People in high positions care the most about saving faces. Show them attitudes, you only get a taste of your own medicine.
Nevana: But I do agree with you on one thing.
Beatrix: What's that?
Nevana: He's a bastard.

title: Beatrix
content:
[Objective: (at 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM)]
Beatrix: Look, the empty coffee cups on my desk are stacked to the ceiling.
Beatrix: I swear, once I've downed my one-thousandth cup, I'm going to turn these empty cups into a piece of installation art!
Beatrix: I'll write a resignation letter and put it through paper shredder—
Beatrix: stuff the shredded pieces into every coffee cup and fill Mr. Barbosa's office with them.
Beatrix: I've even thought of a name for this installation—it'll be absolutely sensational.
Nevana: What's the title? Let me hear it.
Beatrix: Sip and Split.

title: Becker

content:
Becker: Phew... finally...
Emmie: You okay? I saw your sync rate spike by a whole new percentage point at the end there.

Becker: Just now, I felt like I'd hit my limit... I could barely hold on.
Becker: And right then, it felt like someone stepped in to help me. Just enough so I pulled through.
Becker: Who could it have been...?

title: Bellano
content:
Bellano is a fishmonger who appears at the Montelli Quarter marketplace. He has a soft spot for cats.

He can be seen talking with Sofia from 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM and talking with Aleksander from 6:00 PM to 10:59 PM.

title: Bellano
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 1:59 PM)]
Bellano: Fresh catch from Riccioli!
Bellano: Whadda Crab, Coconut Urchin, Rainbow Dolphinfish, Titanium Mackerel, you name it!

title: Bellano
content:
[Objective: (2:00 PM to 4:59 PM)]
Bellano: Look who it is, my little glutton!
Bellano: You're always around when there's fresh fish.
Bellano: Go ahead and dig in! If you can make it to the Riccioli Islands, you'll be in for a real treat.
Bellano: Too bad I'm getting old and can't catch any big fish anymore.
Bellano: If I managed to hook a Fish King, all the cats in Ragunna would come running!

title: Bellano
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)]
Sofia: Hey, Bellano, can't you sell these two little fish separately?
Bellano: No can do. Once these two fish start kissing, they're inseparable!
Bellano: If you try to force them apart, the meat will instantly turn rancid.
Sofia: ...I wonder if Riccioli is full of these strange creatures.
Bellano: You know what? We used to call them "Die Hard Lovers!"
Bellano: The longer they lock lips, the fresher and tastier the meat!
Bellano: Then an Acolyte from the Order visited the island and thought the name was unseemly, so he renamed them with a more scholarly term.
Sofia: What's it called now?
Bellano: —"'Til the Fin-ish!"
Sofia: Ha, what a poetic name. Makes them sound even more delicious.

title: Bellano
content:

Aleksander: This is my cat, Aleksander II—come on! Say hello to the shopkeeper!
Aleksander II: Me-ow!
Bellano: ...
Aleksander II: Purrrrrr...
Bellano: ...Alright, fine, 20% off. No more.
Aleksander: Hooray!

title: Bellfonte
section: Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]
content:
[Objective: (After completing By Sun's Burning Hand)]
;Savior of Septimont? Too cliché...
;Radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma? Hmm... that might just do!

Bellfonte: Savior of Septimont, radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma!
Bellfonte: I, Bellfonte, must humbly apologize for my previous shortsightedness. Please forgive my reckless words. You've driven back the miasma and opened the path to final victory.

title: Bill
content: Bill is an NPC located in City Square and only appears at night  (6:00 PM - 05:59 AM).

title: Bill
content:
Graham: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
Graham: No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your shipments!
Graham: Look at these freeze dried jerkies—fresh from Rinascita to Huanglong. Kitties in Jinzhou love it!
Hamm: Huh? Isn't that a Hound? Why would a Hound be called "Kitty"?
Graham: Uh... well... that's not the point here!
Hamm: The point is, how can a Hound be called Kitty? Kitty is clearly a name for a cat—it must be a misdelivery.
Nara: Right! This goes against common sense. Is Lollo Logistics really reliable?
Bill: Exactly! By this logic, Lollo Logistics should be renamed to "Chichi Logistics."
Hamm: What do you mean?
Bill: See, the Lollo Logistics mascot is a hamster! Hamsters don't go "lo-lo-lo," they go "chi-chi-chi"!
Graham: Well... I can explain! Everyone, let me explain!
Graham: When a hamster's cheeks are full of food, it makes a "lo-lo" sound.
Graham: And do you see the deep pockets on our vests? They're super spacious, and super efficient!
Graham: No matter how oddly shaped the shipment, Lollo Logistics can "swallow it whole!"
Graham: So, in summary, if you need courier services, Lollo Logistics is the way to go!

title: Black Shores
content:
The Black Shores cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place. The frequencies from the Tacetite and of the mist distorts human perception and jams all forms of communication, making the archipelago inaccessible to most. Communication with the outside world is only possible via the Black Shores' Beacon relay system.

Members of the Black Shores who operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands, are known as "Consultants". Those stationed at the headquarters are referred to as "Bloom Bearers". Apart from these fundamental duties, the Black Shores also accommodates a plethora of other specialized roles.

title: Black Shores
content:
With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3. Though the Black Shores openly shares its advanced technologies with its partners, even its own members remain unaware of the true origins of these innovations.

The organization has a secretive membership process and most members of the organization keep their identities hidden. Their symbol is a Blake Bloom, a Remnant plant with energy from the island and each member wears it on their person. Only those who wear it can step on their soil.

title: Black Shores
content: Talents with sight and knowledge from worldwide, invited to join the Black Shores. They operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands. Though excelling in different expertise, they act with a consensus to counter the threat of the Lament.

title: Black Shores
content: Stationed at the headquarters, Bloom Bearers carry their duties mostly within the territory of the Black Shores. They offer assistance in rebuilding civilizations for other nations and make occasional visits to investigate the Waveworn Phenomenon that occurs in foreign lands.

title: Black Shores
content: In charge of administrative duties such as organizing the information of new candidates.

title: Black Shores
content: A mysterious lifeform that rests beneath the Black Shores' subterranean galaxy. Her physical structure and age are shrouded in mystery. In the complicated coding language of the Tethys System, the name "Shorekeeper" also means "Guardian of Secrets". She chose to call herself "Shorekeeper" to symbolize her role in watching over those who venture away from the shores into faraway lands.

title: Black Shores
content: They have developed a Lament prediction system and have established mutual partnerships with nations worldwide. The Resonance Beacons are set up to monitor the Lament, collecting data in real-time. They use monitoring registers that they had placed around the world to monitor the Sentinels. The TD observatory is used to monitor Tacet Discords across Solaris, it handles collection, storage and transmission of anything related to TDs.

title: Black Shores
content: The Tethys System, also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. The Tethys System has no discernible energy source, physical infrastructure, or processing core, but is instead powered entirely by the Tacetite land mass upon which the Black Shores Archipelago was built upon. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious. The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

title: Black Shores
content:
These unique robots, found throughout the Black Shores, serve as the physical terminals of the Tethys System. Their construction and performance capabilities remain largely unknown, yet they possess direct access to the system, second only to its administrator. Within the Black Shores, these robots function both as assistants and tools in the daily activities of its members.

Each terminal has a distinct personality, and the study of these robots has advanced the field of cognitive psychology.

The KU-robots found all over the island are directly linked to the Tethys System. The Tethys system gives them all their own personalities and voice frequencies are encoded into languages that humans can understand. The robots can be considered a living race of their own.

title: Black Shores
content:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament.

Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework. The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

title: Black Shores
content: A type of Stellar Matrix. Inside the Tethys System, a celestial body called Necrostar swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Matrices find their end. Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it.

title: Black Shores
content: Stabilizing devices called Anchors are strategically positioned throughout the above and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetite that makes up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need for building a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores. The Anchors are independently developed and designed by the Black Shores, drawing inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design.

title: Black Shores
content: Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence. At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices, collection of stars, is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has even been honored with the title of "The Modulator".

title: Brant
Brant/Backstory
content: Brant has a boundless passion and theatrical flair, embodying both the performer and the dreamer in equal measure. As the captain of Rinascita’s Troupe of Fools, he thrives in chaos, reveling in the unpredictable nature of both the stage and life itself. His charisma is effortless; larger than life yet never insincere. He is a free spirit who dances between the whimsical and the profound, unafraid to embrace the absurd yet always carrying a quiet depth beneath his exuberance.

title: Brant/Backstory
content: Brant’s romantic nature extends beyond love; he is enamored with the world itself, seeing beauty in every fleeting moment. He believes that life, like a performance, should be embraced fully: boldly, passionately, and without restraint. He slips effortlessly into roles, crafting illusions with his words and presence, yet when the curtain falls, he is remarkably genuine. His loyalty to his troupe and those he cares for is steadfast, and while he may jest and tease, his warmth is undeniable. Though he appears carefree, he is a man who carries his own burdens in silence, choosing to shoulder them with a smile rather than darken the spirits of those around him.

His shoulders are adorned in black and gold pauldrons with many layers beneath them including a light blue layer with a bright fuchsia pattern repeating 3 times. Under that is a white layer with golden anchor shaped pins on both his left and right with jewelry strung in between them along with being adorned with frilly white and pale blue sleeves adorn with golden patterning and engravings and various belts and extensions. He wears long black fingerless with red straps near the wrists that cover up his forearms along with a red and black cape. Brant also white trousers with a double crossed belt and black boots with golden laces.

title: Buling
Buling
content:
In Chinese voice-overs in the main story, a part of Buling's line are spoken in .
(Chinese: 卜 bǔ) is a Chinese surname. When used as a noun, it means "prophecy or prediction."  When used as a verb, it means "to divine, to predict."
During the Shang and Zhou dynasties, the Chinese referred to divination using tortoise shells as "卜" Later, this term became a general term for various forms of divination, although tortoise shells are not always necessary for divination.
(Simplified Chinese: 灵 líng) is the simplified form of (Traditional Chinese: 靈 líng) meaning "supernatural beings, roughly equivalent to gods or spirits."
Because "卜" and "不" (meaning "not") are homophones in Chinese, the name "Buling" has a wordplay in Chinese, which can be humorously expressed as "不灵" (bù líng), meaning that the diviner's divination did not work, or it can be extended to mean that a specific thing is ineffective. This is related to the setting in the game where her ability sometimes causes her to be struck by lightning.

title: Buling/Backstory
content:
City's Main Street, a stall owner was still scrolling through forums when a girl with fiery red hair stopped at her stand. She glanced up over her slipping glasses and smiled.  "Hey there, boss. Want to try something? Exorcisms, talisman readings, fortune-telling… You name it, I 'bling'—wait, you're a ?"  "That's right! Chixia, !" Chixia straightened with pride at being recognized, then quickly regained her serious tone. "I've had reports about you setting up a stall without permission, offering readings to anyone who walks by. It's almost like—"  "A scam?" Buling's grin didn't waver.  "…I wouldn't go that far. But I'd appreciate it if you came by the  to give a statement about your… business."  "Aiya, Boss, it's all honest work, building good bonds lah. Take that young fellow from  who came yesterday morning. He asked me to divine his research project. By now, I'd wager he's on his way here to thank me."  "Seriously?" Chixia began to question, but before she could finish, a young man in a lab coat came hurrying up the street and stopped at the stall.  "Thank you, Master! My experiment finally succeeded—the data fit perfectly! I can finally publish a paper!"  "No need to thank me," Buling said, waving him off. "That was all your hard work and persistence paying off."  Under Chixia's astonished gaze, the researcher bowed his thanks several more times before hurrying away.  "He just needed a little more confidence in his research, that's all," Buling said, nudging her round glasses back into place.  All afternoon, Chixia tailed this suspicious stall owner as she guided a  courier anxious about the career, sold a prosperity talisman to a travelling merchant, and read a local's palm for signs of love. Each request was different, Buling's answers just as varied, yet every customer left looking satisfied.  By sunset, Buling began packing up her stall. She glanced toward the shade of a nearby tree and called out, "Relax. I've earned enough for now, so no more stalls for a while. And I'm starving. How about dinner at your auntie's place? My treat. But just so you know that I'm not ordering anything spicy."  "Wait—how do you even know Mrs. Panhua is my… Did you divine that too?" Chixia stepped out of the shadows.  "Oh, that?" Buling grinned. "She told me herself. Over lunch."  Not long after, 's wandering Taoist Buling and Jinzhou's famed Speedster Chixia would team up to tackle a so-called haunting event on Main Street. But that, of course, is another story.

|title2   = The Way of Flexibility
|text2    = Thick clouds smothered the moonlight that night, plunging the world into darkness.  "It's right there, Master!"  At his young disciple's cry, the aged Taoist shaped a quick mudra with one hand and leveled his peachwood sword with the other. Golden light leapt from the blade, streaking toward the corner of a wall. It struck something unseen, flared outward, and flooded the alley with daylight-bright radiance—revealing a Whisperin  crouched in the shadows.  His eyes flicked to his disciple. She had already drawn a talisman and begun her chant: "Body and seal align, thunder at command… All evils, repelled!"  The words had barely left her lips when a bolt of lightning split the sky, crashing down upon the Tacet Discord. Wrapped in thunderlight, the creature began to fade. Though her talisman was already spent, the girl stayed on guard, fishing a copper coin from her pocket as she stepped closer.  "…Finally… home…"  The broken whisper froze her in place.  "Pull yourself together, Buling," came her master's deep, steady voice. "A Tacet Discord is nothing but a monster. It's no ghost, and certainly nothing human." She nodded, flicked the coin into the air, and another flash of lightning cleaved the darkness. The Tacet Discord vanished completely. The old Taoist's furrowed brow eased as he turned toward the house, whose gates were tightly shut.  Three measured knocks. The door creaked open, and a silver-haired elder stepped out.  "Master, was it really… my son who returned?"  It was Buling's first time following her master down the mountain to "exorcise a ghost." On their way back to the sect, she couldn't help but ask, "Master, you always say there are no such things as ghosts. So why tell that lady her son's spirit came home to see her? And even pass along a message for her to live well?" "…That's called the Way of Flexibility. Someday, you'll understand." "Mm… Seems the world beyond the mountain really does hold a lot to see." "Heh… when you're strong enough to stand on your own and want to travel alone, then go," he said, grinning up at the endless stars. "Cultivation isn't confined to our temple's four walls. Your world should be far wider than this."  At that, Buling's clear eyes filled with the same bright starlight.  "…But if you ever stir up trouble out there," Master Jiufeng added quickly, "don't speak of my name."
|mention2 = Jiufeng
