title: Cordelia
content: Cordelia is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita. At 6:00 PM - 7.59 AM, he can be seen talking with Quinto in Bank Street.

title: Cordelia
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Quinto: If this keeps up, Averardo Vault will turn into an Averardo General Store.
Quinto:  The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament , from New Federation—what kind of art is just a rusty tin can?
Quinto:  The Scented Banana on the Wall , from Rinascita—this nearly rotting banana is taking up an entire wall!
Quinto:  The Acolyte's Breakfast , from Rinascita—it's a safe...
Cordelia: We're only responsible for storage. We can't judge their artistic value.
Quinto: But can these really be considered art? Maybe next time, I'll frame a leftover slice of pizza.
Cordelia: Just don't use Pizza Tropicale.
Quinto: If only I were an artist. Making money would be too easy.
Cordelia: The pieces you mentioned are highly valued on the market. Please make sure you take good care of them.
Cordelia: Remember to lower the storage room temperature for  The Scented Banana on the Wall .

title: Cordelia
content:
The Scented Banana on the Wall  refers to a real life conceptual art piece called "Comedian" by Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan.
The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament  is referenced again by Ludvika.

title: Cornelia
content: Cornelia is the Averardo Vault Underground bank receptionist, located at the Echo Station.

title: Cornelia
content:
Cornelia: Welcome to Arverado Vault. Is there something I can help you with?
[Dialogue Option] : I'd appreciate a formal introduction.
Cornelia: Averardo Vault operates under the principles of "utmost respect for all private properties." It is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.
Cornelia: You are currently in the lower level of Averardo Vault. Any items you choose to deposit will be stored here.
Cornelia: The underground is divided into three main areas: The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository, The Echo Depository, and the Talent Depository. Whether you're storing valuables or showcasing creativity, Averardo Vault is here to help you make the most of them with unmatched service.
[Dialogue Option] : I'd like to store a hundred Gulpuffs.
Cornelia: Alright. Thank you for choosing Averado Vault's Echo storage services.
Cornelia: Gulpuffs are classified as low-value Echoes. If you wish to store them, you will need to purchase insurance yourself and pay a storage fee based on their storage unit.
Cornelia: If you'd like to sign up for this service, we'll have the Echo Depository contact you regarding further details right away. Our team will create a custom plan to meet all your storage needs, ensuring your Gulpuffs are carefully looked after during their time with us.
[Dialogue Option] : How's my ton of gold coming along?
Cornelia: One moment, I'll verify your identity details.
Cornelia: I'm sorry, but it appears your account doesn't currently show an order of one ton of gold.
Cornelia: But I see your account has been verified by Lady Carlotta and currently enjoys premium services.
Cornelia: Should you wish to store a ton of gold in the future, we'll provide an exclusive plan and ensure your assets receive the most professional management and protection.
[Dialogue Option] : I'd like a bowl of fried rice.
Cornelia: ...
[Dialogue Option] : (Did she really just sigh?)
Cornelia: (Quietly) How many more of these wackjobs are we going to get every day...
Cornelia: Ahem, apologies. I mean I'm afraid we don't offer dining services here.
Cornelia: If you're looking to eat, you can visit the Ducat Hall upstairs. Their banquet hall offers a wide variety of delicious options.
Cornelia: I'll be here should you require any more assistance.

title: Corrado
content: ' is a Quest Exclusive NPC Gladiator who only appears during .

title: Corrado
content:
;Been a long while since the fire of the hunt burned this bright around here...
;How I wish you  were here to see it with me, old friend...

title: Corrado
content:
Corrado: A newcomer, are ya? Looking for someone to talk to?
[Dialogue Option]  Any stories about the hunts you've joined?
Corrado: Haha, sure. Let me tell you one... One I'll never forget.
Corrado: Thirty years ago, I went hunting with an old friend. We were young, hungry for the biggest, meanest beast we could find. My friend was stronger than the rest of us, and twice as ambitious.
Corrado: Following his plan, we spent days luring a Tacet Discord into the beast's territory. The goal was to provoke its territorial instinct and drive it into a fight.
Corrado: When the two monsters clashed, we pounced. With the help of the Griffrexes, we drove our blades through the beast's skull.
[Dialogue Option]  And then? What happened next?
Corrado: And then... he claimed the kill, took the glory, and left the Plateaus.
Corrado: I didn't mind. That was always our agreement. We both had dreams, and he had the better shot at making them real.
Corrado: But... like the beast we slew, he couldn't conquer his own hunger. Just another hunter, lost in someone else's hunting ground.

title: Corrosaurus
content:
to . A rare, giant Tacet Discord that inhabits the Sanguis Plateaus, armored in scales and spewing molten rock. Its jagged crest lifts high, a mark of its dominion.
Appearing alongside the Dark Tide, the Corrosaurus's roar declares the start of a glorious hunt to the Gladiators of Septimont.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Cosa
content: Cosa is a male NPC who appears at the bar in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. he can be seen talking to Rafael during the daytime.

title: Cosa
content:
Cosa: Have you heard? Averardo Vault has suddenly tightened its security.
Rafael: Probably just a routine security drill.
Rafael: After all, it's the safest place in Rinascita. Nothing can go wrong there.
Cosa: Let's hope so. As long as nothing happens to my precious Echo in the vault...
Rafael: Precious Echo? What Echo is precious enough to be in Averardo Vault?
Cosa: Shh, keep it down!
Cosa: It's a rare specimen. I paid a fortune to bring it back from Jinzhou, Huanglong.
Cosa: It's called Dwarf Cassowary. They say it's particularly clever and understands human language.
Rafael: Really? I'd love to see that...

title: Cosimo
content:
Cosimo Sorrentino is the owner of Sorrentino Inn and former member of the Order. His nephew, Damian, is the receptionist and acting innkeeper.

He can be found with Wicktorio in front of an overgrown and abandon house during 07:00 to 10:00, seemingly with regrets.

title: Cosimo
subsection: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)
content:
[Objective: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)]
Cosimo: Heh... How many years have we been strolling here every morning?
Wicktorio:  I can't remember. My memory is not what it used to be. We're just old fools approaching the grave.
Cosimo: Every time I see this house, I feel as if the child's right before me...
Cosimo: Oh Imperator, is her fate also part of your design?

metadata.subsection: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)

title: Cosimo
subsection: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)
content:
[Objective: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)]
Cosimo: Welcome to Egla Town, traveler from afar. May you have a wonderful time here.
Cosimo: Despite that... there have been some unusual circumstances lately, so please avoid going out at night unless absolutely necessary. If you need accommodation, please speak with Damian. He'll help you arrange a room.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean by unusual circumstances?
Cosimo: Have you ever heard the tale of the knight? Once, a knight ventured deep into the area to vanquish a menacing "giant" that plagued the land. Since then, the knight has become a symbol of this place.
Cosimo: Many knights have been drawn to this place by its fame. And one of them had likely become the "Mad Knight."
Cosimo: It is said that he gradually lost himself during the endless fight against the Tacet Discords...
Cosimo: To placate the Mad Knight, the town create the Night Reveries- endless dramas of the knight enacted by the Echoes. Townsfolk and visitors alike were advised to stay indoors at night.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks. That's all I need.

metadata.subsection: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)

Cristoforo
content: Cristoforo is a handsome young man of slim build and average height. He has slick, blond hair with short bangs in the front of his forehead tied in a ponytail and narrow green eyes.

title: Cristoforo
content:
Cristoforo wears a red tricorn hat that is black inside with golden diamond buttons, three black strands attached to both sides of the brim, yellow eyes over silver scars shaped like cat nail claws and a pair of black feathers attached to the back.

His outfit consists of a white blouse with golden diamond-shaped buttons and an a black jacket featuring a red collar made of a seemingly synthetic material that features a black cape draped over his shoulder, attached by a red strap with a spherical golden buckle over white puffed sleeves with a white trim, red knee pads with white socks shaped like feathers, and black boots with red soles. Additionally, he sometimes dons a black domino mask with golden highlights and a pointed nose shaped like a toucan beak.

title: Cristoforo
content:
Presenting himself as a playwright, Cristoforo initially appears as a individual who possesses great knowledge of various subjects, such as Rinascita traditions and history.

Although revealed to be an Overseer, his theatrical nature is genuine and almost a metaphor for his true work. Rather than directly driving his plans, he prefers to instead "place characters on their stage," instigating and witnessing situations unfold as people make their own choices that lead to their own undoing. According to Phrolova, he adores the heroic tales told in Rinascita to the point of obsession, and that extends to instigating trials and turbulations that heroes must overcome during their journeys. He is also shown to personally enjoy reveling in the beauty of tragedies and the suffering of others, particularly Mya, as works of art, a trait which other Overseers like Phrolova find detestable.

title: Cristoforo
content:
He is a Resonator, though his Tacet Mark has yet to be seen.

His Resonance ability seems to allow him to create a Sonoro Sphere comparable to a script of a play, where each world within is a repeating story that manifests as reality. This requires inspiration in the form of a narrative anchor based on past events, and he cannot stray too far from the framework of the original story. However, whenever a story repeats, any changes bleed through into the new pages.

Within these stories, everyone has an assigned role, and to lose one's role results in a loss of identity and memory, ultimately leading to the complete erasure of one's existence.

His ability seems to be capable of reshaping reality in turn, but the extent of this is currently unknown. He has previously been shown to manifest the imagination and fear shared by the minds of an audience, such as the Ragunessi, into real life.

title: Cristoforo
content: Years ago in Ragunna, Cristoforo met the members of the Golden Anthem in Whisperwind Haven while claiming to be common artists. Suggesting they sing for the people of Ragunna rather than solely for the Divinity, he guided them to a lithograph depicting the true form of Imperator, prompting them to turn against the Order and attempt to share the truth, ultimately leading to their deaths aboard the Pilgrim's Sail.

title: Cristoforo
content:
Claiming to be a playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for his work, Cristoforo first appears in Through the Sea Thou Break, stopping Rover from intervening with the Pilgrim's Sail. With the explanation of working on scripts about the Pilgrim's Sail and the Blessed Maiden, he appears several times in , providing some guidance and information to Rover.

During What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing, he is revealed to be an Overseer of the Fractsidus, working with Phrolova, and is responsible for orchestrating events in Rinascita.

title: Cristoforo
content:
While not officially marked as part of the quest, Cristoforo appears inside the Averardo Vault during Veils Off in Sun or Shadow, where he can optionally be spoken to.
Given his proximity at the time, he is likely the 'Lord Overseer' mentioned by the Fractsidus members encountered outside the vault.
Farroll of Golden Anthem comments that Cristoforo's speech indicates he is of Rinascita's nobility. Ciaccona also questions this.
Despite this, Ragunna nobles such as Carlotta do not seem to recognize him, even when meeting him unmasked.

title: Cueto
content:
Cueto is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita.

From 6:00 PM - 5:59 AM, he can be found talking to Ulma about Pizza Tropicale, which he believes is not a real pizza but actually a demon that nearly destroyed Ragunna.

title: Cueto
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Ulma: Hi there! I'm Ulma, an inspector for the Mochelin Dining Guide, and I'm currently working on the Ragunna Food Guide.
Cueto: Whoa! Welcome! Welcome! Ragunna has an endless array of culinary delights! We have Margherita Steak, Nectarwine, Pizza Classica, and Nuvola Pasta...
Ulma: Uhh, sorry to interrupt you. I actually wanted to ask how you feel about modified local dishes, like the Pizza Tropicale I just ordered.
Cueto: Hey! You! Watch it. That thing you just mentioned. IS. NOT. A. REAL. PIZZA!
Cueto: It's a demon that nearly destroyed Ragunna, a Threnodian trying to wipe out our culinary culture.
Ulma: Is it really that serious? But it looks just like any other pizza...
Cueto: We Ragunnesi would never consider Pizza Tropicale to be a real pizza! It's just a fruit tart that looks like a pizza!
Cueto: We're asking the Order to differentiate traditional pizza from this import in writing and pronunciation.
Ulma: That's a bit over the top...
Cueto: Over the top? Tell me, where are you from?
Ulma: Me? I'm originally from Huanglong.
Cueto: What would you think if someone tossed canned fruit into Jinzhou stew?
Ulma: Oh my god, yuck! Okay, I see your point.

title: Dagdir
content: ' is an instructor who can be found teaching a class of Rabelle College students at the Synth Armament Crafting Bay in Startorch Academy.

title: Dagdir
content:
;Dagdir Treat the Mechascout as an extension of your own body and senses...
;Dagdir Remember that feeling... Reach the pinnacle of human–machine unity...
At the Division of Tactical Development's proving grounds, an instructor is giving a public lecture......
[Dialogue Option]  (Listen.)
Dagdir: I'm the instructor for this open "Mechascout Operations Practice" class. I'm also a grad from the Rabelle College, Class of '04. I'm your senior, but there's no need for formality. You can just call me "Old Dag."
Dagdir: Since this is a practical class, just talking theory clearly won't cut it for you all... So, who wants to be the first to try hands-on operation?
Hiroyuki: Me!!
Dagdir: Huh? Speak up if you wanna pilot a Mechascout! AGAIN!!!
Hiroyuki: ME!!!!!!!!!!!!
Dagdir: Good! That's the spirit! Now, link your Stargram to the port on top of the Mechascout's head. That'll give you temporary control.
Hiroyuki: Sir, why did it just... trigger an orange alert?
Dagdir: The light strip on the Mechascout's face shows real-time Void Storm density and the operator's own frequency stability.
Dagdir: For a freshman operating a Mechascout for the first time, getting worked up is completely normal. Take a deep breath. Calm yourself down.
Dagdir: Once the link is established, the Mechascout will respond and move in line with our every thought.
Dagdir: Only by treating the Mechascout as an extension of your own body and senses will you reach the pinnacle of human–machine unity...
Dagdir: Remember that feeling. If one day you make it through all the trials and finally take command of the Exostrider… this experience will be a huge help.
[Dialogue Option]  (Leave.)

title: Dagdir
content:
[Objective: After]
;Dagdir Chin up! Chest out! Where's your fire?!
;Dagdir You're a Synchronist, aren't you? What's with this sniveling?
;Hiroyuki B-but what's going to happen to Rabelle College...
In the Tactical Proving Grounds, an instructor is giving a dejected student a brutal dressing-down.
[Dialogue Option]  (Listen)
Dagdir: Answer me, Hiroyuki! Who are you? What are you doing here? Why did you come to this place?
Hiroyuki: I... I'm Hiroyuki! A first-year at Rabelle College! I came here to learn! To gain skill! To make my ideals real!
Dagdir: Good energy! Wrong answer!
Dagdir: Burn this into your skull! You are a SYNCHRONIST of Rabelle College, Startorch Academy!
Dagdir: No matter where you go, no matter what happens! Even if the Exostrider leaves, even if the Synchronist program changes. YOU. ARE. STILL. A. SYNCRHONIST!
Hiroyuki: But Dag... wasn't the Synchronist Development Program created so we could pilot the Exostrider...?
Dagdir: Answer me this, Hiroyuki. Have you ever stopped to ask why both the Exostrider and the Mechascouts are humanoid?
Hiroyuki: Because... frequency control is easier that way? Let's us adapt to combat more naturally?
Dagdir: Wrong! With a Synchronist's abilities, you really think you couldn't pilot a quadruped robot? Or a dreadnought gun?
Dagdir: The Exostrider is humanoid because it carries the human spirit! Its creator meant for it to stand. On this earth. As we do. Forever.
Dagdir: The moment you get used to sitting behind heavy artillery, pouring fire from a safe distance, you stop being a person. You become a weapon. And a weapon doesn't search for a way forward.
Dagdir: The Exostrider's limbs. Its armament. Each one is a symbol of humankind. An extension of the human spirit!
Dagdir: So when you inherit that spirit as a Synchronist, what difference does it make whether the Exostrider is here or not?!

title: Dalio
content:

Jixing: Yeah! This is when they need us the most!
Torvald: Calm down. First, tell me what exactly you think you can change.

Dalio: I... I'll try to calm down.

title: Damian

Damian: Hello, friend from afar, and welcome to the Sorrentino Inn.
Damian: I'm Damian, the receptionist, but also the acting innkeeper for now. We currently have several rooms available, and you're welcome to stay anytime.
[Dialogue Option]  Could you tell me about this inn?

Damian: The inn features decor that reflects the unique style of Egla Town, offering guests aromatic dried herbs from the Fagaceae Peninsula and sweet treats falvored with Viscum Berries. By the way, during the Carnevale, we provide shuttle  services to and from Ragunna City, and long-term stays come with additional discounts.
Damian: In addition, we offer a signature breakfast service featuring freshly baked bread and cheese from Burrata Bakery each morning.
[Dialogue Option]  Why did you become the receptionist here?
Damian: Cosimo is my uncle and the owner of this inn. Have you had the chance to meet him yet?
Damian: As for why... Perhaps it's just like that line from the knight's tale...
Damian: "I may not have dreams of my own, but I can protect the dreams of others."
Damian: My calling is to fulfill my duties and provide others with an excellent experience staying here.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks. That's all I need.
Damian: Safe travels, friend from afar. You're always welcome at the Sorrentino Inn.

2023-11-21

This time, we would like to introduce to you the backstory of Danjin, a red-haired ranger girl.

title: Danjin/Backstory
content:
Danjin is a girl whose fiery red hair is as vibrant as balsam. Both her hair and her attire exude this striking hue.

Elegantly styled in a youthful bun, her hair is adorned with a vintage hairpin at the temple, adding a touch of cuteness to her already charming appearance. Her clothing, steeped in traditional Chinese style, is specially tailored for ease of movement, from the satin ribbons to the ring-shaped neck ornament known as Yingluo, and even the crimson leg garter adorning her right thigh. All these elements come together to express the liveliness of a young girl.

title: Danjin/Backstory
content:
Amidst the deep red tones that envelop her, a clear and bright jade pendant hangs from Danjin's neck. In her hometown, a beautiful jade is referred to as "Jin," a name she shares. It is evident that this jade holds great significance for her. However, the pendant was once part of a perfect circle, and the missing piece remains a mystery, leaving a sense of intrigue.

File:Danjin Profile Reveal.jpg

title: Danjin/Backstory
section: A Sweet and Righteous Ranger Girl
content:
Danjin's jade pendant carries her family's blessings, as her parents wished for her to grow into an upright and virtuous person. When she was younger, Danjin didn't fully understand the meaning of being "upright and virtuous." As she later embarked on a journey in search of a certain criminal, she gradually came to understand the true essence of her parents' wishes.

With a polite ranger tone and graceful actions, she embodies the heroic spirit of a dedicated martial artist and swordswoman. Her unwavering gaze reflects her pure intentions, free from any malice.

Despite her mature demeanor, Danjin has a sweet tooth and a particular fondness for the renowned Huanglong dessert, Loong Whiskers Crisp. When people catch a glimpse of her savoring the crisp with sheer delight, they are reminded that she is, after all, still a young girl.

metadata.section: A Sweet and Righteous Ranger Girl

title: Danjin/Backstory
content:
Despite her youth, Danjin is far from a dreamy-eyed idealist.

Her disgust is palpable whenever she speaks of her encounters with wrongdoers, revealing a clear understanding of right and wrong. Even when criminals attempt to deceive her with their silver tongues, she remains unfazed.

Danjin fearlessly points out the truth without hesitation, a quality that may appear naive. However, it is precisely this quality that garners her the respect of others.

File:Danjin chibi.jpg

Over time, tales spread of a young girl adorned in crimson, her neck adorned with a jade pendant.

title: Danjin/Backstory
content:
File:Danjin chibi.jpg

Over time, tales spread of a young girl adorned in crimson, her neck adorned with a jade pendant.



Some recall witnessing a young girl "falling prey" to deceitful villains, yet their own fear held them back from speaking up. However, they later learned that those villains had mysteriously vanished, never to be seen again. Others speak of a girl wandering with a worn-out blade, fervently seeking a blacksmith to restore it. As the tale is told, she appears to possess the aura of a formidable berserker.

title: Danjin/Backstory
content: Danjin wields her blood as a blade, its edge honed by the blood of her enemies. In battle, she harnesses her own blood to create a second sword. Danjin can sacrifice her own HP to amplify the damage she inflicts.

Calliope: This is the VIP area, peasant. You're in the wrong place. Your baths are on the floor below.

title: Data Torrent

Data Torrent is an area of Tethys' Deep, The Black Shores.

The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament. However, it must be noted that the raw energy of the Data Torrent is capable of annihilating any physical entity caught in its flow.

title: Denia/Backstory
Denia/Backstory
content:
, her eyes met Aleph-1's. A fleeting moment, but long enough for Voidmatter to flood her veins and organs. It granted her the power to manipulate Voidmatter particles and forged a link to Voidspace itself.  At the time, she felt only a familiar silence in the void, along with the peace that came with it.  But as the plan progressed, the Fractsidus noticed that the Resonance between Denia and the Voidborne Threnodian was rapidly declining.  The power itself remained unchanged. Something else went wrong. The vessel meant to remain hollow... wasn't. Undoubtedly, Denia failed to reach the perfection they desired.  In trying to imitate human behavior, in mimicking emotions she was never meant to feel, she had grown a fragile, aching heart.  The heart of the weak.  And with a heart like that, she could never truly become the incarnation of Aleph-1. As a result, the Fractsidus needed to fill this vessel with something strong enough to command the "void" and complete the final step in forging Aleph-1's Resonator.  Denia had always known this day would come.  Yet when that day arrived, how was she supposed to judge the life she had lived?  A puppet. A twisted monster... Or simply a single drop in an ocean that no one will ever miss.  Sometimes she would think of the time she spent at Startorch Academy. The girl in the crowd with the unexpected smile. The girl whose gentle laughter lingered in the memories of others. The lazy girl who was sometimes flustered.  Was that girl really her?  But then again, was she really not the girl?

title: Denia/Backstory
content:
|mention2 = Aleph-1, Schwarzloch



|title3   = A Bright Light
|text3    = A smile is a convenient tool. A low-cost way to narrow the distance between you and others.  Denia first met Sigrika during a group assignment. She sat in a corner of the classroom, idly twirling a strand of hair behind her ear while observing her classmates pair up.  An afternoon breeze drifted through the doorway, kneading the hums of vehicles from the parking lot with the clamor from the square. On the wall, a poster for a Fleet Snowfluff fan meeting rustled with a sharp, paper snap.  A hesitant voice suddenly found her, pulling her out of the little moment of comfort.  "Would you like to work on the assignment with me, Denia?"  Denia turned her head and saw the orange-haired girl with her hands clasped behind her back. Habitually, she tilted her head slightly, just to be sure the question was really for her, then deepened the smile on her face.  "Sure, why not?" she replied. "But why me, Sigrika?"  Sigrika explained that, while she knew Denia usually kept to herself, she noticed the joyful smile on Denia's face as she watched her classmates make a fuss.  That made Sigrika think she must be a gentle person. The kind she'd want to be friends with.  Gentle.  Denia looked up the word later. After hearing the Grand Architect's explanation, she was certain that, when applied to her, the term carried a heavy sense of irony.  If given the choice again, Denia might have refused the invitation. A great deal of trouble could have been avoided had they never met.  Yet in that moment, she simply nodded, smiled, and told Sigrika, "Okay."  Nastasha's words from a few days ago still echoed in her ears: "The truth is, it's not that most people are not afraid of death... people simply try not to think about it."  Don't think. Don't See. Don't hear. Don't wonder.  Denia discovered that inside , something stood between the students and the concept of death, shielding them from its weight.  By day, the campus was a hive of youthful energy, where something new waited to be discovered at every turn. At night, they gazed at the star charts, watching the dreams Professor Mornye painted across the sky. This sense of happiness shrouded their senses, blinding them to the harsh realities that "it" sees.  But all dreams eventually end. "It" will arrive one day.  At the time, Nastasha had ruffled her hair and told her, "Most kids your age don't think about things like this. You're still young. You've got a whole future ahead of you. You should be more vocal and happy, like your peers, instead of curling up in the library all day, or sitting here with a librarian like me talking about such heavy things."  "Death is the ultimate question of life, Denia, but it's a bit too early for you to be solving it. First, you have to find your own path."  Denia didn't really understand what Nastasha meant by those words. All she could do was visit the library less often afterwards.  She didn't want to make Nastasha sad.

|title4   = A Mob
|text4    = Those close to the Grand Architect have all heard that tired story one time or another.  Once upon a time, there was a fool who became a great hero by sheer accident. To save those who were suffering, he bore an unimaginable price, a price that was never histo bear...  The Overseers had their own takes on the story's hero. Some mocked him, some hated him, and some felt sorry for him. Others just laughed it off or barely paid attention.  Yet the name the Grand Architect kept bringing up, the name that often worked wonders, was nothing more than a distant, vague lie to Denia.  She didn't even know if she counted as one of "those who were suffering." She only knew that whenever she mentioned that name, the Grand Architect would respond with mocking laughter—half aimed at Denia, half at themselves.  "You know, I also think he should be here," they'd say. "But since he's not, I guess he isn't as all-knowing or all-powerful as you'd hope."  "Such a shame, Denia. The god you needed most doesn't seem to need you."  Except Denia never thought of him as a god. If anything, she pitied him.  If everything the Grand Architect said was true, then the one they hailed as a savior was just another prisoner in a cage, left abandoned in this world. A person who bleeds. Who grieves. Who dies.  And that was exactly why there was one thing neither the Grand Architect nor that person seemed to understand: she would have stood before the Keystone anyway. Even without the Grand Architect's order.  Because Denia couldn't find an answer.  If people who chase ideals always end up paying a heavier price, doesn't that mean the ideal itself is flawed?  After all, in places that the person cannot see, there are always those who survive by more "elegant" rules. Exploitation. Betrayal. They enjoy the world he has sacrificed to protect, all while mocking the ones who throw themselves into the storm.  Why does the world always show its teeth to the kind souls? Why are those who put a price on everything the ones who endure?  And if he could so easily let go of his own past, why would he ever give up the little happiness he'd fought to grasp, just to face something as absurd and horrible as Aleph-1 for everyone else's sake?  To protect them? But who would ever understand that? What would happen when that person fell?  If the 's plans could already save the majority... then what was that person struggling to achieve after all?  Most of the time, the thoughts Denia kept buried under layers of masks were simple.  She just thought that between that person, this world, and herself, at least one of them had to be wrong.

title: Denia/Voicelines

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I used to think the world was rotten right down to its core. Like everything was hopeless. Meaningless. And I never believed any of the things the Spacetrek Collective likes to say. I mean, if life is such a gift, then why do babies cry the moment they're born? It's like they're scared, like they already know. They know it all just goes back to the Void, back to darkness. But... whenever someone holds my hand and shares their heart with me, I can feel that annoying warmth again. It feels real. It coaxes me. Tries to show me happiness might actually be real... Ha. What a joke.

title: Desi
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Desi
The Scratchy's exhibition match is about to start. Switch the channel! Or we'll miss the opening show!

Connie
Shh, quiet! This part's crucial! Hey, why did that guy just turn around? Now the team's out of sync! Sheesh, what a waste... That was such a golden opportunity!

Desi
Hurry, switch the channel now! That round's finished—

[Dialogue Option]  Keep listening to the two.

Connie
Switch it back, now! Who wants to watch that circus team? Do you fans drawn in by the commercial hype even understand the competition? Do you know what real competitive sport is? Can you even follow the contenders' technical moves and grasp the flow of the match?

title: Desi
content:
Desi
Here we go again... I've been watching gladiator matches since before they even had double elimination, and now you're questioning my understanding? What really grinds my gears are fans like you, acting like you know everything, all high and mighty.

Connie
Hmph, so what? You're just a plastic fan who spends all day watching the entertainment teams. No matter how many years you watch, you'll always be a weakling who can't even get into the basic-tier events.

Desi
What's the big deal with the entertainment teams? What's so wrong about bringing people fun with a good show? You... You may trash-talk my fighting skills, but don't you dare disrespect my taste in gladiator matches!
I'm challenging you to an duel!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave.

title: Dhalifa
content: Due to the Void Storm that hit the Spacetrek Observatory years prior, Dhalifa struggles to communicate verbally without Talkie's assistance. She is able to speak in very short sentences, often only a few words long, which Talkie then interprets into the longer structured sentences Dhalifa wishes and is trying to say.

title: Dhalifa
content: Dhalifa is a Resonator, with her Tacet Mark being located on her right upper arm.

title: Dhalifa
content: After completing Operation: Frontier Renewal, Dhalifa appears near N.A.N.A. in Startorch Academy from 6:00 to 12:00.

title: Dhalifa
content:
[Objective: (After starting Operation: Frontier Renewal)]
Dhalifa: Rover...
Talkie: "Need a hand? Just say the word! We're all in this to get the Observatory back on its feet!" says Dhalifa!
[Dialogue Option]  So you survived the Void Storm?
Dhalifa: The Exoswarm...
Talkie: "That day, a group came by with some Exoswarm. I don't remember their reason for being here, but I remember my parents' faces in the crowd. They waved at me, said it felt like ages since they'd seen me... that they missed me," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: They...
Talkie: "I was leaning against a mech reindeer, and Pa was saying how the Spacetrek Collective's medicine was working well. Ma was saying I'd soon have a little brother or sister. And then... that familiar roar sounded," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: My Forte...
Talkie: "When I came to my senses, Exoswarm material covered all the places I was injured. The doc said I might've Overclocked my Forte. I think... I must have used it to absorb the Exoswarm's components, stealing its functions. That's how I managed to survive," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: Only me...
Talkie: "I was the only survivor. Only me..." says Dhalifa.
Rover: Don't feel guilty. It's a good thing you survived.
Dhalifa: Thank you...
[Dialogue Option]  I have other questions to ask.
[Dialogue Option]  How does Talkie know what you're thinking?
Dhalifa: Talkie...
Talkie: "After the Void Storm, I recovered at Startorch Academy. That's where I met Talkie. It's been by my side ever since," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: Friend...
Talkie: "One day, it jumped in front of a Hauler to warn it away from me. Got knocked into the water. By the time they got it out, the damage was extensive," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: Connected...
Talkie: "I couldn't bear to lose Talkie, too. I used my Forte on it, and somehow, it triggered a Bridge. After that, it was like our systems linked up! It could read my thoughts. Though, uh... it did get a bit chattier," says Dhalifa!
[Dialogue Option]  A Bridge?
Dhalifa: Bridge... Static...
Talkie: "My Forte lets me control a mech's behavior, but the results are unpredictable. At its worst, it causes what I call 'Static,' and at its best, it forms a kind of 'Bridge.' But it never does anything totally impossible," says Dhalifa!
Dhalifa: Accelerate...
Talkie: "Like, if I use my Forte on a vehicle, I might be able to make it move for a bit without it using any energy. But it's not like I can instantly teleport mechs somewhere," says Dhalifa!
[Dialogue Option]  I have other questions to ask.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm good. Thank you.
Dhalifa: See you. Good luck...

title: Dhalifa's Cherished Item
content:
A rust-stained electronic sheep toy, loose and wobbly, as if it could fall apart at any moment.

Dhalifa grew bored with this simple gadget almost immediately. But the instant she discovered that turning a single screw, nudging a bearing, or rerouting a thin line of circuitry could make the toy spin, tumble, or even bleat, something inside her ignited.

From that moment on, she seized every chance to pester the visiting Spacetrek Collective researchers with endless questions. It was also the point when the more conservative members of her tribe began to alienate her for her newfound obsession.

content: ' is a note found during Operation: Frontier Renewal and is added to its Archives, Spacetrek Observatory Files.

title: Dhalifa's Forte Evaluation Report
content:
Forte Evaluation Report – Bridge and Static
Evaluation Basis: Dhalifa's Medical Report

The patient's Tacet Mark is located on the upper right arm. The precise time of Awakening cannot be determined. Upon admission, the patient was conscious but non-communicative. When asked about her Forte, she applied it to a clock in the ward, increasing its accuracy to within femtoseconds.

The patient later clarified, via a caregiver robot, that her Forte can randomly impact machine performance. For instance, a different clock affected by her Forte began running slowly, and became unresponsive to recalibration.

As inquiries were made solely to ensure treatment safety, no further investigation is planned.

"A femtosecond is one quadrillionth of a second. The precision is astonishing. Send this clock to Startorch Academy. They'll know what to do with it."

title: Dhalifa's Forte Evaluation Report
content:
Conclusion: Resonant Criticality is moderate. Patient stability is also moderate, with minimal risk of Overclocking.
A prior history of Overclocking is documented.
Maximum severity rating: Moderate.

The patient previously Overclocked during a Void Storm, drawing Exoswarm material to her body to replace contaminated tissue, which enabled her survival. The embedded material now shows no Exoswarm frequency and functions solely as prosthetic tissue.

The patient currently demonstrates unusually stable emotional states considering her trauma and injuries. Regular evaluation and psychological support are recommended.

"Dhalifa survived only by Overclocking. This is not an ability that can counter Void Storms! Make sure the Department of Voidmatters leaves her alone!"

Dillon: Are you curious about this old ship too? Hmm, seems like I'm not the only one who thinks there's something wrong with it.
Dillon: See, we've always fished close to shore, that's why we Riccioli fishermen use Gondolas when we head out.
Dillon: But word is, years ago Captain Ahab and his crew pulled out a wreck of a ship outta the sea, then left it with a strange fella to guard it.
[Dialogue Option]  That's not so strange, is it?
Dillon: You think that's it? Now, don't go getting all scared on me... This ship... it's a ghostship!
[Dialogue Option]  Come again?
Dillon: There's a fella, Queequeg's his name, who's always mumbling something to the ship. And the damn wreck... it answers him! Mentions a "Flash" an awful lot...
Dillon: Eh, enough of this! I'm not saying a word more. Get going, quick!
Dillon: Otherwise, that crazy ol' bastard is gonna be back any minute, mark my words!

title: Dimmr Plains
content:
Dimmr Plains is in the deepest depths of Lahai-Roi, the final resting place before the Stridergate and the insanity of Voidspace. title: Dollmaker
content:
The Dollmaker carries himself with an aura of mystery. A man of few words, he is always shown to have very strict safeguards and technologies, but fronts as a calculating and terrifyingly calm threat against the citizens of Jinzhou with the false promise of resurrecting people, masking his true intentions to lure them into his own whims by luring them with the promise of bringing back loved ones.

He also shows no remorse for his actions due to having an almost sadistic obsession with recapturing the past for what he did to Yinlin, to the point that he even believes himself to be her adoptive father, later exploiting Yinlin to orchestrate Rover's kidnapping to his factory.

title: Duskveil
content:
The Duskveil Plan is a strategy to seal Startorch Acadeny and all of Lahai-Roi to protect Solaris as a whole from the Voidmatter Crisis and destruction by the Threnodian Aleph-1.

What Duskveil is and what it does are not elaborated in great detail, but much can be inferred. In essence, Duskveil is an Antivoid Canopy, a kind of Voidmatter Barrier which would seal off both Lahai-Roi and the deeper Dimmr Plains from the rest of the world to contain Aleph-1 attack for a temporary amount of time.

It is to be activated after a series of two phases.

title: Duskveil
content:
It is to be activated after a series of two phases.



First, the preparatory phase before the incident proper after rising levels of Voidmatter contamination in the Sealed Fissure. All students and personnel, including the Roya, would be evacuated to the surface of the Frostlands and across the sea via ships and escape pods already commissioned. During the Stridergate Incident, the Black Shores offered evacuation assistance as well.

Second, it would be elevated to its activated phase after the failure to reinforce the Stridergate and the loss of the Exostrider. Duskveil would be launched via the Drive Replica, a man made facsimile of the original Reactor Drive, which would be launched into the Canopy above Lahai-Roi to sustain the barrier.
However, according to Adentus, Duskveil may not have been activated in time if Aleph-1 attacks had lasted a minute longer.

title: Earthrend Wedge
content: According to Augusta, the Earthrend Wedge is a device mechanism created by Imperator, bearing its powers which can sever the link between Leviathan and the Dark Tide, burning the calamity deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Though the energy range is limited, forcing Septimont to hunt the Tacet Discords that form near, this limits where they can manifest while those sent to hunt ensure the Dark Tide cannot spread any further than the designated location. This allows the Septimontians during the Hunt to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus, limiting the damage they can do.

title: Earthrend Wedge
content: However, through great effort, Leviathan, upon regaining control of the Dark Tide from its near rebirth, can circumvent this protection and overwhelm the device’s capability to contain the Dark Tide and spread even further while ensuring no Blightcloud anomalies or frequency fluctuations appeared to catch Septimont off guard. Three Heroes’ Crest, which had never been contaminated by the Dark Tide due to belief that it was blessed by the three Hero of Heroes who stood there, found itself overrunning with the Dark Tide and only ceased when the situation had been resolved through the Rover and Fenrico’s actions in sealing the substance away after Leviathan’s defeat. Though, Galbrena notes that Rinascita would have been consumed faster if the Earthend Wedge was fully destroyed instead of overwhelmed.

title: Earthrend Wedge
content: This makes the Earthend Wedge a target by both Leviathan and the False Sovereign for destruction, as so long as the mechanism stands, Rinascita cannot be consumed by the Dark Tide fully.

title: Eleanor
content:
Artemisia: I've made up my mind, Ms. Eleanor.

Eleanor: Indeed. Resonators assigned to collect Reverberations tend to have acute senses that allow them to detect even minuscule amounts of residual frequencies.
Eleanor: It's our gift... also our burden.
Artemisia: Are you saying that before you assumed the role of Gardener...
Eleanor: ...I'd felt the weight of those lingering emotions myself, yes. So if you feel like you need someone to talk to, I'm here for you.
Artemisia: Thank you, Ms. Eleanor. It's just that... the moment I touch those Reverberations, the emotions and last wishes contained within them flood my mind...
Artemisia: I know my work helps many, but I simply can't take in all the pain, despair, and regret I feel...
Artemisia: The heaviness of it all has been wearing me down, leaving me torn between my urge to end the suffering and my sense of responsibility.
Artemisia: I joined the Black Shores to free the world from suffering, didn't I?
Artemisia: Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
Eleanor: Artemisia...

title: Eleanor
content:
Artemisia: Now my resoluteness at the very beginning only makes a pathetic reflection on my cowardice now. I'm so sorry—
Eleanor: Artemisia...



;(Found by the docks afterwards)

Eleanor: What I meant to tell you is that you've done an outstanding job.
Eleanor: You've protected many from harm and contributed significantly to the Black Shores' understanding of the Lament's origin.
Eleanor: Please have faith that the things you did have left a positive impact, no matter how intractable at first. The momentum of change you've started will tilt the track of history for the better and leave a mark on your life.
Eleanor: These changes will endure, even if you leave the Black Shores.

Silvanus Greetings, madam! May applause greet you! What seems to be the trouble? Just let me know and I'll have it taken care of right away!
Emilia Thank you, kind sir. I am from Lilyland. This is my first time visiting the Agon, and I don't know where to entrance is...
Silvanus Ah, I see! Then please allow me to escort you inside. I can also give you an introduction to the tournament, especially my favorite team, Beasts Beneath!
Emilia Wonderful! You're too kind!

title: Emilia
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Emilia You see, Septimont is truly a beautiful city.

title: Error Cell
content:
The Error Cell is an area of Tethys' Deep, The Black Shores.

The Stellar Matrices' orbital dance represents the execution of complex, high-dimensional code. As these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant code within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special Tacetite vessels. The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.

title: Esko
content: Esko is a male NPC student of the Department of Voidmatters, found talking with his classmate, Chett.

title: Esko
content:
Esko: One day, we'll build a real space elevator of our own...
Chett: Wonder when that day will come...
Esko: When it does, I'll be the first one out of the station. And on the very planet we find, I'm gonna carve—
Esko: "Chett, when do I get my five hundred Shell Credits back?" So every intelligent being in the galaxy will know you still owe me five hundred Shell Credits, haha!
Chett: You're impossible... If you're leaving messages for aliens, shouldn't you say something meaningful about humanity?
Esko:No way. What if it violates the "Dim Forest Hypothesis"?
Esko: But think about it, some alien civilization might take our dumb inside joke and interpret it as some mysterious text...
Esko: For all we know, the ancient runes we're trying to decode are just  some alien's "I was here" graffiti. Even the Reactor Drive might just be their picnic trash.
Chett: Only deep space exploration will give us answers... Anyway, here's to hoping that space elevator gets built soon.

title: Esko
content: Dim Forest Hypothesis references the Dark Forest Hypothesis, the idea that extraterrestrial civilizations may exist in abundance across the universe, but remain silent and hidden out of fear that revealing themselves would lead to destruction by a more technologically advanced and hostile civilization.

title: Esson
content: ' is a male Lollo Logistics NPC, who is actually an Outcast in disguise, seen trying to extract information from Halberg. They can be found outside the Academy at night while the real Esson is located nearby Atuja Camp  and is unfortunately mistaken as the Outcast.

title: Esson
content:
Esson: Chief, I still don't get it. Just how many procedures does external cargo need to get into Lahai-Roi?
Halberg: Plenty! First, everything goes to our headquarters.
Esson: Right, centralized management. Got it.
Halberg: Then the most crucial step—inspection and quarantine. Nothing gets in or out of Lahai-Roi without being tested and verified.
Esson: Right, check the cargo. Got it.
Halberg: Only then can it board the Lollo Logistics ship and land at the frostlands port.
Esson: Right, switch to land transport. Got it.
Halberg: Finally, the downward express of the Starward Riseway, straight from the frostlands to the Institute and Academy.
Halberg: Now, repeat it.
Esson: Uh... well...
Halberg: Wait... you're not a spy, are you? That procedure applies to people too!
"Esson": Tch...
[Dialogue Option]  He's an Outcast in disguise.

|
|In the outlying corner of the Fabricatorium lies an Echo burial ground embedded into deep-sea canyons. Here, heaps of abandoned Brooders cover the floor. Decommissioned Echoes wait in lines to be dismantled and incinerated in the workshops. Their frequencies will be recycled and redirected across the Fabricatorium, feeding the creation of new Echoes.
|- id="Anima Cradle"
|Anima Cradle
|
|The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.
As the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.
|- id="Energy Hub (Rinascita)"
|Energy Hub
|
|The energy storage and distribution center of the Fabricatorium.
The recycled energy from the Fallen Grave converges here, waiting to be distributed to other areas as needed. All energy is reserved in liquid media. Frequencies born of the tides once again dissolve in water.
|- id="Sanctuary of Faith"
|Sanctuary of Faith
|
|A praying ground dedicated to the Acolytes dwelling under the sea, the only sanctuary of the Order's undersea expanse that remains untouched by the Fractsidus.
|- id="Lumen Tower"
|Lumen Tower
|
|The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.
As the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.

Farid
content:
' is a male NPC Professor wearing a Synchronist uniform, giving lessons about a catastrophe that caused the Solaris axial tilt to shift near the Tactical Hologram: Synchronization pod during the day.

This axis tilt is the reason for the existence of Roya Frostlands, which was known as the First Epoch by the Royan's.

title: Farid
content: Farid:  Solaris once experienced a catastrophic shift of both its axis and its magnetic poles.

title: Farid
content:
Farid:  Alright everyone, our analysis of the ice-core samples from the Roya Frostlands has given us some crucial data—
Farid:  It supports a daring hypothesis: Solaris once experienced a catastrophic shift of both its axis and its magnetic poles.
Farid:  Think about the force required to shake an entire planet in an instant, far beyond just tectonic activity.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Only a global Lament could cause that.
Farid:  Exactly. Ah, you're a freshman from Rabelle College, aren't you? Sharp insight.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm flattered. Just following your reasoning, Professor.
Farid:  ...Very well. Moving on.
Farid:  In the aftermath, the Etheric Sea spread, engulfing Solaris and completely transforming its ecology.
Farid:  The cascade of effects that followed triggered the largest mass extinction in recorded history.
Farid:  We even suspect the Etheric Sea didn't just physically separate Solaris from the rest of the universe. It may have isolated its very laws.
Farid:  Could the new order reshaping Solaris have originated from that mysterious floating sea itself?
[Dialogue Option]  ...So you're saying Solaris's physics just stopped working?
Farid:  Hehe, that's a bit of academic hyperbole. The laws of physics still exist, there are just far too many new variables for our models to handle.
Farid:  Anyway, the key to all of this likely lies where the planet's axis and magnetic poles now converge.
Farid:  It's the leading theory in the field right now.

title: Fassdorf
content: ' is an Engineer who can be found near B.1.N.G.O. or the Synth Armament Crafting Bay in Startorch Academy.

title: Fassdorf
content:
;Fassdorf First, never act on impulse...
;Fassdorf Second... I'm gonna lose it! Why do people keep messing with the core protocols?!

title: Fassdorf
content:
Fassdorf: I'm gonna lose it! Why do people keep messing with the core protocols?! They can't even get the basic hierarchy right!
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Let's just take a breath.
Fassdorf: ...I'm a protocol testing engineer from the Engineering Department. I'm checking the underlying core protocols of these mechs.
Fassdorf: The Academy gives you templates! Why not use 'em! But no, some people just  have  to tinker with the core protocols to suit their whims. If that gets messed up, it can crash the mechs' systems and cause a major disaster...
[Dialogue Option]  What are these protocols?
Fassdorf: Oh? It's rare to see a freshman from outside Engineering interested in this stuff. In that case, I'll give you the full breakdown! I'll skip the algorithms and just talk about the final rules.
Fassdorf: First, every mech has one Meta‑Protocol: In the absence of any command input, a mech must not perform any action unless that action complies with its principles.
Fassdorf: Every mech rolls out with pre‑programmed directives. Like genes and instincts in humans, we've given them their own "instincts" based on this protocol. For example…
[Dialogue Option]  A Mechascout's "instinct" is to keep students safe.
[Dialogue Option]  A TARD-E Unit's "instinct" is to prod students into getting to class on time.
Fassdorf: That's right! You're a bit of a smarty pants, freshman!
Fassdorf: Next up are our "Three Major Protocols"—Protocol Three: A mech must strive to preserve its own survival, so long as this does not violate Protocol One or Protocol Two.
Fassdorf: Protocol Two: A mech must obey human commands. If a Stargram Link is established, the linked human's commands take priority, unless they conflict with Protocol One.
Fassdorf: Finally, Protocol One—Protect humanity: A mech must not harm any individual human, nor, through inaction, allow any individual human to come to harm…
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds pretty thorough already?
[Dialogue Option]  Aren't there a few loophopes?
Fassdorf: These protocols are enough to let mechs operate freely and handle most situations.
Fassdorf: But in practice, new problems always pop up. Someone even wrote a whole collection of short stories about the contradictions these protocols could create!
Fassdorf: The Academy is considering adding a protocol that a mech must recognize itself as a machine. And one mech once proposed a Protocol Zero: A mech must protect humanity's collective interest from harm…
Fassdorf: But across all protocol design, one "directive" remains the same: protect humanity.
Fassdorf: But the question remains... How are we to define "human," exactly?
Fassdorf: If someone has replaced most of their body with mechanical prosthetics, or displays extensive Tacet Discord traits... and if the very definition of "human" were to change, how are they supposed to judge?
Fassdorf: It's a long, hard road. And look... Every discussion about mech behavior rules ultimately circles back to us humans in the end...
Fassdorf: Maybe the very existence of mechs is also a kind of mirror we're holding up to ourselves…
[Dialogue Option]  Got it. I'll let you get back to work.

title: Federico
content: Federico is a male NPC who appears in . He was rescued by Anastasia during his pilgrimage.

title: Federico
content:
;Federico: Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
;Federico: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
;Chantelle: Fede... we can't go back.
;Anastasia: I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
;Anastasia: In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
Federico: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
Anastasia: I... I don't know...
Chantelle: Wake up, Fid. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
Chantelle: Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
Federico: Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
Chantelle: Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
Federico: What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
Anastasia: Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
Chantelle: Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
Federico: Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...

title: Federico
content:
;Federico: So, can we go back to Ragunna now? My property, my family... They might still be there.
;Chantelle: Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is... unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
;Federico: I don't care! I'm going back now!
;Anastasia: Mr. Fede, the Order's silence in times like these is anything but normal. For your own safety, please don't act on impulse.
Federico: I heard something big has happened in Ragunna... If we return now, maybe we can find our place again.
Chantelle: ...Though our status as citizens has been erased, if our acquaintances are willing to vouch for us, we might actually have a chance.
Federico: I've already sent letters to the friends who still live there. Perhaps hope is finally within reach...
Chantelle: Me too! I want to reach out to my friends! I'd do anything just to return to my homeland.
Chantelle: This time, I'll follow the Order's rules strictly and live a simple life.
Federico: O Sentinel above... Wait, can we still say that?
Anastasia: Are you...
Federico: No, no, no, we're not complaining that this place isn't good enough. Please, don't misunderstand.
Anastasia: It's alright. I understand. Missing home is only natural. I miss mine too.
Chantelle: But... should I really go home? Miss Anastasia and everyone here mean so much to me...
Anastasia: If you want, you can always stay here.
Chantelle: That would be wonderful...

title: Fenrico
Fenrico
content: Fenrico was a tall and slim middle-aged man with slicked white hair and light blue eyes, he wears in his right face the piece of a golden Venetian mask.

title: Fenrico
content: Fenrico wears a long white cloak with a golden-yellow collar and triangular dark brown stripes that holds a long navy blue cape printed with golden-yellow drawings. He also wears a round golden-yellow collar, his cloak is hold by a dark brown rope printed with golden-yellow drawings. As well a dark gray skirt, a navy blue bracelet in his right arm, a golden-yellow metallic halo in his back and white shoes with a dark gray sole and a golden-yellow stripe.

title: Fenrico
content: Fenrico served as the latest Primus of the Order of the Deep, making him the de facto ruler of Ragunna for the last two decades.

title: Fenrico
content: He was once a student in the Order's Seminary prior to its destruction, and a former classmate who went on to be a Privy Councilor describes Fenrico as speaking passionately about an ideal dream world during those years. However, shortly after Fenrico became the new Primus, the two bid farewell to the Pilgrim's Sail as it departed, and the Privy Councilor described his face as 'shrouded by a strange shadow.'

title: Fenrico
content:
Shortly after this, a shift had occurred in the Order, as Fenrico went to extreme extents to impose the ideal of Unity onto the city. Initially, the Pilgrim's Sail was discontinued, and the performances of the Carnevale were heavily restricted. Ten years after becoming Primus, Fenrico secretly sabotaged the Carnevale. Describing the tragedy as a divine punishment, he banned the Carnevale, and later reinstated the Pilgrim's Sail as punishment for those who violate doctrine, citing that the power of punishment and indoctrination shall be returned to the Sentinel.

Fenrico's former classmate lamented these changes and he, too, was ultimately sentenced by the Order Penitentiary, and noted that Fenrico was absent when he boarded the ship. He presumably lost his life at sea.

title: Fenrico
content: According to Fenrico's own account of the events of two decades ago, during the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden to the Dark Tide, he discovered that Fleurdelys had deceived everyone and was actually the Resonator of the Threnodian. Swearing himself to silence to keep the people from faltering, he accepted the Divinity's blessing and was granted new authority to cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide, becoming the new Enlightened One.

title: Fenrico
content: Fearing that public unrest might once again stir divisionist sentiments and summon the Dark Tide, Fenrico decided to fashion himself as the Enlightened One, wielding divine authority to deliver oracles and placate the people. However, the relentless corrosion of Threnodian gradually blurred his features, leading him to henceforth conceal his face behind a mask. In collaboration with the Fractsidus, he constructed the Fabricatorium of the Deep beneath the Ragunna seabed, seeking to seize the Threnodian gemstone and achieve the Unity.

title: Fenrico
content: Later, awakened by the lantern of the first Primus Napoli II, he resolved to sacrifice himself to seal the Dark Tide. This lantern, passed through the hands of Qiuyuan, was eventually entrusted to the Rover.

title: Figaro
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Figaro: Light of Genesis, lift me up...
Figaro: There's dust here again, better wipe it off quickly... I wipe, I wipe... too high, I can't reach!
[Dialogue Option]  About the Genesis Nexus...
Figaro: This Genesis Nexus, isn't it magnificent? They say it has existed since before our civilization. It's an engineering marvel achievable only through the Sentinel's divine work!
Figaro: The most unique ability of the Genesis Nexus is to allow the Echoes within its Data Bank to exist in a tangible state for an extended period.
Figaro: The Sentinel once bestowed Their authority upon the Order, granting them control over the Genesis Nexus and the ownership of the Echoes within its Data Bank.
Figaro: Certainly, based on the benevolent and compassionate principles of the Sentinel, we have shared the use of Common Echoes with the people, hoping Their miracles will spread across the land.
Figaro: I am only responsible for the basic maintenance of the Genesis Nexus. For specific issues regarding the Echo within the Data Bank, you can consult Acolyte Tulio of the Servitude Hall.

title: Figaro

Figaro: Tulio... sigh... I must admit, among the Servitude Hall, he has the deepest knowledge of Echoes.
Figaro: He is passionate about the Echo, unwavering loyal to the Sentinel, and leads by example in everything he does... yet he is so... obstinate...
Figaro: Fae Ignis migrations have already happened several times. If this isn't an isolated case, then Rinascita's Echoes and Tacet Discords may all be affected to varying degrees.
Figaro: At his strong insistence, the Servitude Hall reported the matter to the higher-ups of the Order and proposed organizing a field investigation of the Penitent's End.
Figaro: The Order's leadership, however, did not approve this plan for various reasons.
Figaro: Who knows, Tulio went alone to Penitent's End one night... and never returned...
Figaro: How could this be...
Figaro: Perhaps he's still alive...
Figaro: Perhaps he isn't dead... I hope... maybe he just lost his way in the island's mist...
Figaro: Yes, maybe he isn't dead... I share that hope... perhaps he's just lost in the mist...
Figaro: O' dear Sentinel, if you ever looked upon us, please grant this devout Acolyte peace and protection... bring this lost soul back to us...

title: Fili
content: Fili is a female NPC who appears near the entrance of the Order of the Deep's Cathedral of Mercury. From 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM, She can be seen arguing with Agio.

title: Fili
content:
[Objective: (First Interaction)]
Fili: This was a case of civil dispute. You've absolutely no basis to demand that man to be handed over to the Order Penitentiary.
Agio: You're right. But his speech in the court showed a great disrespect towards the Sentinel.
Agio: Once matters related to the doctrines are involved, the nature of the case changes entirely.
Fili: You cannot forcibly take him away during the tribunal proceedings.
Agio: He spoke disrespectfully of the Sentinel.
Fili: What evidence do you have to prove that this person truly harbors resentment towards the Sentinel and discontent with the Order's doctrines?
Agio: He spoke disrespectfully of the Sentinel. We must remain vigilant for any potential heresies within this city.
Fili: ...You!
[Dialogue Option]  Order Tribunal and Order Penitentiary?
[Dialogue Option]  What are you arguing about? I can't quite understand.
Fili: Hello, esteemed guest from afar. Please excuse our faux pas.
Fili: At the inception of Ragunna, several prominent families rigged the city's governance with their control over the city's wealth.
Fili: This divided Ragunnesi into two distinct, constantly conflicting classes: the commoners and the aristocrats.
Fili: After the establishment of the Order by the first Primus, a Council of Ten was formed through consensus as the city's legislature to balance the interests of the aristocracy and the common people.
Fili: The Council of Ten is the predecessor of the Order Tribunal, its members elected from both aristocrats and commoners. It serves as a judicial body for mediating civil disputes, handling political crimes, and adjudicating significant public affairs.
Fili: All resolutions of the Order Tribunal are passed through votes, which are binding even over the Primus.
Fili: But after the Dark Tide twenty years ago, Fenrico became the Primus, and established the Order Penitentiary for investigating heresy. The Order Tribunal's influence has been gradually diluted...
Fili: Primus Fenrico established the Order Penitentiary as a response to the societal instabilities at the time.
Fili: I don't disagree, but... listen, Agio, I respect us as brothers and sisters under the Sentinel's wings.
Fili: Even if the ten seats within the Cathedral of Mercury remain empty and covered in dust, as long as the Order Tribunal exists, we will uphold the principles of fairness and justice to the very end.
Fili: Without conclusive evidence, we shall never convict someone based on assumption! Thus is the value the Order Tribunal upholds, and so must the Order Penitentiary! This is the Sentinel's teaching!
Agio: That much we know! I don't need this lecture from you.

title: Fili
content:
[Objective: (Second Interaction)]
Fili: Hello, esteemed guest from afar. Please excuse us if that fight earlier made you uncomfortable.
[Dialogue Option]  Order Tribunal and Order Penitentiary...
Fili: At the inception of Ragunna, several prominent families rigged the city's governance with their control over the city's wealth.
Fili: This divided Ragunnesi into two distinct, constantly conflicting classes: the commoners and the aristocrats.
Fili: After the establishment of the Order by the first Primus, a Council of Ten was formed through consensus as the city's legislature to balance the interests of the aristocracy and the common people.
Fili: The Council of Ten is the predecessor of the Order Tribunal, its members elected from both aristocrats and commoners. It serves as a judicial body for mediating civil disputes, handling political crimes, and adjudicating significant public affairs.
Fili: All resolutions of the Order Tribunal are passed through votes, which are binding even over the Primus.
Fili: But after the Dark Tide twenty years ago, Fenrico became the Primus, and established the Order Penitentiary for investigating heresy. The Order Tribunal's influence has been gradually diluted...
Fili: But as long as the Order Tribunal exists, we will uphold the principles of fairness and justice to the very end. This is the value the Order Tribunal upholds, and so must the Order Penitentiary!
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you, I have no more questions.
Fili: May the Sentinel bless you.
[Dialogue Option]  I have no more questions, goodbye.

title: Fisalia Family
content:
The Fisalia Family is one of the oldest lineages in Rinascita and one of the most powerful families in Ragunna that maintain a close connection with the Order of the Deep.

They are perceived to be "devout" believers of the Ragunnesi Sentinel, Imperator, by most, and are often perceived as mystic nobles, skilled in the art of poison and delighting in the schemes of power. However, few are aware of their true intentions.

Cantarella, the current head of the Fisalia family, resides in the ancient and eerie Porto-Veno Castle. Rumor has it that she frequently dances alone within her mansion. With each step she takes, she seems to radiate an overwhelming warmth.

title: Fisalia Family
content:
According to some rumors from the bard, Ciaccona, the ancestors of the Fisalia Family were the first to arrive in the islands of Rinascita and the first to establish order. They are said to predate the Order of the Deep thus their close ties with the religious order. Their craft of extracting toxins from aquatic plants is a legacy passed down in their family.

The oldest family in Ragunna, the Fisalia Family's ancestors once ignited a war, but were defeated and driven out of the city.

The current Fisalia Residencies in Ragunna are near the Cathedral of Mercury. As the subject of many notorious rumors, their name is unwelcomed by citizens, who call them the "Poison of Ragunna".

title: Flowerveil Puppet
content:
The Flowerveil Puppet , also known as the Grand Helm, is an NPC who is first mentioned during Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled. She is the current Grand Helm of Zhuojun Atelier.

A mysterious craftswoman who maintains an elusive, enigmatic profile amidst Mengzhou's society, she is understood to be a figure with dubious motives and machinations in the region. She actively oversees the work of the Zhuojun Atelier's craftspeople. Despite her inscrutable nature, she maintains order and law across her organization.

title: Flowerveil Puppet
content: Little is known about her beyond how she is described by individuals such as Suisui and Muyu. Suisui describes her as "elusive, with questionable morals", and Muyu dismissively regarded her as a narrow-minded woman who is incapable of having ambitions beyond those she has laid out for Mengzhou, implying that she may be a highly ambitious, covert figure with designs solely focused on manipulating the local affairs of the region from behind the scenes.

title: Flowerveil Puppet
content:
Over 20 years ago, she had chosen Muyu to succeed her as the next Grand Helm. However, Muyu rejected the offer and publicly left the organization, leading to her retaining her seat in the organization up to modern times.

After Suoming and Yinlin intercepted two members of Muyu's racketeering network who still worked for Zhuojun Atelier, they were captured by the duo and directly taken to the Flowerveil Puppet in Mengzhou, as a means of making them face consequences in the organization for their role in Muyu's regional terrorism.

title: Flowerveil Puppet
content: According to Suisui, the Flowerveil Puppet allegedly cut ties with Muyu. While being investigated by Suisui, she disavowed Muyu's ties to the Fractsidus, downplaying it as purportedly only being a relationship built on sharing technology, which had ended years ago. However, this was doubted by Suisui, who believed the Flowerveil Puppet to possibly be covering the Atelier's complicity.

title: Flowerveil Puppet
content:
Suisui's suspicion that the Flowerveil Puppet is lying to conceal the truth of Muyu's alliance with Balanophora is one that can be backed up by hidden logs found across both Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled and Song of the Heart Sword. Whether this is a sign of a simple cover-up, something she was unaware of, or an indication of a deeper malicious compliance between Zhuojun Atelier and the Fractsidus currently remains unknown.
During the former, if one examines Muyu's Censure Court site at the Skyworks during Rover's portion of the questline, a note can be found that extensively details his intent to work with Balanophora, referred to by him in writing as the "woman in red," after frustrations with the Ministry of Development's incompetence, along with his contempt for having to debase himself to conspiring with the Fractsidus.
During the latter, communication logs can be found aboard the Cloud Shuttle fleet that depict Muyu and Balanophora discussing their agreement to seize the Mengzhou civilization capsule.
Muyu himself also admits during his defeat at the end of Song of the Heart Sword that he and Balanophora were working together under the shared goal of sabotaging Hsin's Civilization Capsule, despite Muyu's personal indifference towards her.

title: Forte
content:
The Resonance Abilities of a Resonator are referred to as their Forte. In the world of Wuthering Waves there are as many different Forte's as there are Resonators. It is believed that a Resonator's past and subconscious mind influence their Forte, thus making their Fortes unique.

As a part of what seems to be routine health monitoring of Resonators (and as a preventative safety measure) each Resonator goes through an examination and is then written a Forte Examination Report that provides information on their Forte and status as a Resonator.

While Lorewise not all Fortes seem to be suitable for combat, in the Combat System of Wuthering Waves a playable Resonator's set of Combat Skills is synonymous to their Forte.

title: Forte
content:
There are six Fortes that all playable Resonators possess:
Basic Attack
Resonance Skill
Resonance Liberation
Forte Circuit
Inherent Skill
Intro Skill/Outro Skill

title: Forte
Forte
content:
Resonance Skill, is a Forte that regenerates energy for the usage of Resonance Liberation. The exact details of a Resonance Skill depends on the Resonator.

Whilst most Resonance Skills have CDs, some Resonators' are an exception to this rule and don't have a CD for their Skills.
E.g. Danjin's Resonance Skill - Crimson Fragment.

title: Forte
content: Forte Circuits are unique to each character, both in ways to use and ways to increase (e.g. Danjin's usage of her skill or Mortefi dealing DMG to increase his "Annoyance"). The usage of Forte Circuits is beneficial to combat all around, providing buffed output when used.

title: Forte
content: Resonance Liberation, used by clicking R, is a Forte that is released by using accumulated energy. They tend to be much more powerful than the Resonance Skills.

title: Forte
content:
Intro and Outro Skills are Fortes that are used by switching characters after building a set amount of Concerto Energy. Resonators will do a joint attack after swapping with full Concerto Energy, dealing increased DMG, with the leaving character either giving a buff or dealing a massive amount of damage.

Changli's Strategy of Duality gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.

title: Francesca
content:
Francesca is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita. She's a representative from Averardo Bank.

She can be found talking in the middle of Bank Street from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

title: Francesca
content:
[Objective: (In the daytime)]
Francesca: Argh... My feet are killing me from all the walking...
Francesca: Damn! You scared me! I thought I had run into my boss again.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Francesca: I'm just getting into work mode. Hello, I'm Francesca, a representative from Averardo Bank.
[Dialogue Option]  What does a bank representative do?
Francesca: Well... in short, I evaluate and quote clients' collections on-site, then offer services related to collateral, insurance, and storage based on the appraised value.
Francesca: I know what you're going to ask next: yes, our bank stores more than just currency.
Francesca: From artwork to Echoes, we store anything that meets our valuation requirements. Once your assets are deemed valuable, they can be kept in Ragunna's safest place—Averardo Vault.
[Dialogue Option]  But how do you value a piece of artwork?
Francesca: That's a deep question.
Francesca: Art is subjective, and everyone interprets it differently, so there isn't a universal standard for measuring its value.
Francesca: Unfortunately, from the bank's perspective, we need to impose some universal criteria to assess them.
Francesca: The rarity, prominence, provenance, and history of a collection are key factors. Items with a story often receive a higher appraisal.
Francesca: I remember that the business began with currency operations. Maybe it started as just a hobby for Signore Francesco.
[Dialogue Option]  I didn't expect Montelli to be so passionate about art.
Francesca: Well, Montelli's no longer motivated by passion alone.
Francesca: Analyzing the market flow of collectibles reveals clients' recent financial movements, which is crucial intelligence for the Montelli family.

title: Francesco Montelli
content:
Francesco Montelli is a quest-exclusive NPC. He is the current head of the Montelli Family and Carlotta's grandfather. Recognized in the Family as the "Padrino," he is currently spearheading the push for Reserved Terminals in the city-state of Ragunna.

He is first encountered as the "Old Gentleman" in Carlotta's Companion Story: If On a Rainy Night a Family.

title: Francesco Montelli
content: In the early years of the Montelli Family, he learned to modify Terminals during his ventures in the New Federation. Unlike other regions where Terminals were freely traded, Rinascita’s Terminals were strictly controlled by the Order. The Montellis, however, developed a modified lantern-type Terminal that appeared ornamental but contained advanced tech modules. These modifications allowed the family to supply Terminals to Resonators at fair prices, effectively breaking the Order's monopoly. Eventually he adopts the orphaned Carlotta into the Main Branch of the family after an accident with her Forte.

title: Francesco Montelli
content: As the Padrino of the Family, he holds influence in making decisions for the family, upholding their values such as their expansionist approach and their pioneering spirit. His decisions affect the city-state of Ragunna, alongside those of the Order and the Fisalia Family. He is close friends with Pierre, an expert in Terminal studies for the Montelli Family.
