Franciscus: Huh? Who's there?
[Dialogue Option]  How much did you drink?
[Dialogue Option]  I didn't hear anything...
Franciscus: ...Never mind. Friend, if you have a moment, could you indulge me in a brief confession?
Franciscus: Do you know Levito? He was once the Order's lead musician.
Franciscus: I saw him as my primary rival for the chief musician position and went head to head against him on every matter.
Franciscus: To ensure I got the spot, I publicly disparaged his work. I stooped so low as to spread rumors that his work broke the Order's doctrines. All the slandering I did... They worked. Led to his downfall.
Franciscus: I did these things because I was simply jealous of his talent. I couldn't compose such beautiful pieces, nor conduct the Vox Sancti to perform in such perfect unity...
Franciscus: To this day, I still cannot surpass him.
Franciscus: Then words came suddenly one day that he boarded the Pilgrim's Sail. I never heard from him again... only later did I learn the appalling truth of the pilgrimage.
Franciscus: If anything happened to Levito during his pilgrimage, my part in this shall not be pardoned...
[Dialogue Option]  You should say these words to Levito yourself.
Franciscus: If I could, I would tell him in person of my remorse...
Franciscus: Every night, I repent and punish myself with unbearable guilt. But when daylight comes, I put on my mask again.
Franciscus: Thank you for listening. As you can see, my arrogance... is just a facet of my self-loathing and guilt...
Franciscus: I fear my secret being revealed, yet my heart can't stop whispering it in the night...
Franciscus: This guilt... it's nearly crushing me...

title: Franciscus
subsection: (After confession Near the Vox Sancti during the Day)
content:
[Objective: (After confession Near the Vox Sancti during the Day)]
Franciscus: It's you. I'm  currently tuning these Vox Sancti.
Franciscus: Composing hymns, tuning the Echoes, and conducting the Vox Sancti ensemble to perform the piece flawlessly-these are the duties of the chief musician.
Franciscus: Vox Sancti are sacred species. Only the most pure and solemn hymns are worthy of their divine sounds.
Franciscus: But I still can't fully command them... only Levito could manage that.
Franciscus: Why is it... where lies the difference between us?

title: Fratellino

title: Fratello
content:
Fratellino is the middle brother of the Fratellis Brothers who is training to become stronger to join the Pioneer Association with his brothers. He challenges Rover in Echo Challenge: Flight and Echo Challenge: Plushie Punch.

Each challenge rewards Union EXP x30, Astrite x20, Monnaie x40, and EXP Materials. Completing all his challenge will grant the quest The Bizarre Brothers: Fratello.

title: Fratello
content:
(First interaction at Thessaleo Fells)
???: Huh? Woah! Look at those battle-honed muscles... and that fierce, unwavering gaze... you must be incredibly strong!
Fratello: I'm Fratello, currently training to join the Pioneer Association.
Rover: You need to train before joining t he Pioneer Association?
Fratello: Of course! It's a huge organization spread across Solaris, so you've got to pass all kinds of tests before they let you in!
[Dialogue Option]  Doesn't the Pioneer Association sell newspapers?
[Dialogue Option]  Don't underestimate yourself, my man.
Fratello: Don't mind the details. Now, how about a little competition?
Fratello: Let's race using our Echoes! You can use any Echo you want, and let's see who can finish faster!
Rover: I bet I could beat you even without an Echo.
Fratello: This is the land of Echoes, outlander! What's the point of getting stronger if your Echoes stay weak?
Fratello: Come on, let's see if you can break my record to become the most fired-up person in this land!

title: Fratello
subsection: (Fail to reach objective within time limit)
content:
[Objective: (Fail to reach objective within time limit)]
Fratello: Are you holding back on me?
Fratello: You weren't fired up at all!
Fratello: Come on, one more time! Give it your all and show me who's the most fired-up soul in the land!

Fratello: That... that was incredible! You must be the strongest person in the world!
[Dialogue Option]  The one and only.
[Dialogue Option]  I wouldn't say that.
Fratello: No, no, no, my instincts tell me you're definitely the strongest in the world!
Fratello: Woah! Looks like I need to keep training. Burn bright, my youth!

(Reach the objective within the time limit)
Fratello: Whoa! It's you, the world's strongest!
Fratello: I've set a new record even you can't break!
Fratello: Come on now, accept my challenge!

Fratello: Hahaha! I see, I still need to burn brighter!
Fratello: Just you wait, world's strongest for now! I'll be back!

Fratello: Oh, I was just wondering when you'd show up!
Fratello: I've  set a new record again! Come accept my challenge!

title: Fratello
subsection: (Fail to reach objective within time limit)
content:
Fratello: Oh, I was just wondering when you'd show up!
Fratello: I've  set a new record again! Come accept my challenge!



(Reach the objective within the time limit)
Fratello: Ha, we meet again! Come on!
Rover: You've already earned your place in the Pioneer Associations, so why are you still so obsessed with getting stronger?
Fratello: Are you... also the most curious person in the world?
Rover: No explanation, no challenge.
Fratello: Wait, alright, I'll make it quick.
Fratello: You know about the Dark Tide, right? Twenty years ago, the Dark Tide claimed my parents. Since then, my older brother has raised me and my younger brother.
Fratello: That's why I've always wanted to join the Pioneer Association to uncover the truth behind the Dark Tide!
Fratello: I must train myself to get strong―strong enough to push back the Dark Tide with a single strike! Otherwise, how can I protect my brothers?
Fratello: Heh, now I'm feeling a bit embarrassed! Come on, let's see if you can break my record this time!

metadata.subsection: (Fail to reach objective within time limit)

title: Fratello
subsection: (Fail to reach objective within time limit)
content:
Fratello: Heh, now I'm feeling a bit embarrassed! Come on, let's see if you can break my record this time!



(Reach the objective within the time limit)
Fratello: Hey, look at me! Do you feel it? I've gotten stronger!
Rover: You know that joining the Pioneer Association doesn't mean you'll fully understand the Dark Tide, right?
Fratello: Yeah, I know. But the key is to take the first step, isn't it?
Fratello: Sometimes, it feels like my brothers and I have never escaped the Dark Tide. It seems our lives were frozen at that moment.
Fratello: So when I heard Fratellino say he wanted to join the Pioneer Association, I immediately thought, "Ah, this is my first step!"
Fratello: You must understand how I feel, being the world's strongest!
Fratello: Alright, enough small talk ― come and break my record, world's strongest!

content:

Fratello: No, no, it's a brand new challenge this time.
Fratello: Let's see who can shatter this Seamrock in the shortest time after transforming into a Cuddle Wuddle!
Rover: Seamrock?
Fratello: It's much tougher than regular rock, but laced with tiny internal cracks. Hit it with the right rhythm, and it'll break apart quickly!
Fratello: Trust me, there's no better way to measure your strength and precision than punching the Seamrock!
Fratello: Come on, let's see if you can break my record to become the most fired-up person in this land!

Fratello: Come accept my challenge!

title: Fratello
content:

(Smash the Seamrock)
Fratello: Hey, we meet again! Ready? The challenge starts now!
Rover: You mentioned you have an older brother, right?
Fratello: That's right, the name's Fratellone! He's out there looking for the Nightmare Clouds, something about conquering his fears.
Fratello: Fratellone used to be famous in town for his bravery! But ever since the Dark Tide, he's been plagued by nightmares and has become incredibly cautious.
Fratello: I know it's because he's so afraid of losing me and our younger brother!  In the end, it all comes down to me not being strong enough. Enough talking, let's go!

title: Fratello
content:
(Smash the Seamrock)
Fratello: This aura... you seem stronger now! Amazing!
Rover: Is your younger brother out there training too?
Fratello: That's right! My Fratellino―he said he was going out to collect some documents or what. I wonder if he's taking good care of himself.
Fratello: When the Dark Tide hit, we lost our parents and our house. He's always blamed himself for our parents' deaths. No matter how much we tried to comfort him, it never made a difference and he grew up scatterbrained.
Fratello: Honestly, it's my fault. If I'd been stronger back then... Well, enough talk, let's go!

title: Fratello
content:
Fratello: Honestly, it's my fault. If I'd been stronger back then... Well, enough talk, let's go!



(Smash the Seamrock)
Fratello: Ah, here you are!
Fratello: This is the final challenge, world's strongest! With defeating you as my goal, my training has progressed faster than expected. But I know I'm still far from your level, right?
Fratello: Arfter all, (Name), you are the Rover, the great hero who saved Jinzhou. Your reputation has spread even to these  distant mountains.
Fratello: So, if I can't become as strong as you, I might still fail to protect my brothers during a disaster, right?
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  You are strong enough.
Fratello: Come on, this is the final challenge!

title: Fratello
content:
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  You are strong enough.
Fratello: Come on, this is the final challenge!



Fratello: As expected, I still have a long way to go.
Fratello: Am I getting ahead of myself? I encouraged my brothers to join the Pioneer Association, yet I lack the strength to protect them from danger...
[Dialogue Option]  You've got this!
[Dialogue Option]  You can do it, Fratello!
Fratello: Are you saying that despite my weakness, I can still keep moving forward?
Fratello: How enlightening! I'd say you're not just the strongest, but also the smartest. I'll head back to Egla Town to meet my brothers. See you!

title: Fratellone
content:
Fratellone is the eldest of the Fratellis Brothers and is training to build his courage to join the Pioneer Association with his brothers. Rover frequently saves him from his nightmares in Echo Challenge: Clear Cloud.

Each challenge rewards Union EXP x30, Astrite x20, Monnaie x40, and EXP Materials. Completing all his challenge will grant the quest The Bizarre Brothers: Fratellone.

[Dialogue Option]  Ugh... if we get surrounded by the Plushie Squad... each of us would have to fight 1.3 Plushies...
[Dialogue Option]  I thought we were heading to the Pioneer Association, not boarding the Pilgrim's Sail!

[Dialogue Option] : You can do it, Fratellone!
Fratellone: Thanks!
Fratellone: See you later then!
Fratellone: By the way, once my training is over, come visit me in Egla Town. I'll repay you properly!

[Dialogue Option]  You can do it! You're already ahead of most people!
Fratellone: If you say so... I'll give it another shot!



(Wake up Fratellone)
Fratellone: It feels like I'm getting used to being saved by you lately...
Fratellone: ...
Fratellone: You know, I think I dreamt through every single problem I might face after joining the Pioneer Association.
Fratellone: It feels like I've already had enough.
[Dialogue Option]  But you haven't even joined yet!
[Dialogue Option]  Come on, Fratellone! You've got this!
Fratellone: Alright, since you say so, I'll keep pushing forward!

title: Fratellone
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Come on, Fratellone! You've got this!
Fratellone: Alright, since you say so, I'll keep pushing forward!



(Wake up Fratellone)
Fratellone: Aaah... Good morning!
Fratellone: Looks like you slept pretty well, huh?
Fratellone: Yeah, seems like the Nightmare Clouds can't give me bad dreams anymore.
Fratellone: Maybe I've already had all my nightmares?
[Dialogue Option]  Way to go, Fratellone!
[Dialogue Option]  Can you actually run out of nightmares?
Fratellone: Haha, I'm heading back to Egla Town for a bit. Maybe we'll meet there! I still owe you a big thanks!

title: Fredrico
content:
__NOTOC__
' is a fledgling male Gladiator participating in the Hunt for the first time. He is seen with the Blacksmith, Baptiste.
His father is Goffredo, makes an exclusive appearance in the Ephor's Palace during .

title: Fredrico
content:
Baptiste: This is the best blade I've forged in a long while.
Baptiste: To face the Dark Tide creations, steel and soul must fight as one. Sadly, I've seen far more blades make it home than men...
Baptiste: Hope this blade bring you luck, lad!
Fredrico: Does this sword have a name, sir?
Baptiste: No, not yet. Tell me, lad, what's your name?
Fredrico: Fredrico, sir.
Baptiste: Fredrico... A fine name. Return with this blade, and you can name it after you.
Fredrico: ...I will earn that honor, sir.
Fredrico: For the glory of my House, I'll prove myself worthy of this sword.

title: Fredrico
content:
[Objective: (Afterward By Sun's Burning Hand)]
Baptiste: You made it back, lad!
Fredrico: Barely... This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others...
Baptiste: Survival is an honor in itself. Don't be too hard on yourself.
Fredrico: Also... the sword you gave me, I lost it in the battle...
Fredrico: A Gladiator should never let go of their blade. I guess I'm not ready yet...
Baptiste: Haha! A sword's a sword. I can always forge another.
Baptiste: But you, you are the real blade of Septimont. This hunt only whets your edge.
Baptiste: Shame, though. The sword with your name will have to wait for another day.
Fredrico Until then, I'll keep sharpening myself.

title: Frostlands Surface
content:
The Frostlands Surface is the original homeland of the Roya before its destruction and freezing during the Lament, and the creation of Lahai-Roi in the subterranean cavern beneath. The Polar Collective would establish diplomatic ties with the Roya and establish its Research Institute on the sword that connects the tropical realm to the surface and holds it up. It is where the Exostrider slumbers, awaiting its final duty.

The Frostlands Surface can be reached during The Star That Voyages Far.

title: Fucan
content: [Dialogue Option]  Such a strange name. Nobody around here goes by that...

title: Fucan
content:
Fucan: There's always these weird names on packages, making deliveries a real puzzle...
Fucan: Can you believe there's someone named "Ms. Vera's Dog"?
Fucan: Well, at least it's a living thing. Then there's "Liv's Quilted Coat". How's a coat supposed to receive a package?
Fucan: And this one, "Universe's Strongest Chief". We've got Midnight Rangers and Patrollers, but no chiefs. What's that about? There's no such position in the Ministry of War.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Maybe they're from another universe.
[Dialogue Option]  Is it from a famous Hero Play?
Fucan: Sorry, no time for jokes now. Got a package to deliver, pronto.
Fucan: Maybe... It's been ages since I watched a Hero Play. Work's been non-stop.
Fucan: Anyway, enough chatter. Time to hustle and get these packages where they need to be.
Fucan: Can't afford to mess up our reputation as "We Promise, We Deliver".

title: Fuchang
content: '  is a NPC Physician for Xuanfang Huaxu Academy who is first seen treating a Xuanfang Warden.

title: Fuchang
content:
[Objective: (One time interaction)]
Zhengzhuang: Doctor, what should I do!? I think I've got a terminal illness!!

Fuchang: Don't panic. Take deep breaths. What symptoms are you experiencing?

Zhengzhuang: Every time I go on shift at the Censure Court, I get so dizzy I see spots! My heart pounds like a drum! The air grows heavy, like an invisible hand is choking me!

Zhengzhuang: I've looked through so many medical texts and don't see anything matching it! It must be a rare disease. There's a nine in ten chance i-it's a terminal illness!

Fuchang: Let me check your pulse... take off your mask and stick out your tongue.

Fuchang: ...

Fuchang: Hmm... Your illness. I believe I know what it is.

Zhengzhuang: What? So I am sick? I knew it! Is there a cure, doctor? Give it to me straight. I-I can take it.

title: Fuchang
content:
Zhengzhuang: What? So I am sick? I knew it! Is there a cure, doctor? Give it to me straight. I-I can take it.



Fuchang: There is a cure. I'll write you a prescription, but this prescription isn't for your eyes. Take it to your captain.

Fuchang: The next time you go on shift at the Censure Court, do whatever your captain tells you. Understand?

Zhengzhuang: Of course! I'll do exactly as you say!

title: Fujian
content: Fujian is the son of Fuyan, the owner of Huaipu Mining Firm.

title: Fujian
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Fujian: Hey Dad, got all the goods in. Care to take a look?
Fuyan: Hmm... This batch looks good.
Fujian: You know it, Dad. Jinzhou boasts top-notch minerals. Quality is never an issue here!
Fuyan: And the prices?
Fujian: Already sorted it with the Mineral Corporation. Stick to the old rules. No need to factor in the recent price changes.
Fuyan: We didn't take advantage of them, right?
Fujian: Dad, trust me. We didn't take any advantage. We've been loyal customers, and with my staff discount, this is the right price.
Fuyan: Good, good. Remember, son, fair play keeps the business rolling.

title: Fuling
content: Fuling is an NPC that first appears in . She can later be seen near Burrata Bakery in Whisperwind Haven, Rinascita.

title: Fuling
content:
[Objective: (Idle)]
Wuli: Fuling, check out this book.
Fuling: Fascinating...

title: Fuling
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Fuling)]
Fuling: Hi Rover, it's been a while.
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't it Fuling and Wuli?
[Dialogue Option]  Hello! What brings you two here?
[Dialogue Option]  How are you holding up?
Fuling: Thanks to you and Changli, I'm feeling much better now. I can even walk around a bit.
Fuling: And I still want to explore more places and see different views.
Wuli: And I will never let her do that alone.
Wuli: Rinascita has always been on our list. Fuling talked about painting the sunset in Ragunna City and visiting the Salotto Open Air Gallery.
Fuling: But I'm still not fit enough to walk a long way, so I was thinking maybe I could enjoy the scenery through pictures and paintings.
Fuling: As we planned for it, we found some books scattered around Ragunna. But it's impossible for us to find them all, which is a bit of a letdown...
[Dialogue Option]  I've got some books here.
[Dialogue Option]  I can help you.
Fuling: Well, we'd be immensely grateful! If you come across any illegible pages, feel free to show them to me.
Fuling: I've studied the language of Rinascita before, so I can help interpret them.
Wuli: Can't wait to hear your update, Rover. We'll have a reward ready while you search.

title: Fulmine
content:
Fulmine is an NPC in . He is the manager of the Wutherim Film Studio and a member of the Pioneer Association.

Fulmine's Forte is called Celluloid Chronicle or Film Memory, allowing him to turn events into strands of film-shaped hair. With the help of his partner, C-MOSS, he can project these captured moments.

title: Fulmine
content:
Fulmine: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association of Ragunna.
[Dialogue Option]  About Pioneer Association
Fulmine: The Pioneer Association of Ragunna operates under our visual production division, the Wutherium Film Studio.
Fulmine: We're dedicated to capturing reality through our lenses, showing not just the devastation of disasters but also the transformations they bring.
Fulmine: Our mission here is to capture and preserve these changes to offer people a new way to see the world.
Fulmine: Whenever you need it, C-MOSS and I will be ready to capture every important moment for you.
Fulmine: I'm confident that we'll create many  treasured memories here in Ragunna.

title: Fulmine
content:
Fulmine: I'm confident that we'll create many  treasured memories here in Ragunna.



[Dialogue Option]  About yourself
Fulmine: Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association.
Fulmine: Umm... Did you happen to pick up any film on your way here?
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of film?
Fulmine: Well, like the ones on my head.
Fulmine: My Resonance power, "Film Memory," lets me turn memorable moments and dreams into strands of film-shaped hair.
Fulmine: Nifty, right? Sometimes even lost ideas resurface in the film!
Fulmine: But lately, all those late nights have started taking a toll... I'm losing hair, and along with it, some of my precious film.
Fulmine: Some of it is a bit... personal. If anyone ever saw them, I'd just die of embarrassment—ahhhh!
Fulmine: So, Rover, if you come across any of my films lying around, could you please return them to me?
Fulmine: ...And um, promise me you  won't peek, okay?
[Dialogue Option]  I promise.
[Dialogue Option]  No promises!
[Dialogue Option]  Goodbye
Fulmine: Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Until we meet again!

title: Fulmine
subsection: One time Interaction at the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City
content:
[Objective: One time Interaction at the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City]
Matheus: Nonsense! Absolutely nonsense!
Nathan: Huh!? You are overreacting...
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
Nathan: This Acolyte here was telling me stories about the Order of the Deep in Ragunna, like the Final Tide and Flood of the End Times prophesied by the Sentinel Imperator.
Nathan: I actually think some of these ideas align with terms from current Tacetite theories.
Nathan: For example, you've likely seen the Etheric Sea in Huanglong, haven't you? It's a unique sky phenomenon associated with the appearance of the Tacet Fields and Tacent Discords.
Nathan: Now, we've proven this waveworn phenomenon is a manifestation of the Lament—a pattern we can observe and study and —
Matheus: Nonsense! The tides suspended in the sky are clear evidence of the Sentinel's prophesy!
Matheus: Only by gathering under the protection of Imperator and the Order, by constantly ascending and connecting, can we find the path to salvation.
Nathan: I understand why you'd hold that view, but —
Matheus: By Imperator! Perhaps I really should send you to the Order Penitentiary immediately. You should be on the Pilgrim's Sail, repenting for your sins!
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe you should stop here...
Nathan: Alright, alright...
Matheus: Ragunna will not tolerate insults to our faith!
Tao: Mr. Fulmine!
Fulmine: What is it? Calm down. Take your time.
Tao: Nathan had a major disagreement with an Acolyte named Matheus. Now he threatens to contact the Order Penitentiary to have Nathan expelled...
Fulmine: What? How did it get to this?
Tao: Heard it was about the prophecies by Imperator. Nathan raised some unconventional interpretations and the two started to argue.
Fulmine: Nathan's new in the city. You can't expect him to catch on the depths of Ragunna's history...
Fulmine: Let me handle this... Hello, am I speaking to Brother Matheus?
Matheus: Yes, that's me. May I ask to whom am I speaking?
Fulmine: This is Fulmine from the Pioneer Association. You may have heard of me.
Fulmine: I heard the Order plans to produce a documentary about the Tidal Sancturary to spread Imperator's blessings through a new channel?
Matheus: Yes... the Order is indeed preparing for that.
Fulmine: I believe the Pioneer Association may help with this project. If you're interested, why not come to our studio for a detailed discussion when you're available?
Matheus: Well... but...
Fulmine: Also, I think in the interests of cooperation, and of the Order, we could move past the unpleasant exchange you've had?
Matheus: ...I see. Thank you for your contribution to the Order, Mr. Fulmine.
Tao: He hung up...
Fulmine: I'll take care of this from here. Don't worry.

Fulvia: You can even challenge diners nearby to a friendly duel! Just... not in here, alright? Take it outside if you must clash steel.
[Dialogue Option]

title: Fusheng
content:
Fusheng: If nothing unexpected happens, we will definitely win this war.
[Dialogue Option]  Why?
Fusheng: After fighting for a lifetime, we can always summarize some battle experience and conclusions.
Fusheng: Although everyone is still tense, overall, the Midnight Rangers will no longer be trapped in a bloody battle like the previous war when facing Tacet Discord.
[Dialogue Option]  The previous war?
Fusheng: The Battle Beneath the Crescent many years ago... Oh, come to think of it, it's been a long time since I talked to someone about these things.
Fusheng: I was young back then, and I had never seen such a battle before...
Fusheng: The unstoppable tide of Tacet Discord almost engulfed the entire army, and the comrades in chaos suddenly started killing each other...
Fusheng: The endless war slowly dragged each of us into the vortex of weariness, and a moment of relaxation in the mind could take away your life.
Fusheng: Countless people fell in that war, even my dear friend who grew up with me was not spared.
Fusheng: Those nightmarish days, I can't even distinguish now what was real and what was fake...
Fusheng: Those who have experienced that war find it hard to completely move on. I once left the army and lived in the city, but I found that I can only find peace in the barracks.
Fusheng: ... I still can't let go of my comrades, whether it's the past or the present, haha.

title: Fuyue
content: Fuyue is an NPC in Jinzhou, found at the Commercial District.

title: Fuyue
content:
Fuyue: Jinzhou is just incredible, right? The sky's so blue, the food smells amazing, and the energy from people practicing martial arts is off the charts!
[Dialogue Option]  You're not from around here?
Fuyue: Nope, totally new here. I thought Jinzhou was just some sleepy border town, but wow, it's blowing me away with its charm!
Fuyue: And the folks here... despite dealing with all those Tacet Discords and Exiles, they still manage to whip up delicious food and build these gorgeous houses.
Fuyue: Guess this is what they mean by "living life to the fullest". The moment I arrived here, I just felt like, "Yes! This is it!"
[Dialogue Option]  "Yes! This is it!"?
Fuyue: Yeah. You know what Linglong says? "As a designer, I want to create outfits that match people's lifestyles perfectly."
Fuyue: She believes clothes should not only fit your body but also uplift your mood and energy. That's why a designer thrives in places where everyone's living their best life!
Fuyue: No wonder Linglong chose to open a branch here.
[Dialogue Option]  Linglong?
Fuyue: Wait, you haven't heard of her? She's a total fashion icon! Her brand "Longyue" is like a global sensation. People literally camp out to get their hands on her latest drops.
Fuyue: Linglong aims to make fashion more exciting and accessible. That's why she's opening up stores all over the world!
[Dialogue Option]  A branch?
Fuyue: Guess what? Longyue, Linglong's original brand, is making its way to Jinzhou soon!
Fuyue: Whenever Longyue's main store gets new arrivals, people literally camp out to get their hands on her latest drops.
Fuyue: In order to create more interesting designs and to let more customers buy their favorite clothes, Linglong has decided to open branches all over the world!
Fuyue: With plans to expand globally, she's gotta keep that Longyue vibe while adding local characteristics.
Fuyue: So Linglong's always on the move, soaking up inspiration from different places. I bet she's already had some amazing designs for Jinzhou!
Fuyue: Haha, just imagine everyone here wearing Linglong's designs. Nice people in nice clothes.... It'll be fabulous!

title: Gabriel
content:
Gabriel: Francesca has discovered a batch of potential collectibles and provided an initial valuation.
Gabriel: Among them is one item I believe will interest you.
Gabriel: The clean and vibrant color palette is emblematic of the creator. All proceeds from the auction will be donated to the Order of the Deep.
Davide: ...
Davide: Do me a favor, Gabriel.
Gabriel: It's already arranged, Davi- I mean, anonymous buyer.

title: Gabriel
content:
Gabriel: The avant-gardes of the New Federation haven't turned out anything exciting recently. I've a hunch we're not getting our money back.
Gabriel: What do you think? Should we try our luck in Septimont, Davide? Davide?
Davide: Huh? Oh... what was that? Sorry, I didn't catch you.
Gabriel: What? Spent half of your life managing the Montelli family's collection and now you're seeking a fine piece of art for yourself?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you talking about the painting... or the painter?
Gabriel: Come on, you were eyeing that lady over there. Right?
Davide: Maybe... Or maybe I'm simply attracted by that splash of bright orange tempera. A golden ray of sunshine in Salotto...
Gabriel: She is indeed a charming lady. Got an air of timeless elegance. But judging from the Order's robe she's wearing, she must be an Acolyte.
Gabriel: It won't be easy to have and hold this exquisite piece of art in your hands.
Gabriel: First, you'll need permission from the Order for your union. And it's just the beginning. The rules and restrictions the Order have in place on such a partnership will simply mean you won't be able to serve the Montelli family anymore.
Davide: I understand... despite that inappropriate analogy. There's indeed an insurmountable wall between us and this treasured "collection" of the Cathedral of Mercury...

title: Gaea Rai
content: ', Masch Rai, and Ordega Rai are three Gladiator Brothers who can be found at the small Gladiator camp in Maroonwood in Sanguis Plateaus, Rinascita.

title: Gaea Rai
content:
[Objective: After]
;Gaea Rai All three of us returned safely from the great battle. It's more than we could've wished for.

title: Gaea Rai
content:
Gaea Rai: Rover, do you have a moment to give us some pointers? We've been debriefing the last hunt, but we can't seem to reach a consensus on what mattered most.
[Dialogue Option]  Of course.
Gaea Rai: Most grateful! Well then, we'd like to hear your judgment on which of us got it right.
Gaea Rai: In my opinion, speed wins fights—strike before your prey even realizes you're there. Kill fast, end faster. Drag it out, and things can easily go sideways.
Ordega Rai: You're oversimplifying it, brother! What if the first strike fails? Then what? It's all about following a strategy. That's what brings people back.
Masch Rai: No, no, you're thinking too small. A hunt isn't fought by one warrior! It's about the unit. Coordinating between squads. Obeying orders. That's what ensures victory.
Gaea Rai: But Rover has achieved many heroic feats by themselves! There's an entire army in him!
Ordega Rai: You idiot! This is the champion of the Agon we're talking about! Not all Resonators are built the same!
Masch Rai: Enough arguing... Let Rover tell us the answer.

title: Gaea Rai
content:
Masch Rai: Enough arguing... Let Rover tell us the answer.



[Dialogue Option]  Hit first and hit hard!
Gaea Rai: Aha, great minds think alike! You hear that, boys? You hit 'em fast and you hit 'em hard. Starting tomorrow, the two of you will be in for some power training!
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing will matter if you're dead!
Ordega Rai: Well, said! You can't claim glory from the grave.
[Dialogue Option]  Teamwork makes the dream work!
Masch Rai: Like I said, instead of focusing on individual tactics, we should strengthen our coordination in the field!
[Dialogue Option]  None of that matters.
Gaea Rai: None of them? Are you implying... we're not thinking big enough?!
Gaea Rai: We greatly appreciate your advice. We'll take some time to think this through...
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe next time.

title: Gaea Rai
content:
[Objective: After]
;Gaea Rai Rover! Welcome back!
Gaea Rai: May howls of triumph follow you, Honorable Rover!
Gaea Rai: Do you remember the guidance you once gave us?
Gaea Rai: Thanks to your instructions, when the disaster struck, the three of us managed to survive and even claim victory!
Gaea Rai: It was through your efforts that we set aside our differences and worked together to overcome it.
Gaea Rai: We are truly grateful.

content: Galbrena got her new name from a legendary Tacet Discord she consumed known as the "Flame Demon" Galbrena.

title: Galbrena (TD)
content:
"Galbrena" was a Tacet Discord commonly known and referred to as the "Flame Demon".

As long as hatred burnt, "Galbrena" would always be reborn from its frequencies no matter how many times she is defeated. In order to combat this, a young Angel made a deal with Chimera as to obtain his devouring power. Using Chimera's power, Angel consumed "Galbrena", thus ending her endless cycle of rebirth and took the Tacet Discord's name as her own, becoming the Discord Slayer.

title: Galbrena/Backstory
content:
Female   Rinascita   The Black Shores
|power = Infernal Descent
|evaluation = [Special Containment Risk Assessment Record – X666]  "...The subject's Resonance Ability shows prior contamination by the Dark Tide. The frequency spectrum is heavily obscured and cannot be analyzed via the Rabelle Method. Based on the subject's own testimony, corroborated by external sources, she is classified as a Congenital Resonator."  "...Overlord-Class Tacet Discords detected within the subject's body. Testing is to be transferred to the Tethys System. All non-essential personnel are to evacuate to designated safe zones without delay!"  "...Sample database linked. Comparative analysis initiated."  "...The subject's internal frequency confirmed. Partial matches identified with known Tacet Discords: Chimera, Galbrena, Harpyia, Dullahan, Balor, and the Nameless Dreadshade. Remaining correlations pending verification."  "All identified Tacet Discords exhibit no hostile behavior under suppression by the subject's own frequency. Behavioral stability confirmed under high-stress conditions. Final assessment: containment not advised. Recommendation: routine examinations.  The cause of the subject's Awakening cannot be confirmed. Her innate flame, once corroded by the Dark Tide, decayed but was never fully extinguished. Subsequently, it fused with the Tidespawn known as Chimera, altering the flame's nature and granting her the capacity to consume other frequencies.  Through this process, the subject proactively hunts Tacet Discords, absorbing and transforming their frequencies into her own power. At present, she is able to wield multiple Tacet Discord abilities in combat.  For "demons" devoured by her flame, there are only two outcomes: purification and transformation into her own power, or utter destruction.  "A walking museum of Tacet Discords… Can such power truly belong to a human? Worse still, it evolves." "No… it's an inner empire. I saw it… an empire rising within her."
|overclock = Resonator Galbrena has a documented history of Overclocking. Maximum Overclocking rating: Negligible.  Black Shores Bloom Bearer Research Report  Despite the immense power Ms. Galbrena exhibited after Overclocking—including marked transformation of both appearance and physiology—we nevertheless classify her historical Maximum Overclocking rating as negligible.  This assessment must be understood in context: her Resonance Ability was once corrupted by the Dark Tide, leaving her almost entirely depleted of her Resonance Ability. For a Resonator so diminished to achieve Overclocking at all—to move from deficit to surplus, from absence to presence—is nothing short of miraculous.  Traditionally, Overclocking has been defined as a state that exhausts the mind and body, signifying the dominance of destructive tendencies over regenerative ones within Resonators. Galbrena's case, however, compels us to reconsider this definition. In her, Overclocking did not manifest as deterioration, but as a signal of rebirth. It suggests that the phenomenon may be closely tied to the will of the Resonator and that, if properly guided, Overclocking could potentially yield constructive outcomes, transforming into a power that Resonators could one day learn to wield with intent.  Important Note: All research personnel are strictly prohibited from attempting, by any method, to replicate Ms. Galbrena's Overclocking method. Any such action, once discovered, will result in immediate containment measures.}}

|vo_01_02_tx                 = An incarnate of hellfire, fed on demons, commanding the power of the . This is who I am. Will you fear me… or scorn me? They call my power a curse, an ancient omen of darkness. But I call it something else—an oath. I know what I have to do. And no matter how the world may judge me, I will see it through to the very end.

title: Galbrena/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Many call me "Galbrena," and I've grown used to it. It's the name of my second life. Hey, if it gets the job done, I don't mind it. But Angel... that name has always stayed with me. It was given to me by my parents, outcasts from Ragunna who hoped I'd grow into it one day. Since then, I've crossed many lands, seen my share of "monsters and demons"... but never angels. They say angels exist to fight devils. And where an angel goes, danger follows. They may not look like people think. Sometimes they scare you. Sometimes they warn you. If that's what an angel is… maybe I have lived up to that name after all. So tell me. What do you see?

title: Galbrena/Voicelines

|vo_01_04_tx                 = Along my journey, I've stopped a lot of tragedies... and watched just as many unfold, both natural and man-made. This world isn't always beautiful. And that's exactly why the bonds we make in it feel all the more precious. Like you, I load my gun for the ones who never made it home. I wasn't the first. And I won't be the last.

|vo_02_02_tx                 = Galbrena: I can keep  in check most of the time… but the second I'm distracted, he always finds a way to— Chimera: You never talk this much to anyone else. |vo_02_03_tx                 = Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

title: Galbrena/Voicelines

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = At first, I "ate"  just to survive. But now, I hunt them for power... They don't count as food? Well, if we're talking about food in the usual sense, I can stomach anything on the table.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Live well. Die right. That's how I see it. And if there really is an afterlife, where I get to see "them" again… I want to face them with pride. To say I lived fully. Fought for what I believed in. Died with meaning. No regrets, nothing unfinished. But until my flame burns out, I'll keep crossing death, again and again. And when it's time... |vo_03_01_tx                 = I was born in Septimont. It taught me how to fight, and to this day, I still trust in that. But most weapons don't hold up against the . Its corruption gets in deep, eats them from the inside out. For a long time, I fought Tacet Discords bare-handed. Then I got my hands on these guns. Took a hell of a fight to pry them out of 's jaws. I'd stop to find a place to grab ice cream.

title: Galilei
content: Galilei is a graduating male student from New Federation. He can be found discussing his graduation wishes with his teacher, Rhunfield.

title: Galilei
content:
Galilei: I don't want to return to the New Federation to study the Sentinel. I don't want to join the Spacetrek Collective. And I don't want to work here either.
Rhunfield: But your training results are flawless, and your research shows remarkable foresight. What do you plan to do after graduation, Galilei?
Galilei: I want to live like a Roya.
Rhunfield: What? You can't be serious.
Galilei: Professor... if my skills and my talent are just going to be tools for someone else's agenda, then I'd rather give them up.
Galilei: If I go back to the New Federation, my research will only become another way for the capital to exploit the Sentinel.
Rhunfield: And if I stay here? You and I both know this so-called "Research Alliance" is just a tangled web of interests, all waiting to get a slice of our work.
Galilei: Tell me, Professor, does a true sanctuary for pure research even exist?
Galilei: Haha, I'd rather go live as a Roya. Wouldn't be so bad living with them...

title: Galloway
content: Galloway is a male student from the Department of Voidmatters, seen talking with Kuangda from the Department of Light Energy Sciences.

title: Galloway
content:
Galloway: This daily hike is killing me...
Galloway: Why can't the school build the dorms closer to the classrooms? Huff puff...
Kuangda: You'll get used to it, brother...
Galloway: Hey, your badge... You're from the Agro Wing, right? Aren't your test plots even farther out?
Kuangda: Yep. And we have to keep watch to make sure no mech reindeer wander in and eat our "thesis material"...
Galloway: So you must've complained to the school a long time ago.
Kuangda: We solved the problem already.
Galloway: But how? Did the school move your dorms? Or  did you invent some new transport tech?
Kuangda: Nah. We just started sleeping in the plots.

title: Gilberto
content: Gilberto is a quest-exclusive NPC in  who first appears in .

title: Gilberto
content:
Gilberto was a proud noble of the Fisalia Family though his attitude wasn't looked upon favorably by many. Nyarla, the owner of Masked Reverie, described him as being arrogant and cited how she had to revise a commissioned mask twenty-three times for him.

Alongside Priest Alessio from the Order he used a Lycoris to sabotage the Vitreum Dancer rehearsal before the Carnevale. This resulted in the endangerment of various civilians and was used to frame the Montelli Family, whom the Vitreum Dancers belonged to, as the ones responsible for the incident. He is later captured whilst trying to corrupt Lorelei and revealed to be just a pawn in the grander schemes orchestrated by the Fisalia Family. Following his capture, he is held in the custody of the Montelli Family.

title: Gilberto
content: When he's close to turning due to the Dark Tide, Cantarella attempts to cure Gilberto but the man insists that his mind is beyond fixing and begs her to save the potions she has for those who still have hope of recovering. Galbrena directly informs Cantarella that, whilst the antidote her family made can cure those lightly infected, others like Gilberto whose corruption runs deep cannot be saved. Gilberto once again begs Cantarella to allow him to die human and to not allow him to burden those who still have hope. Galbrena offers to do so on Cantarella's behalf, if she finds it too hard to do so, but Cantarella insists that Fisalia blood should be ended at the hands of another Fisalia and she uses her poisonous Forte to end Gilberto's life. Gilberto thanks her before passing on and his fellow Fisalia take a moment to pay their respects to him.

title: Gilberto
content: Gilberto was mentioned to be a Resonator, though not a very powerful one, and his Forte remains unknown.

title: Giordano
content: Giordano is an NPC who appears in front of the Order of the Deep's Cathedral of Mercury main door from 6:00 AM to 9:59 PM.

title: Giordano
content:
Giordano: Welcome to the Cathedral of Mercury. This sanctuary is open to all, around the clock.
Giordano: Please respect the etiquette and taboos of the Order. No noises, fighting or any other inappropriate or transgressive behaviors within Cathedral of Mercury.
[Dialogue Option]  Rules? Give some examples.
[Dialogue Option]  Understood, understood...
Giordano: Denying the Sentinel's existence, blasphemy, or questioning the Sentinel's decrees is forbidden—Sentinel speaks through the Order today. To question the Order is to question the Sentinel.
Giordano: No ill deeds before the Sentinel's statue, no instigating, no lies—even those born of harmless kindness.
Giordano: Please bear in mind all the over one hundred doctrines. If you're unsure, I am happy to explain each one of them to you.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds a bit ambiguous...
[Dialogue Option]  Is there a specific set of criteria for judgment...?
Giordano: The Order has its own methods of judgment for your actions.
Giordano: If you have questions, you may consult the sacred texts here at the Cathedral of Mercury or speak to one of our Acolytes.
Giordano: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Giordano
content:
Giordano: Welcome to the Cathedral of Mercury. This sanctuary is open to all, around the clock.
Giordano: Please respect the etiquette and taboos of the Order. No noises, fighting or any other inappropriate or transgressive behaviors within Cathedral of Mercury.
[Dialogue Option]  Rules? There are still rules?
[Dialogue Option]  Understood, understood...
Giordano: That is precisely why we must have rules to preserve stability in times like these.
Giordano: Now that the truth has come to light and the crisis has passed, the more extreme clause will be struck from the code.
Giordano: But remember: we act in the Sentinel's stead, entrusted with the duty of guiding the mortal realm. We will not allow Rinascita, the gift bestowed upon all by the Sentinel, to descend into lawlessness simply because They have departed.
Giordano: Hero of Rinascita, if you still have questions, I will gladly answer them.
Giordano: Besides, you may consult the sacred text here at the Cathedral of Mercury or speak to one of our Acolytes.

title: Graham

Graham: Feel free to ask me anything!

Graham: Uh... here it refers to various measures working together to achieve a common goal.
Orrin: I see! And what about "granularity"?
Graham: You can think of it as the level of detail... How do I put this... Right! Just like ground pepper—you can grind it to coarse or fine!

Graham: And do you see the deep pockets on our vests? They're super spacious, and super efficient!
Graham: No matter how oddly shaped the shipment, Lollo Logistics can "swallow it whole!"
Graham: So, in summary, if you need courier services, Lollo Logistics is the way to go!

Gupan: A little girl carried her doll to the garden. The doll suddenly let out a loud cry and called for her mother. The mother came and spooned up the doll instead of her daughter... How about it? Scared yet?
[Dialogue Option]  I thought it's just a nice nursery rhyme.
Gupan: Oh, this is your first time listening to a horror story, isn't it? The fact that it still gets the ones who haven't heard of it proves it's a classic macabre rhyme.
Gupan: The essence of horror stories is about eerie things taking place in day-to-day scenes. Like the tune I just hummed.
Gupan: If you pay attention, you see it's not the girl who's crying but the doll. That's why the second half is added.
[Dialogue Option]  What is the second half?
Gupan: Dad and Mom are arguing, and the little girl is crying. The little girl calls for Mom. M-mom is gone.
Gupan: Dad just fertilized the garden trees, the cherry tree turned new leaves. Curiously I dug underneath, and found my doll buried deep...
[Dialogue Option]  Your taste is really...
Gupan: I don't know when I became obsessed with them. Maybe it's because horror stories have a clear representation of karma.
Gupan: Behind the twists and turns of the gloomy plots is a pursuit of romantic ideals.
Gupan: I have always suspected that there are real horror stories around me, just between you and me.
Gupan: To think of something ominous might lurk in the darkness under the cold industrial surface of this jungle of steel and bolts... Phew... I've got goose bumps.

title: Hamm
content: Hamm is a male NPC who appears in Ragunna, Rinascita at night. He can be seen talking to Nara, Graham, and Bill.

title: Hamm
content:
Graham: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
Graham: No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your shipments!
Graham: Look at these freeze dried jerkies—fresh from Rinascita to Huanglong. Kitties in Jinzhou love it!
Hamm: Huh? Isn't that a Hound? Why would a Hound be called "Kitty"?
Graham: Uh... well... that's not the point here!
Hamm: The point is, how can a Hound be called Kitty? Kitty is clearly a name for a cat—it must be a misdelivery.
Nara: Right! This goes against common sense. Is Lollo Logistics really reliable?
Bill: Exactly! By this logic, Lollo Logistics should be renamed to "Chichi Logistics."
Hamm: What do you mean?
Bill: See, the Lollo Logistics mascot is a hamster! Hamsters don't go "lo-lo-lo," they go "chi-chi-chi"!
Graham: Well... I can explain! Everyone, let me explain!
Graham: When a hamster's cheeks are full of food, it makes a "lo-lo" sound.
Graham: And do you see the deep pockets on our vests? They're super spacious, and super efficient!
Graham: No matter how oddly shaped the shipment, Lollo Logistics can "swallow it whole!"
Graham: So, in summary, if you need courier services, Lollo Logistics is the way to go!

title: Hanakage Underground Street
content: Hanakage Underground Street is an Area located in Chronorift Metropolis. It is accessible via Stranger Things in Honami.

title: Hanakage Underground Street
content:
Unlocked by finding all Missing Namipons in Namipon Case Files

Hanakage Underground Street was originally part of Honami's subway system, and was later repurposed into a cultural passage themed around contemporary art. Before the Lament, quarterly film festivals and exhibitions filled the streets with artworks from across Ashinohara. The gift shops sold unique souvenirs that could only be found in Honami.

title: Hanakage Underground Street
content: Of all its events, the annual "Honami Urban Legend Exhibition" always drew the largest crowds. Submissions ranged form amateur films by students to pieces by renowned photographers of the Pioneer Association. One anonymous short film went almost unnoticed at the time of its debut, but years later, it resurfaced in public debate. Countless interpretations sprang up, as tales in the film began to manifest in reality, one by one: "The Migrating Fish Windsocks," "The Wish-Granting Passageway," and "The Midnight Ghost Bus."

title: Harbinger
content: Harbingers of the Dark Tide are humans who are chosen by Leviathan into becoming their agent to summon forth Tacet Discords against the people of the land and spread its doctrine through force. Those chosen become corrupted and lose their identities as they become puppets to continue spreading Leviathan's influence until they perish.

title: Harbinger
content: Humans selected by the Threnodian Leviathan to spread its doctrine, and sow sorrow and despair among the masses. Influence appears to be a key factor in their selection. Marked by the Dark Tide's corruption, they wield fragments of Leviathan's power, such as summoning Its creations.

title: Harbinger
content: Chosen by Leviathan, humans selected as the Dark Tide's Harbinger are those who summon the Tidespawn or any other manner of Tacet Discord from the Dark Tide itself through usage of Leviathan's power. Doing so allows Leviathan to spread its influence while also gathering "sustenance" from the emotions caused and created by the Harbinger themself. Once chosen, the target will find themselves marked in some manner which identifies their corruption. While this gives them influence and command over the Dark Tide's creations, in turn they slowly find themselves condemned to wander the Dark Tide's illusions as they become Leviathan's puppet. Unable to distinguish between dreams and reality, combined with memory loss over their own actions, Harbingers mistake the living for monsters and may even strike down those close to them and creating misjustice.

title: Harbinger
content: While not impossible for a Harbinger to resist the power and influence of their status, unless one can defeat Leviathan, the only known method to escape being a Harbinger is to sacrifice one's own life. This is primarily due to the fact that the corruption itself cannot be removed, only resisted.

title: Harbinger
content:
Whenever a Harbinger is chosen, certain factors are picked to aid in spreading Leviathan's "gospel". While the majority of the qualifications are unknown, the two known factors would be their status and influence.
Harbingers of the Dark Tide must be an Anchor of Reality for all Tidespawn, meaning they must be a living person.
The second, if more preferable, is that Harbingers must be well-known and have a wide influence on the masses. Whether their reputation is positive or negative doesn't matter as long as numerous people among Rinascita are aware of them.

title: Harbinger
content: Harbingers of the Dark Tide are known to wield fragments of Leviathan's powers, which in turns allow them to summon their creations. Fenrico, a Harbinger of the Dark Tide, could use the power of Leviathan to call forth Tacet Discords to attack his enemies through his command over them and any other Dark Tide Creations. It could also be used to read others memories, such as when Fenrico used what remaining connection he had with the Dark Tide to read Qiuyuan past.

title: Harbinger
content: A Harbinger's status also allows them to resonates with Rinasicta's darkest emotions. Using those emotions as an Anchor, these ties allow the Harbinger to spawn forth the Tidespawn into existence. The stronger these emotions are, the Harbinger's thoughts and memories could be used as a basis to quicken their evolution while also granting them forms they recall. This could potentially allow Tacet Discord of different regions to spawn forth in Rinascita depending on the chosen Harbinger. Though this ability can be passive and does not need the conscious action of the Harbinger for Tidespawn to be born. Rover, an unwitting agent of Leviathan without knowledge of their status, brought forth numerous Tidespawn until they began suppressing their Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface upon being aware what they were.

title: Hector
content:
Hector is an NPC in Ragunna, Rinascita.

During the daytime, he can be seen preparing to ship spices to Septimont. At night, he talks to his aunt, Joanne about his free time in the Septimont.

title: Hector
content:
Hector: Checking the cargo... getting the paperwork ready... and I still need to send off those Acolytes later. Tsk, I should have asked the family for more help.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you getting ready to set sail?
Hector: Yes, we're shipping a large batch of spices to Septimont. Everyone's been super busy lately.
[Dialogue Option]  Septimont?
Hector: Haven't been there? The arena events there are amazing with all those Echo gladiators! I'll definitely sneak out to watch a few matches when we arrive.

title: Hector
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Joanne: Hector, I'll grant you two days of free time in the Septimont.
Joanne: Return to Ragunna on time in two days and report to me at the bank.
Hector: Aunt Joanne... you're drilling this into my ears...
Joanne: That's not how you address me! Mr. Hector.
Hector: Yes, ma'am... Lady Joanne.
Joanne: Before we set sail, you swore to Imperator.
Hector: Hail Imperator. I, Hector, swear I'll never again bet on gladiator fights in the Septimont's underground casinos—
Hector: Or let me perish at sea, never to return home!
Joanne: If you're going to perish, fine. But don't drag down your colleagues or the cargo; they've done nothing wrong.
Joanne: You can watch matches, but if I find you at the betting tables again—",
Hector: —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
Joanne: I promised your mother I'd take care of you. Don't make her shed any more tears.

title: Heliodic Six
content: The Solsworn is the term for a future successor of the Heliodic Six. Each Heliodic six member has a chosen successor from the Roya Tribe. Yngvar, despite his derelict of duty and his disinterest of succeeding The Eye as  he was chosen as her replacement which made his qualification often being questioned by other Roya tribesmen; however he was chosen nonetheless because of resonance abilities. Sigrika is also one of the Heliodic Six successors, although it remains unconfirmed which member she is succeeding, based on "Lahai-Roi Special Cinematics | Farwatchers" it is speculated to be The Shaper.

title: Heliogyre
content:
The Roya tribe uses the lens "Heliogyre," a relic gifted by the Exostrider, to observe the Exostrider's Drive, calculate its trajectory, predict the onset of Void Storm, and provide critical data for the Spacetreck Collective's New Solar Project.

It lies within the Solisylum and is deciphered by six chosen Royan's called the Heliodic Six.

After the event of , a single Foreseer takes on the burden of calculating the Heliogyre, as the other five members are no longer able too.

title: Heliogyre
content:
The Heliogyre is the Exostrider's lens, given to the Roya Tribe in an effort to guide them in avoiding the reoccurring Void Storms that plague Lahai-Roi. The device capable of allowing one to see the future, with the information shared to prevent others being consumed by the Void Sotrms when possible. The Shaper states that only those born with a certain Resonance Ability can be chosen, and none can be forced to link and interpret the Heliogyre.

The Heliodic Six share their computational powers when using the Heliogye, weaving a vast network to reach the Exostrider in a dimension beyond mortal understanding. Six people are usually required - but one is also possible- if with a cost. if no one calculates then even if the Heliogyre Drive rotates, no one can interpret the readings. This would cause Void Storm occurrences to be unknown where life once more will fall into peril.

title: Heliogyre
content: Though one weakness is that it cannot predict the occurrences of artificial Void Storms created by Warren, which was used to infect the Heliogyre Drive for a time and corrupting five of the six Heliodic Six members as they were linked to the machine. Though through the Soliskin, the corruption was undone while the five members appear to be recovering, if slowly.

title: Hiyuki
Hiyuki
content: Hiyuki's Chinese and Japanese name 緋雪 means "scarlet snow".

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
content: Hiyuki is a calm, elegant, and dignified woman whose gentle nature lies beneath an exceptionally composed exterior. As the Miko of Flaming Sakura, she carries herself with the quiet authority and grace expected of someone who has spent a very long time bearing an important responsibility. She rarely allows her emotions to overwhelm her, even when confronted with danger, loss, or difficult decisions, and tends to speak and act with deliberate restraint. However, her composure should not be mistaken for coldness or indifference. Hiyuki is deeply compassionate and empathetic, genuinely caring about the people around her and showing her affection more through her actions than through openly emotional displays. She is strongly duty-driven and possesses an unwavering sense of responsibility, willingly placing the protection of others and the preservation of what she has sworn to defend above her own personal desires. This devotion also gives her a self-sacrificing side, as she is willing to endure hardship and loneliness without complaining if she believes doing so is necessary. Beneath her serene and almost untouchable demeanor, however, Hiyuki carries considerable emotional weight. There is a melancholic and introspective quality to her, as though the long years of responsibility, loss, and the passage of time have left wounds that she rarely allows others to see. She can therefore come across as distant at first, but those who earn her trust are likely to discover someone remarkably warm, considerate, and quietly affectionate. Hiyuki is also strong-willed and determined; once she has accepted something as her responsibility, she does not easily abandon it. Overall, she is a sophisticated combination of serenity, compassion, strength, loyalty, and hidden loneliness—a woman who maintains an almost flawless sense of composure while carrying burdens that she would rather bear herself than place upon someone else.

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
content:
Hiyuki is shown to be a tall albino woman with fair skin, long white hair and eyelashes, and vibrant red eyes. She has two distinct beauty marks, a small one under her left eye and a larger one on her right shoulder.

Her Tacet Mark is located on the outer side of her upper right thigh.

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
content: Hiyuki’s clothing in Wuthering Waves is a refined, shrine-maiden-inspired combat outfit dominated by white, crimson red, black, and touches of gold and silver. Her upper body is covered by a predominantly white, off-the-shoulder kimono-style garment with broad, flowing sleeves and layered fabric, while darker black edging and panels provide contrast around the collar, torso, and waist. The sleeves are loose and elegant, with long white fabric extending outward and decorated with red markings, cords, and tassels, giving the outfit considerable movement. Around her waist she wears a structured black tactical-style obi and belt assembly, consisting of overlapping black fabric, leather-like straps, buckles, pouches, and metallic fittings, with small golden ornaments and floral decorations attached to it. Beneath this, her long pleated lower garment is predominantly deep crimson red, extending almost to the ground like a hakama or kimono skirt, with darker red and black sections creating layered vertical folds; white and grey-blue decorative panels appear along portions of the skirt, accompanied by small gold motifs. Her footwear is largely concealed by the long garment but incorporates dark, traditional-inspired sandals with black and grey elements and elevated soles. Her accessories reinforce the miko aesthetic: her long silver-white hair is arranged in an elaborate high style and decorated with red ribbons and ornamental pieces, while additional cords and tassels hang from her clothing. Overall, the combination of pristine white, vivid crimson, restrained black, and delicate gold/silver accents gives Hiyuki an appearance that combines traditional Japanese shrine-maiden imagery with a distinctly battle-ready Wuthering Waves aesthetic.

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
Hiyuki/Backstory
content:
saw their usually dignified and poised Miko of Flaming Sakura acting like this behind closed doors...  The second hand ticked. The minute hand followed. At last, the hour hand lurched forward. By Ashinohara time, this very moment marked Hiyuki's transition into adulthood. She sighed and downed the drink in one burning gulp.  "You managed. You think I cannot?"  The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame. So this was what they called the "drink of adulthood." Its taste, she decided, was hardly worth the wait. Hiyuki stood and draped a blanket over Gyokuro's muttering form. She lingered in the corner for a long moment. At last, she stepped forward, tucked the edges tight, and closed the door softly behind her.  The next morning, Gyokuro's fury toward the steward tasked with the Legacy Talisman's succession rang out loud enough to be heard two streets away.  The Suzu's power lay in "drawing upon the future." In simple terms, it meant every use exacted a toll from the bearer's remaining lifespan. In the worst case, it meant a successor who inherited the bell today might vanish into nothingness in their very first battle against a Threnodian. Because the price was so high, successors were usually chosen early. Hiyuki had stayed at Gyokuro's side for more than a decade. Even if Gyokuro refused to name her... who else could possibly be chosen?  The steward, unable to handle Gyokuro's temper, could only offer a strained, placating smile. "Even if not Hiyuki, surely you must name someone, Lady Miko."  Gyokuro fell silent for a few breaths. She sighed, cleared her throat, and prepared to resume her tirade.  It was Hiyuki who finally opened the door, ending the farce.  "For years, I have journeyed with you through Ashinohara. I know what each duty demands." "I have mastered every art a miko must know. The weaving of charms, the ceremonial dances—all from teachers of your own choosing." "Only I can ensure the name of the Flaming Sakura remains untarnished, Gyokuro... No. Lady Miko."  Gyokuro's brow furrowed. She waved a hand dismissively.  "You've learned it all, have you? Then don't you realize the Suzu will be the death of you?" "I was an orphan you took in. My family lies buried beneath the snow from that Threnodian attack. I have no attachments left."  The room fell suffocatingly quiet. The only sound was the raspy, obsessive scrape of Gyokuro's thumb as she rubbed the bell on her wrist. She tried to speak, but in the end, no words came.

|title2   = There Will Never Be Another...
|text2    = The days following Hiyuki's succession were inevitably frantic. Where once she had simply walked in Gyokuro's shadow, she now found the weight of every duty resting on her own shoulders.   had long suffered under the  shadow, forcing the land to weave its very survival around the mikos. As the bearer of the Suzu, Hiyuki's status was as uniquely sacred as it was heavy, and her jurisdiction covered the entirety of Ashinohara. She became a nomad of necessity, racing between different places to assist the local mikos and turn the tides of battle.  Yet a miko was as much a living symbol as a blade. Wherever people would gather, a miko must appear to remind them why they fought. The Miko of Flaming Sakura was no exception. Hiyuki carried both burdens well. Perhaps it was because she had learned each duty at Gyokuro's side since childhood, combat and ceremony alike had long since become second nature. The only thing missing was Gyokuro's specific Flaming Sakura swordsmanship. Gyokuro had stubbornly refused to pass down the forms, even going so far as to distance herself from Hiyuki.  "Fine. If you will not teach me, I will learn in secret. One day, I will master it. One day."  But that day never came.  "The Suzu allows the bearer to draw upon the future, and a successor who inherits the Suzu today might vanish into nothingness during their very first battle with a Threnodian..."  Hiyuki couldn't remember the words the steward whispered when placing the Suzu in her hands. She couldn't remember the clumsy way she tied it to her wrist, mimicking a gesture she had seen so many times. She couldn't recall the weather that day, or the face of the person who handed her the small wooden box containing Gyokuro's legacy.  By the time the world rushed back into focus, she was sitting alone in the hollowed halls of the seat of Flaming Sakura, clutching the wish slip that had been inside the box.  Blood froze in her chest. A creeping frost left her fingertips numb. Inch by inch, Hiyuki dragged herself to that familiar corner of the room and curled up. She had crumpled the wish slip earlier. Now she smoothed it flat.  "...I see." "...I accept your wish." "...There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura."
|mention2 = Gyokuro

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
content:
|mention2 = Gyokuro



|title3   = Snowed In
|text3    = "Lady Hiyuki, you have served as the Miko of Flaming Sakura for a century now. If we are to renew the contract..." "It is of no consequence." "Then, as per our previous arrangement... for how many years shall we set the renewal?" "Fill it as you wish." "I did not expect you to be quite so like the previous Miko... Ahem. Very well. As you wish, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura."  The steward bowed and withdrew, closing the door with practiced reverence. Hiyuki noted that the staff accompanying him had changed three times over the decades. She shook her head, eyes narrowing as they fell upon the envelope on her desk. After a pause, she reached instead for a teacup that had long since gone cold.  "Just like the previous Miko... am I?"  How long had it actually been since she took up the title? Long enough that "Hiyuki" was now a fixed entry in  history books. Was it a long time? Not long enough.  True to the fortune lot she had inherited that year, Hiyuki had used her own strength to prove a silent vow: There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. Gradually, the voices urging her to select a successor had faded. The Office of Legacy Talismans now treated its visits to the shrine as a mere formality. Even the steward, she suspected, believed a successor unnecessary. To them, Hiyuki had become the title itself.  Yet Hiyuki often heard a voice. It wasn't the grating, persistent lure of the Fractsidus. It was a peaceful murmur stating facts plainly in her ear.  "Hiyuki, you have held on for so long. But your enemy, the , has a far longer lifespan. It will wait until you die, until every miko, and every successor of every miko, has passed into memory." "Does this path of resistance truly have an end?"  Cold tea is always the most bitter. The over-steeped acridity clung to her tongue, making each breath feel heavy. Hiyuki tapped a finger against the envelope on the desk. Instantly, a layer of frost raced across its surface. With one more light touch, the unopened Fractsidus seal shattered into crystalline dust.  Hiyuki rose and called out to the child who had volunteered to help clean the shrine, reminding her to stay vigilant and watch for intruders while she was away. Her lips curled into a smile as she ruffled the girl's hair and pressed a protective charm into her small palm.  "Lady Miko, where are you going to help this time?" "Honami. I will be back soon. Keep this charm with you during this time, all right?"  Hiyuki waved goodbye to the little girl. As she turned to leave, the bell on her wrist caught the light, shining as brilliantly as ever.
|mention3 = Gyokuro

title: Hiyuki/Backstory
content:
|mention3 = Gyokuro



|title4   = Vanished Honami
|text4    = The people of  had long grown accustomed to the distortions wrought by the . Survival was a matter of routine: seek shelter, wait for the local miko to deploy, and if the situation spiraled, wait for the recovery teams and the Miko of Flaming Sakura to arrive.  To Hiyuki, this felt like just another fight among thousands. She cut through the monsters with practiced efficiency, checking the integrity of the barrier as she always did. As the civilians emerged from the shelters, parents pointed her out to their children with reverent relief. "Look, that's Lady Miko of Flaming Sakura."  Hiyuki offered a slight nod in response. She stepped over a fallen "No Entry" sign and turned back toward the barrier to finish her sweep.  Focus. Strike. Sheathe... Hm?  The blade passed through the air as it always did. Yet something was different. Subtle, but unmistakable.  Hiyuki reexamined the entire barrier. Everything appeared intact, yet a lingering, visceral wrongness clung to her fingertips. She released her hilt. Flexed her wrist. Pressed her fingers together—  A single drop of iridescent black mire welled from her skin. It pooled in the creases of her palm before dripping to the ground, spreading silently beneath her feet.  Hiyuki drew her blade. Frost snapped into existence around her. First, contain it. Evacuate the civilians. Then find a way to—  She turned, but the cry died in her throat. There was nothing before her. It was as if the air itself vanished. For one frozen moment, Hiyuki could not breathe.  Honami was gone.  Aside from the shattered sign at her feet and a trace of mud creeping up the hem of her dress, there was nothing left.  Hiyuki reached out, but her hand recoiled on its own. She gasped for breath, but there was no oxygen. It was as if the atmosphere itself had been erased from existence. She raised her blade to strike, but found no enemy to sever. Only a faint, residual frequency remained, proof that the Threnodian had acted, for a fraction of a second, with power never before recorded.  According to Ashinohara's records, Honami had been pulled into another dimension at that moment. Even after a desperate appeal to the  for their most advanced tracking technology, not a single trace could be found.  When the others finally led Hiyuki away, she was still mindlessly rubbing the bell on her wrist, her mind trapped in that moment of shock.  Was this silent disaster her fault? Of course it was her fault. As the Miko of Flaming Sakura, she had failed to protect Honami. And of course, it was not her fault. Against the power of a Threnodian, a single person didn't matter—even one who could draw a million futures to safeguard the present.  Hiyuki returned to the Flaming Sakura. She took the protective charm from the child at the gate, forcing a ghost of a smile. Then she walked slowly to her room and pushed open the door. There, sitting quietly on her desk, was the envelope she had destroyed.  "Hiyuki, oh Hiyuki... Does this path truly have an end?"

title: Honami Central Park
content:
Unlocked by finding all Missing Namipons in Namipon Case Files

Contrary to popular memory, the park around Neon Tower predates the tower itself. In fact, Neon Tower was sited here precisely because the park's open grounds would minimise radio intereference. After the tower's completion, the original Honami City Park was expanded into Honami Central Park, a proud symbol of the city centre. At the time, it also stood as the largest park in all of Ashinohara.

Its first urban legend came shortly after staff began hanging fish windsocks. One morning, they discovered that every windsock, once scattered across the park, had gathered above the innermost garden. Not long after, the Pioneer Association published a grainy, shocking video captured by a citizen staying late there one night: under the moonlight, many windsocks glided through the sky toward a single spot, as if they were alive...

title: Hongzhen
content: An ancient, secluded town nestled within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure snow, create a scene of serene beauty.  For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.

title: House Silva
content:
House Silva is one of the founding bloodlines of Septimont and a once prominent noble family, though their influence began waver with the rise of the new Ephor.

During the most recent Great Agon the household and their head, Julia Silva, take part in match fixing and go as far as to sabotage Lupa's equipment in the semi-final match after she leaves the household's gladiator team. After their sabotage is brought to Ephor Augusta and confirmed by Priestess Iuno they are banished from Septimont.

The house sponsored the gladiator team "Bough of Legions", which previously consisted of Lupa and Emilio prior to Lupa leaving.

title: Hsin's Fortuity

Hsin's Fortuity is an event-exclusive point of interest located in Taoyuan Vale, Central Plains, Huanglong during the By Moon's Grace event.

Players can visit every day during the event for prizes.

title: Hsin's Fortuity
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Xianchen: Hello, Rover. Have you ever heard the tale of the Fox and the Wheel?
[Dialogue Option]  Doesn't ring a bell to me.
[Dialogue Option]  The Fox?
Xianchen: The Fox is one of the Sentinels in Huanglong. People often call it "Hsin."
Xianchen: Like our Sentinel "Jue," Hsin has its own state to protect.
Xianchen: But Hsin loves to join in the celebrations with its people.
Xianchen: It's said that if you hear the leaves rustling, it must be Hsin wandering in the woods. Sometimes, it even leaves behind small, whimsical gifts, like this lottery wheel here.
Xianchen: People consider this a good omen, as the sound of the spinning wheel mimics the rustling leaves in the tale.
[Dialogue Option]  So that's the story...
[Dialogue Option]  Well, sounds a bit exaggerated.
Xianchen: True or not, people love blessings. It doesn't matter if it makes sense, it's part of the local culture's charm.
