content:
Pan Cake is the Fae Ignis that appears in Brant Companion Story: Sail Day, Captain!
There is another Kasper from Septimont

title: Kastelton
content:
' is a young Roya man who almost became an Outcast, not knowing the severity of the crimes they commit.

He can be found being scolded by former Outcast, Quinones at a camp near Etching Plains Resonance Beacon.

title: Kastelton
content:
Kastelton: I didn't know the Outcasts would do something that awful... If I'd known sooner, I—
Quinones: Well, what were you expecting?
Kastelton: I just wanted to see what the world outside Lahai-Roi looks like. I even tried applying for Startorch Academy, which turned out to be nothing...
Kastelton: My mind went blank and I... stole my sister's staff, thinking I could prove myself and join those Outcasts who all look so free.
Kastelton: But I never thought they'd actually go rob people... or even try to hurt the Exoswarm!
Quinones: You really are an idiot, you know that? Stealing from your own family to prove what, exactly? Go home. And don't ever come back.
Quinones: We're not the ones you think that can get you out of Lahai-Roi. And the Outcasts sure aren't either. I suggest you go home before they come after your Exoswarm.

title: Katvia
content:
' is a female NPC employee for the Averado Bank stationed in Septimont, . She can be found next to Raechyl and a Common Echo Mercurio.
__NOTOC__

title: Katvia
content: Location Raechyl Shop.png|Located near by Averardo Bank Counter

title: Katvia
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Galby: I want to deposit this!
Katvia: Seriously...? We can't do that!

title: Katvia
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Galby: I want to deposit this. Katvia, deposit this for me!
Katvia: All this meat...? This is a bank, not a meat locker!

title: Katvia
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Katvia: What on earth is going on... What  did we do wrong?
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Katvia: Sigh... The Averardo Vault is opening a branch in Septimont, but it hasn't been going too well for us.
Katvia: Everyone feels safe depositing their money with us, and they're happy to do business...
Katvia: ...but some people want to store weird stuff, like fighting gear, poetry collections, random sculptures...
Katvia: Someone even brought a bunch of meat here! I just... Why on earth would they do that?

title: Kepler
subsection: (During the quest Legacy of the Lasting Night)
content:
[Objective: (During the quest Legacy of the Lasting Night)]
Kelper: Rest in peace...
Kelper: You will not be forgotten.
Kelper: Travel among the stars... Enzo, navigator of Rinascita.
Kelper: We will see this through, and the Shorekeeper will guide us to rise once more.
Kelper: Rest easy, my friend.

title: Kepler
subsection: (Kepler can no longer be interacted with, but the Recording Machine next to him can)
content:
[Objective: (Kepler can no longer be interacted with, but the Recording Machine next to him can)]
Nessa's Last Message: "My dearest Kepler..."
Nessa's Last Message: "Did you know? If one chooses to plunge into the torrent of data, they choose to be disintegrated as bits of digits, becoming a dot in a boundless atlas of stars..."
Nessa's Last Message: "The discrete computational representation of me shall evolve and iterate with the Stellar Matrices of the billions of stars, until 'I' am present everywhere and yet nowhere to be found."
Nessa's Last Message: "After the end of the shifts, conversions, and merges, the odds for the fragments of 'me' to reintegrate into a new me, even for the split of femtosecond, are almost zero."
Nessa's Last Message: "Yet, should that infinitesimal chance arise, I would open my eyes as if newly born, seeing everything one last time before dissolving again into the ceaseless flow of stars."
Nessa's Last Message: "This journey of mine has no way back, but fear not, my love—whether it's in a distant afterlife or across the light years..."
Nessa's Last Message: "...I will always find you."
Nessa's Last Message: "Nessa, from Tethys' Deep."

title: Kilani
content: ' is a NPC male student from the Biomatic Club, found at night nearby the Solis Lens Array (Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus), talking to a professor, Tsugu.

title: Kilani
content:
Kilani: Sir, I always wondered, why do you help us so much? Advising the Biomatic Club, getting us funding...
Tsugu: Because I was once in your shoes! Being broke and fighting every other club on  campus... you learn there's nothing like having someone in your corner.
Tsugu: Besides, who hasn't been a student? Looking at you reminds me of myself!

title: Koko
content: Koko is a shop NPC in . She is the manager of Shifang Pharmacy.

title: Koko
content:
Koko: Greetings. Shifang Pharmacy here.
[Dialogue Option]  I want some medicines.
[Dialogue Option]  Gourmet Rumors
Koko: Even though it's called a broth, a lot of ingredients are added during the cooking process.
Koko: As far as I know, while the methods vary, the most common main ingredient is fowl.
Koko: I personally recommend adding more fowl, you know. It's nutritious, relatively low in fat, and good for your health.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Koko: *sigh* Medicinal dishes are even harder to make than I expected.
[Dialogue Option]  Something's bothering you?
Koko: Yeah, I've been trying to make better Caltrop Soup.
Koko: But it's tough finding the right mix of health benefits and flavor.
Koko: I might need to look for new ideas and adjust the recipe a bit.
[Dialogue Option]  Why all the effort?
Koko: "Good medicine tastes bitter", they say, but it's important to make it easier for patients to take.
Koko: That's why I focus on making medicinal dishes that taste delicious and are still effective in treating illnesses.
Koko: I once made some medicine pancakes with Lemongrass and Caltrop. They were a real hit!
[Dialogue Option]  That's impressive.
Koko: Hehe. Just doing what I'm supposed to do as the owner of a pharmacy!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Kossimus
content: Kossimus is a male researcher found at the Research Institute above Starward Riseway.

title: Kossimus
content:
Kossimus:  Whenever my mind hits a wall, I come stand here for a while.

Kossimus:  I once read that humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos.

[Dialogue Option]  Our place in the vast cosmos?

Kossimus:  Yes, our place. Like instinctively pulling up a map on your Terminal. Consciousness is always asking three big questions: Where did we start? Where are we now? And... just how far can we go?

Kossimus: That's where all science begins.

Kossimus: Hah.. But now that humanity's right to explore outer space has been taken from us, all we can do is literally "dig deeper."

[Dialogue Option]  What is your research about?

title: Kossimus
content:
[Dialogue Option]  What is your research about?



Kossimus:  My study focuses on the domain construction mechanisms of the Etheric Sea and its blockade effect on near-ground space flight.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds interesting.
Kossimus: Haha, you think? Are you... a student from Rabelle College? I'm counting on your generation to finally reach outer space. I'd love to be around to see it.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds really complicated...
Kossimus: Hehe. It's like trying to negotiate with an ocean that makes all the rules but follows none. Still, someone has to learn how to talk to it.

Kossimus:  Thank you for the conversation. Talking with the young always shakes the dust off my thoughts.

title: Kronablight
content:
. This enemy has a higher All-Attribute RES. This enemy has the Rage Feather ability and three weaknesses.

After remaining in combat for a period of time, Kronablight enters the Rage Feather state, greatly enhancing its ATK. Weakness I: A successful Counterattack can damage its crest and wings, weakening its attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles. Weakness II: Tune Break can remove its Rage Feather state and reduce its ranged projectiles. Special Weakness: When Kronablight is under Tune Rupture - Shifting, hitting it with Tune Break will greatly reduce its All-Attribute RES.

title: Kronablight
content: A powerful raptor-like Exoswarm, mimicking an ancient predator known as Kronaclaw. In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch. Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi. But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Kronapuff
content:
A native bird of Lahai-Roi, originated from the Kronaclaw, they are clumsy fliers and "bird brained". They once roamed the Roya Frostlands as a predator raptor until the First Epoch had reduced their numbers to near extinctions. With no predators and plenty of food, these former predators slowly changed to that of the current Kronapuff.

Few Kronaclaw roams the Roya Frostlands, with many of thier population replaced with an Exoswarms imitation.

Due to their very round anatomy, they cannot easily fly and are easy preyed. They are also used in cuisine for their fat meat, though, many Royan's have adopted them as pets.

title: Kumu
content: Kumu is an Exile Leader that can be found in Gubei Pass, Central Plains. He's one of the exiles who is not hostile to the player.

title: Kumu
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Kumu)]
Kumu: Shengying's not here again... Well, he's getting the hang of this!
[Dialogue Option]  What makes you say that?
Kumu: I mean he's grown up like a real fighter.
Kumu: I asked him to compete with the folks from Lollo Logistics before but I don't feel his determination in doing this.
Kumu: But he's into this now, always running around outside the camp.
Kumu: Well, he must have mastered his way. Got those couriers all tamed.
Kumu: But he didn't bring any supplies back with him...

title: Lady of the Sea
content: Lady of the Sea  is an Overlord Class Boss in Wuthering Waves that can be found in , and is unlocked after completing .

title: Lady of the Sea
content: against .  A fallen one adrift in the frigid currents, a ruptured remnant in which the Threnodian's residual energy resides.  She pierced her own heart and fell into the ocean. But fate, relentless as the whirlpools below, dragged her even deeper.  Now, her creator has claimed this failed vessel, lying in wait beneath the waves to devour the entire world.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Laliah
content:
Laliah: Hey, want a hug?
[Dialogue Option]  A hug?
Laliah: Yeah, a hug.
Laliah: Haha, don't take it the wrong way. For us Roya, a hug is a kind of greeting. It means warmth, care...
Laliah: Maybe it's because the frostlands are so bitterly cold that everyone's come to love hudddling together for warmth.
Laliah: So if you're ever lonely, tired, or down... come find me. I've got a hug for you.

title: Lampylumen Myriad
content: to . An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum. Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations. For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.|Description When Discovered}}

content:
Canduras: Have you ever heard the sound mushrooms make?
Lan: Huh? Mushroom sounds?
Canduras: And Lichen. And Snowfluff Seals...
Canduras: The Overtonic Society has a frequency extraction device that can capture their voices.
Canduras: The mushrooms make really sharp, high-pitched sounds, almost like they're screaming.

title: Lan Hsin
content:
' is a NPC female Huanglong tourist in Capitoline Hill City.
__NOTOC__

title: Lan Hsin
subsection: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...
content:
[Objective: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...]

Lan Hsin: Look. Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius... I've never seen such works before coming to Septimont.
Lan Hsin: I've noticed that a lot of art in Septimont depicts muscular people as the subject. There's a beauty inherent in the physical form.
Lan Hsin: Seeing these great works, I'm a bit moved... These paintings and sculptures sing praises to the glory of being human... It's truly beautiful.
Lan Hsin: Last time I saw a Gladiator's portrait called "Tiny Mirin." But unlike the name, he was painted to be towering and powerful.

metadata.subsection: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...

title: Lan Hsin
subsection: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...
content:
[Objective: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...]

Lan Hsin: I can't believe... Mirin's actually...
[Dialogue Option]  Actually what?
Lan Hsin: Oh... I saw a Gladiator's portrait called "Tiny Mirin." But unlike the name, he was painted to be towering and powerful.
Lan Hsin: Today, I met him and realized that he really is like his name.
Lan Hsin: He even said he wanted to promote himself as "small and super-agile," but to his surprise, the artist insisted on giving him muscles and making him buff. It ended up being the total opposite of what he intended...
Lan Hsin: Although, I can understand what these works are trying to convey... After all, in the arena, he really is a sight to behold! Truly the work of a genius...

title: Lan Hsin
subsection: Lan Hsin Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...

The Hanzi characters in her name translate to to Orchid Heart
The name Mirin has its roots in the Gaelic language, specifically deriving from the word "muirinn," which means "sea-born" or "of the sea."

Lane: No, wait! Docking my performance again? That's brutal! Ever since I came to Septimont, scoring an A has been completely out of reach!
Lane: Yeah, just a few hundred meters on paper, but getting to the Hilltop means taking the cable car and climbing forever! Who even makes these performance metrics?!
Lollo Logistics Terminal: Courier, please get yourself together! When facing challenges, we encourage self-reflection over complaints about the system!
Lane: Right, self-reflection... but how am I supposed to deliver this anyway? Turn into a merfolk and swim there?
[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
Lane: Oh, you must be Rover that Chief Advisor Ma mentioned, right? I can really use your help now. This bloody system seems to be acting up again.
Lane: Been asking every local in Septimont for hours. Turns out the address is in the Old District, which is flooded already. How exactly am I supposed to deliver there? Even if I could swim down, it's not like there's anyone waiting underwater for this package!
Rover: Can you find the recipient?
Lane: It's not really a person, just some company's official address. Let's see... The recipient is "New Federation Black Beach Virtual Resonance Chain Technology Leasing Corp, Ltd."
Lane: What a convoluted name. How does a New Federation company even end up registered in Septimont? Is it one of those shell companies?
[Dialogue Option]  How about you row over and check out those ruins on the water?
Lane: No thanks. I'm not getting in a boat in Rinascita. You know what happens to boats around here? They're cursed!
Rover: Cursed?
Lane: Haven't you heard? There was this white-haired merchant with this fancy new ship. Custom-built luxury job. Twin engines, wind-resistant, the whole "unsinkable" deal. First voyage near Rinascita? Boom. A giant whale comes out of nowhere and launches the thing into orbit.
Lane: Rumor has it that whale still won't come to the bargaining table. And since insurance won't touch international waters, the poor guy almost lost his shirt.
Rover: ...

title: Lanny
content: Lanny is a NPC that can be found at the fountain in Ragunna's City Square when players first arrive to Rinascita. After talking with Rover, he returns to work.

title: Lanny
content:
Lanny: O sacred waters... reveal to me the path of my destiny...
[Dialogue Option]  Is this where I can try water divination?
Lanny: Of course! Ah, you must be here for the famous "Arito Well," right? They say it's as ancient as the Rinascita Archipelagos themselves.
[Dialogue Option]  What's so interesting about this well water, anyway?
Lanny: Oh, there's more to it than meets the eye. They say it's as ancient as the Rinascita Archipelagos themselves.
Lanny: The well was once blessed by the Sentinel. Back when Ragunna City was founded, people used to get their fresh water from it. There are also legends that say the well is bottomless, which connects to the depths of the ocean...
Lanny: Although Ragunna's freshwater woes are a thing of the past, the well's power wasn't withdrawn by the Sentinel.
Lanny: People still visit to honor the Sentinel, and over time, Ragunnans discovered another of its mystical powers—
Lanny: Toss in a Monnaie, and ask a question with a sincere heart, and you will get the answer that you need: be it the telling of your future of the truth of your past you seek.
Lanny: But bear this in mind—never use the well to pry into forbidden matters. Someone did this once and the well's waters turned black as night, flooding all of Ragunna's streets!
Lanny: Thus was the sea's retribution against humanity for defiling the sacred waters-Oh, my Sentinel, I must refrain from such emotions. Must keep a peaceful mind...
Lanny: O sacred waters, tell me—will today be a good day for a little slacking off at work?
(Ding-a-ling... Lanny's terminal suddenly rings.)
Lanny: Oh no, it's my boss! Looks like they caught on to me sneaking out of the shop! Maybe today really isn't a good day to slack off...
Lanny: Arito Well, isn't it amazing? Haha...

title: Lanny
content:
Lanny: Sacred water... please listen to my confession...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you here for a divination again today?
[Dialogue Option]  Slacking off again today?
Lanny: Shh... I didn't come here for fortune-telling. After that day, I had an epiphany from that brief experience with water divination...
Lanny: If water divination is so accurate, revealing all uncertainties and leading them to definite outcomes...
Lanny: Then, as long as I don't divine, I'll exist in a superposition of getting caught slacking and not getting caught... My fate, will be forever undetermined...
[Dialogue Option]  Divination reveals your fate. You cannot change it.
[Dialogue Option]  I think you might have a point.
Lanny: Oh, taking a little lazy break never hurt anyone!
Lanny: If you wish to perform water divination, simply toss a Monaie into the sacred well and silently ask your question with a devout heart.
Lanny: They say good things will happen if you come for divination daily. Perhaps this is also a form of blessing for the pious from the Sentinel.

title: Lawless Zone
content:
The Lawless Zone is a location on the outskirts of New Federation society. Due to the class politics of the country, those ostracised by society, including Exiles, were blocked from finding legitimate work and resorted to building camps in the lands that would come to bear the name of the Lawless Zone. After forming gangs, the government waged war on the inhabitants of the zone to bring it under control until the war was ended by Calcharo's Ghost Hounds, a mercenary group, who annexed the final gang.

While still populated by the underclass, the zone is still not a safe place to live in and now serves as a source of mercenaries both for the schemes of the New Federation government and those acting outside the state apparatus such as the Fractsidus.

title: Left Behind
content: A Left Behind refers to any citizen of Honami City who died during The Lament and "lives" inside the Sonoro Sphere in the form of a Human Reverberation.

title: Left Behind
content:
Left Behinds are reverberations re-living their last moments before the Lament struck what was left of Honami City. Their existence is maintained by the Sonoro Sphere, alongside their lingering regrets and unfulfilled wishes. While there are those who are aware of the situation who do not fade away, there are those who realize the contradictions in their memories and pass on. It is uncertain if by will or not.

Due to an interference in the Somnoire, it's revealed that the Left Behind's are capable of dreaming, which are called "Lost Dreams".

There are those with regrets that runs too deep to help move on, which concentrates the Lament's power which poses a risk. The Black Shores would inquire the help of the Miko from the former Honami City to help cleanse their regrets away.

content: Lenore is an NPC in . She was the dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive. After completing , she can be seen around the Order of the Deep. Later, after completing , she can be found on the outer walls of Septimont for a one-time conversation.

title: Lenore
content:
Lenore: Mr. Rover! What a surprise to see you again so soon!
Rover: Is this little pavilion the Minor Forbidden Archive?
Lenore: Haha, you always have such a way with words. The Minor Forbidden Archive is underground, you won't see views like this down there. No, I'm actually at the Tidal Sanctuary to finalize my transfer.
Rover: You're leaving the Minor Forbidden Archive?
Lenore: Yes... well...
Lenore: Mr. Rover, I owe you an apology for how I acted that day... I was stubborn.
Lenore: Rinascita's civilization was planted by our ancestors, and the Order is just one of its many fruits. I shouldn't have been frightened by the ancient music; I shouldv' been delighted!
Lenore: In that moment, I felt the spirit of my ancestors resonate within me, didn't I?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm glad you've found some peace within yourself.
Lenore: Hehe...
[Dialogue Option]  Do the Tenets permit you to speak so freely?
Lenore: Of course it's... Ahem! Mr. Rover, let's keep this conversation our little secret!
Rover: Where are you going next?
Lenore: Maybe I'll go find Phoebe. She hasn't visited in some time, and I wonder what she's busy with.
Lenore: Or perhaps I should go further... to the Montelli vault, or even to Septimont? Hmm, I suppose I wouldn't need to wear my uniform...
Lenore: Mr. Rover, do you have any suggestions?
[Dialogue Option]  I say you should go wherever you like.
[Dialogue Option]  I say you should meet the people you want to meet.
Lenore: Ah, I aspire to have your confidence one day!
Lenore: "True faith is born from the heart, and Sentinel's guidance speaks through my voice." From the bottom of my heart, I thank you for your help, Mr. Rover.
Rover: Which chapter of the Tenets is that from?
Lenore: Hahaha! I said that. I am quoting myself!

title: Liang Dongyuan
content:
Liang Dongyuan , also known as Grandmaster Liang, is a deceased, mentioned only NPC who is first mentioned in . He was a member of the Internal Security Agency in Huanglong.

At some point, he was murdered by the Grand Architect, who impersonated him and used his identity to gain political influence in the Mingting Censorate. He eventually sent Qiuyuan to murder Geshu Lin on the pretense that he had colluded with Tacet Discords. Qiuyuan would refuse after seeing Geshu Lin protect a home from a Tacet Discord pack, refusing to follow through with the order. In retaliation, the Grand Architect killed "himself" in Dongyuan's form and framed Qiuyuan for the murder, forcing him to go on the run for the past five years.

title: Lilyland
content:
Lilyland is an independent city-state of the nation of Rinascita. Like Ragunna and Septimont, it is made out of islands deep in the Stormy Sea and shares their common history, being settled by ocean wanderers who came to the Rinascitan archipelago under the guidance and protection of the Sentinel Imperator.

Lilyland is known for hosting the "Lilyland Fashion Week" and having a large stage surrounded by fields of flowers, with the audience throwing petals as applause. The beauty industry in general is important in Lilyland, with products such as Upala Perfume and Efreeta Hair Conditioner, and Huanglong's rising fashion star Linglong has presented work at the fashion week.

According to one of the movies Lucilla asks you to recommend for her in the Startorch Academy Anecdotes, Lilyland have functioning train lines.

title: Lilyland
content:
According to one of the movies Lucilla asks you to recommend for her in the Startorch Academy Anecdotes, Lilyland have functioning train lines.



The Fisher family is highly important in Lilyland, akin to the Montellis or Fisalias of Ragunna. They have commercial and legal ties with the Montellis, and run the largest art museum in the city-state. They also run a Shopping Festival.

The Troupe of Fools often visits it and refers to Lilyland as a "Sea of Flowers". Recently, during their tour, Aalto and Brant apprehended ticket scalpers in what the Pioneer Podcast dubbed the "Lilyland Incident".

Dr. Scott Rabelle left his home country, the New Federation, to settle in Lilyland later in his life.
Denia's Startorch Academy ID contains a possibly false address in Lilyland, the Happy Family Dessert Shop.

title: Lilyland
content: Lilyland is probably named after the city of Florence, given it is nicknamed "la città gigliata" (the Lily town). It is also worth noting that Italy's national flower is the white lily, also known as the Madonna lily (Lilium candidum), which symbolizes purity and virtue. It is deeply rooted in Italian heritage and often associated with the Virgin Mary.

title: Lingfang
Lingfang
content: Lingfang grew up with her father, who served in Mengzhou's Ministry of War and taught her how to fight from when she was young until she grew bored of it after a few years and ran away to study music. She was childhood friends with Ruoyun, and attended the Waking Moon festival with Qingxiao and Ruoyun before the Fortress and Gorges War. During her years wandering, she met a painter who loved to paint Xuanling Birds. The two eventually became married and had a daughter together and lived happily until her husband was killed by Tacet Discords. Following the death of her husband, Lingfang sold her , swearing to get revenge for her husband, and took up the sword once again to fight as a soldier in the Fortress and Gorges War.

title: Lingfang
content: During the war, Lingfang and her comrades fell in battle, and Muyu trapped their reverberations, forcing them under his control and rendering them unable to pass on. Lingfang and her comrades remained trapped under Muyu's control until roughly 200 years later when Yangyang uses the Song of Xuanling to free them.

title: Lingyang/Voicelines
Linsu
content:
She is the fourth and current owner of Bogu's Arbor, a penjing shop. Verina and Rongqing help her with the store.

She is the mother of Linling.

title: Linsu
content:
Linsu: Welcome to Bogu's Arbor. Take your time to look around.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Linsu: Hello dear, come choose a penjing (bonsai) for yourself. Not only do they add a touch of green to your space, but they also freshen up the air!
Linsu: Don't worry, even if you're not buying anything, I'm always happy to have company.
[Dialogue Option]  About the Arbor
Linsu: This penjing shop? It's been around for ages. I'm actually the fourth owner.
Linsu: My daughter Linling, well, she's got her own dreams and doesn't seem to be interested in taking over the shop.
Linsu: Let her be. I'm still feeling fine. I'm still going strong. As long as I can keep moving around, this shop won't close.
[Dialogue Option]  About Ronqing
Linsu: Rongqing? Oh, he's been a regular at my shop since before he started helping out here.
Linsu: He's studying penjing design and thought interning here would be a good fit.
Linsu: I agreed because I could tell by the way he looked at the penjings.... Such passion and sincerity in his eyes.
Linsu: It's great to see that kind of dedication. Though, he does tend to go a bit overboard with decorations sometimes. Miniature models, amber pebbles... you name it.
Linsu: But aiming for perfection isn't a bad thing. Hopefully, he'll refine his style as he learns more about penjing design.
[Dialogue Option]  About Verina
Linsu: Little Verina? She is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
Linsu: She has been a great help. She knows a lot about everything plant-related.
Linsu: All her penjings are something else! So vibrant and enchanting.
Linsu: If only she were my granddaughter...
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Linsu
content: Penjing, also known as penzai, is the ancient Chinese art of depicting artistically formed trees, other plants, and landscapes in miniature. It is the similar practice of Bonsai, but aims for a more natural and landscape sense in design.

title: Liuqin
content: Liuqin is a researcher of medicines working at Huaxu Academy in . He is the brother of Koko.

title: Liuqin
content:
[Objective: (First time meeting)]
Liuqin: Should I join Mr. Mortefi's project? ...Koko, would you support my decision?
Liuqin: Ah, you must be the Rover. What can I do for you?
[Dialogue Option] : Mortefi's project?
Liuqin: Koko is my little sister, and she's currently the acting manager of Shifang Pharmacy.
Liuqin: Yesterday, Mr. Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
Liuqin: But joining would mean spending even less time with Koko.
[Dialogue Option] : Why is this project so appealing to you?
Liuqin: I don't want to pass up this chance. It's more than just a project. Being able to working alongside Mr. Mortefi is an honor itself.
Liuqin: He's probably the most respected researcher here, just behind our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
Liuqin: He's great at fending off unreasonable client demands. He rejected over 40 of them in his first week alone!
Liuqin: He even treats us to afternoon tea. He really looks out for us.
[Dialogue Option] : Who's more talented than this Mortefi?
Liuqin: Mortefi's been trying to outdo him in research, but it's not easy. Xiangli is just... built different.
Liuqin: About Mr. Xiangli... You'll see what I mean when you meet him.

title: Liuqin
content:
[Objective: (Outdoor 6PM-12AM)]
Liuqin: Hmm... the medicine seems to be working better this time.
[Dialogue Option] : Is he sick?
Liuqin: Yes, this is my patient, Niu. He's got a strange illness, and the usual meds don't work on him.
Liuqin: So I decided to try a new medicine, hoping it'll do the trick.

title: Liuqin
content:
[Objective: (Indoor 1AM-9AM)]
Liuqin: Rover, is that you? You're still up at this hour?
Liuqin: You gotta get more sleep, or you'll end up like us, unable to sleep even when you want to.
[Dialogue Option] : Have you been busy lately?
Liuqin: We're pretty much always busy.
Liuqin: You know what? Koko might actually be right. I've seriously considered quitting my job to join her, running the pharmacy.
Liuqin: But after mulling it over, I still preferred to stay and do research.
Liuqin: Our current medicines can handle most diseases.
Liuqin: However, with the discovery of more diseases and the spread of new treatments, we're also facing an increasing number of pathogens.
Liuqin: So, meds gotta stay up to date, and my job is to give more powerful tools to those battling diseases.

title: Liuxian
content:

Yuanwu drinks fresh Trine Tea, "a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself"

title: Liuxian
content:
Liuxuan: Thanks to the patronage from my lovely neighbors, Liuxian Teahouse is still driving after all these years.
Liuxuan: When a regular customer enters the teahouse and sit down with their teacup ready, I would know exactly what tea they want to have.
Liuxuan: Chenpi likes to have Pu'er, Pianyu prefers white tea, and as for Master Yuanwu...
Liuxuan: I'd roast some fresh Trine Tea myself every day, wrap it in oil paper, and then bring it over to his boxing gym.
Liuxuan: It's a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself. I usually pick the tea leaves and roast them here at the teahouse.
Liuxuan: Sometimes I feel that relationships between people are like tea leaves. The more they are encompassed in warmth, the more fragrant they become.

title: Lizhu

Lizhu: Just so you know, that's the 17th most brutal line from Mr. Mortefi, as per our rankings on the Huaxu Hive.
[Dialogue Option]  That's only ranked the 17th?
Lizhu: Oddly enough, some people don't mind his scolding... In fact, they seem to provoke him on purpose.
Lizhu: I really can't understand what those people are thinking...

title: Lizhu
content:
[Objective: (Outdoor, at Afternoon)]
Lizhu: The war in the Norfall Barrens has finally ended.
Lizhu: That Retroact Rain was horrible, wasn't it?
Lizhu: The Retroact Rain was already scary as an illusion... but then actual "ghosts" appeared!
[Dialogue Option]  It could be caused by the Threnodian's awakening.
Lizhu: Yeah, we thought so too. The Threnodian seemed on the brink of awakening... and its recent activities have already had such a terrible impact.
Lizhu: Can you believe the Fractsidus wanted to hatch such a terrifying creature...
Lizhu: I heard Fractsidus members were part of this Threnodian revival too. Rover, any insights?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not quite sure either.
Lizhu: Ah, too bad. I was hoping to get more information from you...
[Dialogue Option]  Where did you hear all these rumors, anyway?
Lizhu: Of course, it's all online!

title: Lizhu
content:
[Objective: (Indoor, at Night)]
Lizhu: Crownless... No way, the progress on the frequency calculations is only at 7%...
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Lizhu: I'm analyzing the Crownless data. I've never seen such a complex Tacet Discord before.
Lizhu: By the way, did you know? Miss Baizhi actually came up with the term "Crownless." What a pity.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is it a pity?
Lizhu: Don't you think the name is a bit... uninspired? Miss Baizhi is a genius at everything, except naming Tacet Discords.
Lizhu: Everyone on the forums wants a more memorable name. They even held a virtual contest for suggestions.
[Dialogue Option]  For example?
Lizhu: My favorite is "Savage God of Torn Wings." What do you think, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I think "Crownless" is a better name...
Lizhu: No way... Did Miss Baizhi blackmail you??
[Dialogue Option]  "Savage God of Torn Wings" is the better name.
Lizhu: Haha, Rover, you've got great taste!
[Dialogue Option]  I don't really care.
Lizhu: In the end, Miss Baizhi, as the discoverer, has the final say.

title: Lollo Logistics

Whether in bustling cities or remote wilderness, Lollo Logistics stations are established to meet clients' delivery needs. Guided by a shared creed, the couriers prioritize their clients' property. Their couriers don an iconic hamster-themed outfit.

content: is an Overlord Class Boss in Wuthering Waves that can be found in the .

title: Lorelei
content: to . Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds. Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins. With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Lorelei
content:
===Etymology===
"Lorelei" is the name of a siren that lures fishermen to their deaths in German mythology, inspired by an infamous real life maritime disaster site of the same name.
The "Queen of the Night" is a character from Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 1791 opera The Magic Flute.

His niece, Batti, and nephew, Leto, often listen to the stories he tells.

He's often accompanied by Chalulu, a Lottie Lost Common Echo.

title: Lucilla/Backstory
content: She is a tall young woman with a slender, shapely build with a graceful and confident posture. She has long, wavy cobalt-blue hair, which gradually fades into a lighter azure at the ends. It reaches well past her waist and is styled with soft, layered waves that give it plenty of volume and movement. Long side bangs partially frame her face while leaving one eye slightly more exposed. Her face is delicate with a slender jawline, a small nose, and soft lips. She has violet-blue eyes with a calm, confident expression, giving her a composed and intelligent look. Thin eyebrows complement her sharp yet feminine features. She wears large silver oval earrings that stand out against her dark blue hair. Completing her appearance is a black wide-brimmed hat decorated with a gold band and subtle metallic accents, adding a fashionable, almost detective-like aesthetic.

title: Lucilla/Backstory
content: she wears a fitted white cropped jacket with rolled sleeves serves as the outer layer. The cuffs and hem feature blue geometric patterns, while a badge on one sleeve suggests an official or academy affiliation. Beneath the jacket is a black collared shirt with a deep V-shaped neckline, layered over a black inner top. Around her neck is a large yellow ribbon tie fastened by an ornate silver brooch. A structured white corset-style waist piece cinches her midsection. It is decorated with metallic buckles, silver clasps, and a circular emblem at the center, emphasizing both elegance and utility. She wears a black asymmetrical skirt featuring embossed geometric patterns and a dramatic thigh-high side slit. One side extends into a long panel while the opposite leg remains mostly exposed. Black semi-transparent stockings cover one leg, while the other leg is largely bare except for decorative accessories. Around one thigh she wears a metallic chain garter with circular links, accompanied by additional leather straps and small utility pouches attached at her hips.

title: Lucilla/Backstory
content:
Her hands are covered by sleek black gloves embellished with silver details and a blue gemstone ring.

Multiple bracelets and metallic wrist cuffs add further detail. She carries a quilted blue handbag with black leather trim, silver hardware, and a decorative emblem on the front. She finishes the outfit with black high-heeled pumps featuring a rounded toe and medium-height block heels.

|vo_01_01_tx                 = Sometimes, it feels a little strange when you call me "Professor." Feels like since you enrolled, I've been the one taking instruction. In any case, glad to have you around, Rover. Or should I say, "Professor Rover"?

|vo_01_02_tx                 = Seeing you takes me back to my Pioneer Association days. Oh, the anticipation of setting foot on one strange land after another. Sometimes you'd stumble onto something wonderful. More often? Brutal challenges. Absurd misadventures. Lying flat on your back in camp, staring up at the stars, too exhausted to move... |vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = When I first joined the Pioneer Association, it was pure rebellion. A way to spite my mother's plans. A little "self-sabotage" just to get under her skin. "Look," I wanted to say, "your carefully cultivated protege just joined an organization with zero political capital." Feels arrogant now, looking back. She raised me too well. Made me just like her...

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Coming to Startorch Academy was mostly by chance. I was first dispatched to Lahai-Roi for an extended expedition. Then one thing led to another, and I was reassigned to the Spacetrek Collective, eventually ending up here at the Academy. At first, they wanted me to use my Forte to trace ancient memories buried in Exostrider material. But how was a small life form such as myself ever to resonate with an alien civilization?

|vo_01_05_tx                 = I left that cold home. Left the New Federation. Left the Pioneer Association, too. Back then, I was just running for the sake of running. I loathed where I had come from so much that I tried to erase my memories of it. But you can't erase who you are... I thought the Academy would be another stop on the road. Then the views here took hold of me. And now, when I look back, all I see is them.

title: Lucretia
content:
' is an event-exclusive NPC for the  during the .

She is found with Patricia outside the Debate Club Expedition room at .

title: Lucretia
content:
Lucretia: Which debate you wanna catch? I think the Helios one sounds pretty interesting.
Patricia: Which brings more suffering: resenting that Helios shines on everyone BUT me, or resenting that it doesn't shine on ONLY me?
Lucretia: Given Helios's output, being the sole recipient would probably fry any carbon-based life. But then again, long-term deprivation isn't great either...
Patricia: Yeahhh, this is why the "strict standardization vs. innovation in experiments" debate is probably more your vibe.
Lucretia: Hey, which one will you be checking out?
[Dialogue Option]  The Helios metaphor feels relatable.
Lucretia: I feel the same! Using Helios as a metaphor for someone unreachable, the way both scenarios hit you with that longing, that gut-punch of it was never going to happen... UGH. It's so good.
Patricia: And since we're doing metaphors, Helios could also stand for, like... universally desired things. You know. Research funding.
Patricia: Imagine if everyone else got their grants approved, and I was the only one stuck with rewriting my proposal... Oh, the pain!
[Dialogue Option]  The debate on experimental design is more practical.
Patricia: That's true. Both perspectives are valid, but that kind of discussion probably offers more angles and deeper insights. Let's go with that one.
Lucretia: Alright, since you're finally stepping out of the lab and Archives for once, we'll do it your way. Thanks, Rover. See you later!
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not sure.
Lucretia: Tough choice either way. Good thing we're not the ones on stage. We just get to listen to the debaters do their thing!

title: Ludvika
content: Ludvika is a female NPC working at the Averardo Vault (Instance).

title: Ludvika
content:
Ludvika: Hello there! Are you looking to sell any collectibles?
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of items do you collect?
Ludvika: Oh, all kinds. Literature from before the Lament, old currency, electronics, contemporary art, and precious metals.
Ludvika: Averardo Vault values anything of significance—anything that speaks to Ragunna's past of whispers of its future.
Ludvika: Of course, value is subjective. Difference eyes see different worth.
Ludvika: So we evaluate each collectible to determine its value.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds pretty rigorous.
Ludvika: Ha, you needn't worry. A few years back, we paid quite a sum for a sealed metal canister.
[Dialogue Option]  What was inside?
Ludvika: Nothing. We believe it's a pet food can manufactured before the Lament, but due to a production error, it was never filled with anything.
Ludvika: I understand your confusion. But that's precisely why we set such a high price. It's one of the last known artifacts from before the Lament.
Ludvika: As I said, we consider value from every angle, often going contrary to popular belief.
Ludvika: To us, these items are unquestionably priceless.
Ludvika: Enough small talk. Do you have anything you'd like us to evaluate? Artifacts? Maybe a Reserved Echo?
[Dialogue Option]  What about Abby?
Ludvika: ...Do you mean the Echo with human-level intelligence and communication skills?
Ludvika: Honestly, we've never encountered something quite like that in the Vault!
Ludvika: If you're willing to part with it... We'll be sure to come up with an offer you'll like!
You tell Ludvika you're just kidding and decline her offer. She looks a little disappointed.
[Dialogue Option]  I've got a backpack full of things I don't need.
Ludvika: Yes... these are rare items indeed.
Ludvika: But if I'm being honest, they likely hold far more personal meaning to you than they ever could to us.
Ludvika: We'd hate to take something so dear from you. Perhaps you'll reconsider?
Memories of these collectibles flash through your mind. You decide to keep them as mementos of your journey.
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing at the moment.
Ludvika: I understand. Shell Credits aren't the most important things in this world.
Ludvika: If you ever change your mind, don't hesitate to stop by anytime.

content:
Lumi wields a broadblade and leads a transport squad team in the Yuezhou branch of Lollo Logistics. Her warm and caring nature has earned her the respect and admiration of those around her, making her a valued member of the team.  Born in a mountain village, she grew up surrounded by nature's beauty and developed a deep appreciation for the simple joys of life.

On the surface, Lumi appears to be a sweet, cheerful, and friendly individual, radiating positivity and warmth through her constant smiles. However, beneath her cheerful exterior lies a heartfelt compassion and deep care for those around her. Lumi's genuine concern and desire to prioritize the well-being of others is evident in her considerate actions and genuine expressions of empathy. She not only gives the impression of being sweet but also possesses a kind and generous spirit that goes beyond appearances.

' is a deceased NPC that can be found in the Lost Beyond  as a Reverberation after completing the .

He can be seen talking to Noemie in the morning and dancing with her at night on the cliff.

title: Luneau
content:
;Luneau Won't you at least consider my suggestion?

Luneau: I have some spare cash on hand. You can borrow my money and pay me back later.
Noemie: Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept this. I've also returned everything Phrolova's given me.
Noemie: It's infuriating. She bought her first violin by herself with savings from her job. Does she think I can't do the same?

Luneau: Alright, it's a deal!

title: Lupa/Backstory
Lupa/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Lupa
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Ugh… I didn't expect the paparazzi to be on us during our stroll. A-actually, no, they weren't just after me, they wanted your picture too, Warrior. After all, you're a champion and the talk of the town now! But I bet you're not too keen on ending up in those gossip rags. Don't worry, I'll handle it tomorrow. Our good times are for us, and us alone!

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Sparring with you always takes me back to my childhood. Back then, we'd fight with cardboard "weapons." No crowd, no cheers, no glory, just pure fun. Whether we won or lost, we'd always laugh and hug it out. Warrior… can I get a hug now, too?

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = You wish to try? Sure, go ahead! Here, take this comb, my assistant bought it. They say you need a whole collection for a tail like mine. Mmm… wow, you're really good at this! Even I can't run a comb through it like that... Why am I suddenly so sleepy...

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Being apart, going solo... I remember feeling a little uneasy. Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me. It was a fight I had to win. I wasn't afraid of failure, but I knew that someone who couldn't face failure with dignity would never truly know victory. And... I was the "protagonist" you chose, wasn't I? I couldn't let you down.
|vo_01_04_mention            = Cartethyia

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_mention            = Cartethyia



|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I have received many honors, but the championship medal I won with you is the one I cherish the most. I love this city, the land it rests on, its sights, and its people. It is a place of glory and pride, of filth and despair, but I love it all. I don't suppose you can stay in Septimont forever, this is just a small part of your journey. But for me, it will burn like fire. No matter what darkness comes next, this memory will always light my way.

|vo_02_01_tx                 = I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

|vo_02_02_tx                 = Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

|vo_02_03_tx                 = A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the !

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = The "vittles." Oh, it means food cooked exclusively by  sans human input. All "vittles" taste very bland... Do Septimont Echoes hate seasoning?

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = I just want to enjoy the thrill of competition, win or lose. I can hear my heart pounding when I strike, weapon in hand, my cheeks burning as the crowd cheers... It's simple. Pure. No need for extra pomp or returns. The hard work, the strategy, the sacrifice... It's all worth it to feel that joy! Sticking with this for life won't be easy, but would I have to quit? Not a chance.

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = This spear? It was a gift from Domina Julia... Yeah, the same weapon I carried into my very first match in Septimont. Back then, I was just a child with "some natural talent." She spotted me in the crowd and brought me into the limelight. So, in the following years, I turned a blind eye to the outrageous contract terms, willfully ignoring the fact that she sought to use me for her own gain. I used to believe her pride would hold her back, that it would stop her from crossing the line...

title: Lupa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = It's now all a blur to me... the memory of being trapped in that empty city... Walls crawling with Tidal Blight, monsters prowling the streets. Everyone had vanished without a trace. It was the lowest I'd ever seen Septimont. I couldn't bear to see such hellish sights. But I told myself, "I can still hold on." I had to keep going... keep searching for a way to save this city, no matter how many times it took.

|vo_04_01_tx                 = In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Cartethyia

title: Luuk Herssen/Backstory
Luuk Herssen/Backstory
Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Luuk Herssen
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Funny thing. When I first went color blind from the side effects of Ichor, the world turned into an old black‑and‑white movie overnight. The only color I saw was the mesmerizing golden hues gilding the world around me: the morning light dancing on the windowsill, students' smiles as I unwrapped their bandages, and the vibrant energy they brought to the room as they pushed open my door... Look, even this bouquet the students brought me this morning glows faintly with the same golden light. Perhaps when I have time, I'll go pick out new specimens myself.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = I was born into a family of doctors. My childhood toys were stethoscopes, and my bedtime stories were medical texts... Anyone would've said I was cut out for medicine. For years, I moved like delicate clockwork, each step precise, deliberate, flawless, on the set trail. But once I'd mastered how to handle a scalpel, confusion made its first incision. Each time I stood beneath the surgical light, I could feel invisible threads pulling at me. Reason ordered me to cut, while the heart refused to move. Can this truly save everyone? Can I really excise all the sickness and decay from this world just by standing here?

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Later, I turned to psychology. I began listening to people's dreams, hesitations, and fears. I watched repressed emotions begin to stir beneath a calm surface, and that was another kind of "surgery": the incision wasn't on the flesh but on their silent facade. Through it, I saw many climb back up from the depths of despair... and myself being pieced back together through their stories.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Do you still remember that night of rain? The wind was so strong it could strip a man's bones bare. I thought the world had left me with nothing but an empty grave for company, until I saw you, standing at the edge of the storm, reaching out your hand—you saw through that scheme of "theirs (The Grand Architect)" long before I did. Even death was just another narrative device in their twisted play. As the rain scoured the scripts off the tombstones like melting snow, the so-called "truth" was washed away, dissolving into obscurity. ...That was not the ending I wanted. I will carve out the truth, and I will expose every lie... to the burning light of day.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I've seen the sun in our pact. So now, it's my turn to lead the way. Whatever lies ahead—despair or hope—just as we once supported each other through the blizzard, let's walk together shoulder to shoulder.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Luuk Herssen's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Hmm... does being around people count as a hobby? I like meeting others, listening to the stories of their lives. You'd be surprised by the wondrous, amusing tales you'll hear. It's far more interesting than burying myself in research papers. Of course, when I'm alone, I like to pour myself a cup of tea, sit by the window, and watch the snow fall... or arrange my scalpels and medicine bottles just right. It's oddly soothing, though sometimes it brings back memories of the old days. Hah, I was joking, of course. I've long since moved on from the past. Whatever happened back then, each day I have is now is something to look forward to.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Luuk Herssen's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Honestly, I don't think I have many worries at this moment—would you believe that? I've learned to enjoy a conversation with others instead of brooding by myself. Whether it's the weather, breakfast, or a flower by the roadside... be it our anxieties or trivialities, they're just proof we're still alive. So, if something's troubling you, just share it with me.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = You already know the answer, don't you? Candy, of course. Would you like one? Lately I've been experimenting with some new varieties. My students are a constant source of inspiration. The other day, one came to me, dead serious, and asked if I could make a candy that could release exam stress overnight. Heh. Should I tell him that, compared to candy, a chat with me in my counseling office might work better?

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = I can't stomach pungent vegetables or seafood that tastes too fishy. Those tastes remind me of rainy seasons... of damp, moldy, rotten smells. I've never been fond of endless rain... Still, I'd never judge someone else's taste. Every dish that earns affection must have its own charm, wouldn't you say?

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them (The Fractsidus) straight back to hell.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = These restraint devices on my neck and arms... they're for containing the Ichor, or what they call the "Golden Serum." Nothing mysterious here. I'm sure you've heard the story, haven't you? They're just "surgical scars." The Ichor can remold itself into any form I desire. As long as I need it, it always appears in my hand in perfect shape. Thanks to these, the Ichor stays quiet within me. I don't... pose any threat now, and I'm in full control.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = The day before I came to , I dumped all of Novialle's mess onto my assistant. I felt oddly at ease when I saw the look of sheer shock and confusion on his face. You were right. I needed to loosen the string I'd kept too tight, and move somewhere new for a fresh start.

title: Luuk Herssen/Voicelines
content:

|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Lucilla.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = The President of the Academy and a... savvy adult. Lucilla knows what she wants, and what others want from her. Unlike those pedantic academics, she understands when to put her foot down and when to give ground for the sake of . She's like the undercurrents flowing beneath the Academy's ice cap—calm, quiet, and always keeping things afloat.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Lucilla

|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Aemeath.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = That child who means so much to you... I do see you in her. So bullheaded up against fate itself. So decisive and brave it leaves one speechless. At moments when that upbeatness flickers, I can tell that bright smile is just a mask she puts on, but if that's what she wants others to see, I'll respect it.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Aemeath

|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Sigrika... She shoulders a weight far too heavy for someone her age. Thankfully, there's candy to sweeten the gloom. She never hesitates to sample my newest candies. Her fearlessness has me impressed. Perhaps that curiosity of hers... is what finally lets her act her age.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Sigrika

|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Rhein.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = We share no blood, two "brothers" played as pawns in this game of Golden Serum. Even so, there were similarities between us—when we have our eyes set on a path, we never turn back. That same hunger to reach the truth, no matter how it burns. If he ever wakes again... I believe he'll be a brilliant painter. He always had the gift. His life shouldn't end here. There must be a way.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Rhein

|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About the Fractsidus and "Them".ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Strange, isn't it? They (The Grand Architect) toyed with so many lives as if they were stage props, yet I know nothing of their name or gender. I doubt they ever bothered to remember mine either, but that's fine. One day, we'll wrench the entire Fractsidus from their roots and cast them down the abyss they carved out for themselves.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Fractsidus, Grand Architect

|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Hello, Rover. Happy birthday. The frostlands rarely see the seasons change, only an endless winter stretching as far as the eye can see. Yet the snow that buries the past also nurtures new beginnings. On a day like this—feels right to send out my best wishes. Thank you for choosing to spend this day with me. Keep walking towards the sunrise. The world ahead is vast, and your every footprint in the snow will be touched by the light. You'll keep moving forward, and I'll be not far behind, watching over the places you've illuminated. When you look back, I'll still be here, arms open— Just as we always have, emerging from the dark, together. From this day on, I'll remain your companion, one you'll never need to thank.

title: Lynae
Lynae (Fractsidus)
content: Lynae is a deceased, mentioned only NPC and was a Fractsidus operative prior to her death. Her voice is heard briefly during What Burns Beneath Frostlands via a recording.

title: Lynae (Fractsidus)
content: Lynae was a Fractsidus operative set to infiltrate Startorch Academy in Lahai-Roi as a spy. At some point before the events of the Main Quest When the Unknown Thrums Lynae was killed by government mercenaries after being deemed a threat by the New Federation. Her corpse was found by one of the mercenaries targeting her, with said mercenary then taking on her identity and attending Startorch Academy in her place.

title: Lynae/Backstory
content: Lynae was a mercenary born in the lawless zone, hired by the New Federation government, one of whose missions was to kill the real "Lynae." Like other mercenaries, she was cold and ruthless, believing that anything that wasn't a weapon or equipment was "dead weight." During her mission, she found an acceptance letter from Startorch Academy and took it, faking her death and assuming the identity of "Lynae." Once isolated, now carefree and vibrant, Lynae developed an affection for Startorch Academy and wished to remain a student, alongside her friends. Some old habits, however, still reminded her of who she once was.

title: Lynae/Backstory
content:
Lynae is a young woman of average height with fair skin and sharp purple-blue eyes. Her hair is dyed a light blonde with teal highlights mixed in and her original hair color peaks through via her dark brown roots. She keeps her hair primarily down with the exception of a small chunk of hair tied into a hoop aswell as various braids across her head, bangs, and the back of her head.

Her Tacet Mark is located on the posterior side of her left thigh.

title: Lynae/Backstory
content: Lynae wears a white dress shirt tucked into her skirt and a loose teal and green tie with a black cat tie clip attached. She keeps her sleeves rolled up, and her shirt features spray paint stains. Across her chest and around her shoulder and waist is a black strap; a white and iridescent jacket hangs from the back. She keeps her student ID card clipped onto the strap around her waist. Her skirt is black, pleated, high-waisted, and ends partway down her thighs. Additionally, Lynae has a black garter on her right thigh, with a spray can attached to it. She sports calf-reaching black socks with black boots with teal soles that that have rollerblade wheels situated on the back. Black and white headphones sit around her neck, and painted nails, rings, and bracelets decorate her hands.

title: Lynae/Backstory
Lynae/Backstory
content:
~17 years before LD
"Lynae" (birth name unknown) is born.
1 year before LD
"Lynae" discovers a deceased Fractsidus operative named Lynae with a Startorch acceptance letter. "Lynae" steals the operative's identity to attend Startorch.
1 year post LD
Rover comes to Lahai-Roi and teams up with Lynae.
Lynae re-enrolls as a first-year Startorch student under her own identity. She chooses to keep the name as she is attached to it now.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Lynae
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Hey, you! Brought you some snacks. Nice day, huh? Whaddya say we get some scorch marks on the road? Oh, and I heard the cafeteria is serving some weird new dish. We should try it for lunch! Oh yeah, I also heard the Film Club is screening an old New Federation film this afternoon that I've always wanted to watch! Interested? And then tonight we could... Oh. Uh, yeah, my bad. Should I...? Yeah, I'll let you keep sleeping.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = New spray cans, odd parts for my seniors, candy from Sigrika... Just a few souvenirs from the last school event. Yeah, just tidying up. You barely notice it happening, then all of a sudden you look around and your room's full of this stuff. Can't bring myself to toss any of it. Weird, right? There was a time I wouldn't even let myself have a potted plant. I'd just have to leave it behind anyway, ya know? Oh, I've got you something. Here. I finished painting this Exostrider model yesterday. Not bad, huh? Looks just like the real thing.
|vo_01_02_mention            = Sigrika

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_mention            = Sigrika



|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = When I first got to , I used to wake up in a cold sweat... wondering if I could really just live like this. I kept waiting for the other shoe to drop. I was chasing this fragile, perfect idea of freedom all day, and then running from my old self in my dreams at night. Just... waiting for the bill to come. So I started making every choice like it was my last day here. "What would I do if this were it?" Yeah, and looking back, I guess the answer was almost always... "skip class."

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I can tell, you know. Even if you don't say it. The weight of your past is a lot heavier than anyone knows. Hey, if you wanted to tell me about it, I'd be all ears. But I won't dig. The you I know and want to understand is the you standing right here. It's just... hauling that around must get heavy, right? So if there ever comes a day where you just want to drop it all, forget who you're supposed to be, and just... breathe... Let me know. I've got a few channels to set you up with a whole new look and story. Whatever identity you wanna try on for size, I can make it happen. Well... as long as it's not too crazy. But judging by that look on your face, I think I already know what your answer's gonna be.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I never could put down roots in my merc life. Anywhere. So I built my whole thing on taking what I could get in the moment. Little indulgences, you could say. That way, whenever I had to bail, I knew I'd gotten everything out of it. And now? Honestly? I still feel the same way. The difference is... that gnawing fear of losing it all? It's gone. Every day here is just... good. I just want to pour everything I've got into appreciating that. I guess what I'm trying to say is... next time we go for a joyride, let me drive. Just like the day we first met.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Lynae's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Custom paint jobs, skating, parkour, FPS games.... Hard to pick a favorite, but I'd put the feeling of a full throttle under the skies of Lahai-Roi in first place. Lately though, my list of hobbies has been out of control. There's just too much cool stuff to try. Wait... Overflowing Palette? What's that? Heh, now you gotta tell me!

|vo_02_02_title              = Lynae's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Back in the day, it was all about my cover getting blown, or the Fractsidus pulling new crap, or dealing with moving on to someplace new... But now... Ugh. My biggest headache is figuring out how I'm gonna dig myself out of this credit deficit...

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Lemme let you in on a little secret. Everything tastes amazing when you're eating it in class. Even instant noodles. Gah, just the thrill of it, you know? Like, you wait for the teacher to turn their back to write on the board and then...

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = When I came to , all I brought with me was that acceptance letter. The one that never really had my name on it. It was a key. One that unlocked this wild, colorful dream... and all the chaos that came with it. Without it, I never would've met you or anyone else. So... I don't regret what I did. And hey, like you said—This time, this admission letter will be my own.

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = The New Federation isn't all bells and whistles. If you're a Resonator, you do what you're told. If you're a merc like I was, you do it for cash. No loyalty. No higher purpose. The only fun I had was spraying a little graffiti after a job was done.... even if I had to scrub it off two seconds later. Anyway, enough about that. So, about our rides. What's the new paint job gonna look like?

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Mornye
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Mornye.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Mornye

title: Lynae/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_mention            = Mornye



|vo_04_02_title              = About Sigrika
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = When I first got here, Sigrika helped me get a handle on student life... She's super serious, the kind who never lets up on herself, you know? She never complains though, just bottles it all up inside. She's gonna hit a wall one day if she keeps that up... So, how about you and I... pull a little "intervention"? Lyosroth
content: ' is a NPC male Royan Shepherd who can be found next to a Giant Soliskin in Soliseed Plains. He asks Rover for help in locating and guiding the wandering Soliskin back to Bjartr Woods.

title: Lyosroth
content:
[Objective: (First time dialogue)]
Lyosroth: Hello, Rover. Forgive me for being so blunt, but there's something I was hoping you could help us with.
Lyosroth: The bulk of the Shepherds at Bjartr Woods are engaged in tasks lately, with each having to look after over twenty Soliskins.
Lyosroth: And over a hundred Soliskin descended from the Solvein Canopy again just yesterday alone...
Lyosroth: With so few Shepherds, many Soliskin are now wandering aimlessly around Lahai-Roi... And of course, there are those that simply ran off to who knows where.
Lyosroth: We would search for them ourselves, but we can't afford to leave the ones under our care...
Lyosroth: If it's not too much to ask, could you help us find the missing Soliskin?
[Dialogue Option]  Hide-and-seek. My favorite game!
[Dialogue Option]  Do I get paid?
Lyosroth: Of course.
[Dialogue Option]  Glad to help.
Lyosroth: You may find me with the Giant Soliskin at the heart of Soliseed Plains once you've retrieved a Soliskin.
Lyosroth: Our rewards await. We're counting you, Rover.

title: Lyosroth
content:
[Objective: (First time delivering Soliseeds)]
Giant Soliskin: Luu? Luu-Luu! (*Excited cheeps*)
Lyosroth: A Soliskin has just returned to us, Rover! Was it your doing?
Lyosroth: It's astonishing how you managed to find this lost Soliskin so quickly! Wait, what's that in your hand?
Lyosroth: It's a Soliseed of Essehalo! Did you receive this from the lost Soliskin, Rover?
Lyosroth: Soliskin produce Soliseeds from their Essehalos, and treat them as their own offspring.
Lyosroth: They only give them to people they trust. It seems seeking your help was the right decision, Rover!
Giant Soliskin: Chuu, luuluu! (*Excited cheeps*)
Lyosroth: The Giant Soliskin shows its thanks and would like you to accept this gift.
Lyosroth: Please, take it. We will have more gifts waiting for you if you manage to find more Soliskin and Soliseeds!

title: Lyubov
content:
Lyubov is an NPC that appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna from 6:00 AM 5:59 PM. She can only be interacted with from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM.

From 6:00 AM to 1:59 PM, she can be seen thinking about what souvenir she should buy. And from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM, she can be seen talking with Sofia and Sergio

title: Lyubov
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 1:59 PM)]
Lyubov: Which souvenirs should I pick...
Lyubov: A Volcanic Windchime from the Septimont... a Jade Clam from Riccioli... or maybe one of each!

title: Lyubov
content:
[Objective: (2:00 PM to 5:59 PM)]
Lyubov: Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
Sergio: Alright, that'll be 220 Monnaie.
Lyubov: What? What's a Monnaie?
Sofia: You're mistaken, Mister!
Sofia: Monnaie is long outdated by now!
Sofia: Now we use Shell Credit for payments as the rest of Solaris does. Monnaie has become just a souvenir of Ragunna.
Sergio: Oh, yeah... you are right.
Sergio: It feels like just yesterday we were still using Monnaie... I'm getting old...
Sergio: Now I remember the time when Averardo Bank collected Monnaie to exchange new notes for us.
Sergio: Oh, right, that'll be 220 Shell Credits, young lady.

title: Maccus
content: Maccus is a male NPC located in Capitoline Hill City down in the arena hallway.

title: Maccus
content:
Maccus: Welcome to Colosseum Olymdos. Is there anything you'd wish to learn about this place?
[Dialogue Option]  About the Colosseum...
Maccus: Colosseum Olymdos is the most renowned arena in the city, and the hosting ground of the largest Echo tournament ever to exist—the Great Agon.
Maccus: Though the oval-shaped arena was built six hundred years ago, we apply the most advanced and modern technologies within every match.
Maccus: One can even say that the Colosseum is a microcosm of the city of Septimont.
[Dialogue Option]  About the Great Agon...
Maccus: The Great Agon, held every four years, is the grandest event there is in Septimont!
Maccus: Gladiators gear up for battle, with their dreams and passion at their shoulders as they march into the arena!
Maccus: You can feel everyone's anticipation brewing as we wait for the reveal of this year's champion!
[Dialogue Option]  About the teams...
Maccus: We've got quite a big competition this year... The most popular ones so far are Beasts Beneath, Vulcan Mining, Blue Furies...
Maccus: And of course, the team led by Rover and Lupa!
Maccus: Which teams will contend for the championship? Let's find out!

(Under the hands of a Priestess, even a blank wall may transform with quiet revelation.)

She trembles. She cannot bear to look. She cannot bring herself to paint.)
