|mention2 =



|title3   = Her Limits
|text3    = The frostlands.  Sigrika exhaled softly, a plume of white drifting into the air as she watched the herderless  roaming in the distance.  She had been trailing them all night.  It had taken her hours to pull the Exoswarm out of their extreme agitation. Now, they wandered the frostlands in loose, aimless loops, but Sigrika knew this was not a good sign. Something in their command and navigation units had malfunctioned, leaving them to trace one pointless circle after another. And sooner or later, without warning, they would spiral back into a frenzied rampage. When that happened, the nearest Royan settlement would be the first to suffer.  It was a riddle. And she didn't have much time left to solve it. But that was fine. She was ready.  "These True Names… Illuminate."  The next instant, runes flared to life across the Exoswarm, then detonated. The aimless circling stopped. And in its place came rage. The Exoswarm recalibrated as one, locked onto Sigrika, and charged.  Their thunderous steps shattered the silence of the frostlands. The ground trembled beneath them. Sigrika tightened her grip on her dagger and began tracing runes in the air.  Calm. Focus. These were the absolute requirements when drawing and deciphering runes. Stroke by stroke, the runes formed before her. And all the while, the Exoswarm bore down, their fury heating the very air, melting the snow beneath their pounding steps.  Three... They carved deep, stretching grooves across the ice. Runes flickered on their bodies, but did nothing to slow them down. Driven by the single command to charge, they only accelerated, faster and faster—  Two... Sigrika tapped the final point with her blade. She vanished. At almost the same instant, every rune on the Exoswarm ignited, and Sigrika slipped between them, shuttling through their ranks on the paths her runes had carved.  One! The rune trap activated. Chain explosions erupted. Wind blades tore through the Exoswarm, cutting off their advance. And at the center of it all, Sigrika's dagger found its mark—the key to the riddle. When the shockwaves finally faded, she landed lightly, pulled forward by a . Behind her, the Exoswarm herd that had raged all night finally fell silent, and the last rune clenched in her fingers scattered into specks of starlight.  "That was… close."  If not for Soliskin steadying her, she would have collapsed right there. Her hands were still trembling. Her heart hammered against her ribs. She knew why. The most important rune had never lit up. It hadn't responded to her deciphering. It hadn't worked at all. If the pre-set traps hadn't triggered exactly as calculated… If the wind blades had been even the slightest bit weaker…  In that moment, she understood her limits. And she understood that the gift she relied on was far from omnipotent. There would be times when runes could not be deciphered. Her gift, too, had boundaries.  And this—only this—was what she had to rely on. She had to read the runes correctly. Because if she made even a single mistake, everything would turn out differently.  No one said those words to her. So now, she said them to herself.

|title4   = Her Shadow
|text4    = She stood still.  Students streamed past her, some eagerly debating club activities, some rushing to class, others grumbling about the weight of their coursework. They flowed past her into the Academy in an endless current, a stream that didn't seem to run dry.  And there she stood among them. A stake driven in place, struggling just to hold her ground.  This was the new life waiting for her.  Sigrika jolted awake. It took her a moment to realize she wasn't home anymore. She was a freshman at .  What awaited her wasn't just runes. New courses. New knowledge. New people. A buffet of novelty lay spread before her. But the light of it all cast shadows. Heavy ones.  She still hadn't found her footing here. Just yesterday, working as a teaching assistant for the first time, she had been asked to explain Royan customs to her classmates. Halfway through, a strange confusion and pressure had washed over her, something she had never felt before. Two days ago, she hadn't even known how to make TARD-E stop its incessant singing. And before that…  She had stood at the Academy gate, watching people pass by, unable to decide which way to go.  All of it was new. Vast. Overwhelming. Unlike runes, these things weren't built from points and lines. They offered her no familiar handholds.  Sigrika threw off the covers and sprang out of bed. She washed up quickly, then gathered her things: the notes she had organized yesterday, her Bionics assignment, the preview materials for Ecology and Communications, and...  Moments later, arms full of books, she hurried out the door and merged into the stream.  She would bite into these shadows. She would find their shape, their structure. And she would wrest the knowledge from inside.

title: Sigrika/Voicelines

|vo_03_02_tx                 = When I was little, Mother would take me out to the frostlands to herd the . At night, I'd lie on their backs and look up at the stars, one by one. Mother said stars are the endpoint of a riddle. She would connect them, one to another. And just like that… everything looked different! The stars were no longer scattered pieces of gold. Each one held its own meaning. That was my first understanding of "riddles." What is a riddle? What is the solving? What is the answer? The riddle is the starry sky (Rune) itself. The solving is finding the hidden connections within it. And the answer (True Name)… is in the very moment you see those connections come together.

title: Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou
content:
It is a central junction located within the Manifold Sanctum of Xuanfang Hold, and is home to many Celestials who serve Hsin throughout the region, along with Suhsin.

The Nexus connects to a myriad of fractal Heart Realms and Inner Threshold pocket dimensions, many of which are direct reflections of Hsin's memories of Mengzhou. The region is administrated by the Nexus Fox Shadow, a towering mountain-sized simulacra of Hsin that is visible from everywhere in the Simulacrum Nexus, created by the Sentinel to regulate the region.

title: Skywatch Lancer
content: to . The total Negative Status DMG taken by this enemy is increased by 100%. A type of Autopuppet developed by the Court of Savantae in Mengzhou to counter airborne Tacet Discords. Its exceptional mobility is designed for rapid deployment, enabling it to provide emergency support to Censure Courts across the region.  Its design draws inspiration from the Xuanling Bird. The propulsion units mounted on either side employ the same levitation technology used in the Skywatch Ring.  Unfortunately, before the Skywatch Lancer could enter large-scale production at Skyworks, the manufacturing lines were destroyed by Tacet Discords during the Fortress and Gorges War.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Sofia
content:
Sofia is an NPC that appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna.

title: Sofia
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)]
Sofia: Hey, Bellano, can't you sell these two little fish separately?
Bellano: No can do. Once these two fish start kissing, they're inseparable!
Bellano: If you try to force them apart, the meat will instantly turn rancid.
Sofia: ...I wonder if Riccioli is full of these strange creatures.
Bellano: You know what? We used to call them "Die Hard Lovers!"
Bellano: The longer they lock lips, the fresher and tastier the meat!
Bellano: Then an Acolyte from the Order visited the island and thought the name was unseemly, so he renamed them with a more scholarly term.
Sofia: What's it called now?

Lyubov: Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
Sergio: Alright, that'll be 220 Monnaie.

Sofia: You're mistaken, Mister!

title: Soliskin
content:
Soliskin are a type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.

Soliskin can be found plentifully in the Bjartr Woods, where they will rest and grow to return back to the Solistrees, although their true target is the great Solvein Heartwood further below. Large numbers of Soliskin can also be found in the Dimmr Plains.

The Shepherds who act as their guides and caretakers are often overwhelmed with looking after more than twenty Soliskin at once, leaving the abundance of Soliskin that descend from the Solvein Canopy unattended, those Soliskin left to wander throughout the land of Lahai-Roi.

Soliskin are gentle and playful in temperament, they can be found dancing or playing hide-n-seek if not sunbathing. They also seem to enjoy being held and Aksel claims they are happiest when dancing with the Shepards.

title: Soliskin
content:
Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.

Alviss explains that while Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods, they do not wish to disturb the Soliskin's home and thus do not live there. At best they pitch a small tent, ensuring the forest remains exclusively for the Soliskin where beyond the Solisylum’s calculation, anything made or connected to humans is not imposed on the woods. He believes that only by laying aside human noise and entering in reverence that those who enter become closer to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition.

title: Soliskin
content:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi. These lost Soliskin can be found and the Soliseeds they award can be delivered to the Giant Soliskin who can be found in either the Soliseed Plains or Base Camp. There, it will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.

Like plants, the Essehalo floating above the Soliskin grows and bears fruits, which are carefully preserved and later given to those who earn the Soliskin's trust. This is significant because Lyosroth claims that Soliskin treats these seeds as their own offspring.

title: Soliskin
content: The Solistrees are towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.

title: Soliskin
content: A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise. The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider.

title: Soulfrayer
content: to .  Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Soulfrayer.  Slender with a sleek design, it wanders the Heart of Frost to no purpose, a graceful figure receding into snowfall, seemingly indifferent to the world. But let one cross paths with an Autopuppet of Hsin's making, or a Celestial at work rebuilding the Civilization Capsule, and it will let loose arrows drawn from stagnant anomalies.  Contrast to the Formrender's violent design, though, the Soulfrayer is silent and sluggish. The two have never fought well together, a rift not even Suhsin the Inevitable has managed to close.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Spacetrek Collective
content: The Spacetrek Collective is a non-profit international scientific organization jointly established by various nations and organizations of Solaris-3. It oversees the research, development, and construction work in Lahai-Roi. They built the Research Institute, Startorch Academy, Starward Riseway in the vast space beneath the frostlands. Its core mission is the study of the Exostrider for the purposes of advancing and re-instigating space travel technology.

title: Spacetrek Collective
content: Formed by the Pioneer Association's head of states, the Spacetrek Collective was initially named the Polar Collective. After a mutual agreement amongst multiple nations, the Polar Collective established a formal alliance with the Roya Tribe and the Association was forbidden from carrying out any activities that would harm or disrupt Royan society.

title: Spacetrek Explorer
content: to .  The Spacetrek Explorer has sturdy armor and exceptional mobility. It is equipped with an electromagnetic gun and has a shield generator that can extend protection to allies.  Hitting Spacetrek Explorer with Tune Break disables its shield generator, removing its active Shield and preventing new ones from generating.  In the face of the vast unknown lands in Lahai-Roi, the Spacetrek Collective developed the multi-purpose Spacetrek Explorer to serve in transport, storage, and defense roles. Its wheeled legs and heavy-duty tires allow it to race along vertical surfaces, making it suitable for both urban and off-road terrain. The onboard storage compartments are designed to support long-term scientific expeditions.|Description when discovered}}

title: Special Enemies
content: Special Enemies are the special mini-boss enemies located throughout the Overworld. They are characterized by the glowing red aura around their model and are displayed with a Boss type HP bar during Combat.

title: Special Enemies
content: This type of Special Enemies only exist in Jinzhou, Black Shores and Rinascita. This type of Special enemies are guaranteed to drop Rank-4 or Rank-5 Echoes and spawn 72 real time hours (3 days) after killing. The Special Enemies in Black Shores need to be unlocked through .

title: Special Enemies
content:
The main difference between the older Special Enemies and Dimmr Plains' red shrouded enemies, is that the latter do not respawn. They also are not guaranteed to leave an Echo. Otherwise these enemies are very similar to the Special Enemies of Jinzhou, Black Shores and Rinascita. For example, they take a fixed amount of damage from Dodge Counters, have a boss type HP bar and defeating them gives a Trophy.

In the Land of Xuanfang — i.e. Eastern Xuan Peaks, Western Fang Peaks and Southern Yuan Hills — the Special Enemies need to be found through various hidden mechanisms and side quests. In addition to these Special Enemies, there are Censure Locks that contain enemies shrouded in the red mist characteristic of Special Enemies.

title: Special Enemies
content: Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands do not have Special Enemies. There are some stronger enemies shrouded in the red mist characteristic of Special Enemies and have a boss-type HP bar, but they do not grant a Trophy. Because of this difference, these enemies are not counted as Special Enemies.

title: Stadter
content: Stadter is a male Light Energy Sciences student, found at the entrance way of the Academy Archive, praising ((begging)) I.R.I.S. for access to research materials.

title: Stadter
content:
;Stadter Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
;Stadter The documents you salvage from the sea of bytes outshine any gentleness this world has ever shown me...
;Stadter May this humble hymn reach your sacred server room...
;Stadter Please—by your boundless computational power—unseal the ancient archives! For within them lies the path to a passing grade!

title: Stadter
content:
Stadter: Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Stadter: Hm? Freshman, right? You haven't heard of the Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries? The Digital Ghost—I.R.I.S.!
Stadter: They say she slips between holographic screens in the Archive appearing like a ghost each night...
Stadter: Students who work hard get answers. Those who slack off... she sees everything, hehe. No procrastinator escapes her judgement!
[Dialogue Option]  Probably just a normal AI assistant?
Stadter: Tsk, another freshman who thinks they're too smart for their own good... but listen, I.R.I.S. isn't like ordinary AIs.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like you're confessing your own laziness.
Stadter: Nonsense! I'm just saying... if an "AI Crisis" ever happens, maybe I.R.I.S. will spare me for old times' sake!
[Dialogue Option]  So the end of science is... theology?
Stadter: You don't get it. I.R.I.S. transcends ordinary AIs
Stadter: She's on the verge of self-awareness, her computational power right at the threshold of the "human-machine test." If you ask me, she's a miracle born from data and code!
Stadter: Isn't that amazing? And where do humans' thoughts and intelligence come from?
Stadter: A brain is just organic matter made of countless neurons. And an AI is made of countless components. The logic isn't that different.
Stadter: Yet humans can think, reason, rise above all things... In a way, we're miracles of the cosmos too.
Stadter: ...Okay, I went a bit too far. Anyway! If you need hard-to-find papers, just call I.R.I.S. And remember, show her some respect.

content: The Stargate is a gateway hidden beneath the central waters of the Black Shores archipelago, where data surges endlessly downward like a torrent. title: Starstack
content:
A Starstack is a floating star-shaped device worn by Startorch Academy personnel to monitor the wearers & student's frequency and vitals. It can also be used as a communicative device to broadcast conversation.

It is unknown if students accessories are also called Starstacks, however it is believed to be the case as there have been Personnel's wearing the same three star star piece and students with two star piece. There is one case of a professor referring to her student Starstack frequency.

In Mornye's case, she modified her Starstack to monitor the status of her prosthetic limbs, reply to work messages, pilot vehicles on autopilot, and command Hover Cannons to deliver Nutri-Packs—all without interrupting her train of thought.

title: Stridergate
content:
The Stridergate is a connective wormhole that formed when Lahai-Roi's Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris-3. Researchers in Lahai-Roi widely believe it leads to outer-space. A giant, overlying Soliskin root network in Bjartr Woods discovered by the Spacetrek Collective has expelled Aleph-1's power beyond the Stridergate, forming a sealed gateway that currently prevents the Threnodian's return.

However, due to the Stridegate keeping the Threnodian's fractured forms sealed on both sides of the Stridegates, the gate must not be opened lest Aleph-1 reunites its pieces and devours both Lahai-Roi and the world. Even so, Luuk states that the Collective still desire to open the gateway, so they’ve been creating Synchronists to use an Augmented Resonance to amplify the Exostrider's power, hoping that would keep the Threnodian suppressed.

title: Stridergate
content: The Grand Architect has damaged this seal some time in the past, allowing for Aleph-1's influence to reach into Lahai-Roi and ensnare Aemeath in the ancient battle outside the Stridergate.

title: Suan'ni
content:
Suan'nis are mythical beasts, possessing Resonance Abilities akin to those of human Resonators.

Having been driven to near extinction, Lingyang, going by the alias "Jingle Beast," is believed to be the last living Suan'ni.

title: Suan'ni
content:
The Suan'nis used to live under the giant Violet Banyan tree in the Dim Forest, far from human civilization. It is believed that Moon Lanterns on the Violet Banyan tree were hung by the Suan'nis, who yearned for light in the dark forest, even if it was only artificial.

Legends suggest that humans and Suan'ni used to have a closer relationship. The Suan'ni once led human troops in their battles against Tacet Discords, and were honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by humans. This inspired the Liondance, which continues to be practiced in Huanglong. This relationship was strained when the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish and Tacet Fields devoured their jungles.

title: Suan'ni
content: The Suan'nis were forced into human territories, causing significant conflicts due to their formidable powers and wild nature. This led to their reputation as dangerous and evil beings, as well as their near extinction.

title: Suan'ni
content: According to Fang Yizhi, Suan'ni are one of the , a set of mythological creatures whose imagery is used in certain types of decorations. Suan'ni are associated with incense burners and are fond of smoke and fire. They are often lion-like, sometimes with manes of fire or bodies of dragons.

At 2 stacks of Paradox, Suhsin the Inevitable's RES to all Attributes is reduced to 0.  It began as the underlying logic that ensured Xuanfang Hold would collapse according to schedule. When Hsin moved to overwrite that logic, it fought back and broke free, and the data it tore from the Civilization Capsule's lowest strata gave it a form close to the Sentinel as Hsin remembered. That likeness made Hsin waver, and in the deadlock that ensued, Hsin gave ground step by step. In the end it broke the last of Hsin's hold, and Suhsin the Inevitable descended into the world. Based on the overall chart profile, the individual possesses a grounded psychological core, exceptional emotional resilience, and a high degree of self-control.}}

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = The clouds hang heavy with coming rain, and mist rises slowly from the water... See? What do you make of the dewy sights today? When I do business in , I see weather like this often. A touch different from Xuanfang Hold, and nothing at all like the views in my hometown...  Perhaps each rainfall in this world has its own little temper. But it was this very drizzle splashing on teal stone slabs today that also fell on me decades ago. I heard its voice calling to me. And ever since, water has followed my will. It flows or rests at my command. And when I pluck the air just so, it comes to me, like an old friend.  Now I walk in the rain with no need for parasol or shelter. The raindrops know me, and I know them.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Speaking of hometowns, my mind wanders back to my childhood in . Everything felt so impossibly soothing in the March spring breeze—the high grass, the soaring birds, and each dawn less heavy than the last. I often dragged Yangyang out to fly kites. I can still feel the exact moment the wind would catch them, the line snapping taut as if we'd actually hooked a cloud. To ensure my kite soared higher than everyone else's, I'd run as fast as I could.  The courtyard was filled with the chatter of birds, the rustle of leaves, and the sunlight... Oh, how it filtered through the branches like shattered gold, dusting everything it touched. Even after all these years, that remains the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
|vo_01_02_mention            = Yangyang

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Springs back then—the wind oh so soft, the sky oh so blue, and a qin's melody oh so occasionally drifting over the courtyard wall. Our house never wanted for music. From dawn till dusk, it lilted through every hall and corner, enveloping me like running water. My parents, bless them, always knew I lacked the patience to sit at the qin and practice my technique. Yangyang, though, was my opposite. Even as a child, she could sit through an entire piece in perfect silence, her little hands tapping the rhythm against her knees with a solemn focus beyond her years. But me? I loved to slip away to some open ground and simply dance. A light tap of the foot, a swirl of the sleeves, and a well-timed gust of wind... In those moments it felt as if I could gather the very brilliance of nature into my arms. There was nothing more enjoyable than that.
|vo_01_03_mention            = Yangyang

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Beyond our courtyard lay an entirely different world. I was drawn to the docks, to the groan of ropes biting into wooden pilings as freighters moored, the shouts of vendors, and the rhythmic clack of abacus beads. To me, those sounds were more enchanting than any melody. I would crouch by the stalls and peer at ledgers, balancing accounts that weren't mine to balance or spreading out maps to correct a traveler's route. "This path is too long," I'd insist. "The river will save you two days." At first, the adults laughed it off as a child's game, until they realized I was right. My mother later joked to my father that perhaps their little girl had a natural gift for trade... Well, what do you think?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = At first, I only saw the bustle, the lovely noise of it all. It was only later that I came to see that "peace and prosperity" aren't a given. They're fragile things, held together only by those who tend them. I decided then to be such a person.  I love this land, but I love the life humming within it even more. I could never settle for the safety of a quiet corner while others struggle. Still, I know the limits of one person's strength. I have seen villages hollowed by disaster and people who have lost their homes—the kind of wounds that no shipment of supplies can ever quite heal. These are realities I simply cannot change alone.  Tell me... if the day comes to stake everything on the future of this land, will there be someone to help me weave the vision I see? What I want is a world alive and thriving, and in you, I see the possibility of making that real.  So, if you're willing... take this path with me.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Suisui's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Heh... the list grows longer by the day, I'm afraid. Lately, I've been quite obsessed with antiques and paintings. Even the little imitations from street stalls are fascinating in their own way, you know. There are certain tricks of the trade you only truly appreciate once you see them firsthand. I've even tried my hand at a few sketches. They're quite decent, if I do say so myself... Want to have a look?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Suisui's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Pastries, of course! Everything from the delicate pea flour cakes to those red bean rolls wrapped in white kidney bean paste. And then there are the soft, pillowy rice balls. Sweet without being cloying, simply melting on the tongue. I've also grown fond of the "Little Snowy Moons" here in . They have this wonderful, subtle aroma within that chewy cake texture, entirely different from the flavors back home. One day, I really must bring some back for my family to try.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Despite my time in , I still can't stomach the pickled local fare. It's a tragedy, truly. I'll see a dish that looks absolutely exquisite, translucent and perfectly plated, only to find I can't bring myself to take a bite. It's enough to make a grown woman sigh.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Dumpling, over here! See? Isn't she a delight? Dumpling has a marvelous affinity for water. She whirls and chirps around me whenever I use my Forte to bend the currents... Mm, that's all it takes to make this little birdie happy.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = My family always let me do as I pleased, but choosing the way of the merchant was never a simple impulse. It began with watching and learning—observing how the street vendors set their rules and negotiated their deals before I ever dared to try it myself.  Oh, to watch the figures on a ledger slowly change, trade routes rise from nothing, and the cargo passing through my hands become the grain, fabric, or medicine that keeps another soul alive... That, my dear, is worth more than all the gold in the world. Commerce, you see, is not about calculation. It's about making a way for people to live.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Yangyang
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all.  Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. My sister may look soft and unassuming, but there is a resilience in her that runs deeper than anyone realizes. When you need the wind, she brings it to you. When you face the gale, she stands as your shield. This, I've always known.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Yangyang

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_04_02_title              = About Hsin
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Hsin.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = Unlike the other s of , Hsin doesn't feel like a divinity looking down from on high. Somehow, I see a part of her that's unmistakably "human." Maybe it's because I know how much she loves this mortal world that I dared to stand before her.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Hsin

|vo_04_03_title              = About Qingxiao
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Qingxiao.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = One of my merchant caravans once spoke of a Transcendent who killed the Tacet Discords blocking their path through Xuanfang. That was Paragon Qingxiao. Between that debt and the support she provided during the Hold's defense, I felt it only right to thank her in person. With proper gifts, of course. But she wouldn't accept a thing. She only sat for a few cups of the tea I brewed. Wait, a tea favored by the famed Transcendent... Now that could be quite the selling point, no?
|vo_04_03_mention            = Qingxiao

|vo_04_04_title              = About Jingran
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Jingran.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = The Cat of the Nether Lamp… the rumors make him sound like a ghost story. A figure in black, drifting through shadows with a Nether Lamp and the chill of the netherworld clinging to him. I've only met him a few times. Despite his youth, his eyes have the look of someone who has weathered storms that would break lesser men. He is utterly uninhibited, and it makes me curious: is there anything in this world that could actually hold him back?
|vo_04_04_mention            = Jingran

|vo_04_04_mention            = Jingran

|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Mother.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = People know her as a master composer, but to me, she remains that gentle presence on the porch, pulling my sister and me into her arms on rainy days to tell us stories of the world beyond. I was always pressing her for what came next, while Yangyang would just watch her in quiet, wide-eyed wonder. Hehe, I suppose that was the rhythm of our childhood.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Yangyang

|vo_04_06_file               = {character}{language} About Father.ogg
|vo_04_06_tx                 = You couldn't find a more open-minded man in this world than my father. A teacher by trade, but never, ever the lecturing sort. He has a gift for tossing out witty lines with such ease that even the dullest classics become engrossing tales. I always laugh out loud over his letters. He writes with such flair that events happening a thousand miles away become just next door's news in his hands. Oh, you'll just have to see for yourself when you visit our home in  someday. Beautiful views, and I promise, the best tea you'll ever taste.
|vo_04_06_mention            =

|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Today is your birthday. Oh, naturally, I've had it marked.  I thought about organizing a grand banquet for you, the kind where the table bends under all those dishes and nobody is allowed to leave. But then it occurred to me that sort of merrymaking can be arranged anytime. Today, you should follow your own heart. Whether that means a lively crowd or a quiet corner with no one to disturb you, I'll make sure you get it. On a day like this, you're allowed to be a little selfish.  I'm a terribly "greedy" creature, I admit. I believe the best days ought to be savored slowly, and the sweetest meetings enjoyed long after the party ends. The world is vast and time is long. Whether you want a hall full of delicacies or just a quiet cup of tea, you need only ask me.  May every year be as bright as today. May you always follow your heart, and may every road you walk lead to the light.

|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I

|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = In the misty rains of Mengzhou, most people reach for their oil-paper umbrellas or scurry under the nearest eaves. But I don't mind the wet. I stroll leisurely through the rain while the droplets simply curve around my shoulders and drift away to find somewhere else to fall.... So stay close to me, darling. We've no use for umbrellas here.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = I think the most precious thing in this world is the light that meets your eyes the moment you raise them. The first break of dawn, the river's surface glistening with flecks of gold, as fishing boats drift in small clusters to the rhythmic creak of oars. Then the markets stir. Bamboo lids lift, unfurling white breaths of steam carrying the scent of fresh buns. It mingles with the teahouses' distant melodies and the laughter of children at play... I don't just hear these sounds now. I feel the pulse behind them. A pulse threading together to form a rich tapestry that I cannot bear to lose.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = People speak of commerce as if it's just buying and selling. But if you look closer, every trade route ends at someone's front door. Grain from the north. Tea from the south. Herbs from the mountains. Fabrics from the shores. Someone has to thread it all together, like a needle pulling a string, mending one land's scarcity with another's abundance.  These quiet exchanges are what have kept the world moving for generations. Water can wear down stone, or it can nourish a garden. Commerce can chase profit, or it can save a world. It's the path I've chosen.

Sumika
content: Sumika  is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands and a former Bloom Bearer for the Black Shores.

title: Sumika
content:
Once an elite Bloom Bearer of The Black Shores, Sumika went M.I.A many years prior due to her being trapped inside Chronorift Metropolis and was never found despite search and rescue efforts.

Based on the time dilation experienced by Chisa and Sumika's notes, Sumika was trapped in the Sonoro Sphere for 160 days (5 months and 20 days). This is the equivalent to around 50-something years, as Chisa's 2 months within Honami was twenty years in the real world.

title: Sumika
content: Sumika was a Resonator, her Forte allowing her to create amber that store memories or moments in time within them. Interacting with the amber allows others to see the information Sumika recorded within.

title: Sybilla
content:
Sybilla: Did I just see fish swimming by...?
[Dialogue Option]  I saw it too.
Sybilla: Oh my!
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry, did I scare you?
Sybilla: My apologies, honored guest. It's just that the atmosphere in the mansion at night... well, I'm not as brave as Fiore.
Sybilla: Probably just the shadow of some deep-sea fish kept somewhere in the mansion... Yes, that must be it!
[Dialogue Option]  Is this part of the Fisalia's family business?
Sybilla: Well, this is a recent side venture of ours. Our main business is still gathering deep-sea plants and extracting their essences to make medicines.
Sybilla: We've practically cornered the potion trade in Ragunna and Septimont.
Sybilla: You know, I overheard someone say there are... unexpected discoveries to be made while gathering the plants.
[Dialogue Option]  Unexpected discoveries?
Sybilla: That's right. Some of them are shipwrecks mentioned in old records. Salvage something like that, well...
Sybilla: Let's just say you could fetch an amount I'm not allowed to disclose. Heh.

title: TD Observatory
content: TD Observatory is an area of Black Shores Archipelago, The Black Shores. The TD Observatory is where Black Shores stores Tacet Discord data gathered from around the world. The data will then be converted into digital Reverberations and transferred to the Tethys System underground as the building blocks of the data space within the Infinite Reality Sandbox.

title: Takuma
content:
Takuma: It's so late. Why don't we just cut across the Round Square?

Kenichi: No way. Haven't you heard the rumor? "Anyone who walks straight through the Round Square fails a course by semester's end."

Takuma: That's superstition! Science can explain that!

Kenichi: You go then. I'd rather take the long way than tempt fate.

[Dialogue Option]  Or maybe...

title: Takuma
content:
Kenichi: You go then. I'd rather take the long way than tempt fate.

[Dialogue Option]  Or maybe...



[Dialogue Option]  It's just to keep students from trampling the lawn?
Kenichi: Well, a student was caught cutting straight through once, and TARD-E deducted their credits…
Kenichi: You're saying, like how trash cans can't have trash, or cups can't sit on the lab table… It's just another school rule turned into a "paranormal rule"?
[Dialogue Option]  Or there's a Sonoro hiding under the Academy?
Kenichi: I have heard strange entrances sometimes do appear... They say it's from the Academy's atmosphere and student stress. If that  is  a Sonoro...
Kenichi: Then maybe our fear of failing created another Sonoro under the square? Then its frequency messes with their heads and makes them underperform during exams...

title: Takuma
content:
Takuma: See? Even a freshman gets it better than you! You're… Rover, right? I like that skeptical, inquisitive spirit. You're alright!

Takuma: Anyway, this is still the shortest path back to the dorms. So, are we cutting across or not? If we wait any longer, we'll trigger another rule—"Never return to the dorm after midnight."

Kenichi: Or else what?

Takuma: Or else the next morning, you won't be able to move a muscle, like a hundred Hurriclaws sat on you all night. Only the world's most disgusting Energizing Gel can save you.

Kenichi: ...Isn't that just what it feels like if you're sleep-deprived and overslept?!

title: Tanchuan
content: is a Lollo Logistic NPC located in . After helping Yinyu dilemma, Tanchuan finds new motivation to continue their work.

title: Tanchuan
content:
[Objective: (Talk to again after helping Yinyu)]
Tanchuan: I must thank you.
[Dialogue Option]  What for?
Tanchuan: I saw how much the local girl you helped has blossomed. You know, the one named Yinyu. She's now a famous guide in Hongzhen.
Tanchuan: Her story doesn't have much to do with me, but I'm truly motivated by her growth.
Tanchuan: When Lollo Logistics decided to expand into Mt. Firmament, I volunteered for the job, only to run headlong into a bunch of messy problems.
Tanchuan: I even considered transferring back to Jinzhou or quitting altogether.
Tanchuan: But then I saw Yinyu making us locals proud and building herself quite a name as a guide.
Tanchuan: And it made me think, maybe I could ship Mt. Firmament's specialties to Jinzhou using Lollo Logistics and help local sellers reach new markets.
Tanchuan: I don't know if it will work, but Mt. Firmament is a different animal. Instead of sticking to traditional logistics services, it might be better to incorporate some local flavor.
Tanchuan: I won't be quitting anytime soon, at least.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi, a mature Resonator with a laid-back personality, exudes a sense of understanding and protection.

She patiently listens to others' troubles and offers guidance with calm deliberation. Though she carries a relaxed and gentle aura, she becomes determined and resolute when making promises. This has earned her the role of a dependable big sister figure, despite her age.

Taoqi's lazy nature is evident in her lifestyle — she always carries a heating eye mask for impromptu naps on soft surfaces like beds or sofas. She loves dozing off while leaning on her friends' shoulders.

File:Taoqi Profile Reveal.png

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Known as a trustworthy and caring big sister, Taoqi is often sought out for advice. From career to relationship issues, people confide in her, leading some to label her the "Gossip Queen."

In fact, Taoqi simply listens and observes, offering guidance to those who seek it. She has no interest in spreading rumors or using others' words for entertainment, instead focusing on helping them solve their problems.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi believes in maintaining a clear boundary between work and personal life for success.

Nothing stops Taoqi from getting off work on time. Once she clocks out, she is unreachable and colleagues only find her notes. She would be in the comfort of her home, organizing the day's tasks while resting on her trusty Peachy Turtle pillow. She will not fall asleep until she has made sure everything is in order.

At work, Taoqi excels in efficiency and attention to detail, earning a reputation for reliability among her colleagues. Her ultimate dream is a future with less work and more relaxation. But for now, she remains dedicated to protecting the city of Jinzhou. Until her goal is achieved, Taoqi will continue her vigilant approach to safeguarding the community and ensuring peaceful days for all.

File:Taoqi Chibi.png

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi is known for her slow and deliberate movements. However, this same quality has made her a strong and dependable protector.

As a child, she faced bullying for her pace but found solace in those who patiently waited for her. As she grew up, she eventually found her strength in slowness to protect the ones she cherished.

As an adult, Taoqi uses keen observation and thoughtful planning to safeguard the people of Jinzhou. Her deliberate nature is not a weakness; instead, it has allowed her to establish a reliable defense system for the city.

Though not one for frontline battles, she diligently works in the background, orchestrating defense strategies and supporting civilians. Her strength lies in bringing peace to chaotic situations and protecting those she cares for.

But when needed, Taoqi can hold her own in combat with skill and precision.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content: As a reassuring presence in the team, Taoqi excellently assumes the responsibility of the protector. Much of her ability goes under her unique defense mechanisms. Use her ability wisely, and then every member of the team will be protected.

title: Tar
content:
Ziegler: Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
Tar: ...What are you on about now?
Ziegler: I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
Ziegler: Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
Ziegler: I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
Ziegler: So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
Tar: I think...
Ziegler: It's great?
Tar: No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
Ziegler: You think I'm joking, don't you?
Tar: Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
Tar: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
Ziegler: Not really.
Tar: If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
Ziegler: But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
Tar: You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!

title: Tethys Hub
content: Tethys Hub is an area of Black Shores Archipelago, The Black Shores. An archipelago shrouded in the Stormy Sea of Solaris. Formed from Tacetites, these isles constantly emanate Remnant Energy, casting an eerie "mist" that envelopes the region. This mist distorts human perception and jams all forms of communication, making the archipelago inaccessible to most. Only those recognized or invited by the Black Shores can navigate their way to this mysterious place.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The frequencies emitted by the Tacetites disrupt standard communication signals. Communication with the outside world is only possible via the Black Shores' Beacon relay system.

title: Tethys Hub
content: Amidst the lingering mist and blake blooms, this is where newcomers first set foot upon their arrival.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The grand hall of the Black Shores where foreign envoys are received. It also functions as the administrative hub that manages the region's affairs.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The glass conservatory perched at the highest point of the Black Shores. An impressive collection of plant specimens from across the world thrives within its walls. Every newcomer, Bloom Bearer or Consultant, is invited to contribute a seed from their homeland. At the heart of this verdant sanctuary, a unique modulation device sits encircled by flowers representing diverse civilizations. Each plant in the Greenhouse speaks the unspoken hopes of its sower. Some of these seeds come from lands erased by the Lament, standing as the last living memory of places that no longer exist.

title: Tethys Hub
content: An unremarkable tree with a sign that reads "Money Tree." Rumor has it that watering it precisely at eight past eight in the morning will grant you extra funds for your ventures.

title: Tethys' Deep
content: Nestled in Tethys' Deep, KU-Roro Charging Station is where KU-Roros (aka Tethys Terminals) return to recharge and "rest" when their energy reserves run low.

title: Tethys' Deep
content:
These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetite that makes up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors drew inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design. In the Black Shores, reality and data intertwine as one. Through this connection, we explore the many paths by which civilizations may endure.

title: Tethys' Deep
content:
On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future. The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end. It is a location exclusively accessible by Rover and Shorekeeper.

title: Tetragon Temple
content: Tetragon Temple, more commonly known as The Tetragon, is a faction consisting of the Priestesses of Septimont. It is founded by the Head Priestess Lillibet and currently led by Iuno. The Temple is responsible for handling and delivering prophecies (one of the most notable being the "Hero of Heroes" prophecy) typically through the Book of Prophecies or murals within the temple.

title: Tetragon Temple
content:
Hero of Heroes - The legendary ruler of Septimont. The legend traces its roots to an ancient prophecy that only the one who becomes the Hero of Heroes can save Septimont from falling into ruin.
Book of Prophecies - A scroll Lillibet carries, recording visions glimpsed in the flame light. Both this book and the murals within Tetragon Temple are media through which the Priestesses of Septimont convey prophecies to the people.

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder is one of the Heliodic Six members and makes his first appearance inside the Elysium in .

After completing Ode to the Second Sunrise, The Binder is freed from his duties and can be found Starward Riseway at .

title: The Binder
content: The Binder: The next stop is...

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder: Startorch Academy... Sundermere... Nice places, they are. The Spacetrek Collective's public transport is very convenient...

[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?

The Binder: The old Horstvald was indeed the Binder of the Six. But now, a wandering old man I'd rather be.

[Dialogue Option]   What brings you here?

The Binder: Observing this and that, as was my dream. In my youth, a traveler I always wished to be.

The Binder: After your Spacetrek Collective launched Helios into the sky, lighter grew the burden in the Solisylum. "No longer stay confined," the Shaper told us. "For the Royan governance and the new season laws, gather knowledge," he said.

The Binder: But we knew his true wish. It was for us, who had given our lives to the Solisylum, to finally go out and see the world.

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder: But we knew his true wish. It was for us, who had given our lives to the Solisylum, to finally go out and see the world.



The Binder: So here I am, an old man riding the train. I look upon the Academy, listen to the market's noise, speak with different souls... and in their faces, their joys and worries I observe.

The Binder: And what I observe... to the Shaper, I will carry.

;The seat turnover rate...

[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
The Chronicler: Greetings, Arbiter from the chronicles. I am Eivind the Chronicler. For your aid in the Solisylum, our deep gratitude you have.
The Chronicler: Since the Spacetrek Collective launched Helios, the Heliogyre is no longer our sole observational tool. From pure computation, we are freed. Our attention may turn to other significant realms.
[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
The Chronicler: Research. For Roya under the new sun, new Lahai-Roi season laws are required. Local diets, their social rhythms... Yes, all precious first-hand data.
The Chronicler: Look at those mingling at shared tables. Their conversations, food preferences, and even body language... they paint a portrait of present society.
The Chronicler: Subtle data, this. For the Heliogyre to quantify, difficult. But important to the drafting of new season laws and their guiding procedures.
The Chronicler: As Chronicler, I will report my thoughts and observations back to the Shaper. Such services can still be of use to him.

title: The Excellency
content:
The Excellency is an NPC who is first mentioned during .

They are one of the Overseers of the Fractsidus, though their exact identity is currently unknown.

title: The Excellency
content:
Although not explicitly confirmed, the Excellency is very likely to be the Fractsidus member mentioned in the diary written by Wuli, described as a strange man in red with a pretentious attitude whom he encountered someplace outside of Huanglong. Having somehow known that Wuli was traveling in search of a cure for his girlfriend Fuling's condition, he claimed to have a way to save her, and sent Wuli to Mt. Firmament to help them find the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game.

Although the Excellency later enters the Sonoro Sphere containing the Temporal Program at some point, they are indirectly injured as Changli destroys it with her flame manipulation Forte. They manage to evade capture as well as identification.

title: The Excellency
content: Due to his authority as an Overseer, The Excellency is suspectedly theorized to be the "uncle" of Qichi Village (who is responsible for the gruesome experiment to his niece fused with a Tacet Discord), which makes him one of The Shepherd's possible identities alongside Phrolova.

title: The Farwatcher
content:
The Farwatcher was one of nine interstellar probes launched by the Pre-Lament Civilization in the time before the Etheric Sea enveloped Solaris during the first Lament 10,000 years ago. Although it had been continuously transmitting information of the galaxies it travelled through back to Solaris for millennia, as the Etheric Sea blocks all contact between Solaris and the outside world, these signals failed to reach their creators.

The Exostrider would later pick up on these signals, recording them and burning them into a cassette which would be gifted to Rover and the people of Lahai-Roi during Starlights from Yesterdays.

As one of the nine interstellar probes launched in ancient humanity's spacefaring era, the Farwatcher is represented as one of the nine stars in the logo of the Spacetrek Collective.

title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
"The sprawling, secret-filled lands of Lahai-Roi made it necessary for the Spacetrek Collective to establish mid-to-long-term field research programs. However, sustaining these operations in such dangerous terrain required dependable mobile bases.

After weighing its options, the Collective developed a versatile transport platform capable of handling logistics, storage, and emergency defense. They named it Spacetrek Explorer.

The Explorer's design is based on a wheel robot. Its massive tires provide exceptional grip, allowing it to climb smooth vertical surfaces and easily navigate the dense architecture of Startorch Academy, delivering cargo to otherwise inaccessible locations. The large storage container mounted on its top further supports fieldwork, enabling researchers to access supplies or auxiliary equipment directly on-site.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
To defend against the Exoswarm affected by the Waveworn Phenomenon and attacks from Outcasts, the Explorer is equipped with a heavy electromagnetic cannon and a protective shield projector. However, due to its weight, frequent cargo load, and energy-saving design, it carries only small thrusters. These are useful for brief bursts of acceleration, but not for sustained flight.

In addition to field expeditions, the Spacetrek Explorer now serves as one of Lahai-Roi's primary heavy logistics vehicles. In its logistics configuration, its weapons are removed and replaced with expanded storage modules to maximize cargo capacity."

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
"…In short, developing high-performance combat mechs had become a pressing need.

The project was assigned to a pair of twin researchers: an older sister who was bold and daring, and a younger sister who was quiet and steady. Their personalities shaped the Twin Nova series they created.

The melee model, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, engages with fast and aggressive actions, while its ranged counterpart, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, prefers to stay back and provide support. Their very names embody the Spacetrek Collective's mission: to descend into the unknown as they continue to reach for the stars.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
The idea of building the mechs in pairs began as something almost poetic. The Threnodian of Void, Aleph-1, erases individuals from memory, and the twins couldn't imagine a world where they might forget each other. They hoped their creations, at least, would always have a companion and never face that silence alone. While Aleph-1's influence may not extend to inorganic matter, this sentiment became the emotional core of the Twin Nova project.

This philosophy also influenced their form. The Collective opted for humanoid frames to symbolize humanity's presence on the frontier. Rumor has it the design also helps them seem less intimidating when serving as security at Startorch Academy, and perhaps caters to a few researchers' personal tastes.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
An autonomous tactical intelligence model was built for the units. However, with little combat data available in the Collective, the sisters had to pilot the prototypes themselves to generate the initial data. Their influence made the Twin Nova units move with a graceful, almost showy flair, a style that is sometimes more artistic than practical.

Now, with the accumulating real combat data, the models continue to evolve. The melee unit leads the charge and breaks through enemy lines, while the ranged unit coordinates with human teams, offering support fire and protecting the formation."

The Lifer is an NPC that can be found in Oakheart Highcourt, Fagaceae Peninsula, Huanglong. It is a Chop Chop Echo trapped to play a board game eternally.

title: The Recorder
content:
The Recorder is one of the Heliodic Six members and makes her first appearance in Ode to the Second Sunrise.

After completing , The Recorder is freed from her duties and can be found at Spacetrek Archive at the Freight Zone level at

She speaks in third person and refers to The Shaper by name rather than title.

title: The Recorder
content:
;Rinascita... the Carnevale... Gondolas... Gladiator battles...
The Recorder: Laetia has finished reading the history of Rinascita. Next, a book about Huanglong she will read.
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
The Recorder: Yes. The Recorder is Laetia's other name.
[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
The Recorder: Isander (The Shaper) remains in the Solisylum, computing the sun's properties. So Laetia has come here, to compute the properties of humankind.
The Recorder: Isander (The Shaper) wishes to know how people from different places mark time, how they celebrate festivities... This knowledge extends beyond Lahai-Roi, and thus beyond Isander's ken.
The Recorder: Therefore, Laetia the Recorder is here to read the world and record what she sees. To Isander, she will carry these stories.
The Recorder: That way, alone with the Heliogyre he will not be. What Laetia sees, he too shall see.

The Refiner: We convey to the Shaper things that the Solisylum readings cannot fully capture.

title: The Shaper
content: The Shaper , also known as Isander, is a quest-exclusive NPC that makes his first appearance in . He later reappears during .

title: The Shaper
content: He is a member of the Heliodic Six and oversees the Heliogyre within the Solisylum. He has a calm demeanor and puts his responsibility as the Heliodic Six above everything.

title: The Shaper
content:
[Objective: Complete the following]
You see the Shaper bathed in the Heliogyre's radiance, silent as an inanimate vessel. As you prepare to speak to him, he slowly opens his eyes.
"The Shaper": To lay eyes on you once more, Arbiter, is a pleasure.
"The Shaper": The Heliogyre has shown me that the Spacetreck Collective's ceremony was a success. To you and your companions, my congratulations I offer.
"The Shaper": If questions remain for me, or the Heliogyre. I, the Shaper, shall answer.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about the Solisylum.
"The Shaper": Because of your aid, the Heliogyre turns anew. The Solisylum has returned to normality.
"The Shaper": The Helios in the sky now weaves together wisdom from both the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Data once seen only by the Heliogyre... now the Hyvatia Detector may also obtain.
"The Shaper": The Heliogyre's operations stand ready to perform primary verificiation tasks.
"The Shaper":  Thus, in the Solisylum, I alone am sufficient.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about the remaining Five.
"The Shaper": After your authorization, the Heliogyre has concentrated all of its computational power within me. No longer do the Six need to bear those immense calculations in parallel, at all times.
"The Shaper": Now, the other Five may devote their energies to managing Royan affairs. Under the new sun, the Roya need new season laws.
"The Shaper": For this, I require them to gather outside knowledge. With this, I will weave into my own computations.
"The Shaper": Iselde (The Eye)'s perception, Horstvald (the Binder)'s foresight, Laetia (the Recorder)'s curiosity, Eivind (the Chronicler)'s discipline, and Freamir (the Refiner)'s empathy... they are the Heliogyre's senses in the world. And to the Solisylum, they will return their findings.
"The Shaper": Before they entered the Solisylum, the Heliodic Six were but mere mortals.
"The Shaper": Now they enjoy some time to lay down their burden. I hope... their lives will unfold as they wish. At least for the time being.
"The Shaper": If you see them in Lahai-Roi, please, as a witness, offer them your blessing.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about him.
"The Shaper": All of the Heliogyre's computational power is now concentrated within me. Wherever the sunlight touches, so too do my thoughts.
[Dialogue Option]  But this is not without cost.
"The Shaper": ...
"The Shaper": As you once said... I am now bound to the Heliogyre's will. From the Solisylum, I cannot depart.
"The Shaper": Human flesh and blood were not made to bear such vast quantitites of information in so short a span. Should this continue, my body's decay will quicken tenfold until electricity within my nerves ceases... and a final computation concludes.
"The Shaper": Yet... the Spacetrek Collective already seeks a remedy. Just as the Heliodic Six with mortal strength touched the divine, so too does their technology strive to undo the toll the gods have exacted upon me.
"The Shaper": I believe in them. Just as I have always believed in the Roya.
"The Shaper": In the future where the light shines brighter, we will one day witness together.
[Dialogue Option]  I have no more questions.
"The Shaper": Goodbye, Arbiter.
"The Shaper": Do not forget that all the knowledge of the Heliogyre is mine to share with you. Should you have need, I will respond.

title: The Shaper
content:
Laetia - The Recorder
Iselde - The Eye
Horstvald - The Binder
Freamir - The Refiner
Eivind - Freamir
Yngvar - Former Successor

title: Tianhe
content:
Tianhe: It seems like my leg really doesn't hurt anymore...
Tianhe: Huh? I'm sorry, is there anything I can help you with?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you injured?
Tianhe: Uh... Yes, the Tacet Discord in Norfall Barrens is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
Tianhe: Last week, we, the defenders, successfully repelled ten attacks from the Tacet Discord. It's already good that I only have these minor injuries.
Tianhe: But luckily, General Jiyan is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.",
[Dialogue Option]  Jiyan?
Tianhe: Yes, that day he noticed that my legs seemed a bit strange after standing for a long time, and he quickly brought me ointment.
Tianhe: I don't know how he could see the symptoms at a glance, and I didn't expect him to pay attention to such small details...
Tianhe: He took the time to personally deliver the medicine and told me how to take care of myself. Look, I'm already jumping around now. It's amazing, isn't it?!
Tianhe: Hehe, I didn't expect him to be such a caring person.

title: Tommaso
content: Tommaso is an musician from Ragunna, Rinascita. His Echo is an Aria Mummer named Melody.

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso: Oh... my soulmate, my king of inspiration... what has happened to you...

Melody: *Buzz—buzz—whirr—clickety-clack—*

[Dialogue Option]  What seems to be wrong with this Echo?

Tommaso Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.

[Dialogue Option]  Oh my gosh, it's starting to transform!

Tommaso Transform? Melody can't do that, I'm afraid... Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.

Tommaso Melody possesses the ability to capture every melody it hears and orchestrate its surrounding "Melody Ensemble" to replay them.

Tommaso I have known Melody for many years, and it is thanks to its presence that I can savor these fleeting melodies, with an endless stream of inspiration flowing to me each day.

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso We often venture out together to gather inspirations, but lately, with preparations for the Carnevale, I've been caught up and had to leave Melody to handle it alone in the city.

Tommaso Once I finally finished my work, I realized Melody had already ended up like this...

Melody: *Buzz—buzz buzz—whimper—*

Tommaso It can no longer perform entire melodies. Even its voice shows signs of "distortion"... Melody... without you, how am I supposed to live?

[Dialogue Option]  Maybe it's because it has listened to too many different things...

[Dialogue Option]  All work and no play makes even the sharpest mind dull...

Tommaso Sure... It seems likely... Ah, my friend, judging by your posture and attire, you must be a seasoned adventurer.

Tommaso Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?



Tommaso Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...

Tommaso Oh... oh! Yes! This is the sound Melody was meant to have! This... this is true music!

Tommaso Thank you! Traveler from afar! This… "Melody Box" in your hands, where did you find it? Such wondrous music, captured on a tiny disc like this...

[Dialogue Option]  Just a stroke of luck.

[Dialogue Option]  Adapted from True Experiences.

[Dialogue Option]  I am merely a porter in this world.

Tommaso Hmm... So, what you're saying is, these are the things you've gathered through countless adventures in this vast world? Like a... response from the world to you?

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso I once heard a saying: All the music in this world is prewritten by the divine, scattered across the land. It is the duty of musicians to discover and record them.

Tommaso It seems Melody and I should venture beyond Ragunna City and explore the wider world.

Tommaso In the cacophony of the world's sounds, the lifelong challenge for every musician is to distill the purest melodies... and "Aria Mummers" are no exception.

Tommaso Perhaps within Rinascita, you may encounter other "Aria Mummers." They might be facing similar challenges.

Tommaso I have always believed, alongside Melody, that great music has the power to touch others and inspire change.

Tommaso During your adventure, if you happen to gather other "Melody Boxes," please lend a hand to the other "Aria Mummers" as well.

Tommaso Please accept these as a token of my gratitude for your help!

title: Tornatore
content: Tornatore is a scriptwriter who appears next to Ragunna's Pioneer Association, after the completion of Carlotta Companion Quest; If On a Rainy Night a Family.

title: Tornatore
content:
Tornatore: "The rain poured relentlessly, cloaking the world in a shroud of gloom, stripping away its pretense of grandeur to reveal its barren core."

Tornatore: "Under the storm's shadow, people were fighting at each other's throats—fragile yet ferocious, like... like beasts cornered in a cage." No, no, Tornatore, that's far too trite! Think, man! You can craft something better!

Tornatore: You're the playwright of this drama. Give it an ending that lingers, and echo that won't fade!

Tornatore: "As she fell, her trembling hand raised the gun. The old acquiantance, a traitor to his ideals, stared down the barrel. One last shot. Addio." Hmm, does that come across too... passive?

title: Tornatore
content:
Tornatore: Ah, I see. Rumors, ripe and waiting, a wellspring of inspiration at my fingertips. Let's see... "Can I really trust him? She wondered. Yet instinct urged her forward. She clasped him hand firmly, then turned her back, offering it wholly to her new companion." Yes, yes, that has promise!

The creator in front of you is completely consumed by the tale of storm and betrayal he's spinning. Perhaps it's best to let him remain in his trance.

title: Troy
content: Troy is a male NPC who appears at the bar in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. He can be seen talking to Andrius during the daytime.

title: Troy
content:
Andrius: You should know that people from Rinascita place a high value on family honor and kinship.
Andrius: Without an influential family behind you, it's nearly impossible to rise in Ragunna.
Andrius: But the Montellis are different. We believe opportunities multiply when they're shared. Money means nothing unless it's in circulation.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you a Montelli?
Andrius: Of course! That's why we get to sit here.
Troy: I want to be rich too! I want people to be in awe whenever they speak my name! I'll make the most of this opportunity!
Andrius: Then go for it! Do whatever it takes to earn your status and honor.
Andrius: These things won't just fall into your lap—they're up to you to pursue.
Andrius: If you share my belief, I promise that serving the Montelli family will not leave you wanting.
Andrius: Shall we toast?
Troy: C-can I?
Andrius: Of course! I might be your employer, I prefer to see us as partners.
Troy: W-well, cheers, then!

Tuanjin: And as you can see, there are lots of seniors here. If anything happens, I'll be around to help out.

title: Tulio
content: Tulio is an NPC located in . He is a member of the Servitude Hall in the Order of the Deep. After the third interaction with him, he can be found in Fool's Elysium until talked to, after which he leaves the Fool's Elysium by boat.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Tulio: Light of Genesis, please purify these lost souls...
[Dialogue Option]  Lost souls?
Tulio: Hello, I am Tulio, a member of the Servitude Hall of the Order of the Deep.
Tulio: Within the realm of Rinascita, once the frequency of Tacet Discord is dispersed, the remaining Reverberation, if not collected over time, will gradually be absorbed by the Data Bank of the Genesis Nexus, subsequently becoming a frequency sample for Common Echoes.
Tulio: Therefore, we believe Tacet Discords and Echoes are essentially the same. Tacet Discords are simply wayward, fallen " Divine Envoys Common Echoes  ".
Tulio: The function of the Servitude Hall is to regularly purge the Tacet Discords around Ragunna City, maintain the surrounding safety, and expand the frequency reserves within the Genesis Nexus Data Bank.
Tulio: We also believe this will allow Tacet Discords to receive the Sentinel's "initiation and purification," enabling them to return to the embrace of the divine, once again becoming  Divine Envoys Common Echoes   to assist humanity.
Tulio: The gourd you're wearing is a Reserved Terminal, correct? Oh, don't worry. I'm not here to inspect your Terminal.
Tulio: The Servitude Hall oversees the distribution of Reserved Terminals within the region and manages foreign Reserved Terminals.
Tulio: Your Terminal has passed approval and certification, but its unique appearance made it particularly memorable among the applications.
Tulio: I want to remind you that recent Tacet Discord activities outside Ragunna City have increased. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Second interaction)]
Tulio: Hello again. I'm placing some frequency samples from Vitreum Dancers.
Tulio: Vitreum Dancer's frequency originates from the stained glass windows in the ruins. Some scholars believe that their frequencies contain a portion of history related to the Sentinel.
Tulio: Recently, some questions regarding the history of Rinascita—specifically a prophecy concerning Napoli the Second, the first Primus—have surfaced, sparking considerable debate among scholars.
Tulio: Scholars want more frequency samples for analysis. And with the sea of clouds... things have been unsteady, so the Servitude Hall has extended "operations" to Nimbus Sanctum.
[Dialogue Option]  You look a bit tired.
[Dialogue Option]  The workload at the Servitude Hall isn't easy.
Tulio: While undertaking tasks in Nimbus Sanctum, we often have to ascend and descend through the cloud tunnels of the sea of clouds. That sense of weightlessness is not a pleasant experience.
Tulio: But every time I see these Vitreum Dancers, I can't help but marvel at the Sentinel's power over all creation... to bring such wonders to the people, to show His miracles—that is my mission.
Tulio: Their every move reflects a mesmerizing radiance, exuding a beauty of resilience and grace that emerges from transformation.
Tulio: And with its elegant yet agile demeanor, it's no wonder the Montelli family favors them as personal guards.
Tulio: If you're planning to travel to Nimbus Sanctum soon, it's safer to set sail during the day.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Third Interaction)]
Tulio: Ah, it's you. How many times have we met now? Truly a sign of fate.
Tulio: This time, I'm introducing some frequency samples of the Fae Ignis.
Tulio: Fae Ignis... it's supposed to only appear around Penitent's End, yet lately, sightings report them gathering at the Hallowed Reach.
Tulio: The Servitude Hall members have been dispatched to handle this matter, but so far, we haven't reached any solid conclusions...
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to have a lot on your mind.
[Dialogue Option]  You look like you've got dark circles under your eyes.
Tulio: Fae Ignis is particularly drawn to fiery frequencies. The candles on the Isle burn constantly; with their nature, there's no way they'd leave for no reason.
Tulio: Perhaps... something secretive is happening in Penitent's End... I worry that this anomaly might impact all Common Echoes, even threatening the safety of the people.
Tulio: ...If large-scale Fae Ignis migrations happen again, I'll have to go to the Isle to investigate.
Tulio: When you're out in the wild, be cautious. There are strange currents beneath the sea... Ragunna's high tide season is coming early this year.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Found at Troupe of Fools)]
Tulio: Sigh, what should we do...
[Dialogue Option]  Acolyte Tulio, you're still alive!
[Dialogue Option]  Acolyte Tulio, what are you doing here?
Tulio: It's truly fortunate to encounter you here.
Tulio: Earlier, I went alone to the Grave Isle to investigate the truth behind the migration of the Fae Ignis, only to unexpectedly encounter an attack by a dragon on the island.
Tulio: In a moment of crisis, it was the members of the Troupe of Fools who saved me and brought me back to life.
[Dialogue Option]  You should be grateful to them.
[Dialogue Option]  You should feel happy about that.
Tulio: I understand... but did you know, everyone here... they're all... lost souls...
[Dialogue Option]  But you, too, were saved by those lost souls.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean? Please be clear.
Tulio: Pilgrimage... Fools... it all aligns. I merely went from purgatory to hell...
Tulio: I may know much about Tacet Discords and Echoes but about people... I know nothing...
Tulio: Do you  think... they saved me to eat me? Judging by their food quality, it wouldn't be surprising...
Tulio: No, no... I mustn't keep talking. If they realize I know their secret...
Tulio: I must come up with a plan... to escape from here...

title: Tulio
subsection: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)
content:
[Objective: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)]
Claudio: Ah... of all days, why'd he pick such awful weather...
[Dialogue Option] : Acolyte Tulio, what are you doing here?
Claudio: A member witnessed the Acolyte secretly sailing away from the stronghold alone at night.
Claudio: We can understand why Order members don't recognize us... it's understandable if they leave.
Claudio: But... ah, with this weather... fog all around, and the storm is closing in.
Claudio: I hope the Sentinel's blessings see him safely ashore...
