title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
|text3         = To some extent, there isn’t much difference between the sixteen-year-old Yangyang and the six-year-old Yangyang.



She still holds the same expectations for the world, believing in fairy tales as always, believing in the goodness between people, believing in miracles, believing that all things beautiful will eventually happen.

Many would call this naive luck, the thoughts of a spoiled child who has never faced the harsh realities of life.

Indeed, Yangyang grew up in a privileged and nurturing home, shielded from suffering. Her life was perfect...

...Until that fateful day.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Indeed, Yangyang grew up in a privileged and nurturing home, shielded from suffering. Her life was perfect...

...Until that fateful day.



At age 11, her tranquil life was shattered by a ruthless attack from Exiles while traveling with her family’s caravan. The brutal reality of death and cruelty left her reeling as she fled and sought refuge among strangers in an unfamiliar settlement. These resilient people lived off the land, cautious yet resourceful. She was forced to fend for herself, adapting to this harsh new world at a young age. She couldn’t tell if they were like the ruthless attackers or not. The constant alertness of these settlers made her question if it was safe to trust anyone. Dressed in fine clothes and alone, she stood out among them, and they too were suspicious of her. Could it be a trap?

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
In the end, they passed food to her, and she took it, though she’d never seen anything like it.

Kindness found its roots even in the most barren of lands. Yangyang wanted to repay the trust they released before her, but her knowledge proved not helpful at all in the wild, and her sword skills proved too childish against real hostility. Everything seemed entirely unfamiliar to her, yet this was the harsh reality most people had to face. The reality felt so overwhelmingly agonizing.

“Grandma, have you... been living like this all the time?” As Yangyang tried to help an old lady sort out the meager resources they had, she couldn’t help but ask this abrupt question.

“Yes, why? City girl. You shocked? Relax. Everything will be fine.”

“But when? Will things really be fine one day?”

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
“Yes, why? City girl. You shocked? Relax. Everything will be fine.”

“But when? Will things really be fine one day?”



“Of course. How will good things come true if you don’t even believe them yourself? We were skeptical of you, too, but we chose to believe. It’s the same for you. Gotta have faith in something in life. Even if you don’t know how it’ll turn out. That’s what faith is all about.”

“When? Hm, maybe when you grow up, little one.”

So yes, perhaps Yangyang hasn’t experienced enough hardship yet. Or maybe one’s inclination to show kindness isn’t based on past experiences, but inherent in their character.

In the darkest of situations, some will show kindness simply because others chose to trust them. And this in turn will spark more acts of goodwill.

Ever since, Yangyang always spread kindness to strangers, sparked by that one encounter.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Ever since, Yangyang always spread kindness to strangers, sparked by that one encounter.



Of course, her kindness is not without boundaries. Betrayal can turn her warm breeze into a harsh storm.

But she holds onto hope, believing in the power of goodness. She chooses to trust and expects the best from others. This is her chosen way to make the world a better place.
|mention3      =

|title4        = What Wind Taught Her
|text4         = Yangyang has fallen into the winds three times.

The first time was when she fell from her mother’s arms.

Shortly after Yangyang’s birth, she was already surrounded by love. Her mother playfully swung her in her arms, pretending she was flying and landing.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
But when the swing went a little too high, Yangyang felt the whispers of wind and sensed an approaching storm, even before she could speak. As she landed, her babbling was mistaken for fear from the accident, but it was actually a reaction to the oncoming tempest.

The second time was when she passed out from sensory overload.

As she grew up, Yangyang’s once vague sensing ability strengthened, allowing her to feel intangible airstreams in her palms. She called them the “Streams” and they gave her insights into energy fluctuations, anomalies, and even the smallest physical details of a person.

Trapped in a self-destructive cycle, Yangyang yearned to explore her ability and gain more insight. But the more she tried to be thorough, the deeper she fell into a maze of details.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
What followed cannot be called a fall, for it was a descent through time, not space. The sensory overload lasted for months, between faintness and sobriety. Yangyang felt as light as a feather caught in a raging storm, perpetually falling.

“I must focus on the key details within my reach, rather than trying to capture everything...” Finally, Yangyang pulled herself out of the never-ending free fall and safely landed.

The third, but maybe not the last time, was when Yangyang leaped up and threw herself into the winds.

The continual sensory overload altered her hair and taught Yangyang to tolerate the discomfort. Despite the Streams’ excessive information, the recipient could sift through and extract crucial details. Signs of a struggle at the disappearance site, unusual fluctuations outside the city, and a steady rise in energy reactions...

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Yangyang had never used her ability in such a dire situation, but her determination to help overrode any hesitation. The Streams surged, forming a distinct line that led to a missing child, being chased by  and teetering on the edge of a cliff. Without hesitation, Yangyang leaped towards the precarious figure, outstretching her hand to save the child.

Feathers danced in the air, carrying Yangyang and the child in a gentle yet powerful wind. The child looked around at the floating feathers and asked, “Are you the lark fairy that flies in the wind, big sister?”

Lost in memories, Yangyang smiled. She thought of the times when she fell into the winds, again and again. Perhaps she truly was one with the winds.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
|mention4      =

|title5        = The Answer Lies in the Winds
|text5         = On her journey away from home, Yangyang met two kinds of people.



The first kind always seemed in such haste, yet remained unsure where they were heading, and often ended up lost and returned in regret. The other kind always had a clear destination in mind. They always made it finally, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. Yangyang held up her head and looked at Jinzhou city on the horizon, unsure if she could be considered one of the second kind of people. Once again, she thought of the term “One Instrument for Life”.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
“One Instrument for Life”. That is the most important principle in Yangyang’s family teachings. Originally, it meant that every family member could strive to excel in everything, but they must choose one musical instrument to specialize in and practice continuously throughout their life to become a master. As circumstances changed, the principle gradually evolved into dedicating one’s entire life to one pursuit, striving for excellence to make this life worthwhile.

Her mother’s Instrument was composing. Yangyang had seen people dancing to her mother’s songs. On the other hand, Yangyang’s sister was already a successful figure in the chamber of commerce.

However, Yangyang could not easily decide her own Instrument as they once did. What was the thing worthy of dedicating her life to? What person should she be?

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
She turned to her mother for help: Mother, do you want me to inherit the family business? Or, what do you want me to do? I can try anything and I will strive for excellence. Although life is full of infinite possibilities, in the end, we can only choose one path, right?

Her mother looked at her with love and said, my child, it is precisely because of this that you should not seek answers from me, but rather ask your own heart. This is a difficult question, but you need not rush an answer.
speakers: She turned to her mother for help
She turned to her mother for help

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
And so, Yangyang held onto her question, waiting patiently for an answer that seemed to elude her. She waited through her return home from the desolate settlement, through the climb out of an abyss, and through growing weary of her family’s overprotectiveness. The desire to join the world and experience its harshness grew stronger, no longer content with being a mere leaf drifting in the wind. She longed to bear the weight of reality, instead of hiding away from it.

That was when a sudden ambush in the wilderness resulted in heavy casualties from  attacks on the frontline. News of this tragedy quickly spread through the city, igniting feelings of sorrow, anger, and despair among its inhabitants. Emotions boiled over, with people gathered around a bonfire. Tears flowed freely, hoarse cries echoed through the night. But by morning, grief became a luxury as life returned to normal.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Yangyang stood among them, tears streaming down her face. She hadn’t experienced any personal loss, but witnessing their sorrow and the joy of the rescued children stirred something inside her. It was a transformative moment, as she realized her true calling: to protect others, just as she had been protected before. She wanted to shield them from misfortune and give them hope for a brighter future.

As Yangyang stood at the edge of Jinzhou on her enrollment night as an , she gazed at the sky and the bustling residents below. Doubt crept in as she questioned her ability to protect these lively citizens, a responsibility she had always dreamed of fulfilling.

The Streams came from afar and gently held Yangyang in their embrace, dispelling her last bits of doubt.

|vo_01_01_tx                 = If anything feels unfamiliar or unaccommodating, you can always ask me for help, Rover. This isn't only because you are our guest. It's just... you have no memory or any friends here in . I think there might be moments when you'd need me.

|vo_01_02_tx                 = Since I became an , I've met people from all walks of life in the wild. On the other hand, those who had a clear destination in mind usually did make it, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. |vo_01_01_tx                 = ...I thought that when I saw you again, words would come pouring out—so many that I wouldn't know where to start. But... now that you're really here, my heart is so full of joy that it pushed everything else away.

|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = A lot has happened in  while you were away. I've written to you about the long and short of it. Yet, some stories are just better told face to face, right? So, the adventures you mentioned in your letters—the , , Septimont, and —would you share them with me again?

|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = The night before I left for Xuanfang Hold, I had a nightmare... In it, I was searching for a person... someone I'd never actually met. It wasn't until I woke up that I realized that person was you. But like what you said in your letter—a dream is only a dream. Now that I can see you, touch you, and feel you... I don't think I'll ever have a dream like that again.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I know that after this reunion, the time will come for us to part again. But this time, our shared memories are the stories we lived, we didn't have to reduce them to words in letters. And, through the bittersweetness of our parting, our next meeting may be all the more worth looking forward to... Who knows? Maybe next time, I'll be the one coming to see you.

|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = My sister used to take me kite-flying all the time. She'd joke that as long as I was there, we could catch a breeze even on a windless day. But when we were competing to see whose kite flew higher, she'd watch me like a hawk to make sure I didn't cheat—not that she'd stand a chance catching me if I did.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Yangyang's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = I've crossed paths with all kinds of people on this journey. Some walked with me, some passed me by, and some... drew the line against me. With them, there was no middle ground nor room for compromises, no matter how much of ourselves we shared. I know there will be more of this kind the further down this path. But it won't stop me from moving forward. My ideals and faith have forged the blade I carry. It protects at the same time as it cuts... Should the day come when I must point it at others... my resolve was made long ago.

|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland.

|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Protection takes many forms. It can be stepping up for the defenseless, lifting someone out of hardship, or simply offering a quiet ear for someone who's hurting. But whatever the case may be, you must be strong enough to support others. That is why I must press on along my path. I don't dream of gaining the power to protect the world, but for now... I want to stand by your side. Together, I believe we can protect so much more.

He said that whether I was happy or sad, it was better to write things down than to keep them bottled up inside. He was worried that I wouldn't find someone to confide in while I was away, but fortunately, I found you.

The wind has taught and guided me. Perhaps, it's up to me to search for the final answer. And I believe it lies within the wind.

title: Yanning
content: Yanning is found at the northern entry to Hongzhen, near Gulan.

title: Yanning
content: A lonely girl, Yanning was climbing in dangerous places because her parents were always away. To keep her safe, Gulan asked Rover to borrow a self-moving suitcase as a toy. The plan worked, keeping Yanning safe. However, Gulan knew this was just a temporary solution, and that what Yanning truly needed was not a distraction, but the companionship of her parents.

title: Yanning
content:
[Objective: (1st Interaction)]
Gulan: Hey, kid. Where are your parents?
Yanning: It's dangerous there. Get down now!
Yanning: My parents are working.
Yanning: I always play here.
Yanning: Or else I'd be bored out of my mind since I don't have anyone to play with...
Gulan: Then why don't we build a snowman together? Come down first. Let's build a big one.
Yanning: Well... I guess it has been a while since I last built a snowman... Okay then.

title: Yanshu

title: Yeye
content:
Yeye: Tell you what, Mister Yuanwu's got really awesome boxing moves!
Yeye: See these muscles? I bet you wouldn't even believe it if I told you I used to get sick all the time back in the day. I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my bigger brother looking after me.
Yeye: He joined the Rangers after I got older, so I went ahead to take boxing lessons from Mister Yuanwu, and he'd offer me Trine Tea after each session. Man, boxing really gets your body going!
[Dialogue Option]  Can't say no to that.
Yeye: Hehe. I need to put in some more practice, that way one day I can be just as strong as that girl Jianxin!
Yeye: And by then, I'll be the one that's protecting my brother!

title: Yeyhe
content: Yeyhe is a researcher in Huaxu Academy in the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry.

title: Yeyhe
content:
Yeyhe: Hmm... Tacetite weapons have their limits, you know...
[Dialogue Option]  What limit?
Yeyhe: Oh, hey! I was just discussing a new weapon project with the department head.
Yeyhe: Your timing is impeccable. I have a question for you.
Yeyhe: You know what? We just had this epiphany! So, regular Tacetite weapons are like, for one person, right? They don't have much impact on a big battle?
[Dialogue Option]  That's right.
Yeyhe: But imagine this: a Tacetite weapon that needs a whole team to operate. That would pack a serious punch!
[Dialogue Option]  Can it actually move at that size?
Yeyhe: Uh... then just fix it!
[Dialogue Option]  What if you're surrounded by Tacet Discords?
Yeyhe: Uh, hold on a sec...
Yeyhe: Ugh, yeah... Still a bunch of kinks to work out...

title: Yeyhe
content:
[Objective: (In the afternoon)]
Yeyhe: Man, everytime I read Mr. Mortefi's research, I learn something new...
[Dialogue Option]  You're the researcher I've seen before.
Yeyhe: No way, you were there too?
Yeyhe: Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
Yeyhe: Seriously! Who's the genius behind these thoughtless demands on our R&D?
Yeyhe: Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
[Dialogue Option]  It seems you admire him a lot.
Yeyhe: I've always looked up to him. His genius and fearless attitude... I hope to emulate that one day.
Yeyhe: Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.

title: Yhan
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Get in teams of two and we'll do another simulation battle.
[Dialogue Option]  Perseverance is not the same as recklessness. Do you hear me?

[Dialogue Option]  First, about weapon damage-
[Dialogue Option]  Break time is over. All stand up! The training resumes. Attention!

title: Yhan
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Yhan: Hey, new guy. Care for some sparring? Necessary training will keep your mind sharp. Remember, you have no chance for mistakes out there.

title: Yhan
content:
Yhan: Hey, new guy. Care for some sparring? Necessary training will keep your mind sharp. Remember, you have no chance for mistakes out there.



Yhan: Combat isn't just about strength. You need skills and wisdom too when facing enemies on the battlefield.
[Dialogue Option]  Enter Simulation Training
Yhan: You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Yhan: Greetings.
[Dialogue Option]  What can you teach me?
Yhan: Combat skills and tactics. Or anything you're willing to learn, as long as I have it.
Yhan: Practicality is key on the battlefield. Years of combat have taught me that. If you want fancy tricks, go elsewhere.
Yhan: I'll teach you how to surive, and how to win.
[Dialogue Option]  Is surviving more important?
Yhan: Absolutely. But let me be clear, I am not condoning cowardice.
Yhan: I will give my life for Huanglong anytime, but I've also witnessed too many pointless deaths.
Yhan: I do not want to see our new recruits make the same mistakes. My purpose is to teach you how to avoid them and give you a better chance at life.
Yhan: Do not rush blindly into battle like those before you. You deserve more than that.
[Dialogue Option]  Is winning more important?
Yhan: While winning is important, the battlefield is constantly changing.
Yhan: Avoid rushing for success and making costly mistakes. Focus on improving your skills and knowing what actions to take.
Yhan: Remember, you have many years ahead of you. You should prioritize staying alive.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Yhoran
content: Yhoran is an NPC and a member of the Black Shores' Emergency Response Team. They're currently researching combat strategies against Tacet Discords.

title: Yi'an
content: Yi'an can be found leaning against a wall at the northern border of Hongzhen.

title: Yi'an
content:
Yi'an: Have you talked to Yuanzhi yet?
[Dialogue Option]  (Nod.)
Yi'an: She told you everything, I presume?
Yi'an: She wants to go to school in Jinzhou and maybe become a researcher... That's what she said.
Yi'an: Being a researcher doesn't sound that impressive to me...
Yi'an: I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great.
[Dialogue Option]  There are pros and cons in either choice.
Yi'an: Well, I'm not trying to say who's right or wrong. Everybody has their own perspective.
Yi'an: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
[Dialogue Option]  What Yuanzhi needs is your understanding.
Yi'an: We've been friends for years, so I can understand her...
Yi'an: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
[Dialogue Option]  You're just afraid of losing a friend.
Yi'an: You're probably right all along...
Yi'an: I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
Yi'an: The gap between me an her seems to grow wider and wider...
Yi'an: Regardless, I still respect her decision to become a researcher. After all, it's the path she's chosen for herself.
Yi'an: I wouldn't like it either if she were telling me how to live my life.
Yi'an: She's my friend, so the least I can do is wish her happiness.

title: Yihu
content: Yihu is a waiter at Panhua Restaurant who enjoys gossips and telling jokes in Guankou (stand-up show) style. Later, it's revealed he's an undercover intel for the Public Security Bureau.

title: Yihu
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Ready to order? We've got Chili Oil Chicken, Pulled Chicken, Poached Chicken...
[Dialogue Option]  Alright. If you need help with anything, just holler. I'm always at your service!
[Dialogue Option]  Here's your meal. Enjoy!

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Yihu: Hehe, I'll let you in on a little secret. You can overhear all kinds of things here.
Yihu: From big news to juicy gossip, just hang around long enough and you'll know everything there is to know about Jinzhou!
Yihu: Don't believe me? I myself have a whole list of stories I could share with you.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not interested.
Yihu: Oh! Alright, alright, it's not urgent. We can chat when you're interested.
[Dialogue Option]  Can you describe what happened?
Yihu: So much is happening. Look at Liuxian Teahouse, it's bustling. So many people come here to drink tea and chat.
Yihu: But I heard the teahouse is secretly owned by some big shot who just so happens to also be a great fighter, and kind of a gentleman at that.
Yihu: Alright, that's it for now. If you have any interesting stories, feel free to share. We love hearing them! I'll leave you to it.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (During the evening)]
Yihu: I tell you, nighttime is when it really gets lively. Everyone's out and about, chatting and relaxing.
Yihu: You might run into folks from all walks of life, even some big shots you wouldn't see during the day.
Yihu: If you're hoping to bump into someone, don't miss out on the nightlife here!

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (Past 2AM behind Panhua's Restaurant)]
Yihu: Huh? Wh-what are you doing here in the middle of the night...?
[Dialogue Option]  Well, you're here too.
Yihu: I-I'm here to prepare a birthday meal for a customer who's celebrating tomorrow!

title: Yihu
content: Guankou, also known as called talk strings or cross talk, refers to an oral technique used in Xiangsheng performances where two performers exchange dialog with each other in a comedic matter.

title: Yingda
content: Yingda is an NPC in Huanglong. Yingda is the Captain of Chenbi and Shuhe.

title: Yingda
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Yingda: Hello, to schedule a meeting with the Jinzhou Magistrate, please submit the necessary paperwork.
[Dialogue Option]  Someone has already completed the procedures for me.
Yingda: OK, in that case, just produce it when you are at the meeting.
[Dialogue Option]  Why have you been staring over there?
Yingda: Hmm... It's part of my duties as a City Hall guard.
Yingda: But there might be other reasons. The two guards over there, Chenbi and Shuhe. I'm their leaders.
[Dialogue Option]  Why don't you trust Chenbi?
Yingda: Since her father died in the war, she's always wanted to complete her father's unfinished business.
Yingda: That's why she signed up to be a City Hall guard. If not shining as a Midnight Ranger, she's finding other ways to make a mark.
Yingda: But you know, they're young, and already a few days on guard duty has them so stressed. I do find it concerning.
[Dialogue Option]  Why don't you trust Shuhe?
Yingda: Him? That kid's got all the strength in the world.
Yingda: It's just that sometimes, once she decides on something, she will never change her mind. She's straightforward and a bit stubborn...

title: Yingda
content:
[Objective: (During the evening)]
Yingda: City Hall is the heart of Jinzhou.
Yingda: I need to give everything I have for the event happening today.
Yingda: I hope they grow competent enough soon...

title: Yingda
content: At night around 18:00, Yingda calls over Shuhe and Chenbi from their post to talk. The two will return to their post at 21:00.

content: Yinyu is a female local NPC located in . After talking to her about her dilemma, she becomes a guide for visitors.

title: Yinyu
subsection: ( Between 06:00- 17:59 , north from the center plaza)
content:
[Objective: ( Between 06:00- 17:59 , north from the center plaza)]
Yinyu: Hongzhen was founded very early. It was thriving when Jinzhou was just an idea.
Yinyu: Back then, Hongzhen rivaled Jinzhou now.
Yinyu: That's also the reason many scholars believe Hongzhen is not only the ancestral land of the early settlers of Jinzhou, but also the predecessor of Jinzhou itself.
Yinyu: As you can see, the houses that have been preserved in town share many similarities with Jinzhou architecture.

metadata.subsection: ( Between 06:00- 17:59 , north from the center plaza)

title: Yinyu
subsection: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)
content:
[Objective: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)]
Yinyu: The stone wall before you is called the Water Shadow Screen. It is naturally formed by years of continuous erosion from the waters of Sagaci Springs.
Yinyu: What's notable is that it inspired the ancestors of Hongzhen to invent a delightful form of entertainment—the Water Shadow Play.
Yinyu: All you need to do is gather some maple leaves that are scattered throughout the mountains and cut them into various shapes. Then, by using small twigs to manipulate them, the shadows of the leaves will dance in the water, bringing fascinating stories to life.
Yinyu: And that's why brewing and sipping tea while watching a Water Shadow Play became the favorite past time for the folks of Mt. Firmament.

metadata.subsection: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)

title: Yinyu
content:
[Objective: ( Between 00:00- 05:59 , nearby Xinyi)]
Yinyu: Oh, it's you.
Yinyu: I appreciate what you did last time. I think I got a lot better since then.
Yinyu: Now everyone loves to hear my Mt. Firmament stories, and quite a few want me to be their guide.
[Dialogue Option]  Congrats.
[Dialogue Option]  You did it all on your own.
Yinyu: Well, I couldn't have done it without your suggestions and encouragement.
Yinyu: Of course, I can't be complacent. I learned much of Mt. Firmament's history from these documents.
Yinyu: The more I learn, though, the more I realize how little I knew before.

title: Yirou
content:
Yirou is one of the leaders of the restoration of Memento Square. She holds the Sentinel Jué in high regard, which is why she puts such a high value on repairing and restoring the statue. In her opinion, this project will help inspire and console the people of Jinzhou in the face of the attacks and disasters of the Tacet Discords. This idealistic perspective is at odds with Hao'bai, who believes that the main priority of the project should be repairing and defending the area.

Yirou seems oblivious to Hao'bai's feelings for her, but others in the camp have commented on their conflicting opinions.

title: Yirou
content:
Yirou: Just curious why they haven't started repairing the Sentinel statue yet...
Yirou: All the issues mentioned in the report can be solved!
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong with it all?
Yirou: The mountains and rocks are unstable... Frequent Tacet Discord Outbreaks...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm afrain it won't be resolved for a while.
[Dialogue Option]  Not a small problem indeed.
Yirou: People are living in fear, afraid that these disasters will happen again...
Yirou: A restoration of the Sentinel sculpture would surely inspire everyone.
Yirou: After all, we all grew up listening to Sentinel's stories!

title: Yngvar
content: Yngvar is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in Ode to the Second Sunrise. He is the successor for the title of "The Eye" in the Heliodic Six.

title: Yngvar
content:
Often skipping ceremonies and neglecting his duties as a Foreseer to the Heliodic Six, Yngyar's qualification to being a successor is often questioned by other Roya members.

It is later revealed he did not wish to succeed "The Eye" and become a member of the Heliodic Six, chosen only for his Resonance Ability. To escape his fate, he aligns himself with the Fractsidus to destroy the Heliogyre in exchange for a pass to New Federation.

title: Yuan Fortress
content:
Yuan Fortress was an area of Xuanfang, Huanglong, whose ruins lie under what is now Xuanfang Hold. A preserved recreation of it exists in the Xuanyuan Domain inside of the core of Xuanfang Hold, at the base of the Ren Realm.

After completing Song of the Heart Sword, it becomes accessible via a portal outside of the Sanctum. Ruoyun can be found and interacted with at a gazebo near the entrance of the fortress. The rest of Xuanyuan Domain is not accessible.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: Yuan Fortress was originally built by the Zhuojun Atelier's Jiangshui Branch over 200 years ago, under the tutelage of Muyu. It was the former operational stronghold of Xuanfang that preceded Xuanfang Hold, and was the base of the Xuanfang Wardens. It was destroyed during the Fortress and Gorges War when a coalition of Court of Savantae artisans and Xuanfang Wardens banded together to sacrifice themselves to trigger the self-destruction of its core, pushing out Ovathrax's Tacet Discord forces in the ensuing explosion.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: Xuanfang Hold, having already been in the middle of construction, was initially forced to prematurely wield its artillery systems and newly-built Autopuppet armada against the Tacet Discords by Sentinel Hsin in an attempt to safeguard the fortress and Xuanfang's people from being overwhelmed by Ovathrax. Hsin directly oversaw the regional war effort with the aid of a Xuanling Bird messenger, delivering orders to the troops on the ground to prioritize the evacuation of civilians, before being ordered to prioritize their own survival once most civilians were safely escorted out of the region.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: However, a coalition of devout Court of Savantae personnel and Xuanfang Wardens remained in Yuan Fortress to Hsin's shock, who refused her order to evacuate. Instead, they chose to take their fate into their own hands by voluntarily sacrificing themselves to detonate Yuan Fortress in order to protect Hsin, while also ensuring the survival of Xuanfang Hold by protecting its Lexicon Axis. A team of artisans and soldiers that included Ruoyun mounted a brave effort to reach the core, before detonating the entire Fortress and wiping out the surrounding hordes in a fell swoop. The coalition's sacrifice was not be in vain, as Xuanfang Hold's construction was successfully completed in the aftermath, ultimately taking the Fortress' place as the new capital stronghold of the region.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: In place of employing the traditional manpower that safeguarded the Fortress for generations, Hsin opted to replace them with Autopuppets, while installing the Censure Court system to restructure Xuanfang's local defense around a trap-and-kill system. Rather than being deterred by Xuanfang Wardens from the Yuan Fortress, Tacet Discords were lured into Censure Court traps via the use of Disorienting Fog fields, before being caught and taken to the Sunken Warren underneath Fogveil Pagoda to be destroyed.

title: Yuan Fortress
content:
Hsin later recreated an idealistic, preserved version of the Fortress inside of the Manifold Sanctum of Xuanfang Hold, within the Xuanyuan Domain. It was encountered by Rover and Qingxiao upon their arrival after being forcibly transported into the Domain while in pursuit of Muyu, who had taken over the Domain as a base of operations for his Reverberation experiments. The duo met Ruoyun there, who had been piloting an owl Autopuppet under the alias of Jadie to mask her identity.

title: Yuanwu
Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Yuanwu is a martial artist known for his mastery of Leihuangquan, a swift and powerful style named after lightning and thunder. His lightning-fast fists strike with streaks of blue energy, leaving his opponents reeling from the full force of their destructive power.

As a teenager, Yuanwu sought absolute power and relied on raw force to defeat his enemies. This obsession led to his downfall, as he fell into a trap laid by his rival and was exiled from his home.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
During his years of wandering, Yuanwu reflected on his past mistakes and honed his martial arts skills. With his expanding knowledge and improved techniques, he gradually grasped the essence of Leihuangquan — the art of balance between strength and adaptability. A martial artist's path of vengeance is destined to begin and end on the fighting ground. As fate would have it, his sworn enemy crossed paths with him once again in the arena, where their conflict would come to its ultimate climax.

As lightning flashed, Yuanwu's fist broke through his opponent's gauntlet, revealing the illegal add-on hidden within. This moment marked Yuanwu's mastery of Leihuangquan, and exposed the years of lies and slander that had been concealed for ages.

The tale of Yuanwu's vengeance drew to a close, but his story as a boxing gym owner was only beginning.

"Welcome to Yuanwu’s Boxing Gym."

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
The tale of Yuanwu's vengeance drew to a close, but his story as a boxing gym owner was only beginning.

"Welcome to Yuanwu’s Boxing Gym."



Yuanwu, now an amiable middle-aged proprietor, can always be found at the entrance of his boxing gym, greeting visitors with a warm smile daily.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Gone are the days when the young Yuanwu fought his way with brute force. He has matured into a composed and confident middle-aged gentleman.

Yuanwu dons a dark-colored coat paired with a white top hat that perfectly aligns with his composed, modest, and courteous demeanor. The tailored waistcoat underneath highlights his robust physique, reflecting his years of martial arts training. The addition of navy blue in his attire further elevates the impression of thunder and lightning.

Though known to those around him as a kind gentleman, Yuanwu sheds his usual composed demeanor when faced with combat. He swiftly unleashes precise and fierce strikes, overwhelming his opponents. Yuanwu does not like to engage in physical altercations, but once forced into it, he throws himself fully into the fight, aiming for a quick and resounding victory.

File:Yuanwu Design.png

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
In Yuanwu's boxing gym, every visitor can receive dedicated coaching from the owner himself.

Whether the person wants to exercise, pursue a career in boxing, or simply soak up the energizing ambiance of the gym, Yuanwu is always ready to suggest tailored training plans based on their unique physical abilities and health needs.

At the end of every training session, Yuanwu always graciously serves his clients with a cup of Trine Tea.  He takes great care in preparing each cup himself. The steaming hot tea effectively soothes the sore muscles and fatigue from the intense workout. Yuanwu's boxing gym is a unique place where clients can engage in a spirited boxing match and then relax with a pot of tea, basking in comfort and contentment.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Yuanwu is a regular consumer of Bittberry Tea from the renowned Liuxian Teahouse. This secret blend is known for its intense bitterness and exorbitant price, making it a luxury only a select few can afford. Rumor has it that Yuanwu is the only one who can down a cup without flinching.

Yuanwu always carries a flask with him during his daily activities. Some say it contains his secret potion for staying fit, but in reality, it's usually just ordinary hot water.

File:Yuanwu jug.png

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content: When in combat, Yuanwu maintains his elegant composure. His mastery of lightning manipulation amplifies his team's capabilities and shines through in his impressive combat skills. When the situation turns dire, Yuanwu can take charge as the team's primary damage dealer, unleashing powerful fists of twisting thunder to crush any enemy in their path.

title: Yuanzhi
content:
Yuanzhi: Excuse me, but did you just get back from the mountain? Did you see Xunwei and Lili?
Yuanzhi: They are both researchers from Huaxu Academy, wearing uniforms, and are about my age.
[Dialogue Option]  Yes.
Yuanzhi: I see, so they did go into the mountain for research.
[Dialogue Option]  Nope.
Yuanzhi: It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe, but I can't recall for sure.
Yuanzhi: It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
Yuanzhi: I'd really like to see Xunwai and Lili's work routine. I think I can learn a lot even just by watching them work.
[Dialogue Option]  But you're from Hongzhen, so how did you know them?
Yuanzhi: There was a blizzard a few days ago. They and Wei took shelter in my house. We chatted and got to know each other.
Yuanzhi: From then on, they come to see me whenever they're free and share all kinds of interesting things.
Yuanzhi: Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves.
Yuanzhi: I never thought I could see the world through such a perspective. Things I thought couldn't be any more ordinary turned out to be so interesting and... valuable.
Yuanzhi: Maybe I'm daydreaming here, but I thought perhaps I could become a Huaxu researcher, too, like Xunwei, and Wei
Yuanzhi: At least I'm working toward that goal.
[Dialogue Option]  Being a researcher takes a lot of effort.
Yuanzhi: Lili told me that, too, but I'm determined.
Yuanzhi: I think there are very few things in this world that are easy... If they all take an effort anyway, might as well do what you like.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a nice aspiration, but how do you plan to achieve it?
[Dialogue Option]  Nice aspiration. Good luck.
Yuanzhi: I plan to head to Jinzhou to study.
Yuanzhi: I must take my first step. More doing, less talking. That's what I learned from Xunwei.
Yuanzhi: But before I do that, I want to say goodbye to Yi'an.
Yuanzhi: Yi'an is my best friend. We grew up together. I don't want him to be troubled by my decision.

content: ' is a former Roya Outcast found at a former Outcast's camp in Etching Plains Resonance Beacon. He granted forgiveness by the Solsworn, but opted to remain at the camp to help reform other Outcasts.

title: Zakarias
content:
Peder: Professor Zakarias, you were once accepted by the Solsworn, and they even invited you to return to Bjartr Woods.
Peder: Why come back?
Zakarias: I believe the question you really meant to ask is why I came back, Peder? Or... how was I accepted by the Solsworn in the first place?
Peder: I-I admit, what I really wanted to know is what I should do to justify my return to Bjartr Woods.
Peder: This is no means my act of weakness, nor do I expect my past mistakes to just be wiped away. It's just that... this path of atonement, with seemingly no end in sight, scares me.
Zakarias: Hmm... Once, there was a Roya who committed a crime so unspeakable that if I tried to put it into words alone, it would probably chill you to the bone.
Zakarias: The Solsworn, in a rare act of punishment, cast judgment upon him, drove him out of Bjartr Woods, and left the sinner to roam the wilderness.
Zakarias: Though he should have been utterly alone, he suddenly found himself bathing in the warmth of the Reactor's glow, the river soothing his parched throat, and the fruit filling his empty belly.
Zakarias: Realizing that even bearing such sin, he was still sheltered by Lahai-Roi and the Exostriders, he broke down in tears.
Zakarias: From then on, he walked the lands of Lahai-Roi. For every ounce of malice in his past, he would repay it with an equal share of kindness. Whether to every blade of grass and every tree, to outsiders, to the Roya, or even to the Exoswarm.
Zakarias: At last, one day, when his hair had turned completely white and he was leading a lost mech reindeer back to Bjartr Woods, a Soliskin appeared and took his hand.
Peder: A Soliskin... I've only ever seen them when I was a child. Only those with a pure heart can see them...
Peder: I understand now, Professor Zakarias. I know what I need to do. But I still wish to know... Why have you not returned to Bjartr Woods?
Zakarias: Heh, because there are still plenty of lost people like you out there.

title: Zani
Zani
content: A Zani (more commonly spelled Zanni) was a character performed during Italian comedy, typically appearing as an immigrant working as a servant. Typically, a Zani was a shrewd, successful trickster.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani has a fascinating duality of character: a fastidiously well-ordered and extremely competent professional during the day, and a powerful, nearly elemental, force for justice at night. Her public image is one of steadfast devotion to routine and order, a quality she nurtures through her decades-long association with the Montelli family's Averardo Bank. She is a disciplined professional in the way she goes about her job, and her penchant for an ordered existence extends even to her personal habits and tastes, including her desire for comfort foods at the end of a long day. Despite her obvious professionalism, she often expresses a dry, matter-of-fact weariness with her work, viewing it as a part of her existence that is inevitable, if not always welcome, and looking at inefficiency or busywork with a practical disdain. Her secret history as the "Blazing Nightwalker" tells of a deep-seated sense of justice beyond the law.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani dismantled a reigning criminal syndicate one-handed in this covert identity, becoming a vigilante when the established channels were useless. Her motives are not narcissistic or fueled by the desire to be famous; indeed, she finds her heroic moniker "ridiculous" and actively avoids the limelight, understanding that fame gets in the way of her job. This is a pragmatic choice, as it allows her to pursue justice without targeting herself. But this past has had a lasting effect.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani carries a subtle exhaustion that she tends to express as insomnia, a testament to the heavy toll of what she has endured. She is not very forthcoming about much, but she is quite candid about the fact that this vigorous vigilante work "changed her", causing a "lost spark" and a crushing exhaustion. Despite this personal cost, her internal drive to protect the innocent and bring order is steadfast. Her mental strength is amazing, channeling her stress into positive, albeit unconventional, outlets. Joining the Montelli family was a tactical decision, offering structure and resources to help her continue her mission of bringing order and tidying up the residual chaos of her own activities. Zani is defined by her powers of observation, analytical nature, and quick wit in her interactions.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Her dry sarcasm and understated humor are favorite devices that she uses both as a defense and to communicate her special point of view. Zani is fiercely loyal to those she trusts and to the Montellis, always putting their interests first. This loyalty is balanced, however, by a strong moral compass; she doesn't shy away from navigating dangerous political waters or taking on corruption when it gets in the way of justice. Her ability to read situations quickly, connect seemingly unrelated clues, and act swiftly wins her a worthwhile ally. Not overtly emotional, Zani possesses a strong, if unassuming, sense of compassion.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: She keeps a small, cherished doll, a gift from one of the children she rescued, as a quiet, personal reminder of the worth of her work and the true motivation for her to carry on her fight. Zani has a protective instinct for others, particularly those near and dear to her, and is constantly advising them to rest and not fall into the trap of doing too much, drawing on her own experience. She values integrity and open-mindedness in others, even in members of the opposing factions, and is not averse to forming alliances when there are common goals to be pursued. Zani's journey is one of grappling with the tension between her natural preference for order and her strong, almost primal, need for immediate action.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani dreams of a peaceful, secure Ragunna where every individual can find his or her niche, a dream inextricably tied to her sense of belonging to her hometown. The introduction of new issues, and particularly her meetings with the Rover, seem to bring a new sense of direction and a "burst of color" into her otherwise highly regulated life. She recognizes the Rover's unique capacity for positive change, even going so far as to admit that their presence might render her own vigilante function "increasingly irrelevant" - a development she welcomes, as it brings her one step closer to the quiet, peaceful life she secretly desires. Her fondest wish, after all, is for a world peaceful enough that she can finally "sleep through the night", undisturbed by the constant fight for justice. She is a testament to unlimited potential, understated resilience, and an unwavering, if often concealed, dedication to a greater, more orderly world.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani is a tall woman with pale skin, white hair, and dark red eyes with slitted pupils. She has a distinct beauty mark under her right eye, as well as dark eyebags. Due to her awakening, she now has black, ram-like horns and a slim tail with a pointed tip.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani wears a high collared white button-up shirt with cuffed sleeves that reach past her elbows and has golden buttons. She wears a bright red tie atop her shirt, along with a black leather harness that goes above her chest and hooks over her right shoulder, clasped with a circular golden buckle. Beneath her shirt collar is a frilled collar as well as a black choker that matches her harness, the pouch on her right bicep contains a radio, and she wears a black arm band around her left bicep bearing the Montelli family sigil. She wears a black jacket with a white fabric underlayer and frilled sleeves, attached to her shoulders by a harness. The lower half of her outfit consists of tight black high-waist pants with golden zippers on each leg ending mid-way down her thighs.

title: Zani/Backstory
content:
Among her other accessories are a golden pair of key-shaped earrings with green gems, as well as black half-palm leather gloves. She wears red socks and a pair of strapless black high heels with red soles.

When using her Forte, Zani's outfit changes, mostly the upper half. Her shirt becomes ripped, with the sleeves ending before her shoulders and a low-cut V-shaped collar that dips halfway down her chest. The back of her shirt is completely torn, with the cut going all the way down and showing her Tacet Mark located on her back. She loosely wraps her tie around her right arm and wears two thin black bands on both her biceps. Her black choker stays but is adorned with golden horizontal stripes that match her horns and the golden scars on her body. The lower half of her outfit stays the same as it does in her regular form. The vents on her horns also glow a bright yellow.

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content:
As trade routes opened up in every direction, flavors from across Huanglong's one capital and six cities gradually converged



To improve people's livelihoods and boost their local economies, cities throughout Huanglong have partnered with Lollo Logistics to build transport networks while working with local commerce guilds to open new trade routes.
Among these guilds, one of the most renowned is the Zhaoming Commerce Guild of Mengzhou.
Its Chairwoman, Suisui, is celebrated for her discerning eye. Wherever she travels, whatever she acquires tends to spark a trend.
Even in Jinzhou, the youngest of the six cities, the bustling Panhua's Restaurant and the well-stocked Mahe's Grocery both have ties to the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content: Word has it that when Panhua's Restaurant first rolled out its Spicy Pulled Chicken, the dish was such a hit it caused a local chili shortage in Jinzhou. When Suisui heard about it through her regular letters with her younger sister, she sent guild staff to Jinzhou to look into the matter. happened, Jinzhou City Hall was also seeking to expand its commercial partnerships. As it With the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's help, chili peppers from as far away as Chongzhou soon found their way to Jinzhou, becoming a fixture on local dinner tables. This initiative also solved a headache for Chongzhou's farmers, who'd had a bumper chili harvest and nowhere to sell it.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content:
Beyond fresh produce, the Zhaoming Commerce Guild also excels at sourcing regional specialty goods and getting them exactly where they're needed. Blue-and-white porcelain, fine bolts of silk, intricately crafted mechanical dolls, bamboo-woven baskets... As the Guild's Chairwoman, Sulsul's eye for quality is sharp enough that whatever catches it tends to become the hottest item in town.

With the guild's support and Lollo Logistics' delivery network, goods from every comer of Huanglong flow more freely now, like a gentle stream reaching farther and farther, soft rain quietly rescuing farmers and artisans who'd been struggling to find buyers, easing worries that were all too real. And so people across every city can now find goods from a thousand miles away right on their own doorstep, and taste specialty dishes from lands far from home.

title: Zhenjian
content: Zhenjian is a male Black Shore NPC found at the TD Observatory, The Black Shores.

title: Zhenjian
content:
Zhenjian The corrupted data at the Anchor has been cleared, and the backlog of anomaly data is finally running smoothly again.
[Dialogue Option]  Anomaly data?
Zhenjian Yes, it's a collection of data on Reverberations, Tacet Discords, and other anomalies caused by the Lament.
[Dialogue Option]  What can we do with it?
Zhenjian For example, with Tethys' computing power, we can build evolutionary models of the Tacet Discords to predict how they might develop in the future.
Zhenjian We can also input Reverberations gathered from the Lament zone into Tethys to recreate those areas in the Sand Table.
Zhenjian But from what we've observed so far, the Sand Table has its limits.
Zhenjian The more ancient the Lament, the more diluted the Reverberations are, which makes it harder to replicate the affected areas accurately.
Zhenjian Still, I believe this is just the beginning of what Tethys can do. There's much more potential to tap.

title: Zhezhi/Backstory
content: Zhezhi is a relatively tall young woman with a slim build, pink eyes with turquoise highlights and long dark brown hair with a dark grey gradient and pink tips partially pulled back into small twin tails with long white black tipped bows. Her tacet mark is located down the length of her right wrist.

title: Zhezhi/Backstory
content: Zhezhi wears a short turquoise dress with long black extensions/coattails that artistically fades into white with some pink and gold layering and writing at the front that splits around the center and both legs revealing a white bodysuit with brown and pink floral patterns and two holsters in which she hold various art supplies. She wears bright red strapped turquoise pauldrons with an extension that flows down to her knees in a pink artistic pattern.

title: Zhihuai
content:
;Lumy: Aww, what a lovely little kitty! Look how comfortable it is around people.

;Stig: Is it true cat's toe beans taste like chocolate...?

title: Zhihuai
content:
[Objective: Interact with the cat]
Cat: Meow, meow... meow.
The cat elegantly licks its paw and shows you its soft, furry belly.
[Dialogue Option]  Pet its belly.
The cat is startled at first, but succumbs to your superior cat-petting technique and quickly starts purring again.
Zhihuai: Wow, most people who go straight for the belly usually get the teeth. No wonder you're famous around the Academy. You're quite the cat-petting pro.
[Dialogue Option]  Pet its head.
The cat accepts your petting, its warm head nuzzling and rubbing against your palm.
Zhihuai: Isn't Malma a sweetie?
[Dialogue Option]  Play with it with the toy over there.
The cat is delighted and immediately starts playing with you.
Zhihuai: It's Malma's favorite toy. I always bring it along with her wherever I go.
Zhihuai: Malma is very smart and has a good temper. I was worried that traveling across the ocean with me might stress her out at first, but turns out she's not scared at all.
Lumy: I've been following the club's socials! They sometimes post Malma's daily routine, and just a single glance is enough to heal me from a long day of work.
Lumy: I heard the club is planning to have Malma do a meet & greet with fans during the Celebration, so I got here as fast as I could!
Stig: I wasn't a big cat-person before… and I wasn't very good at taking care of one either.
Stig: Fortunately, Malma takes good care of herself. Aside from the usual hide-and-seek, she's trouble-free. Before meeting her, I thought all cats were home destroyers…
Zhihuai: Playfulness is part of a cat's nature. There's no need to worry, Stig.
Zhihuai: We plan to have her come out and meet everyone more often, even after the Celebration. Oh, it's a call from our leader. Mind looking after Malma for a little while, Stig?
Zhihuai:M-Me? Okay.
Zhihuai: Aw, here I was hoping to chat with you, Rover. Guess I'll see you next time.
[Dialogue Option]  See you.
With that, Zhihuai hurries away.

title: Zhihuai
content:

[Dialogue Option]  Use the Translation Module to interpret the language.

title: Zhihuai
subsection: Zhihuai: Malma! Please don't get llost in this big and bustling Celebration!
content:
[Objective: Zhihuai: Malma! Please don't get llost in this big and bustling Celebration!]
Zhihuai: Rover! Sigh, I said I hoped to have a proper chat with you, but not under these circumstances.
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Zhihuai: Malma's gone missing.
[Dialogue Option]  Malma's missing?
Zhihuai: Yep, that's the situation we're in…
Stig: It's all my fault for not keeping an eye on Malma.
Zhihuai: It wasn't your fault. Here's the thing, Rover. Malma likes being around people, but she also likes to pick on Stig.
Zhihuai: I'm guessing she's playing hide-and-seek with Stig, but she's been gone for so long, and I'm getting worried something might've happened to her…
Lumy: Sob... There're so many people in the venue. Do you think someone might've catnapped her?
Lumy: She's so adorable... How can someone beat me to it!
Stig: ?
Zhihuai: This isn't the time for jokes, Lumy...
Zhihuai: I still need to cover the booth. Could you help us look for Malma? There will be a reward if you find her!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave it to me.
[Dialogue Option]  Finding cats is my specialty.
Zhihuai: That's great! Malma is a chatty cat and never holds back on her meows.
Zhihuai: Just look anywhere you hear cat noises, and you'll find Malma eventually!
Zhihuai: Malma loves to meow, so follow the cat noises, and your chances of finding her are pretty good.
Zhihuai: I'm counting on you, Rover!

title: Zhixiu
content:
Zhixiu: There are some docs Mr. Xiangli put together for us, sort of like... extra homework? A little gift from our resident genius.
Zhixiu: He's always making breakthroughs so quickly, we struggle to keep up.
Zhixiu: But we have to keep up. If you can't even try to keep pace, why bother being an academic?

title: Zhixiu
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Zhixiu: Hi, Rover! Remember me?
[Dialogue Option]  You're a researcher from Huaxu Academy...
Zhixiu: Yes, that's me. I'm glad you still remember.
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry, I don't recall.
Zhixiu: Oh don't worry, I'll introduce myself again. I'm Zhixiu, a researcher at Huaxu Academy. We met before, remember?
Zhixiu: Long story short, interested in trying out "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"?
Zhixiu: In this game, participants race as Gulpuffs.
Zhixiu: Jinzhou's Echo technology might not be as popular as Rinascita's, but I think it has great potential.
Zhixiu: Entertainment is key here. Plus, it's good for collecting research data.
Zhixiu: Besides this swimming challenge, I've got some other events lined up. Hope you enjoy them, Rover.

title: Zhiyu
content: Zhiyu is a Midnight Ranger with the ability to sense incoming rainfall. Though he once believed his Forte was useless, serving on an exploratory team has given him increased confidence.

title: Zhiyu
content:
Zhiyu: Did you know water can speak?
[Dialogue Option]  Sure, like "Splish, splash" or "Drip, drop"?
Zhiyu: Haha, very funny. No, I mean...
Zhiyu: It's more like... the raindrops in the clouds are talking to me, telling me when they're coming and how long they'll stay.
[Dialogue Option]  You're saying the rain talks to you?
Zhiyu: Nah, I can only hear regular rain. When it's that Retroact stuff? Nothing.
[Dialogue Option]  Retroact Rain?
Zhiyu: Technically, Retroact Rain isn't even real rain. It's more like... Remnant Energy.
Zhiyu: Remnant Energy replays old events. When the rain flows up, you get these mirages of the past showing up in it.
Zhiyu: If you can't tell what's real and what's not, those mirages can mess with your head. I guess everyone's got someone they can't let go of...
Zhiyu: So if you run into Retroact Rain, stay sharp. Don't let your emotions get the better of you.
Zhiyu: I can't hear the Retroact Rain, only the ordinary kind... Do you think my Resonance Ability is weak?
[Dialogue Option]  Makes sense.
Zhiyu: You won't hurt my feelings if you tell me that this kind of Resonance Ability... is kind of useless.
Zhiyu: I used to feel insecure about it, but since I started working on the Exploration Canal, my skills have been super helpful.
Zhiyu: I realized that there is no such thing as a strong or weak ability, it's how you use it that matters.

title: Zhonglin
content:
Zhonglin:  Yes, it's nice to have someone to chat with. This is relaxing for me.
Zhonglin:  To be honest, I still feel a lingering fear whenever I think about the Temporal Disruption in Mt. Firmament. Even though it's in the past now, I'm still tense as a tightrope.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is that?
Zhonglin:  It's just that I'm worried I won't be able to manage everything or that the supplies in my shop might run short.
Zhonglin:  Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with the Magistrate and Lady Xinyi holding down the fort.
Zhonglin:  That's why I've seen a lot of patients lately. Some have injuries that could cause complications later if not treated correctly.
[Dialogue Option]  Your hard work is appreciated.
Zhonglin:  I can't deny it's hard work, but it's also my duty as a healer to treat patients. I chose to do it, so no complaints.
Zhonglin:  Sigh, I just hope everyone will get well soon.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Zhuojun Atelier  is a politically influential enclave of mechanist artisans based out of Mengzhou. They are a notoriously clandestine organization of engineers, craftspeople, tinkerers, and inventors of automata mechanics with dubious morals. Led by the enigmatic Flowerveil Puppet, who holds the rank of Grand Helm, it has several different branches, each overseen by Helmsmasters.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Consistently described by several such as Balanophora and Suisui as being shifty and calculating, they are infamous for their questionable morals and unknown goals in their technocratic pursuit of automata arts, such as the construction of Bladepuppets, and a multitude of various synthetic puppet models that are found throughout Mengzhou. The Atelier has given rise to infamous Huanglong criminals such as Muyu and the Séance Society's Dollmaker.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
The historical origins of Zhuojun Atelier are unknown. It is known that they have existed as far back as 200 years ago, and been an influential player in the Mengzhou political sphere during the early days of the Fortress and Gorges War. Zhuojun Atelier was one of two factions of mechanists based in Mengzhou, with the other being the Mengzhou branch of the Court of Savantae.

Two centuries ago, Muyu led the Jianshui Branch in overseeing the construction of Yuan Fortress, with the Fortress designed to be a stronghold for the region prior to its eventual destruction and replacement.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
In response to the threat of Ovathrax, Hsin, the Moon Fox summoned the two factions to Mengzhou City Hall in order to deliberate between which faction would be best suited to construct Xuanfang Hold. The Zhuojun Atelier delegation confidently asserted that they were the better fit for the task, due to their knowledge of the local terrain, peoples, and greater experience with larger-scale feats of engineering in comparison to the Court of Savantae.

However, Hsin, having preemptively decided the Court to be the better fit due to their willingness to sacrifice themselves in pursuit of knowledge. In a move that shocked the Atelier's delegation, she publicly chose the Court despite the Atelier's local expertise to oversee the project, causing the Atelier's delegation to leave in bitter spite from being cut out of the construction.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
Muyu, then-Helmsmaster of the Atelier's Jiangshui Branch, later participated in the Fortress and Gorges war and contributed his Artisan skills to the war effort. Reeling from Yuan Fortress' catastrophic self-destruction as a sacrifice by the Court of Savantae and the Xuanfang Wardens to regain a regional advantage against the Tacet Discord threat, he was overwhelmed by the countless horrors of war and strife he witnessed and snapped, experiencing a Resonator awakening in the midst of his insanity.

During an incident orchestrated by Muyu 10-15 years ago, he hijacked a troupe of Bladepuppets, reprogramming them to go on a killing spree that took the lives of several in Mengzhou, including Jingran's parents, who were employed as Artisans by the Atelier.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Over 20 years ago, Muyu was chosen as the Flowerveil Puppet's successor to inherit the position of Grand Helm. However, as Muyu grew increasingly inclined towards misanthrophy and hyper-rationalism, he eventually left Zhuojun Atelier, and begin plotting a centuries-long plot against Sentinel Hsin, leading to him working with Balanophora to enact the Autopuppet Crisis against Xuanfang Hold and its Sanctum, before being defeated by Rover, Qingxiao, and Jingran- who had sought revenge for Muyu's killing of his parents years ago and feigned aiding him to get close- in his attempt to become a self-proclaimed Celestial in the form of the Calamity Effigy and pilfer the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule for the Sentinel's knowledge.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: In the aftermath of his defeat and death, Muyu's accomplices in the Atelier who aided in his insurrection began being exposed. This included a group intercepted outside of Xuanfang by Suoming and Yinlin, who were rounded up and reported to the Grand Helm by the duo.

title: Zhuyi

Zhuyi is an NPC in .

He recently joined the Pioneer Association, and serves as an intern photographer. He idolizes the Icebreakers and wishes to become one.

==Dialogue==

title: Zhuyi
content:
He recently joined the Pioneer Association, and serves as an intern photographer. He idolizes the Icebreakers and wishes to become one.

==Dialogue==



Zhuyi: Do you know the adventure stories of the Icebreakers? They are legends in the history of the Pioneer Association, my idols!
Zhuyi: On the polar regions, up the volcanoes, deep in the great rifts, and across the wetlands... their footprints are spread across every corner of the world. This is what adventurers should be like.
Zhuyi: As written on the front page of "Tidal Geography": Go see the world and witness history in the making.
Zhuyi: Go see the masterpieces of humanity, paintings, architecture, and inventions, and find joy in the journey.
Zhuyi: The seniors always tell me to wait a little longer. I guess it's because I don't have the resonance ability that they never took me on the expeditions.
Zhuyi: But there are members of the Icebreakers that discovered their Resonance in times of crisis. Perhaps it's the same for me.
Zhuyi: You'll never know if you never try.

title: Ziegler
content: Ziegler is a male NPC who appears in City Square, Ragunna at night.

title: Ziegler
content:
Ziegler: Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
Tar: ...What are you on about now?
Ziegler: I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
Ziegler: Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
Ziegler: I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
Ziegler: So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
Tar: I think...
Ziegler: It's great?
Tar: No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
Ziegler: You think I'm joking, don't you?
Tar: Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
Tar: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
Ziegler: Not really.
Tar: If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
Ziegler: But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
Tar: You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!

title: Zip Zap
content: .  Zip Zap is a type of ironclad electromagnetic Murmurin TD that attracts metal to form a protective shell around itself.
